name: Shalya Parva

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
evaM nipAtite karNe samare savyasAchinA |
alpAvashiShTAH kuravaH kimakurvata vai dvija
shlokas.2:
udIryamANaM cha balaM dRRiShTvA rAjA suyodhanaH |
pANDavaiH prAptakAlaM cha kiM prApadyata kauravaH
shlokas.3:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM tadAchakShva dvijottama |
na hi tRRipyAmi pUrveShAM shRRiNvAnashcharitaM mahat
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH karNe hate rAjandhArtarAShTraH suyodhanaH |
bhRRishaM shokArNave magno nirAshaH sarvato.abhavat
shlokas.5:
hA karNa hA karNa iti shochamAnaH punaH punaH |
kRRichChrAtsvashibiraM prAyAddhatasheShairnRRipaiH saha
shlokas.6:
sa samAshvAsyamAno.api hetubhiH shAstranishchitaiH |
rAjabhirnAlabhachCharma sUtaputravadhaM smaran
shlokas.7:
sa daivaM balavanmatvA bhavitavyaM cha pArthivaH |
sa~NgrAme nishchayaM kRRitvA punaryuddhAya niryayau
shlokas.8:
shalyaM senApatiM kRRitvA vidhivadrAjapu~NgavaH |
raNAya niryayau rAjA hatasheShairnRRipaiH saha
shlokas.9:
tataH sutumulaM yuddhaM kurupANDavasenayoH |
babhUva bharatashreShTha devAsuraraNopamam
shlokas.10:
tataH shalyo mahArAja kRRitvA kadanamAhave |
pANDusainyasya madhyAhne dharmarAjena pAtitaH
shlokas.11:
tato duryodhano rAjA hatabandhU raNAjirAt |
apasRRitya hradaM ghoraM vivesha ripujAdbhayAt
shlokas.12:
athAparAhNe tasyAhnaH parivArya mahArathaiH |
hradAdAhUya yogena bhImasenena pAtitaH
shlokas.13:
tasminhate maheShvAse hatashiShTAstrayo rathAH |
sa.nrabhAnnishi rAjendra jaghnuH pA~nchAlasainikAn
shlokas.14:
tataH pUrvAhNasamaye shibirAdetya sa~njayaH |
pravivesha purIM dIno duHkhashokasamanvitaH
shlokas.15:
pravishya cha puraM tUrNaM bhujAvuchChritya duHkhitaH |
vepamAnastato rAj~naH pravivesha niveshanam
shlokas.16:
ruroda cha naravyAghra hA rAjanniti duHkhitaH |
aho bata vivignAH sma nidhanena mahAtmanaH
shlokas.17:
aho subalavAnkAlo gatishcha paramA tathA |
shakratulyabalAH sarve yatrAvadhyanta pArthivAH
shlokas.18:
dRRiShTvaiva cha puro rAja~njanaH sarvaH sa sa~njayam |
praruroda bhRRishodvigno hA rAjanniti sasvaram
shlokas.19:
AkumAraM naravyAghra tatpuraM vai samantataH |
ArtanAdaM mahachchakre shrutvA vinihataM nRRipam
shlokas.20:
dhAvatashchApyapashyachcha tatra trInpuruSharShabhAn |
naShTachittAnivonmattA~nshokena bhRRishapIDitAn
shlokas.21:
tathA sa vihvalaH sUtaH pravishya nRRipatikShayam |
dadarsha nRRipatishreShThaM praj~nAchakShuShamIshvaram
shlokas.22:
dRRiShTvA chAsInamanaghaM samantAtparivAritam |
snuShAbhirbharatashreShTha gAndhAryA vidureNa cha
shlokas.23:
tathAnyaishcha suhRRidbhishcha j~nAtibhishcha hitaiShibhiH |
tameva chArthaM dhyAyantaM karNasya nidhanaM prati
shlokas.24:
rudannevAbravIdvAkyaM rAjAnaM janamejaya |
nAtihRRiShTamanAH sUto bAShpasa.ndigdhayA girA
shlokas.25:
sa~njayo.ahaM naravyAghra namaste bharatarShabha |
madrAdhipo hataH shalyaH shakuniH saubalastathA
ulUkaH puruShavyAghra kaitavyo dRRiDhavikramaH
shlokas.26:
sa.nshaptakA hatAH sarve kAmbojAshcha shakaiH saha |
mlechChAshcha pArvatIyAshcha yavanAshcha nipAtitAH
shlokas.27:
prAchyA hatA mahArAja dAkShiNAtyAshcha sarvashaH |
udIchyA nihatAH sarve pratIchyAshcha narAdhipa
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha sarvato nihatA nRRipa
shlokas.28:
duryodhano hato rAjanyathoktaM pANDavena cha |
bhagnasaktho mahArAja shete pA.nsuShu rUShitaH
shlokas.29:
dhRRiShTadyumno hato rAja~nshikhaNDI chAparAjitaH |
uttamaujA yudhAmanyustathA rAjanprabhadrakAH
shlokas.30:
pA~nchAlAshcha naravyAghrAshchedayashcha niShUditAH |
tava putrA hatAH sarve draupadeyAshcha bhArata
karNaputro hataH shUro vRRiShaseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.31:
narA vinihatAH sarve gajAshcha vinipAtitAH |
rathinashcha naravyAghra hayAshcha nihatA yudhi
shlokas.32:
ki~nchichCheShaM cha shibiraM tAvakAnAM kRRitaM vibho |
pANDavAnAM cha shUrANAM samAsAdya parasparam
shlokas.33:
prAyaH strIsheShamabhavajjagatkAlena mohitam |
sapta pANDavataH sheShA dhArtarAShTrAstathA trayaH
shlokas.34:
te chaiva bhrAtaraH pa~ncha vAsudevo.atha sAtyakiH |
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha drauNishcha jayatAM varaH
shlokas.35:
tavApyete mahArAja rathino nRRipasattama |
akShauhiNInAM sarvAsAM sametAnAM janeshvara
ete sheShA mahArAja sarve.anye nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.36:
kAlena nihataM sarvaM jagadvai bharatarShabha |
duryodhanaM vai purataH kRRitvA vairasya bhArata
shlokas.37:
etachChrutvA vachaH krUraM dhRRitarAShTro janeshvaraH |
nipapAta mahArAja gatasattvo mahItale
shlokas.38:
tasminnipatite bhUmau viduro.api mahAyashAH |
nipapAta mahArAja rAjavyasanakarshitaH
shlokas.39:
gAndhArI cha nRRipashreShTha sarvAshcha kuruyoShitaH |
patitAH sahasA bhUmau shrutvA krUraM vachashcha tAH
shlokas.40:
niHsa~nj~naM patitaM bhUmau tadAsIdrAjamaNDalam |
pralApayuktA mahatI kathA nyastA paTe yathA
shlokas.41:
kRRichChreNa tu tato rAjA dhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH |
shanairalabhata prANAnputravyasanakarshitaH
shlokas.42:
labdhvA tu sa nRRipaH sa~nj~nAM vepamAnaH suduHkhitaH |
udIkShya cha dishaH sarvAH kShattAraM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.43:
vidvankShattarmahAprAj~na tvaM gatirbharatarShabha |
mamAnAthasya subhRRishaM putrairhInasya sarvashaH
evamuktvA tato bhUyo visa~nj~no nipapAta ha
shlokas.44:
taM tathA patitaM dRRiShTvA bAndhavA ye.asya kechana |
shItaistu siShichustoyairvivyajurvyajanairapi
shlokas.45:
sa tu dIrgheNa kAlena pratyAshvasto mahIpatiH |
tUShNIM dadhyau mahIpAlaH putravyasanakarshitaH
niHshvasa~njihmaga iva kumbhakShipto vishAM pate
shlokas.46:
sa~njayo.apyarudattatra dRRiShTvA rAjAnamAturam |
tathA sarvAH striyashchaiva gAndhArI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.47:
tato dIrgheNa kAlena viduraM vAkyamabravIt |
dhRRitarAShTro naravyAghro muhyamAno muhurmuhuH
shlokas.48:
gachChantu yoShitaH sarvA gAndhArI cha yashasvinI |
tatheme suhRRidaH sarve bhrashyate me mano bhRRisham
shlokas.49:
evamuktastataH kShattA tAH striyo bharatarShabha |
visarjayAmAsa shanairvepamAnaH punaH punaH
shlokas.50:
nishchakramustataH sarvAstAH striyo bharatarShabha |
suhRRidashcha tataH sarve dRRiShTvA rAjAnamAturam
shlokas.51:
tato narapatiM tatra labdhasa~nj~naM parantapa |
avekShya sa~njayo dIno rodamAnaM bhRRishAturam
shlokas.52:
prA~njalirniHshvasantaM cha taM narendraM muhurmuhuH |
samAshvAsayata kShattA vachasA madhureNa ha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
visRRiShTAsvatha nArIShu dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
vilalApa mahArAja duHkhAdduHkhataraM gataH
shlokas.2:
sadhUmamiva niHshvasya karau dhunvanpunaH punaH |
vichintya cha mahArAja tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.3:
aho bata mahadduHkhaM yadahaM pANDavAnraNe |
kShemiNashchAvyayA.nshchaiva tvattaH sUta shRRiNomi vai
shlokas.4:
vajrasAramayaM nUnaM hRRidayaM sudRRiDhaM mama |
yachChrutvA nihatAnputrAndIryate na sahasradhA
shlokas.5:
chintayitvA vachasteShAM bAlakrIDAM cha sa~njaya |
adya shrutvA hatAnputrAnbhRRishaM me dIryate manaH
shlokas.6:
andhatvAdyadi teShAM tu na me rUpanidarshanam |
putrasnehakRRitA prItirnityameteShu dhAritA
shlokas.7:
bAlabhAvamatikrAntAnyauvanasthA.nshcha tAnaham |
madhyaprAptA.nstathA shrutvA hRRiShTa AsaM tathAnagha
shlokas.8:
tAnadya nihatA~nshrutvA hRRitaishvaryAnhRRitaujasaH |
na labhe vai kvachichChAntiM putrAdhibhirabhiplutaH
shlokas.9:
ehyehi putra rAjendra mamAnAthasya sAmpratam |
tvayA hIno mahAbAho kAM nu yAsyAmyahaM gatim
shlokas.10:
gatirbhUtvA mahArAja j~nAtInAM suhRRidAM tathA |
andhaM vRRiddhaM cha mAM vIra vihAya kva nu gachChasi
shlokas.11:
sA kRRipA sA cha te prItiH sA cha rAjansumAnitA |
kathaM vinihataH pArthaiH sa.nyugeShvaparAjitaH
shlokas.12:
kathaM tvaM pRRithivIpAlAnbhuktvA tAta samAgatAn |
sheShe vinihato bhUmau prAkRRitaH kunRRipo yathA
shlokas.13:
ko nu mAmutthitaM kAlye tAta tAteti vakShyati |
mahArAjeti satataM lokanAtheti chAsakRRit
shlokas.14:
pariShvajya cha mAM kaNThe snehenAklinnalochanaH |
anushAdhIti kauravya tatsAdhu vada me vachaH
shlokas.15:
nanu nAmAhamashrauShaM vachanaM tava putraka |
bhUyasI mama pRRithvIyaM yathA pArthasya no tathA
shlokas.16:
bhagadattaH kRRipaH shalya Avantyo.atha jayadrathaH |
bhUrishravAH somadatto mahArAjo.atha bAhlikaH
shlokas.17:
ashvatthAmA cha bhojashcha mAgadhashcha mahAbalaH |
bRRihadbalashcha kAshIshaH shakunishchApi saubalaH
shlokas.18:
mlechChAshcha bahusAhasrAH shakAshcha yavanaiH saha |
sudakShiNashcha kAmbojastrigartAdhipatistathA
shlokas.19:
bhIShmaH pitAmahashchaiva bhAradvAjo.atha gautamaH |
shrutAyushchAchyutAyushcha shatAyushchApi vIryavAn
shlokas.20:
jalasandho.athArshyashRRi~NgI rAkShasashchApyalAyudhaH |
alambuso mahAbAhuH subAhushcha mahArathaH
shlokas.21:
ete chAnye cha bahavo rAjAno rAjasattama |
madarthamudyatAH sarve prANA.nstyaktvA raNe prabho
shlokas.22:
yeShAM madhye sthito yuddhe bhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH |
yodhayiShyAmyahaM pArthAnpA~nchAlA.nshchaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.23:
chedI.nshcha nRRipashArdUla draupadeyA.nshcha sa.nyuge |
sAtyakiM kuntibhojaM cha rAkShasaM cha ghaTotkacham
shlokas.24:
eko.apyeShAM mahArAja samarthaH saMnivAraNe |
samare pANDaveyAnAM sa~Nkruddho hyabhidhAvatAm
kiM punaH sahitA vIrAH kRRitavairAshcha pANDavaiH
shlokas.25:
atha vA sarva evaite pANDavasyAnuyAyibhiH |
yotsyanti saha rAjendra haniShyanti cha tAnmRRidhe
shlokas.26:
karNastveko mayA sArdhaM nihaniShyati pANDavAn |
tato nRRipatayo vIrAH sthAsyanti mama shAsane
shlokas.27:
yashcha teShAM praNetA vai vAsudevo mahAbalaH |
na sa saMnahyate rAjanniti mAmabravIdvachaH
shlokas.28:
tasyAhaM vadataH sUta bahusho mama saMnidhau |
yuktito hyanupashyAmi nihatAnpANDavAnmRRidhe
shlokas.29:
teShAM madhye sthitA yatra hanyante mama putrakAH |
vyAyachChamAnAH samare kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.30:
bhIShmashcha nihato yatra lokanAthaH pratApavAn |
shikhaNDinaM samAsAdya mRRigendra iva jambukam
shlokas.31:
droNashcha brAhmaNo yatra sarvashastrAstrapAragaH |
nihataH pANDavaiH sa~Nkhye kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.32:
bhUrishravA hato yatra somadattashcha sa.nyuge |
bAhlIkashcha mahArAja kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.33:
sudakShiNo hato yatra jalasandhashcha kauravaH |
shrutAyushchAchyutAyushcha kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.34:
bRRihadbalo hato yatra mAgadhashcha mahAbalaH |
Avantyo nihato yatra trigartashcha janAdhipaH
sa.nshaptakAshcha bahavaH kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.35:
alambusastathA rAjanrAkShasashchApyalAyudhaH |
ArshyashRRi~Ngashcha nihataH kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.36:
nArAyaNA hatA yatra gopAlA yuddhadurmadAH |
mlechChAshcha bahusAhasrAH kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.37:
shakuniH saubalo yatra kaitavyashcha mahAbalaH |
nihataH sabalo vIraH kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.38:
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha shUrAH parighabAhavaH |
nihatA bahavo yatra kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.39:
nAnAdeshasamAvRRittAH kShatriyA yatra sa~njaya |
nihatAH samare sarve kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.40:
putrAshcha me vinihatAH pautrAshchaiva mahAbalAH |
vayasyA bhrAtarashchaiva kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.41:
bhAgadheyasamAyukto dhruvamutpadyate naraH |
yashcha bhAgyasamAyuktaH sa shubhaM prApnuyAnnaraH
shlokas.42:
ahaM viyuktaH svairbhAgyaiH putraishchaiveha sa~njaya |
kathamadya bhaviShyAmi vRRiddhaH shatruvashaM gataH
shlokas.43:
nAnyadatra paraM manye vanavAsAdRRite prabho |
so.ahaM vanaM gamiShyAmi nirbandhurj~nAtisa~NkShaye
shlokas.44:
na hi me.anyadbhavechChreyo vanAbhyupagamAdRRite |
imAmavasthAM prAptasya lUnapakShasya sa~njaya
shlokas.45:
duryodhano hato yatra shalyashcha nihato yudhi |
duHshAsano vishastashcha vikarNashcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.46:
kathaM hi bhImasenasya shroShye.ahaM shabdamuttamam |
ekena samare yena hataM putrashataM mama
shlokas.47:
asakRRidvadatastasya duryodhanavadhena cha |
duHkhashokAbhisantapto na shroShye paruShA giraH
shlokas.48:
evaM sa shokasantaptaH pArthivo hatabAndhavaH |
muhurmuhurmuhyamAnaH putrAdhibhirabhiplutaH
shlokas.49:
vilapya suchiraM kAlaM dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
dIrghamuShNaM cha niHshvasya chintayitvA parAbhavam
shlokas.50:
duHkhena mahatA rAjA santapto bharatarShabha |
punargAvalgaNiM sUtaM paryapRRichChadyathAtatham
shlokas.51:
bhIShmadroNau hatau shrutvA sUtaputraM cha pAtitam |
senApatiM praNetAraM kimakurvata mAmakAH
shlokas.52:
yaM yaM senApraNetAraM yudhi kurvanti mAmakAH |
achireNaiva kAlena taM taM nighnanti pANDavAH
shlokas.53:
raNamUrdhni hato bhIShmaH pashyatAM vaH kirITinA |
evameva hato droNaH sarveShAmeva pashyatAm
shlokas.54:
evameva hataH karNaH sUtaputraH pratApavAn |
sa rAjakAnAM sarveShAM pashyatAM vaH kirITinA
shlokas.55:
pUrvamevAhamukto vai vidureNa mahAtmanA |
duryodhanAparAdhena prajeyaM vinashiShyati
shlokas.56:
kechinna samyakpashyanti mUDhAH samyaktathApare |
tadidaM mama mUDhasya tathAbhUtaM vachaH sma ha
shlokas.57:
yadabravInme dharmAtmA viduro dIrghadarshivAn |
tattathA samanuprAptaM vachanaM satyavAdinaH
shlokas.58:
daivopahatachittena yanmayApakRRitaM purA |
anayasya phalaM tasya brUhi gAvalgaNe punaH
shlokas.59:
ko vA mukhamanIkAnAmAsItkarNe nipAtite |
arjunaM vAsudevaM cha ko vA pratyudyayau rathI
shlokas.60:
ke.arakShandakShiNaM chakraM madrarAjasya sa.nyuge |
vAmaM cha yoddhukAmasya ke vA vIrasya pRRiShThataH
shlokas.61:
kathaM cha vaH sametAnAM madrarAjo mahAbalaH |
nihataH pANDavaiH sa~Nkhye putro vA mama sa~njaya
shlokas.62:
brUhi sarvaM yathAtattvaM bharatAnAM mahAkShayam |
yathA cha nihataH sa~Nkhye putro duryodhano mama
shlokas.63:
pA~nchAlAshcha yathA sarve nihatAH sapadAnugAH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha draupadyAH pa~ncha chAtmajAH
shlokas.64:
pANDavAshcha yathA muktAstathobhau sAtvatau yudhi |
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha bhAradvAjasya chAtmajaH
shlokas.65:
yadyathA yAdRRishaM chaiva yuddhaM vRRittaM cha sAmpratam |
akhilaM shrotumichChAmi kushalo hyasi sa~njaya

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannavahito yathA vRRitto mahAnkShayaH |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha samAsAdya parasparam
shlokas.2:
nihate sUtaputre tu pANDavena mahAtmanA |
vidruteShu cha sainyeShu samAnIteShu chAsakRRit
shlokas.3:
vimukhe tava putre tu shokopahatachetasi |
bhRRishodvigneShu sainyeShu dRRiShTvA pArthasya vikramam
shlokas.4:
dhyAyamAneShu sainyeShu duHkhaM prApteShu bhArata |
balAnAM mathyamAnAnAM shrutvA ninadamuttamam
shlokas.5:
abhij~nAnaM narendrANAM vikRRitaM prekShya sa.nyuge |
patitAnrathanIDA.nshcha rathA.nshchApi mahAtmanAm
shlokas.6:
raNe vinihatAnnAgAndRRiShTvA pattI.nshcha mAriSha |
AyodhanaM chAtighoraM rudrasyAkrIDasaMnibham
shlokas.7:
aprakhyAtiM gatAnAM tu rAj~nAM shatasahasrashaH |
kRRipAviShTaH kRRipo rAjanvayaHshIlasamanvitaH
shlokas.8:
abravIttatra tejasvI so.abhisRRitya janAdhipam |
duryodhanaM manyuvashAdvachanaM vachanakShamaH
shlokas.9:
duryodhana nibodhedaM yattvA vakShyAmi kaurava |
shrutvA kuru mahArAja yadi te rochate.anagha
shlokas.10:
na yuddhadharmAchChreyAnvai panthA rAjendra vidyate |
yaM samAshritya yudhyante kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabha
shlokas.11:
putro bhrAtA pitA chaiva svasreyo mAtulastathA |
sambandhibAndhavAshchaiva yodhyA vai kShatrajIvinA
shlokas.12:
vadhe chaiva paro dharmastathAdharmaH palAyane |
te sma ghorAM samApannA jIvikAM jIvitArthinaH
shlokas.13:
tatra tvAM prativakShyAmi ki~nchideva hitaM vachaH |
hate bhIShme cha droNe cha karNe chaiva mahArathe
shlokas.14:
jayadrathe cha nihate tava bhrAtRRiShu chAnagha |
lakShmaNe tava putre cha kiM sheShaM paryupAsmahe
shlokas.15:
yeShu bhAraM samAsajya rAjye matimakurmahi |
te santyajya tanUryAtAH shUrA brahmavidAM gatim
shlokas.16:
vayaM tviha vinAbhUtA guNavadbhirmahArathaiH |
kRRipaNaM vartayiShyAma pAtayitvA nRRipAnbahUn
shlokas.17:
sarvairapi cha jIvadbhirbIbhatsuraparAjitaH |
kRRiShNanetro mahAbAhurdevairapi durAsadaH
shlokas.18:
indrakArmukavajrAbhamindraketumivochChritam |
vAnaraM ketumAsAdya sa~nchachAla mahAchamUH
shlokas.19:
siMhanAdena bhImasya pA~nchajanyasvanena cha |
gANDIvasya cha nirghoShAtsaMhRRiShyanti manA.nsi naH
shlokas.20:
charantIva mahAvidyunmuShNanti nayanaprabhAm |
alAtamiva chAviddhaM gANDIvaM samadRRishyata
shlokas.21:
jAmbUnadavichitraM cha dhUyamAnaM mahaddhanuH |
dRRishyate dikShu sarvAsu vidyudabhraghaneShviva
shlokas.22:
uhyamAnashcha kRRiShNena vAyuneva balAhakaH |
tAvakaM tadbalaM rAjannarjuno.astravidAM varaH
gahanaM shishire kakShaM dadAhAgnirivotthitaH
shlokas.23:
gAhamAnamanIkAni mahendrasadRRishaprabham |
dhana~njayamapashyAma chaturdantamiva dvipam
shlokas.24:
vikShobhayantaM senAM te trAsayantaM cha pArthivAn |
dhana~njayamapashyAma nalinImiva ku~njaram
shlokas.25:
trAsayantaM tathA yodhAndhanurghoSheNa pANDavam |
bhUya enamapashyAma siMhaM mRRigagaNA iva
shlokas.26:
sarvalokamaheShvAsau vRRiShabhau sarvadhanvinAm |
Amuktakavachau kRRiShNau lokamadhye virejatuH
shlokas.27:
adya saptadashAhAni vartamAnasya bhArata |
sa~NgrAmasyAtighorasya vadhyatAM chAbhito yudhi
shlokas.28:
vAyuneva vidhUtAni tavAnIkAni sarvashaH |
sharadambhodajAlAni vyashIryanta samantataH
shlokas.29:
tAM nAvamiva paryastAM bhrAntavAtAM mahArNave |
tava senAM mahArAja savyasAchI vyakampayat
shlokas.30:
kva nu te sUtaputro.abhUtkva nu droNaH sahAnugaH |
ahaM kva cha kva chAtmA te hArdikyashcha tathA kva nu
duHshAsanashcha bhrAtA te bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH kva nu
shlokas.31:
bANagocharasamprAptaM prekShya chaiva jayadratham |
sambandhinaste bhrAtR^I.nshcha sahAyAnmAtulA.nstathA
shlokas.32:
sarvAnvikramya miShato lokA.nshchAkramya mUrdhani |
jayadratho hato rAjankiM nu sheShamupAsmahe
shlokas.33:
ko veha sa pumAnasti yo vijeShyati pANDavam |
tasya chAstrANi divyAni vividhAni mahAtmanaH
gANDIvasya cha nirghoSho vIryANi harate hi naH
shlokas.34:
naShTachandrA yathA rAtriH seneyaM hatanAyakA |
nAgabhagnadrumA shuShkA nadIvAkulatAM gatA
shlokas.35:
dhvajinyAM hatanetrAyAM yatheShTaM shvetavAhanaH |
chariShyati mahAbAhuH kakShe.agniriva sa~njvalan
shlokas.36:
sAtyakeshchaiva yo vego bhImasenasya chobhayoH |
dArayeta girInsarvA~nshoShayeta cha sAgarAn
shlokas.37:
uvAcha vAkyaM yadbhImaH sabhAmadhye vishAM pate |
kRRitaM tatsakalaM tena bhUyashchaiva kariShyati
shlokas.38:
pramukhasthe tadA karNe balaM pANDavarakShitam |
durAsadaM tathA guptaM gUDhaM gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.39:
yuShmAbhistAni chIrNAni yAnyasAdhUni sAdhuShu |
akAraNakRRitAnyeva teShAM vaH phalamAgatam
shlokas.40:
Atmano.arthe tvayA loko yatnataH sarva AhRRitaH |
sa te sa.nshayitastAta AtmA cha bharatarShabha
shlokas.41:
rakSha duryodhanAtmAnamAtmA sarvasya bhAjanam |
bhinne hi bhAjane tAta disho gachChati tadgatam
shlokas.42:
hIyamAnena vai sandhiH paryeShTavyaH samena cha |
vigraho vardhamAnena nItireShA bRRihaspateH
shlokas.43:
te vayaM pANDuputrebhyo hInAH svabalashaktitaH |
atra te pANDavaiH sArdhaM sandhiM manye kShamaM prabho
shlokas.44:
na jAnIte hi yaH shreyaH shreyasashchAvamanyate |
sa kShipraM bhrashyate rAjyAnna cha shreyo.anuvindati
shlokas.45:
praNipatya hi rAjAnaM rAjyaM yadi labhemahi |
shreyaH syAnna tu mauDhyena rAjangantuM parAbhavam
shlokas.46:
vaichitravIryavachanAtkRRipAshIlo yudhiShThiraH |
viniyu~njIta rAjye tvAM govindavachanena cha
shlokas.47:
yadbrUyAddhi hRRiShIkesho rAjAnamaparAjitam |
arjunaM bhImasenaM cha sarvaM kuryurasa.nshayam
shlokas.48:
nAtikramiShyate kRRiShNo vachanaM kauravasya ha |
dhRRitarAShTrasya manye.ahaM nApi kRRiShNasya pANDavaH
shlokas.49:
etatkShamamahaM manye tava pArthairavigraham |
na tvA bravImi kArpaNyAnna prANaparirakShaNAt
pathyaM rAjanbravImi tvAM tatparAsuH smariShyasi
shlokas.50:
iti vRRiddho vilapyaitatkRRipaH shAradvato vachaH |
dIrghamuShNaM cha niHshvasya shushocha cha mumoha cha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktastato rAjA gautamena yashasvinA |
niHshvasya dIrghamuShNaM cha tUShNImAsIdvishAM pate
shlokas.2:
tato muhUrtaM sa dhyAtvA dhArtarAShTro mahAmanAH |
kRRipaM shAradvataM vAkyamityuvAcha parantapaH
shlokas.3:
yatki~nchitsuhRRidA vAchyaM tatsarvaM shrAvito hyaham |
kRRitaM cha bhavatA sarvaM prANAnsantyajya yudhyatA
shlokas.4:
gAhamAnamanIkAni yudhyamAnaM mahArathaiH |
pANDavairatitejobhirlokastvAmanudRRiShTavAn
shlokas.5:
suhRRidA yadidaM vAchyaM bhavatA shrAvito hyaham |
na mAM prINAti tatsarvaM mumUrShoriva bheShajam
shlokas.6:
hetukAraNasa.nyuktaM hitaM vachanamuttamam |
uchyamAnaM mahAbAho na me viprAgrya rochate
shlokas.7:
rAjyAdvinikRRito.asmAbhiH kathaM so.asmAsu vishvaset |
akShadyUte cha nRRipatirjito.asmAbhirmahAdhanaH
sa kathaM mama vAkyAni shraddadhyAdbhUya eva tu
shlokas.8:
tathA dautyena samprAptaH kRRiShNaH pArthahite rataH |
pralabdhashcha hRRiShIkeshastachcha karma virodhitam
sa cha me vachanaM brahmankathamevAbhima.nsyate
shlokas.9:
vilalApa hi yatkRRiShNA sabhAmadhye sameyuShI |
na tanmarShayate kRRiShNo na rAjyaharaNaM tathA
shlokas.10:
ekaprANAvubhau kRRiShNAvanyonyaM prati saMhatau |
purA yachChrutamevAsIdadya pashyAmi tatprabho
shlokas.11:
svasrIyaM cha hataM shrutvA duHkhaM svapiti keshavaH |
kRRitAgaso vayaM tasya sa madarthaM kathaM kShamet
shlokas.12:
abhimanyorvinAshena na sharma labhate.arjunaH |
sa kathaM maddhite yatnaM prakariShyati yAchitaH
shlokas.13:
madhyamaH pANDavastIkShNo bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
pratij~nAtaM cha tenograM sa bhajyeta na saMnamet
shlokas.14:
ubhau tau baddhanistri.nshAvubhau chAbaddhaka~NkaTau |
kRRitavairAvubhau vIrau yamAvapi yamopamau
shlokas.15:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha kRRitavairau mayA saha |
tau kathaM maddhite yatnaM prakuryAtAM dvijottama
shlokas.16:
duHshAsanena yatkRRiShNA ekavastrA rajasvalA |
parikliShTA sabhAmadhye sarvalokasya pashyataH
shlokas.17:
tathA vivasanAM dInAM smarantyadyApi pANDavAH |
na nivArayituM shakyAH sa~NgrAmAtte parantapAH
shlokas.18:
yadA cha draupadI kRRiShNA madvinAshAya duHkhitA |
ugraM tepe tapaH kRRiShNA bhartR^INAmarthasiddhaye
sthaNDile nityadA shete yAvadvairasya yAtanA
shlokas.19:
nikShipya mAnaM darpaM cha vAsudevasahodarA |
kRRiShNAyAH preShyavadbhUtvA shushrUShAM kurute sadA
shlokas.20:
iti sarvaM samunnaddhaM na nirvAti katha~nchana |
abhimanyorvinAshena sa sandheyaH kathaM mayA
shlokas.21:
kathaM cha nAma bhuktvemAM pRRithivIM sAgarAmbarAm |
pANDavAnAM prasAdena bhu~njIyAM rAjyamalpakam
shlokas.22:
uparyupari rAj~nAM vai jvalito bhAskaro yathA |
yudhiShThiraM kathaM pashchAdanuyAsyAmi dAsavat
shlokas.23:
kathaM bhuktvA svayaM bhogAndattvA dAyA.nshcha puShkalAn |
kRRipaNaM vartayiShyAmi kRRipaNaiH saha jIvikAm
shlokas.24:
nAbhyasUyAmi te vAkyamuktaM snigdhaM hitaM tvayA |
na tu sandhimahaM manye prAptakAlaM katha~nchana
shlokas.25:
sunItamanupashyAmi suyuddhena parantapa |
nAyaM klIbayituM kAlaH sa.nyoddhuM kAla eva naH
shlokas.26:
iShTaM me bahubhiryaj~nairdattA vipreShu dakShiNAH |
prAptAH kramashrutA vedAH shatrUNAM mUrdhni cha sthitam
shlokas.27:
bhRRityA me subhRRitAstAta dInashchAbhyuddhRRito janaH |
yAtAni pararAShTrANi svarAShTramanupAlitam
shlokas.28:
bhuktAshcha vividhA bhogAstrivargaH sevito mayA |
pitR^INAM gatamAnRRiNyaM kShatradharmasya chobhayoH
shlokas.29:
na dhruvaM sukhamastIha kuto rAjyaM kuto yashaH |
iha kIrtirvidhAtavyA sA cha yuddhena nAnyathA
shlokas.30:
gRRihe yatkShatriyasyApi nidhanaM tadvigarhitam |
adharmaH sumahAneSha yachChayyAmaraNaM gRRihe
shlokas.31:
araNye yo vimu~ncheta sa~NgrAme vA tanuM naraH |
kratUnAhRRitya mahato mahimAnaM sa gachChati
shlokas.32:
kRRipaNaM vilapannArto jarayAbhipariplutaH |
mriyate rudatAM madhye j~nAtInAM na sa pUruShaH
shlokas.33:
tyaktvA tu vividhAnbhogAnprAptAnAM paramAM gatim |
apIdAnIM suyuddhena gachCheyaM satsalokatAm
shlokas.34:
shUrANAmAryavRRittAnAM sa~NgrAmeShvanivartinAm |
dhImatAM satyasandhAnAM sarveShAM kratuyAjinAm
shlokas.35:
shastrAvabhRRithamAptAnAM dhruvaM vAsastriviShTape |
mudA nUnaM prapashyanti shubhrA hyapsarasAM gaNAH
shlokas.36:
pashyanti nUnaM pitaraH pUjitA~nshakrasa.nsadi |
apsarobhiH parivRRitAnmodamAnA.nstriviShTape
shlokas.37:
panthAnamamarairyAtaM shUraishchaivAnivartibhiH |
api taiH sa~NgataM mArgaM vayamapyAruhemahi
shlokas.38:
pitAmahena vRRiddhena tathAchAryeNa dhImatA |
jayadrathena karNena tathA duHshAsanena cha
shlokas.39:
ghaTamAnA madarthe.asminhatAH shUrA janAdhipAH |
sherate lohitAktA~NgAH pRRithivyAM sharavikShatAH
shlokas.40:
uttamAstravidaH shUrA yathoktakratuyAjinaH |
tyaktvA prANAnyathAnyAyamindrasadmasu dhiShThitAH
shlokas.41:
taistvayaM rachitaH panthA durgamo hi punarbhavet |
sampatadbhirmahAvegairito yAdbhishcha sadgatim
shlokas.42:
ye madarthe hatAH shUrAsteShAM kRRitamanusmaran |
RRiNaM tatpratimu~nchAno na rAjye mana Adadhe
shlokas.43:
pAtayitvA vayasyA.nshcha bhrAtR^Inatha pitAmahAn |
jIvitaM yadi rakSheyaM loko mAM garhayeddhruvam
shlokas.44:
kIdRRishaM cha bhavedrAjyaM mama hInasya bandhubhiH |
sakhibhishcha suhRRidbhishcha praNipatya cha pANDavam
shlokas.45:
so.ahametAdRRishaM kRRitvA jagato.asya parAbhavam |
suyuddhena tataH svargaM prApsyAmi na tadanyathA
shlokas.46:
evaM duryodhanenoktaM sarve sampUjya tadvachaH |
sAdhu sAdhviti rAjAnaM kShatriyAH sambabhAShire
shlokas.47:
parAjayamashochantaH kRRitachittAshcha vikrame |
sarve sunishchitA yoddhumudagramanaso.abhavan
shlokas.48:
tato vAhAnsamAshvAsya sarve yuddhAbhinandinaH |
Une dviyojane gatvA pratyatiShThanta kauravAH
shlokas.49:
AkAshe vidrume puNye prasthe himavataH shubhe |
aruNAM sarasvatIM prApya papuH sasnushcha tajjalam
shlokas.50:
tava putrAH kRRitotsAhAH paryavartanta te tataH |
paryavasthApya chAtmAnamanyonyena punastadA
sarve rAjannyavartanta kShatriyAH kAlachoditAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
atha haimavate prasthe sthitvA yuddhAbhinandinaH |
sarva eva mahArAja yodhAstatra samAgatAH
shlokas.2:
shalyashcha chitrasenashcha shakunishcha mahArathaH |
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH
shlokas.3:
suSheNo.ariShTasenashcha dhRRitasenashcha vIryavAn |
jayatsenashcha rAjAnaste rAtrimuShitAstataH
shlokas.4:
raNe karNe hate vIre trAsitA jitakAshibhiH |
nAlabha~nsharma te putrA himavantamRRite girim
shlokas.5:
te.abruvansahitAstatra rAjAnaM sainyasaMnidhau |
kRRitayatnA raNe rAjansampUjya vidhivattadA
shlokas.6:
kRRitvA senApraNetAraM parA.nstvaM yoddhumarhasi |
yenAbhiguptAH sa~NgrAme jayemAsuhRRido vayam
shlokas.7:
tato duryodhanaH sthitvA rathe rathavarottamam |
sarvayuddhavibhAgaj~namantakapratimaM yudhi
shlokas.8:
sva~NgaM prachChannashirasaM kambugrIvaM priya.nvadam |
vyAkoshapadmAbhimukhaM vyAghrAsyaM merugauravam
shlokas.9:
sthANorvRRiShasya sadRRishaM skandhanetragatisvaraiH |
puShTashliShTAyatabhujaM suvistIrNaghanorasam
shlokas.10:
jave bale cha sadRRishamaruNAnujavAtayoH |
Adityasya tviShA tulyaM buddhyA choshanasA samam
shlokas.11:
kAntirUpamukhaishvaryaistribhishchandramasopamam |
kA~nchanopalasa~NghAtaiH sadRRishaM shliShTasandhikam
shlokas.12:
suvRRittorukaTIja~NghaM supAdaM sva~NgulInakham |
smRRitvA smRRitvaiva cha guNAndhAtrA yatnAdvinirmitam
shlokas.13:
sarvalakShaNasampannaM nipuNaM shrutisAgaram |
jetAraM tarasArINAmajeyaM shatrubhirbalAt
shlokas.14:
dashA~NgaM yashchatuShpAdamiShvastraM veda tattvataH |
sA~NgA.nshcha chaturo vedAnsamyagAkhyAnapa~nchamAn
shlokas.15:
ArAdhya tryambakaM yatnAdvratairugrairmahAtapAH |
ayonijAyAmutpanno droNenAyonijena yaH
shlokas.16:
tamapratimakarmANaM rUpeNAsadRRishaM bhuvi |
pAragaM sarvavidyAnAM guNArNavamaninditam
tamabhyetyAtmajastubhyamashvatthAmAnamabravIt
shlokas.17:
yaM puraskRRitya sahitA yudhi jeShyAma pANDavAn |
guruputro.adya sarveShAmasmAkaM paramA gatiH
bhavA.nstasmAnniyogAtte ko.astu senApatirmama
shlokas.18:
drauNiruvAcha||
ayaM kulena vIryeNa tejasA yashasA shriyA |
sarvairguNaiH samuditaH shalyo no.astu chamUpatiH
shlokas.19:
bhAgineyAnnijA.nstyaktvA kRRitaj~no.asmAnupAgataH |
mahAseno mahAbAhurmahAsena ivAparaH
shlokas.20:
enaM senApatiM kRRitvA nRRipatiM nRRipasattama |
shakyaH prAptuM jayo.asmAbhirdevaiH skandamivAjitam
shlokas.21:
tathokte droNaputreNa sarva eva narAdhipAH |
parivArya sthitAH shalyaM jayashabdA.nshcha chakrire
yuddhAya cha matiM chakrUrAveshaM cha paraM yayuH
shlokas.22:
tato duryodhanaH shalyaM bhUmau sthitvA rathe sthitam |
uvAcha prA~njalirbhUtvA rAmabhIShmasamaM raNe
shlokas.23:
ayaM sa kAlaH samprApto mitrANAM mitravatsala |
yatra mitramamitraM vA parIkShante budhA janAH
shlokas.24:
sa bhavAnastu naH shUraH praNetA vAhinImukhe |
raNaM cha yAte bhavati pANDavA mandachetasaH
bhaviShyanti sahAmAtyAH pA~nchAlAshcha nirudyamAH
shlokas.25:
shalya uvAcha||
yattu mAM manyase rAjankururAja karomi tat |
tvatpriyArthaM hi me sarvaM prANA rAjyaM dhanAni cha
shlokas.26:
duryodhana uvAcha||
senApatyena varaye tvAmahaM mAtulAtulam |
so.asmAnpAhi yudhAM shreShTha skando devAnivAhave
shlokas.27:
abhiShichyasva rAjendra devAnAmiva pAvakiH |
jahi shatrUnraNe vIra mahendro dAnavAniva

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vacho rAj~no madrarAjaH pratApavAn |
duryodhanaM tadA rAjanvAkyametaduvAcha ha
shlokas.2:
duryodhana mahAbAho shRRiNu vAkyavidAM vara |
yAvetau manyase kRRiShNau rathasthau rathinAM varau
na me tulyAvubhAvetau bAhuvIrye katha~nchana
shlokas.3:
udyatAM pRRithivIM sarvAM sasurAsuramAnavAm |
yodhayeyaM raNamukhe sa~NkruddhaH kimu pANDavAn
vijeShye cha raNe pArthAnsomakA.nshcha samAgatAn
shlokas.4:
ahaM senApraNetA te bhaviShyAmi na sa.nshayaH |
taM cha vyUhaM vidhAsyAmi na tariShyanti yaM pare
iti satyaM bravImyeSha duryodhana na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.5:
evamuktastato rAjA madrAdhipatima~njasA |
abhyaShi~nchata senAyA madhye bharatasattama
vidhinA shAstradRRiShTena hRRiShTarUpo vishAM pate
shlokas.6:
abhiShikte tatastasminsiMhanAdo mahAnabhUt |
tava sainyeShvavAdyanta vAditrANi cha bhArata
shlokas.7:
hRRiShTAshchAsa.nstadA yodhA madrakAshcha mahArathAH |
tuShTuvushchaiva rAjAnaM shalyamAhavashobhinam
shlokas.8:
jaya rAja.nshchiraM jIva jahi shatrUnsamAgatAn |
tava bAhubalaM prApya dhArtarAShTrA mahAbalAH
nikhilAM pRRithivIM sarvAM prashAsantu hatadviShaH
shlokas.9:
tvaM hi shakto raNe jetuM sasurAsuramAnavAn |
martyadharmANa iha tu kimu somakasRRi~njayAn
shlokas.10:
evaM sa.nstUyamAnastu madrANAmadhipo balI |
harShaM prApa tadA vIro durApamakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.11:
shalya uvAcha||
adyaivAhaM raNe sarvAnpA~nchAlAnsaha pANDavaiH |
nihaniShyAmi rAjendra svargaM yAsyAmi vA hataH
shlokas.12:
adya pashyantu mAM lokA vicharantamabhItavat |
adya pANDusutAH sarve vAsudevaH sasAtyakiH
shlokas.13:
pA~nchAlAshchedayashchaiva draupadeyAshcha sarvashaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha sarve chApi prabhadrakAH
shlokas.14:
vikramaM mama pashyantu dhanuShashcha mahadbalam |
lAghavaM chAstravIryaM cha bhujayoshcha balaM yudhi
shlokas.15:
adya pashyantu me pArthAH siddhAshcha saha chAraNaiH |
yAdRRishaM me balaM bAhvoH sampadastreShu yA cha me
shlokas.16:
adya me vikramaM dRRiShTvA pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
pratIkAraparA bhUtvA cheShTantAM vividhAH kriyAH
shlokas.17:
adya sainyAni pANDUnAM drAvayiShye samantataH |
droNabhIShmAvati vibho sUtaputraM cha sa.nyuge
vichariShye raNe yudhyanpriyArthaM tava kaurava
shlokas.18:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
abhiShikte tadA shalye tava sainyeShu mAnada |
na karNavyasanaM ki~nchinmenire tatra bhArata
shlokas.19:
hRRiShTAH sumanasashchaiva babhUvustatra sainikAH |
menire nihatAnpArthAnmadrarAjavashaM gatAn
shlokas.20:
praharShaM prApya senA tu tAvakI bharatarShabha |
tAM rAtriM sukhinI suptA svasthachitteva sAbhavat
shlokas.21:
sainyasya tava taM shabdaM shrutvA rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
vArShNeyamabravIdvAkyaM sarvakShatrasya shRRiNvataH
shlokas.22:
madrarAjaH kRRitaH shalyo dhArtarAShTreNa mAdhava |
senApatirmaheShvAsaH sarvasainyeShu pUjitaH
shlokas.23:
etachChrutvA yathAbhUtaM kuru mAdhava yatkShamam |
bhavAnnetA cha goptA cha vidhatsva yadanantaram
shlokas.24:
tamabravInmahArAja vAsudevo janAdhipam |
ArtAyanimahaM jAne yathAtattvena bhArata
shlokas.25:
vIryavA.nshcha mahAtejA mahAtmA cha visheShataH |
kRRitI cha chitrayodhI cha sa.nyukto lAghavena cha
shlokas.26:
yAdRRigbhIShmastathA droNo yAdRRikkarNashcha sa.nyuge |
tAdRRishastadvishiShTo vA madrarAjo mato mama
shlokas.27:
yudhyamAnasya tasyAjau chintayanneva bhArata |
yoddhAraM nAdhigachChAmi tulyarUpaM janAdhipa
shlokas.28:
shikhaNDyarjunabhImAnAM sAtvatasya cha bhArata |
dhRRiShTadyumnasya cha tathA balenAbhyadhiko raNe
shlokas.29:
madrarAjo mahArAja siMhadviradavikramaH |
vichariShyatyabhIH kAle kAlaH kruddhaH prajAsviva
shlokas.30:
tasyAdya na prapashyAmi pratiyoddhAramAhave |
tvAmRRite puruShavyAghra shArdUlasamavikramam
shlokas.31:
sadevaloke kRRitsne.asminnAnyastvattaH pumAnbhavet |
madrarAjaM raNe kruddhaM yo hanyAtkurunandana
ahanyahani yudhyantaM kShobhayantaM balaM tava
shlokas.32:
tasmAjjahi raNe shalyaM maghavAniva shambaram |
atipashchAdasau vIro dhArtarAShTreNa satkRRitaH
shlokas.33:
tavaiva hi jayo nUnaM hate madreshvare yudhi |
tasminhate hataM sarvaM dhArtarAShTrabalaM mahat
shlokas.34:
etachChrutvA mahArAja vachanaM mama sAmpratam |
pratyudyAhi raNe pArtha madrarAjaM mahAbalam
jahi chainaM mahAbAho vAsavo namuchiM yathA
shlokas.35:
na chaivAtra dayA kAryA mAtulo.ayaM mameti vai |
kShatradharmaM puraskRRitya jahi madrajaneshvaram
shlokas.36:
bhIShmadroNArNavaM tIrtvA karNapAtAlasambhavam |
mA nimajjasva sagaNaH shalyamAsAdya goShpadam
shlokas.37:
yachcha te tapaso vIryaM yachcha kShAtraM balaM tava |
taddarshaya raNe sarvaM jahi chainaM mahAratham
shlokas.38:
etAvaduktvA vachanaM keshavaH paravIrahA |
jagAma shibiraM sAyaM pUjyamAno.atha pANDavaiH
shlokas.39:
keshave tu tadA yAte dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
visRRijya sarvAnbhrAtR^I.nshcha pA~nchAlAnatha somakAn
suShvApa rajanIM tAM tu vishalya iva ku~njaraH
shlokas.40:
te cha sarve maheShvAsAH pA~nchAlAH pANDavAstathA |
karNasya nidhane hRRiShTAH suShupustAM nishAM tadA
shlokas.41:
gatajvaraM maheShvAsaM tIrNapAraM mahAratham |
babhUva pANDaveyAnAM sainyaM pramuditaM nishi
sUtaputrasya nidhane jayaM labdhvA cha mAriSha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vyatItAyAM rajanyAM tu rAjA duryodhanastadA |
abravIttAvakAnsarvAnsaMnahyantAM mahArathAH
shlokas.2:
rAj~nastu matamAj~nAya samanahyata sA chamUH |
ayojayanrathA.nstUrNaM paryadhAva.nstathApare
shlokas.3:
akalpyanta cha mAta~NgAH samanahyanta pattayaH |
hayAnAstaraNopetA.nshchakruranye sahasrashaH
shlokas.4:
vAditrANAM cha ninadaH prAdurAsIdvishAM pate |
bodhanArthaM hi yodhAnAM sainyAnAM chApyudIryatAm
shlokas.5:
tato balAni sarvANi senAshiShTAni bhArata |
saMnaddhAnyeva dadRRishurmRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam
shlokas.6:
shalyaM senApatiM kRRitvA madrarAjaM mahArathAH |
pravibhajya balaM sarvamanIkeShu vyavasthitAH
shlokas.7:
tataH sarve samAgamya putreNa tava sainikAH |
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha drauNiH shalyo.atha saubalaH
shlokas.8:
anye cha pArthivAH sheShAH samayaM chakrire tadA |
na na ekena yoddhavyaM katha~nchidapi pANDavaiH
shlokas.9:
yo hyekaH pANDavairyudhyedyo vA yudhyantamutsRRijet |
sa pa~nchabhirbhavedyuktaH pAtakaiH sopapAtakaiH
anyonyaM parirakShadbhiryoddhavyaM sahitaishcha naH
shlokas.10:
evaM te samayaM kRRitvA sarve tatra mahArathAH |
madrarAjaM puraskRRitya tUrNamabhyadravanparAn
shlokas.11:
tathaiva pANDavA rAjanvyUhya sainyaM mahAraNe |
abhyayuH kauravAnsarvAnyotsyamAnAH samantataH
shlokas.12:
tadbalaM bharatashreShTha kShubdhArNavasamasvanam |
samuddhUtArNavAkAramuddhUtarathaku~njaram
shlokas.13:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
droNasya bhIShmasya cha vai rAdheyasya cha me shrutam |
pAtanaM sha.nsa me bhUyaH shalyasyAtha sutasya me
shlokas.14:
kathaM raNe hataH shalyo dharmarAjena sa~njaya |
bhImena cha mahAbAhuH putro duryodhano mama
shlokas.15:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kShayaM manuShyadehAnAM rathanAgAshvasa~NkShayam |
shRRiNu rAjansthiro bhUtvA sa~NgrAmaM sha.nsato mama
shlokas.16:
AshA balavatI rAjanputrANAM te.abhavattadA |
hate bhIShme cha droNe cha sUtaputre cha pAtite
shalyaH pArthAnraNe sarvAnnihaniShyati mAriSha
shlokas.17:
tAmAshAM hRRidaye kRRitvA samAshvAsya cha bhArata |
madrarAjaM cha samare samAshritya mahAratham
nAthavantamathAtmAnamamanyata sutastava
shlokas.18:
yadA karNe hate pArthAH siMhanAdaM prachakrire |
tadA rAjandhArtarAShTrAnAvivesha mahadbhayam
shlokas.19:
tAnsamAshvAsya tu tadA madrarAjaH pratApavAn |
vyUhya vyUhaM mahArAja sarvatobhadramRRiddhimat
shlokas.20:
pratyudyAto raNe pArthAnmadrarAjaH pratApavAn |
vidhunvankArmukaM chitraM bhAraghnaM vegavattaram
shlokas.21:
rathapravaramAsthAya saindhavAshvaM mahArathaH |
tasya sItA mahArAja rathasthAshobhayadratham
shlokas.22:
sa tena sa.nvRRito vIro rathenAmitrakarshanaH |
tasthau shUro mahArAja putrANAM te bhayapraNut
shlokas.23:
prayANe madrarAjo.abhUnmukhaM vyUhasya da.nshitaH |
madrakaiH sahito vIraiH karNaputraishcha durjayaiH
shlokas.24:
savye.abhUtkRRitavarmA cha trigartaiH parivAritaH |
gautamo dakShiNe pArshve shakaishcha yavanaiH saha
shlokas.25:
ashvatthAmA pRRiShThato.abhUtkAmbojaiH parivAritaH |
duryodhano.abhavanmadhye rakShitaH kurupu~NgavaiH
shlokas.26:
hayAnIkena mahatA saubalashchApi sa.nvRRitaH |
prayayau sarvasainyena kaitavyashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.27:
pANDavAshcha maheShvAsA vyUhya sainyamari.ndamAH |
tridhA bhUtvA mahArAja tava sainyamupAdravan
shlokas.28:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
shalyasya vAhinIM tUrNamabhidudruvurAhave
shlokas.29:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA svenAnIkena sa.nvRRitaH |
shalyamevAbhidudrAva jighA.nsurbharatarShabha
shlokas.30:
hArdikyaM tu maheShvAsamarjunaH shatrupUgahA |
sa.nshaptakagaNA.nshchaiva vegato.abhividudruve
shlokas.31:
gautamaM bhImaseno vai somakAshcha mahArathAH |
abhyadravanta rAjendra jighA.nsantaH parAnyudhi
shlokas.32:
mAdrIputrau tu shakunimulUkaM cha mahArathau |
sasainyau sahasenau tAvupatasthaturAhave
shlokas.33:
tathaivAyutasho yodhAstAvakAH pANDavAnraNe |
abhyadravanta sa~NkruddhA vividhAyudhapANayaH
shlokas.34:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
hate bhIShme maheShvAse droNe karNe mahArathe |
kuruShvalpAvashiShTeShu pANDaveShu cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.35:
susa.nrabdheShu pArtheShu parAkrAnteShu sa~njaya |
mAmakAnAM pareShAM cha kiM shiShTamabhavadbalam
shlokas.36:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yathA vayaM pare rAjanyuddhAya samavasthitAH |
yAvachchAsIdbalaM shiShTaM sa~NgrAme tannibodha me
shlokas.37:
ekAdasha sahasrANi rathAnAM bharatarShabha |
dasha dantisahasrANi sapta chaiva shatAni cha
shlokas.38:
pUrNe shatasahasre dve hayAnAM bharatarShabha |
narakoTyastathA tisro balametattavAbhavat
shlokas.39:
rathAnAM ShaTsahasrANi ShaTsahasrAshcha ku~njarAH |
dasha chAshvasahasrANi pattikoTI cha bhArata
shlokas.40:
etadbalaM pANDavAnAmabhavachCheShamAhave |
eta eva samAjagmuryuddhAya bharatarShabha
shlokas.41:
evaM vibhajya rAjendra madrarAjamate sthitAH |
pANDavAnpratyudIyAma jayagRRiddhAH pramanyavaH
shlokas.42:
tathaiva pANDavAH shUrAH samare jitakAshinaH |
upayAtA naravyAghrAH pA~nchAlAshcha yashasvinaH
shlokas.43:
evamete balaughena parasparavadhaiShiNaH |
upayAtA naravyAghrAH pUrvAM sandhyAM prati prabho
shlokas.44:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM ghorarUpaM bhayAnakam |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha nighnatAmitaretaram

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM kurUNAM bhayavardhanam |
sRRi~njayaiH saha rAjendra ghoraM devAsuropamam
shlokas.2:
narA rathA gajaughAshcha sAdinashcha sahasrashaH |
vAjinashcha parAkrAntAH samAjagmuH parasparam
shlokas.3:
nAgAnAM bhImarUpANAM dravatAM nisvano mahAn |
ashrUyata yathA kAle jaladAnAM nabhastale
shlokas.4:
nAgairabhyAhatAH kechitsarathA rathino.apatan |
vyadravanta raNe vIrA drAvyamANA madotkaTaiH
shlokas.5:
hayaughAnpAdarakShA.nshcha rathinastatra shikShitAH |
sharaiH sampreShayAmAsuH paralokAya bhArata
shlokas.6:
sAdinaH shikShitA rAjanparivArya mahArathAn |
vicharanto raNe.abhyaghnanprAsashaktyRRiShTibhistathA
shlokas.7:
dhanvinaH puruShAH kechitsaMnivArya mahArathAn |
ekaM bahava AsAdya preShayeyuryamakShayam
shlokas.8:
nAgaM rathavarA.nshchAnye parivArya mahArathAH |
sottarAyudhinaM jaghnurdravamANA mahAravam
shlokas.9:
tathA cha rathinaM kruddhaM vikirantaM sharAnbahUn |
nAgA jaghnurmahArAja parivArya samantataH
shlokas.10:
nAgo nAgamabhidrutya rathI cha rathinaM raNe |
shaktitomaranArAchairnijaghnustatra tatra ha
shlokas.11:
pAdAtAnavamRRidnanto rathavAraNavAjinaH |
raNamadhye vyadRRishyanta kurvanto mahadAkulam
shlokas.12:
hayAshcha paryadhAvanta chAmarairupashobhitAH |
ha.nsA himavataH prasthe pibanta iva medinIm
shlokas.13:
teShAM tu vAjinAM bhUmiH khuraishchitrA vishAM pate |
ashobhata yathA nArI karajakShatavikShatA
shlokas.14:
vAjinAM khurashabdena rathanemisvanena cha |
pattInAM chApi shabdena nAgAnAM bRRiMhitena cha
shlokas.15:
vAditrANAM cha ghoSheNa sha~NkhAnAM nisvanena cha |
abhavannAditA bhUmirnirghAtairiva bhArata
shlokas.16:
dhanuShAM kUjamAnAnAM nistri.nshAnAM cha dIpyatAm |
kavachAnAM prabhAbhishcha na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.17:
bahavo bAhavashChinnA nAgarAjakaropamAH |
udveShTante viveShTante vegaM kurvanti dAruNam
shlokas.18:
shirasAM cha mahArAja patatAM vasudhAtale |
chyutAnAmiva tAlebhyaH phalAnAM shrUyate svanaH
shlokas.19:
shirobhiH patitairbhAti rudhirArdrairvasundharA |
tapanIyanibhaiH kAle nalinairiva bhArata
shlokas.20:
udvRRittanayanaistaistu gatasattvaiH suvikShataiH |
vyabhrAjata mahArAja puNDarIkairivAvRRitA
shlokas.21:
bAhubhishchandanAdigdhaiH sakeyUrairmahAdhanaiH |
patitairbhAti rAjendra mahI shakradhvajairiva
shlokas.22:
Urubhishcha narendrANAM vinikRRittairmahAhave |
hastihastopamairanyaiH sa.nvRRitaM tadraNA~NgaNam
shlokas.23:
kabandhashatasa~NkIrNaM ChatrachAmarashobhitam |
senAvanaM tachChushubhe vanaM puShpAchitaM yathA
shlokas.24:
tatra yodhA mahArAja vicharanto hyabhItavat |
dRRishyante rudhirAktA~NgAH puShpitA iva ki.nshukAH
shlokas.25:
mAta~NgAshchApyadRRishyanta sharatomarapIDitAH |
patantastatra tatraiva ChinnAbhrasadRRishA raNe
shlokas.26:
gajAnIkaM mahArAja vadhyamAnaM mahAtmabhiH |
vyadIryata dishaH sarvA vAtanunnA ghanA iva
shlokas.27:
te gajA ghanasa~NkAshAH petururvyAM samantataH |
vajrarugNA iva babhuH parvatA yugasa~NkShaye
shlokas.28:
hayAnAM sAdibhiH sArdhaM patitAnAM mahItale |
rAshayaH sampradRRishyante girimAtrAstatastataH
shlokas.29:
sa~njaj~ne raNabhUmau tu paralokavahA nadI |
shoNitodA rathAvartA dhvajavRRikShAsthisharkarA
shlokas.30:
bhujanakrA dhanuHsrotA hastishailA hayopalA |
medomajjAkardaminI Chatraha.nsA gadoDupA
shlokas.31:
kavachoShNIShasa~nChannA patAkAruchiradrumA |
chakrachakrAvalIjuShTA triveNUdaNDakAvRRitA
shlokas.32:
shUrANAM harShajananI bhIrUNAM bhayavardhinI |
prAvartata nadI raudrA kurusRRi~njayasa~NkulA
shlokas.33:
tAM nadIM pitRRilokAya vahantImatibhairavAm |
terurvAhananaubhiste shUrAH parighabAhavaH
shlokas.34:
vartamAne tathA yuddhe nirmaryAde vishAM pate |
chatura~NgakShaye ghore pUrvaM devAsuropame
shlokas.35:
akroshanbAndhavAnanye tatra tatra parantapa |
kroshadbhirbAndhavaishchAnye bhayArtA na nivartire
shlokas.36:
nirmaryAde tathA yuddhe vartamAne bhayAnake |
arjuno bhImasenashcha mohayAM chakratuH parAn
shlokas.37:
sA vadhyamAnA mahatI senA tava janAdhipa |
amuhyattatra tatraiva yoShinmadavashAdiva
shlokas.38:
mohayitvA cha tAM senAM bhImasenadhana~njayau |
dadhmaturvArijau tatra siMhanAdaM cha nedatuH
shlokas.39:
shrutvaiva tu mahAshabdaM dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDinau |
dharmarAjaM puraskRRitya madrarAjamabhidrutau
shlokas.40:
tatrAshcharyamapashyAma ghorarUpaM vishAM pate |
shalyena sa~NgatAH shUrA yadayudhyanta bhAgashaH
shlokas.41:
mAdrIputrau sarabhasau kRRitAstrau yuddhadurmadau |
abhyayAtAM tvarAyuktau jigIShantau balaM tava
shlokas.42:
tato nyavartata balaM tAvakaM bharatarShabha |
sharaiH praNunnaM bahudhA pANDavairjitakAshibhiH
shlokas.43:
vadhyamAnA chamUH sA tu putrANAM prekShatAM tava |
bheje disho mahArAja praNunnA dRRiDhadhanvibhiH
hAhAkAro mahA~njaj~ne yodhAnAM tava bhArata
shlokas.44:
tiShTha tiShTheti vAgAsIddrAvitAnAM mahAtmanAm |
kShatriyANAM tadAnyonyaM sa.nyuge jayamichChatAm
Adravanneva bhagnAste pANDavaistava sainikAH
shlokas.45:
tyaktvA yuddhe priyAnputrAnbhrAtR^Inatha pitAmahAn |
mAtulAnbhAgineyA.nshcha tathA sambandhibAndhavAn
shlokas.46:
hayAndvipA.nstvarayanto yodhA jagmuH samantataH |
AtmatrANakRRitotsAhAstAvakA bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tatprabhagnaM balaM dRRiShTvA madrarAjaH pratApavAn |
uvAcha sArathiM tUrNaM chodayAshvAnmahAjavAn
shlokas.2:
eSha tiShThati vai rAjA pANDuputro yudhiShThiraH |
ChatreNa dhriyamANena pANDureNa virAjatA
shlokas.3:
atra mAM prApaya kShipraM pashya me sArathe balam |
na samarthA hi me pArthAH sthAtumadya puro yudhi
shlokas.4:
evamuktastataH prAyAnmadrarAjasya sArathiH |
yatra rAjA satyasandho dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.5:
ApatantaM cha sahasA pANDavAnAM mahadbalam |
dadhAraiko raNe shalyo velevoddhRRitamarNavam
shlokas.6:
pANDavAnAM balaughastu shalyamAsAdya mAriSha |
vyatiShThata tadA yuddhe sindhorvega ivAchalam
shlokas.7:
madrarAjaM tu samare dRRiShTvA yuddhAya viShThitam |
kuravaH saMnyavartanta mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam
shlokas.8:
teShu rAjannivRRitteShu vyUDhAnIkeShu bhAgashaH |
prAvartata mahAraudraH sa~NgrAmaH shoNitodakaH
samArChachchitrasenena nakulo yuddhadurmadaH
shlokas.9:
tau parasparamAsAdya chitrakArmukadhAriNau |
meghAviva yathodvRRittau dakShiNottaravarShiNau
shlokas.10:
sharatoyaiH siShichatustau parasparamAhave |
nAntaraM tatra pashyAmi pANDavasyetarasya vA
shlokas.11:
ubhau kRRitAstrau balinau rathacharyAvishAradau |
parasparavadhe yattau ChidrAnveShaNatatparau
shlokas.12:
chitrasenastu bhallena pItena nishitena cha |
nakulasya mahArAja muShTideshe.achChinaddhanuH
shlokas.13:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM rukmapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
tribhiH sharairasambhrAnto lalATe vai samarpayat
shlokas.14:
hayA.nshchAsya sharaistIkShNaiH preShayAmAsa mRRityave |
tathA dhvajaM sArathiM cha tribhistribhirapAtayat
shlokas.15:
sa shatrubhujanirmuktairlalATasthaistribhiH sharaiH |
nakulaH shushubhe rAja.nstrishRRi~Nga iva parvataH
shlokas.16:
sa ChinnadhanvA virathaH khaDgamAdAya charma cha |
rathAdavAtaradvIraH shailAgrAdiva kesarI
shlokas.17:
padbhyAmApatatastasya sharavRRiShTimavAsRRijat |
nakulo.apyagrasattAM vai charmaNA laghuvikramaH
shlokas.18:
chitrasenarathaM prApya chitrayodhI jitashramaH |
Aruroha mahAbAhuH sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.19:
sakuNDalaM samukuTaM sunasaM svAyatekShaNam |
chitrasenashiraH kAyAdapAharata pANDavaH
sa papAta rathopasthAddivAkarasamaprabhaH
shlokas.20:
chitrasenaM vishastaM tu dRRiShTvA tatra mahArathAH |
sAdhuvAdasvanA.nshchakruH siMhanAdA.nshcha puShkalAn
shlokas.21:
vishastaM bhrAtaraM dRRiShTvA karNaputrau mahArathau |
suSheNaH satyasenashcha mu~nchantau nishitA~nsharAn
shlokas.22:
tato.abhyadhAvatAM tUrNaM pANDavaM rathinAM varam |
jighA.nsantau yathA nAgaM vyAghrau rAjanmahAvane
shlokas.23:
tAvabhyadhAvatAM tIkShNau dvAvapyenaM mahAratham |
sharaughAnsamyagasyantau jImUtau salilaM yathA
shlokas.24:
sa sharaiH sarvato viddhaH prahRRiShTa iva pANDavaH |
anyatkArmukamAdAya rathamAruhya vIryavAn
atiShThata raNe vIraH kruddharUpa ivAntakaH
shlokas.25:
tasya tau bhrAtarau rAja~nsharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
rathaM vishakalIkartuM samArabdhau vishAM pate
shlokas.26:
tataH prahasya nakulashchaturbhishchaturo raNe |
jaghAna nishitaistIkShNaiH satyasenasya vAjinaH
shlokas.27:
tataH sandhAya nArAchaM rukmapu~NkhaM shilAshitam |
dhanushchichCheda rAjendra satyasenasya pANDavaH
shlokas.28:
athAnyaM rathamAsthAya dhanurAdAya chAparam |
satyasenaH suSheNashcha pANDavaM paryadhAvatAm
shlokas.29:
avidhyattAvasambhrAntau mAdrIputraH pratApavAn |
dvAbhyAM dvAbhyAM mahArAja sharAbhyAM raNamUrdhani
shlokas.30:
suSheNastu tataH kruddhaH pANDavasya mahaddhanuH |
chichCheda prahasanyuddhe kShurapreNa mahArathaH
shlokas.31:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya nakulaH krodhamUrChitaH |
suSheNaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA dhvajamekena chichChide
shlokas.32:
satyasenasya cha dhanurhastAvApaM cha mAriSha |
chichCheda tarasA yuddhe tata uchchukrushurjanAH
shlokas.33:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya vegaghnaM bhArasAdhanam |
sharaiH sa~nChAdayAmAsa samantAtpANDunandanam
shlokas.34:
saMnivArya tu tAnbANAnnakulaH paravIrahA |
satyasenaM suSheNaM cha dvAbhyAM dvAbhyAmavidhyata
shlokas.35:
tAvenaM pratyavidhyetAM pRRithakpRRithagajihmagaiH |
sArathiM chAsya rAjendra sharairvivyadhatuH shitaiH
shlokas.36:
satyaseno ratheShAM tu nakulasya dhanustathA |
pRRithakSharAbhyAM chichCheda kRRitahastaH pratApavAn
shlokas.37:
sa rathe.atirathastiShThanrathashaktiM parAmRRishat |
svarNadaNDAmakuNThAgrAM tailadhautAM sunirmalAm
shlokas.38:
lelihAnAmiva vibho nAgakanyAM mahAviShAm |
samudyamya cha chikShepa satyasenasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.39:
sA tasya hRRidayaM sa~Nkhye bibheda shatadhA nRRipa |
sa papAta rathAdbhUmau gatasattvo.alpachetanaH
shlokas.40:
bhrAtaraM nihataM dRRiShTvA suSheNaH krodhamUrChitaH |
abhyavarShachCharaistUrNaM padAtiM pANDunandanam
shlokas.41:
nakulaM virathaM dRRiShTvA draupadeyo mahAbalaH |
sutasomo.abhidudrAva parIpsanpitaraM raNe
shlokas.42:
tato.adhiruhya nakulaH sutasomasya taM ratham |
shushubhe bharatashreShTho giristha iva kesarI
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya suSheNaM samayodhayat
shlokas.43:
tAvubhau sharavarShAbhyAM samAsAdya parasparam |
parasparavadhe yatnaM chakratuH sumahArathau
shlokas.44:
suSheNastu tataH kruddhaH pANDavaM vishikhaistribhiH |
sutasomaM cha vi.nshatyA bAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.45:
tataH kruddho mahArAja nakulaH paravIrahA |
sharaistasya dishaH sarvAshChAdayAmAsa vIryavAn
shlokas.46:
tato gRRihItvA tIkShNAgramardhachandraM sutejanam |
sa vegayuktaM chikShepa karNaputrasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.47:
tasya tena shiraH kAyAjjahAra nRRipasattama |
pashyatAM sarvasainyAnAM tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.48:
sa hataH prApatadrAjannakulena mahAtmanA |
nadIvegAdivArugNastIrajaH pAdapo mahAn
shlokas.49:
karNaputravadhaM dRRiShTvA nakulasya cha vikramam |
pradudrAva bhayAtsenA tAvakI bharatarShabha
shlokas.50:
tAM tu senAM mahArAja madrarAjaH pratApavAn |
apAlayadraNe shUraH senApatirari.ndamaH
shlokas.51:
vibhIstasthau mahArAja vyavasthApya cha vAhinIm |
siMhanAdaM bhRRishaM kRRitvA dhanuHshabdaM cha dAruNam
shlokas.52:
tAvakAH samare rAjanrakShitA dRRiDhadhanvanA |
pratyudyayurarAtI.nste samantAdvigatavyathAH
shlokas.53:
madrarAjaM maheShvAsaM parivArya samantataH |
sthitA rAjanmahAsenA yoddhukAmAH samantataH
shlokas.54:
sAtyakirbhImasenashcha mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
yudhiShThiraM puraskRRitya hrIniShedhamari.ndamam
shlokas.55:
parivArya raNe vIrAH siMhanAdaM prachakrire |
bANashabdaravA.nshchogrAnkShveDA.nshcha vividhAndadhuH
shlokas.56:
tathaiva tAvakAH sarve madrAdhipatima~njasA |
parivArya susa.nrabdhAH punaryuddhamarochayan
shlokas.57:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM bhIrUNAM bhayavardhanam |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam
shlokas.58:
yathA devAsuraM yuddhaM pUrvamAsIdvishAM pate |
abhItAnAM tathA rAjanyamarAShTravivardhanam
shlokas.59:
tataH kapidhvajo rAjanhatvA sa.nshaptakAnraNe |
abhyadravata tAM senAM kauravIM pANDunandanaH
shlokas.60:
tathaiva pANDavAH sheShA dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH |
abhyadhAvanta tAM senAM visRRijantaH shitA~nsharAn
shlokas.61:
pANDavairavakIrNAnAM saMmohaH samajAyata |
na cha jaj~nuranIkAni disho vA pradishastathA
shlokas.62:
ApUryamANA nishitaiH sharaiH pANDavachoditaiH |
hatapravIrA vidhvastA kIryamANA samantataH
kauravyavadhyata chamUH pANDuputrairmahArathaiH
shlokas.63:
tathaiva pANDavI senA sharai rAjansamantataH |
raNe.ahanyata putraiste shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.64:
te sene bhRRishasantapte vadhyamAne parasparam |
vyAkule samapadyetAM varShAsu saritAviva
shlokas.65:
Avivesha tatastIvraM tAvakAnAM mahadbhayam |
pANDavAnAM cha rAjendra tathAbhUte mahAhave

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasminvilulite sainye vadhyamAne parasparam |
dravamANeShu yodheShu ninadatsu cha dantiShu
shlokas.2:
kUjatAM stanatAM chaiva padAtInAM mahAhave |
vidruteShu mahArAja hayeShu bahudhA tadA
shlokas.3:
prakShaye dAruNe jAte saMhAre sarvadehinAm |
nAnAshastrasamAvApe vyatiShaktarathadvipe
shlokas.4:
harShaNe yuddhashauNDAnAM bhIrUNAM bhayavardhane |
gAhamAneShu yodheShu parasparavadhaiShiShu
shlokas.5:
prANAdAne mahAghore vartamAne durodare |
sa~NgrAme ghorarUpe tu yamarAShTravivardhane
shlokas.6:
pANDavAstAvakaM sainyaM vyadhamannishitaiH sharaiH |
tathaiva tAvakA yodhA jaghnuH pANDavasainikAn
shlokas.7:
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne yuddhe bhIrubhayAvahe |
pUrvAhNe chaiva samprApte bhAskarodayanaM prati
shlokas.8:
labdhalakShAH pare rAjanrakShitAshcha mahAtmanA |
ayodhaya.nstava balaM mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam
shlokas.9:
balibhiH pANDavairdRRiptairlabdhalakShaiH prahAribhiH |
kauravyasIdatpRRitanA mRRigIvAgnisamAkulA
shlokas.10:
tAM dRRiShTvA sIdatIM senAM pa~Nke gAmiva durbalAm |
ujjihIrShustadA shalyaH prAyAtpANDuchamUM prati
shlokas.11:
madrarAjastu sa~Nkruddho gRRihItvA dhanuruttamam |
abhyadravata sa~NgrAme pANDavAnAtatAyinaH
shlokas.12:
pANDavAshcha mahArAja samare jitakAshinaH |
madrarAjaM samAsAdya vivyadhurnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.13:
tataH sharashataistIkShNairmadrarAjo mahAbalaH |
ardayAmAsa tAM senAM dharmarAjasya pashyataH
shlokas.14:
prAdurAsa.nstato rAjannAnArUpANyanekashaH |
chachAla shabdaM kurvANA mahI chApi saparvatA
shlokas.15:
sadaNDashUlA dIptAgrAH shIryamANAH samantataH |
ulkA bhUmiM divaH peturAhatya ravimaNDalam
shlokas.16:
mRRigAshcha mAhiShAshchApi pakShiNashcha vishAM pate |
apasavyaM tadA chakruH senAM te bahusho nRRipa
shlokas.17:
tatastadyuddhamatyugramabhavatsa~NghachAriNAm |
tathA sarvANyanIkAni saMnipatya janAdhipa
abhyayuH kauravA rAjanpANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.18:
shalyastu sharavarSheNa varShanniva sahasradRRik |
abhyavarShadadInAtmA kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.19:
bhImasenaM sharaishchApi rukmapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaH |
draupadeyA.nstathA sarvAnmAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.20:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha shaineyaM shikhaNDinamathApi cha |
ekaikaM dashabhirbANairvivyAdha cha mahAbalaH
tato.asRRijadbANavarShaM gharmAnte maghavAniva
shlokas.21:
tataH prabhadrakA rAjansomakAshcha sahasrashaH |
patitAH pAtyamAnAshcha dRRishyante shalyasAyakaiH
shlokas.22:
bhramarANAmiva vrAtAH shalabhAnAmiva vrajAH |
hrAdinya iva meghebhyaH shalyasya nyapata~nsharAH
shlokas.23:
dviradAsturagAshchArtAH pattayo rathinastathA |
shalyasya bANairnyapatanbabhramurvyanada.nstathA
shlokas.24:
AviShTa iva madresho manyunA pauruSheNa cha |
prAchChAdayadarInsa~Nkhye kAlasRRiShTa ivAntakaH
vinardamAno madresho meghahrAdo mahAbalaH
shlokas.25:
sA vadhyamAnA shalyena pANDavAnAmanIkinI |
ajAtashatruM kaunteyamabhyadhAvadyudhiShThiram
shlokas.26:
tAM samarpya tataH sa~Nkhye laghuhastaH shitaiH sharaiH |
sharavarSheNa mahatA yudhiShThiramapIDayat
shlokas.27:
tamApatantaM pattyashvaiH kruddho rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
avArayachCharaistIkShNairmattaM dvipamivA~NkushaiH
shlokas.28:
tasya shalyaH sharaM ghoraM mumochAshIviShopamam |
so.abhyavidhyanmahAtmAnaM vegenAbhyapatachcha gAm
shlokas.29:
tato vRRikodaraH kruddhaH shalyaM vivyAdha saptabhiH |
pa~nchabhiH sahadevastu nakulo dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.30:
draupadeyAshcha shatrughnaM shUramArtAyaniM sharaiH |
abhyavarShanmahAbhAgaM meghA iva mahIdharam
shlokas.31:
tato dRRiShTvA tudyamAnaM shalyaM pArthaiH samantataH |
kRRitavarmA kRRipashchaiva sa~NkruddhAvabhyadhAvatAm
shlokas.32:
ulUkashcha patatrI cha shakunishchApi saubalaH |
smayamAnashcha shanakairashvatthAmA mahArathaH
tava putrAshcha kArtsnyena jugupuH shalyamAhave
shlokas.33:
bhImasenaM tribhirviddhvA kRRitavarmA shilImukhaiH |
bANavarSheNa mahatA kruddharUpamavArayat
shlokas.34:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM kRRipaH kruddho bANavarShairapIDayat |
draupadeyA.nshcha shakuniryamau cha drauNirabhyayAt
shlokas.35:
duryodhano yudhAM shreShThAvAhave keshavArjunau |
samabhyayAdugratejAH sharaishchAbhyahanadbalI
shlokas.36:
evaM dva.ndvashatAnyAsa.nstvadIyAnAM paraiH saha |
ghorarUpANi chitrANi tatra tatra vishAM pate
shlokas.37:
RRishyavarNA~njaghAnAshvAnbhojo bhImasya sa.nyuge |
so.avatIrya rathopasthAddhatAshvaH pANDunandanaH
kAlo daNDamivodyamya gadApANirayudhyata
shlokas.38:
pramukhe sahadevasya jaghAnAshvA.nshcha madrarAT |
tataH shalyasya tanayaM sahadevo.asinAvadhIt
shlokas.39:
gautamaH punarAchAryo dhRRiShTadyumnamayodhayat |
asambhrAntamasambhrAnto yatnavAnyatnavattaram
shlokas.40:
draupadeyA.nstathA vIrAnekaikaM dashabhiH sharaiH |
avidhyadAchAryasuto nAtikruddhaH smayanniva
shlokas.41:
shalyo.api rAjansa~Nkruddho nighnansomakapANDavAn |
punareva shitairbANairyudhiShThiramapIDayat
shlokas.42:
tasya bhImo raNe kruddhaH sa.ndaShTadashanachChadaH |
vinAshAyAbhisandhAya gadAmAdatta vIryavAn
shlokas.43:
yamadaNDapratIkAshAM kAlarAtrimivodyatAm |
gajavAjimanuShyANAM prANAntakaraNImapi
shlokas.44:
hemapaTTaparikShiptAmulkAM prajvalitAmiva |
shaikyAM vyAlImivAtyugrAM vajrakalpAmayasmayIm
shlokas.45:
chandanAgurupa~NkAktAM pramadAmIpsitAmiva |
vasAmedosRRigAdigdhAM jihvAM vaivasvatImiva
shlokas.46:
paTughaNTAravashatAM vAsavImashanImiva |
nirmuktAshIviShAkArAM pRRiktAM gajamadairapi
shlokas.47:
trAsanIM ripusainyAnAM svasainyapariharShiNIm |
manuShyaloke vikhyAtAM girishRRi~NgavidAriNIm
shlokas.48:
yayA kailAsabhavane maheshvarasakhaM balI |
AhvayAmAsa kaunteyaH sa~NkruddhamalakAdhipam
shlokas.49:
yayA mAyAvino dRRiptAnsubahUndhanadAlaye |
jaghAna guhyakAnkruddho mandArArthe mahAbalaH
nivAryamANo bahubhirdraupadyAH priyamAsthitaH
shlokas.50:
tAM vajramaNiratnaughAmaShTAshriM vajragauravAm |
samudyamya mahAbAhuH shalyamabhyadravadraNe
shlokas.51:
gadayA yuddhakushalastayA dAruNanAdayA |
pothayAmAsa shalyasya chaturo.ashvAnmahAjavAn
shlokas.52:
tataH shalyo raNe kruddhaH pIne vakShasi tomaram |
nichakhAna nadanvIro varma bhittvA cha so.abhyagAt
shlokas.53:
vRRikodarastvasambhrAtastamevoddhRRitya tomaram |
yantAraM madrarAjasya nirbibheda tato hRRidi
shlokas.54:
sa bhinnavarmA rudhiraM vamanvitrastamAnasaH |
papAtAbhimukho dIno madrarAjastvapAkramat
shlokas.55:
kRRitapratikRRitaM dRRiShTvA shalyo vismitamAnasaH |
gadAmAshritya dhIrAtmA pratyamitramavaikShata
shlokas.56:
tataH sumanasaH pArthA bhImasenamapUjayan |
taddRRiShTvA karma sa~NgrAme ghoramakliShTakarmaNaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
patitaM prekShya yantAraM shalyaH sarvAyasIM gadAm |
AdAya tarasA rAja.nstasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.2:
taM dIptamiva kAlAgniM pAshahastamivAntakam |
sashRRi~Ngamiva kailAsaM savajramiva vAsavam
shlokas.3:
sashUlamiva haryakShaM vane mattamiva dvipam |
javenAbhyapatadbhImaH pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm
shlokas.4:
tataH sha~NkhapraNAdashcha tUryANAM cha sahasrashaH |
siMhanAdashcha sa~njaj~ne shUrANAM harShavardhanaH
shlokas.5:
prekShantaH sarvatastau hi yodhA yodhamahAdvipau |
tAvakAshcha pare chaiva sAdhu sAdhvityathAbruvan
shlokas.6:
na hi madrAdhipAdanyo rAmAdvA yadunandanAt |
soDhumutsahate vegaM bhImasenasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.7:
tathA madrAdhipasyApi gadAvegaM mahAtmanaH |
soDhumutsahate nAnyo yodho yudhi vRRikodarAt
shlokas.8:
tau vRRiShAviva nardantau maNDalAni vicheratuH |
Avalgitau gadAhastau madrarAjavRRikodarau
shlokas.9:
maNDalAvartamArgeShu gadAviharaNeShu cha |
nirvisheShamabhUdyuddhaM tayoH puruShasiMhayoH
shlokas.10:
taptahemamayaiH shubhrairbabhUva bhayavardhanI |
agnijvAlairivAviddhA paTTaiH shalyasya sA gadA
shlokas.11:
tathaiva charato mArgAnmaNDaleShu mahAtmanaH |
vidyudabhrapratIkAshA bhImasya shushubhe gadA
shlokas.12:
tADitA madrarAjena bhImasya gadayA gadA |
dIpyamAneva vai rAjansasRRije pAvakArchiShaH
shlokas.13:
tathA bhImena shalyasya tADitA gadayA gadA |
a~NgAravarShaM mumuche tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.14:
dantairiva mahAnAgau shRRi~Ngairiva maharShabhau |
tottrairiva tadAnyonyaM gadAgrAbhyAM nijaghnatuH
shlokas.15:
tau gadAnihatairgAtraiH kShaNena rudhirokShitau |
prekShaNIyatarAvAstAM puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.16:
gadayA madrarAjena savyadakShiNamAhataH |
bhImaseno mahAbAhurna chachAlAchalo yathA
shlokas.17:
tathA bhImagadAvegaistADyamAno muhurmuhuH |
shalyo na vivyathe rAjandantinevAhato giriH
shlokas.18:
shushruve dikShu sarvAsu tayoH puruShasiMhayoH |
gadAnipAtasaMhrAdo vajrayoriva nisvanaH
shlokas.19:
nivRRitya tu mahAvIryau samuchChritagadAvubhau |
punarantaramArgasthau maNDalAni vicheratuH
shlokas.20:
athAbhyetya padAnyaShTau saMnipAto.abhavattayoH |
udyamya lohadaNDAbhyAmatimAnuShakarmaNoH
shlokas.21:
prArthayAnau tadAnyo.anyaM maNDalAni vicheratuH |
kriyAvisheShaM kRRitinau darshayAmAsatustadA
shlokas.22:
athodyamya gade ghore sashRRi~NgAviva parvatau |
tAvAjaghnaturanyonyaM yathA bhUmichale.achalau
shlokas.23:
tau parasparavegAchcha gadAbhyAM cha bhRRishAhatau |
yugapatpetaturvIrAvubhAvindradhvajAviva
shlokas.24:
ubhayoH senayorvIrAstadA hAhAkRRito.abhavan |
bhRRishaM marmaNyabhihatAvubhAvAstAM suvihvalau
shlokas.25:
tataH sagadamAropya madrANAmRRiShabhaM rathe |
apovAha kRRipaH shalyaM tUrNamAyodhanAdapi
shlokas.26:
kShIbavadvihvalatvAttu nimeShAtpunarutthitaH |
bhImaseno gadApANiH samAhvayata madrapam
shlokas.27:
tatastu tAvakAH shUrA nAnAshastrasamAyutAH |
nAnAvAditrashabdena pANDusenAmayodhayan
shlokas.28:
bhujAvuchChritya shastraM cha shabdena mahatA tataH |
abhyadravanmahArAja duryodhanapurogamAH
shlokas.29:
tadanIkamabhiprekShya tataste pANDunandanAH |
prayayuH siMhanAdena duryodhanavadhepsayA
shlokas.30:
teShAmApatatAM tUrNaM putraste bharatarShabha |
prAsena chekitAnaM vai vivyAdha hRRidaye bhRRisham
shlokas.31:
sa papAta rathopasthe tava putreNa tADitaH |
rudhiraughapariklinnaH pravishya vipulaM tamaH
shlokas.32:
chekitAnaM hataM dRRiShTvA pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
prasaktamabhyavarShanta sharavarShANi bhAgashaH
shlokas.33:
tAvakAnAmanIkeShu pANDavA jitakAshinaH |
vyacharanta mahArAja prekShaNIyAH samantataH
shlokas.34:
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha saubalashcha mahAbalaH |
ayodhayandharmarAjaM madrarAjapuraskRRitAH
shlokas.35:
bhAradvAjasya hantAraM bhUrivIryaparAkramam |
duryodhano mahArAja dhRRiShTadyumnamayodhayat
shlokas.36:
trisAhasrA rathA rAja.nstava putreNa choditAH |
ayodhayanta vijayaM droNaputrapuraskRRitAH
shlokas.37:
vijaye dhRRitasa~NkalpAH samabhityaktajIvitAH |
prAvisha.nstAvakA rAjanha.nsA iva mahatsaraH
shlokas.38:
tato yuddhamabhUdghoraM parasparavadhaiShiNAm |
anyonyavadhasa.nyuktamanyonyaprItivardhanam
shlokas.39:
tasminpravRRitte sa~NgrAme rAjanvIravarakShaye |
anileneritaM ghoramuttasthau pArthivaM rajaH
shlokas.40:
shravaNAnnAmadheyAnAM pANDavAnAM cha kIrtanAt |
parasparaM vijAnImo ye chAyudhyannabhItavat
shlokas.41:
tadrajaH puruShavyAghra shoNitena prashAmitam |
dishashcha vimalA jaj~nustasminrajasi shAmite
shlokas.42:
tathA pravRRitte sa~NgrAme ghorarUpe bhayAnake |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha nAsItkashchitparA~NmukhaH
shlokas.43:
brahmalokaparA bhUtvA prArthayanto jayaM yudhi |
suyuddhena parAkrAntA narAH svargamabhIpsavaH
shlokas.44:
bhartRRipiNDavimokShArthaM bhartRRikAryavinishchitAH |
svargasa.nsaktamanaso yodhA yuyudhire tadA
shlokas.45:
nAnArUpANi shastrANi visRRijanto mahArathAH |
anyonyamabhigarjantaH praharantaH parasparam
shlokas.46:
hata vidhyata gRRihNIta praharadhvaM nikRRintata |
iti sma vAchaH shrUyante tava teShAM cha vai bale
shlokas.47:
tataH shalyo mahArAja dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
vivyAdha nishitairbANairhantukAmo mahAratham
shlokas.48:
tasya pArtho mahArAja nArAchAnvai chaturdasha |
marmANyuddishya marmaj~no nichakhAna hasanniva
shlokas.49:
taM vArya pANDavaM bANairhantukAmo mahAyashAH |
vivyAdha samare kruddho bahubhiH ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.50:
atha bhUyo mahArAja shareNa nataparvaNA |
yudhiShThiraM samAjaghne sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.51:
dharmarAjo.api sa~Nkruddho madrarAjaM mahAyashAH |
vivyAdha nishitairbANaiH ka~NkabarhiNavAjitaiH
shlokas.52:
chandrasenaM cha saptatyA sUtaM cha navabhiH sharaiH |
drumasenaM chatuHShaShTyA nijaghAna mahArathaH
shlokas.53:
chakrarakShe hate shalyaH pANDavena mahAtmanA |
nijaghAna tato rAja.nshchedInvai pa~nchavi.nshatim
shlokas.54:
sAtyakiM pa~nchavi.nshatyA bhImasenaM cha pa~nchabhiH |
mAdrIputrau shatenAjau vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.55:
evaM vicharatastasya sa~NgrAme rAjasattama |
sampreShayachChitAnpArthaH sharAnAshIviShopamAn
shlokas.56:
dhvajAgraM chAsya samare kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
pramukhe vartamAnasya bhallenApaharadrathAt
shlokas.57:
pANDuputreNa vai tasya ketuM ChinnaM mahAtmanA |
nipatantamapashyAma girishRRi~NgamivAhatam
shlokas.58:
dhvajaM nipatitaM dRRiShTvA pANDavaM cha vyavasthitam |
sa~Nkruddho madrarAjo.abhUchCharavarShaM mumocha ha
shlokas.59:
shalyaH sAyakavarSheNa parjanya iva vRRiShTimAn |
abhyavarShadameyAtmA kShatriyaM kShatriyarShabhaH
shlokas.60:
sAtyakiM bhImasenaM cha mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
ekaikaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA yudhiShThiramapIDayat
shlokas.61:
tato bANamayaM jAlaM vitataM pANDavorasi |
apashyAma mahArAja meghajAlamivodgatam
shlokas.62:
tasya shalyo raNe kruddho bANaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
dishaH prachChAdayAmAsa pradishashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.63:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA bANajAlena pIDitaH |
babhUva hRRitavikrAnto jambho vRRitrahaNA yathA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pIDite dharmarAje tu madrarAjena mAriSha |
sAtyakirbhImasenashcha mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
parivArya rathaiH shalyaM pIDayAmAsurAhave
shlokas.2:
tamekaM bahubhirdRRiShTvA pIDyamAnaM mahArathaiH |
sAdhuvAdo mahA~njaj~ne siddhAshchAsanpraharShitAH
AshcharyamityabhAShanta munayashchApi sa~NgatAH
shlokas.3:
bhImaseno raNe shalyaM shalyabhUtaM parAkrame |
ekena viddhvA bANena punarvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.4:
sAtyakishcha shatenainaM dharmaputraparIpsayA |
madreshvaramavAkIrya siMhanAdamathAnadat
shlokas.5:
nakulaH pa~nchabhishchainaM sahadevashcha saptabhiH |
viddhvA taM tu tatastUrNaM punarvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.6:
sa tu shUro raNe yattaH pIDitastairmahArathaiH |
vikRRiShya kArmukaM ghoraM vegaghnaM bhArasAdhanam
shlokas.7:
sAtyakiM pa~nchavi.nshatyA shalyo vivyAdha mAriSha |
bhImasenaM trisaptatyA nakulaM saptabhistathA
shlokas.8:
tataH savishikhaM chApaM sahadevasya dhanvinaH |
ChittvA bhallena samare vivyAdhainaM trisaptabhiH
shlokas.9:
sahadevastu samare mAtulaM bhUrivarchasam |
sajyamanyaddhanuH kRRitvA pa~nchabhiH samatADayat
sharairAshIviShAkArairjvalajjvalanasaMnibhaiH
shlokas.10:
sArathiM chAsya samare shareNAnataparvaNA |
vivyAdha bhRRishasa~NkruddhastaM cha bhUyastribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.11:
bhImasenastrisaptatyA sAtyakirnavabhiH sharaiH |
dharmarAjastathA ShaShTyA gAtre shalyaM samarpayat
shlokas.12:
tataH shalyo mahArAja nirviddhastairmahArathaiH |
susrAva rudhiraM gAtrairgairikaM parvato yathA
shlokas.13:
tA.nshcha sarvAnmaheShvAsAnpa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha tarasA rAja.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.14:
tato.apareNa bhallena dharmaputrasya mAriSha |
dhanushchichCheda samare sajyaM sa sumahArathaH
shlokas.15:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya dharmaputro mahArathaH |
sAshvasUtadhvajarathaM shalyaM prAchChAdayachCharaiH
shlokas.16:
sa chChAdyamAnaH samare dharmaputrasya sAyakaiH |
yudhiShThiramathAvidhyaddashabhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.17:
sAtyakistu tataH kruddho dharmaputre sharArdite |
madrANAmadhipaM shUraM sharaughaiH samavArayat
shlokas.18:
sa sAtyakeH prachichCheda kShurapreNa mahaddhanuH |
bhImasenamukhA.nstA.nshcha tribhistribhiratADayat
shlokas.19:
tasya kruddho mahArAja sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
tomaraM preShayAmAsa svarNadaNDaM mahAdhanam
shlokas.20:
bhImaseno.atha nArAchaM jvalantamiva pannagam |
nakulaH samare shaktiM sahadevo gadAM shubhAm
dharmarAjaH shataghnIM tu jighA.nsuH shalyamAhave
shlokas.21:
tAnApatata evAshu pa~nchAnAM vai bhujachyutAn |
sAtyakiprahitaM shalyo bhallaishchichCheda tomaram
shlokas.22:
bhImena prahitaM chApi sharaM kanakabhUShaNam |
dvidhA chichCheda samare kRRitahastaH pratApavAn
shlokas.23:
nakulapreShitAM shaktiM hemadaNDAM bhayAvahAm |
gadAM cha sahadevena sharaughaiH samavArayat
shlokas.24:
sharAbhyAM cha shataghnIM tAM rAj~nashchichCheda bhArata |
pashyatAM pANDuputrANAM siMhanAdaM nanAda cha
nAmRRiShyattaM tu shaineyaH shatrorvijayamAhave
shlokas.25:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya sAtyakiH krodhamUrChitaH |
dvAbhyAM madreshvaraM viddhvA sArathiM cha tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.26:
tataH shalyo mahArAja sarvA.nstAndashabhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha subhRRishaM kruddhastottrairiva mahAdvipAn
shlokas.27:
te vAryamANAH samare madrarAj~nA mahArathAH |
na shekuH pramukhe sthAtuM tasya shatruniShUdanAH
shlokas.28:
tato duryodhano rAjA dRRiShTvA shalyasya vikramam |
nihatAnpANDavAnmene pA~nchAlAnatha sRRi~njayAn
shlokas.29:
tato rAjanmahAbAhurbhImasenaH pratApavAn |
santyajya manasA prANAnmadrAdhipamayodhayat
shlokas.30:
nakulaH sahadevashcha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
parivArya tadA shalyaM samantAdvyakira~nsharaiH
shlokas.31:
sa chaturbhirmaheShvAsaiH pANDavAnAM mahArathaiH |
vRRitastAnyodhayAmAsa madrarAjaH pratApavAn
shlokas.32:
tasya dharmasuto rAjankShurapreNa mahAhave |
chakrarakShaM jaghAnAshu madrarAjasya pArthiva
shlokas.33:
tasmi.nstu nihate shUre chakrarakShe mahArathe |
madrarAjo.atibalavAnsainikAnAstRRiNochCharaiH
shlokas.34:
samAchChannA.nstatastA.nstu rAjanvIkShya sa sainikAn |
chintayAmAsa samare dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.35:
kathaM nu na bhavetsatyaM tanmAdhavavacho mahat |
na hi kruddho raNe rAjA kShapayeta balaM mama
shlokas.36:
tataH sarathanAgAshvAH pANDavAH pANDupUrvaja |
madreshvaraM samAseduH pIDayantaH samantataH
shlokas.37:
nAnAshastraughabahulAM shastravRRiShTiM samutthitAm |
vyadhamatsamare rAjanmahAbhrANIva mArutaH
shlokas.38:
tataH kanakapu~NkhAM tAM shalyakShiptAM viyadgatAm |
sharavRRiShTimapashyAma shalabhAnAmivAtatim
shlokas.39:
te sharA madrarAjena preShitA raNamUrdhani |
sampatantaH sma dRRishyante shalabhAnAM vrajA iva
shlokas.40:
madrarAjadhanurmuktaiH sharaiH kanakabhUShaNaiH |
nirantaramivAkAshaM sambabhUva janAdhipa
shlokas.41:
na pANDavAnAM nAsmAkaM tatra kashchidvyadRRishyata |
bANAndhakAre mahati kRRite tatra mahAbhaye
shlokas.42:
madrarAjena balinA lAghavAchCharavRRiShTibhiH |
loDyamAnaM tathA dRRiShTvA pANDavAnAM balArNavam
vismayaM paramaM jagmurdevagandharvadAnavAH
shlokas.43:
sa tu tAnsarvato yattA~nsharaiH sampIDya mAriSha |
dharmarAjamavachChAdya siMhavadvyanadanmuhuH
shlokas.44:
te ChannAH samare tena pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
na shekustaM tadA yuddhe pratyudyAtuM mahAratham
shlokas.45:
dharmarAjapurogAstu bhImasenamukhA rathAH |
na jahuH samare shUraM shalyamAhavashobhinam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
arjuno drauNinA viddho yuddhe bahubhirAyasaiH |
tasya chAnucharaiH shUraistrigartAnAM mahArathaiH
drauNiM vivyAdha samare tribhireva shilImukhaiH
shlokas.2:
tathetarAnmaheShvAsAndvAbhyAM dvAbhyAM dhana~njayaH |
bhUyashchaiva mahAbAhuH sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.3:
sharakaNTakitAste tu tAvakA bharatarShabha |
na jahuH samare pArthaM vadhyamAnAH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.4:
te.arjunaM rathava.nshena droNaputrapurogamAH |
ayodhayanta samare parivArya mahArathAH
shlokas.5:
taistu kShiptAH sharA rAjankArtasvaravibhUShitAH |
arjunasya rathopasthaM pUrayAmAsura~njasA
shlokas.6:
tathA kRRiShNau maheShvAsau vRRiShabhau sarvadhanvinAm |
sharairvIkShya vitunnA~Ngau prahRRiShTau yuddhadurmadau
shlokas.7:
kUbaraM rathachakrANi IShA yoktrANi chAbhibho |
yugaM chaivAnukarShaM cha sharabhUtamabhUttadA
shlokas.8:
naitAdRRishaM dRRiShTapUrvaM rAjannaiva cha naH shrutam |
yAdRRishaM tatra pArthasya tAvakAH samprachakrire
shlokas.9:
sa rathaH sarvato bhAti chitrapu~NkhaiH shitaiH sharaiH |
ulkAshataiH sampradIptaM vimAnamiva bhUtale
shlokas.10:
tato.arjuno mahArAja sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
avAkirattAM pRRitanAM megho vRRiShTyA yathAchalam
shlokas.11:
te vadhyamAnAH samare pArthanAmA~NkitaiH sharaiH |
pArthabhUtamamanyanta prekShamANAstathAvidham
shlokas.12:
tato.adbhutasharajvAlo dhanuHshabdAnilo mahAn |
senendhanaM dadAhAshu tAvakaM pArthapAvakaH
shlokas.13:
chakrANAM patatAM chaiva yugAnAM cha dharAtale |
tUNIrANAM patAkAnAM dhvajAnAM cha rathaiH saha
shlokas.14:
IShANAmanukarShANAM triveNUnAM cha bhArata |
akShANAmatha yoktrANAM pratodAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.15:
shirasAM patatAM chaiva kuNDaloShNIShadhAriNAm |
bhujAnAM cha mahArAja skandhAnAM cha samantataH
shlokas.16:
ChatrANAM vyajanaiH sArdhaM mukuTAnAM cha rAshayaH |
samadRRishyanta pArthasya rathamArgeShu bhArata
shlokas.17:
agamyarUpA pRRithivI mA.nsashoNitakardamA |
babhUva bharatashreShTha rudrasyAkrIDanaM yathA
bhIrUNAM trAsajananI shUrANAM harShavardhanI
shlokas.18:
hatvA tu samare pArthaH sahasre dve parantapa |
rathAnAM savarUthAnAM vidhUmo.agniriva jvalan
shlokas.19:
yathA hi bhagavAnagnirjagaddagdhvA charAcharam |
vidhUmo dRRishyate rAja.nstathA pArtho mahArathaH
shlokas.20:
drauNistu samare dRRiShTvA pANDavasya parAkramam |
rathenAtipatAkena pANDavaM pratyavArayat
shlokas.21:
tAvubhau puruShavyAghrau shvetAshvau dhanvinAM varau |
samIyatustadA tUrNaM parasparavadhaiShiNau
shlokas.22:
tayorAsInmahArAja bANavarShaM sudAruNam |
jImUtAnAM yathA vRRiShTistapAnte bharatarShabha
shlokas.23:
anyonyaspardhinau tau tu sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
tatakShaturmRRidhe.anyonyaM shRRi~NgAbhyAM vRRiShabhAviva
shlokas.24:
tayoryuddhaM mahArAja chiraM samamivAbhavat |
astrANAM sa~Ngamashchaiva ghorastatrAbhavanmahAn
shlokas.25:
tato.arjunaM dvAdashabhI rukmapu~NkhaiH sutejanaiH |
vAsudevaM cha dashabhirdrauNirvivyAdha bhArata
shlokas.26:
tataH prahasya bIbhatsurvyAkShipadgANDivaM dhanuH |
mAnayitvA muhUrtaM cha guruputraM mahAhave
shlokas.27:
vyashvasUtarathaM chakre savyasAchI mahArathaH |
mRRidupUrvaM tatashchainaM tribhirvivyAdha sAyakaiH
shlokas.28:
hatAshve tu rathe tiShThandroNaputrastvayasmayam |
musalaM pANDuputrAya chikShepa parighopamam
shlokas.29:
tamApatantaM sahasA hemapaTTavibhUShitam |
chichCheda saptadhA vIraH pArthaH shatrunibarhaNaH
shlokas.30:
sa chChinnaM musalaM dRRiShTvA drauNiH paramakopanaH |
Adade parighaM ghoraM nagendrashikharopamam
chikShepa chaiva pArthAya drauNiryuddhavishAradaH
shlokas.31:
tamantakamiva kruddhaM parighaM prekShya pANDavaH |
arjunastvarito jaghne pa~nchabhiH sAyakottamaiH
shlokas.32:
sa chChinnaH patito bhUmau pArthabANairmahAhave |
dArayanpRRithivIndrANAM manaH shabdena bhArata
shlokas.33:
tato.aparaistribhirbANairdrauNiM vivyAdha pANDavaH |
so.atividdho balavatA pArthena sumahAbalaH
na sambhrAntastadA drauNiH pauruShe sve vyavasthitaH
shlokas.34:
sudharmA tu tato rAjanbhAradvAjaM mahAratham |
avAkirachCharavrAtaiH sarvakShatrasya pashyataH
shlokas.35:
tatastu suratho.apyAjau pA~nchAlAnAM mahArathaH |
rathena meghaghoSheNa drauNimevAbhyadhAvata
shlokas.36:
vikarShanvai dhanuH shreShThaM sarvabhArasahaM dRRiDham |
jvalanAshIviShanibhaiH sharaishchainamavAkirat
shlokas.37:
surathaM tu tataH kruddhamApatantaM mahAratham |
chukopa samare drauNirdaNDAhata ivoragaH
shlokas.38:
trishikhAM bhrukuTIM kRRitvA sRRikkiNI parilelihan |
udvIkShya surathaM roShAddhanurjyAmavamRRijya cha
mumocha tIkShNaM nArAchaM yamadaNDasamadyutim
shlokas.39:
sa tasya hRRidayaM bhittvA praviveshAtivegataH |
shakrAshanirivotsRRiShTA vidArya dharaNItalam
shlokas.40:
tatastaM patitaM bhUmau nArAchena samAhatam |
vajreNeva yathA shRRi~NgaM parvatasya mahAdhanam
shlokas.41:
tasmi.nstu nihate vIre droNaputraH pratApavAn |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM tameva rathinAM varaH
shlokas.42:
tataH sajjo mahArAja drauNirAhavadurmadaH |
arjunaM yodhayAmAsa sa.nshaptakavRRito raNe
shlokas.43:
tatra yuddhaM mahachchAsIdarjunasya paraiH saha |
madhya.ndinagate sUrye yamarAShTravivardhanam
shlokas.44:
tatrAshcharyamapashyAma dRRiShTvA teShAM parAkramam |
yadeko yugapadvIrAnsamayodhayadarjunaH
shlokas.45:
vimardastu mahAnAsIdarjunasya paraiH saha |
shatakratoryathA pUrvaM mahatyA daityasenayA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
duryodhano mahArAja dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
chakratuH sumahadyuddhaM sharashaktisamAkulam
shlokas.2:
tayorAsanmahArAja sharadhArAH sahasrashaH |
ambudAnAM yathA kAle jaladhArAH samantataH
shlokas.3:
rAjA tu pArShataM viddhvA sharaiH pa~nchabhirAyasaiH |
droNahantAramugreShuH punarvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.4:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu samare balavAndRRiDhavikramaH |
saptatyA vishikhAnAM vai duryodhanamapIDayat
shlokas.5:
pIDitaM prekShya rAjAnaM sodaryA bharatarShabha |
mahatyA senayA sArdhaM parivavruH sma pArShatam
shlokas.6:
sa taiH parivRRitaH shUraiH sarvato.atirathairbhRRisham |
vyacharatsamare rAjandarshayanhastalAghavam
shlokas.7:
shikhaNDI kRRitavarmANaM gautamaM cha mahAratham |
prabhadrakaiH samAyukto yodhayAmAsa dhanvinau
shlokas.8:
tatrApi sumahadyuddhaM ghorarUpaM vishAM pate |
prANAnsantyajatAM yuddhe prANadyUtAbhidevane
shlokas.9:
shalyastu sharavarShANi vimu~nchansarvatodisham |
pANDavAnpIDayAmAsa sasAtyakivRRikodarAn
shlokas.10:
tathobhau cha yamau yuddhe yamatulyaparAkramau |
yodhayAmAsa rAjendra vIryeNa cha balena cha
shlokas.11:
shalyasAyakanunnAnAM pANDavAnAM mahAmRRidhe |
trAtAraM nAdhyagachChanta kechittatra mahArathAH
shlokas.12:
tatastu nakulaH shUro dharmarAje prapIDite |
abhidudrAva vegena mAtulaM mAdrinandanaH
shlokas.13:
sa~nChAdya samare shalyaM nakulaH paravIrahA |
vivyAdha chainaM dashabhiH smayamAnaH stanAntare
shlokas.14:
sarvapArashavairbANaiH karmAraparimArjitaiH |
svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAdhautairdhanuryantraprachoditaiH
shlokas.15:
shalyastu pIDitastena svasrIyeNa mahAtmanA |
nakulaM pIDayAmAsa patribhirnataparvabhiH
shlokas.16:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA bhImaseno.atha sAtyakiH |
sahadevashcha mAdreyo madrarAjamupAdravan
shlokas.17:
tAnApatata evAshu pUrayAnAnrathasvanaiH |
dishashcha pradishashchaiva kampayAnA.nshcha medinIm
pratijagrAha samare senApatiramitrajit
shlokas.18:
yudhiShThiraM tribhirviddhvA bhImasenaM cha saptabhiH |
sAtyakiM cha shatenAjau sahadevaM tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.19:
tatastu sasharaM chApaM nakulasya mahAtmanaH |
madreshvaraH kShurapreNa tadA chichCheda mAriSha
tadashIryata vichChinnaM dhanuH shalyasya sAyakaiH
shlokas.20:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya mAdrIputro mahArathaH |
madrarAjarathaM tUrNaM pUrayAmAsa patribhiH
shlokas.21:
yudhiShThirastu madreshaM sahadevashcha mAriSha |
dashabhirdashabhirbANairurasyenamavidhyatAm
shlokas.22:
bhImasenastataH ShaShTyA sAtyakirnavabhiH sharaiH |
madrarAjamabhidrutya jaghnatuH ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.23:
madrarAjastataH kruddhaH sAtyakiM navabhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha bhUyaH saptatyA sharANAM nataparvaNAm
shlokas.24:
athAsya sasharaM chApaM muShTau chichCheda mAriSha |
hayA.nshcha chaturaH sa~Nkhye preShayAmAsa mRRityave
shlokas.25:
virathaM sAtyakiM kRRitvA madrarAjo mahAbalaH |
vishikhAnAM shatenainamAjaghAna samantataH
shlokas.26:
mAdrIputrau tu sa.nrabdhau bhImasenaM cha pANDavam |
yudhiShThiraM cha kauravya vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.27:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma madrarAjasya pauruSham |
yadenaM sahitAH pArthA nAbhyavartanta sa.nyuge
shlokas.28:
athAnyaM rathamAsthAya sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
pIDitAnpANDavAndRRiShTvA madrarAjavashaM gatAn
abhidudrAva vegena madrANAmadhipaM balI
shlokas.29:
ApatantaM rathaM tasya shalyaH samitishobhanaH |
pratyudyayau rathenaiva matto mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.30:
sa saMnipAtastumulo babhUvAdbhutadarshanaH |
sAtyakeshchaiva shUrasya madrANAmadhipasya cha
yAdRRisho vai purA vRRittaH shambarAmararAjayoH
shlokas.31:
sAtyakiH prekShya samare madrarAjaM vyavasthitam |
vivyAdha dashabhirbANaistiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.32:
madrarAjastu subhRRishaM viddhastena mahAtmanA |
sAtyakiM prativivyAdha chitrapu~NkhaiH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.33:
tataH pArthA maheShvAsAH sAtvatAbhisRRitaM nRRipam |
abhyadravanrathaistUrNaM mAtulaM vadhakAmyayA
shlokas.34:
tata AsItparAmardastumulaH shoNitodakaH |
shUrANAM yudhyamAnAnAM siMhAnAmiva nardatAm
shlokas.35:
teShAmAsInmahArAja vyatikShepaH parasparam |
siMhAnAmAmiShepsUnAM kUjatAmiva sa.nyuge
shlokas.36:
teShAM bANasahasraughairAkIrNA vasudhAbhavat |
antarikShaM cha sahasA bANabhUtamabhUttadA
shlokas.37:
sharAndhakAraM bahudhA kRRitaM tatra samantataH |
abhrachChAyeva sa~njaj~ne sharairmuktairmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.38:
tatra rAja~nsharairmuktairnirmuktairiva pannagaiH |
svarNapu~NkhaiH prakAshadbhirvyarochanta dishastathA
shlokas.39:
tatrAdbhutaM paraM chakre shalyaH shatrunibarhaNaH |
yadekaH samare shUro yodhayAmAsa vai bahUn
shlokas.40:
madrarAjabhujotsRRiShTaiH ka~NkabarhiNavAjitaiH |
sampatadbhiH sharairghorairavAkIryata medinI
shlokas.41:
tatra shalyarathaM rAjanvicharantaM mahAhave |
apashyAma yathA pUrvaM shakrasyAsurasa~NkShaye

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH sainyAstava vibho madrarAjapuraskRRitAH |
punarabhyadravanpArthAnvegena mahatA raNe
shlokas.2:
pIDitAstAvakAH sarve pradhAvanto raNotkaTAH |
kShaNenaiva cha pArthA.nste bahutvAtsamaloDayan
shlokas.3:
te vadhyamAnAH kurubhiH pANDavA nAvatasthire |
nivAryamANA bhImena pashyatoH kRRiShNapArthayoH
shlokas.4:
tato dhana~njayaH kruddhaH kRRipaM saha padAnugaiH |
avAkirachCharaugheNa kRRitavarmANameva cha
shlokas.5:
shakuniM sahadevastu sahasainyamavArayat |
nakulaH pArshvataH sthitvA madrarAjamavaikShata
shlokas.6:
draupadeyA narendrA.nshcha bhUyiShThaM samavArayan |
droNaputraM cha pA~nchAlyaH shikhaNDI samavArayat
shlokas.7:
bhImasenastu rAjAnaM gadApANiravArayat |
shalyaM tu saha sainyena kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.8:
tataH samabhavadyuddhaM sa.nsaktaM tatra tatra ha |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha sa~NgrAmeShvanivartinAm
shlokas.9:
tatra pashyAmahe karma shalyasyAtimahadraNe |
yadekaH sarvasainyAni pANDavAnAmayudhyata
shlokas.10:
vyadRRishyata tadA shalyo yudhiShThirasamIpataH |
raNe chandramaso.abhyAshe shanaishchara iva grahaH
shlokas.11:
pIDayitvA tu rAjAnaM sharairAshIviShopamaiH |
abhyadhAvatpunarbhImaM sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.12:
tasya tallAghavaM dRRiShTvA tathaiva cha kRRitAstratAm |
apUjayannanIkAni pareShAM tAvakAni cha
shlokas.13:
pIDyamAnAstu shalyena pANDavA bhRRishavikShatAH |
prAdravanta raNaM hitvA kroshamAne yudhiShThire
shlokas.14:
vadhyamAneShvanIkeShu madrarAjena pANDavaH |
amarShavashamApanno dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
tataH pauruShamAsthAya madrarAjamapIDayat
shlokas.15:
jayo vAstu vadho veti kRRitabuddhirmahArathaH |
samAhUyAbravItsarvAnbhrAtR^InkRRiShNaM cha mAdhavam
shlokas.16:
bhIShmo droNashcha karNashcha ye chAnye pRRithivIkShitaH |
kauravArthe parAkrAntAH sa~NgrAme nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.17:
yathAbhAgaM yathotsAhaM bhavantaH kRRitapauruShAH |
bhAgo.avashiShTa eko.ayaM mama shalyo mahArathaH
shlokas.18:
so.ahamadya yudhA jetumAsha.nse madrakeshvaram |
tatra yanmAnasaM mahyaM tatsarvaM nigadAmi vaH
shlokas.19:
chakrarakShAvimau shUrau mama mAdravatIsutau |
ajeyau vAsavenApi samare vIrasaMmatau
shlokas.20:
