sAdhvimau mAtulaM yuddhe kShatradharmapuraskRRitau |
madarthaM pratiyudhyetAM mAnArhau satyasa~Ngarau
shlokas.21:
mAM vA shalyo raNe hantA taM vAhaM bhadramastu vaH |
iti satyAmimAM vANIM lokavIrA nibodhata
shlokas.22:
yotsye.ahaM mAtulenAdya kShatradharmeNa pArthivAH |
svayaM samabhisandhAya vijayAyetarAya vA
shlokas.23:
tasya me.abhyadhikaM shastraM sarvopakaraNAni cha |
sa.nyu~njantu raNe kShipraM shAstravadrathayojakAH
shlokas.24:
shaineyo dakShiNaM chakraM dhRRiShTadyumnastathottaram |
pRRiShThagopo bhavatvadya mama pArtho dhana~njayaH
shlokas.25:
puraHsaro mamAdyAstu bhImaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
evamabhyadhikaH shalyAdbhaviShyAmi mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.26:
evamuktAstathA chakruH sarve rAj~naH priyaiShiNaH |
tataH praharShaH sainyAnAM punarAsIttadA nRRipa
shlokas.27:
pA~nchAlAnAM somakAnAM matsyAnAM cha visheShataH |
pratij~nAM tAM cha sa~NgrAme dharmarAjasya pUrayan
shlokas.28:
tataH sha~NkhA.nshcha bherIshcha shatashashchaiva puShkarAn |
avAdayanta pA~nchAlAH siMhanAdA.nshcha nedire
shlokas.29:
te.abhyadhAvanta sa.nrabdhA madrarAjaM tarasvinaH |
mahatA harShajenAtha nAdena kurupu~NgavAH
shlokas.30:
hrAdena gajaghaNTAnAM sha~NkhAnAM ninadena cha |
tUryashabdena mahatA nAdayantashcha medinIm
shlokas.31:
tAnpratyagRRihNAtputraste madrarAjashcha vIryavAn |
mahAmeghAniva bahU~nshailAvastodayAvubhau
shlokas.32:
shalyastu samarashlAghI dharmarAjamari.ndamam |
vavarSha sharavarSheNa varSheNa maghavAniva
shlokas.33:
tathaiva kururAjo.api pragRRihya ruchiraM dhanuH |
droNopadeshAnvividhAndarshayAno mahAmanAH
shlokas.34:
vavarSha sharavarShANi chitraM laghu cha suShThu cha |
na chAsya vivaraM kashchiddadarsha charato raNe
shlokas.35:
tAvubhau vividhairbANaistatakShAte parasparam |
shArdUlAvAmiShaprepsU parAkrAntAvivAhave
shlokas.36:
bhImastu tava putreNa raNashauNDena sa~NgataH |
pA~nchAlyaH sAtyakishchaiva mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shakunipramukhAnvIrAnpratyagRRihNansamantataH
shlokas.37:
tadAsIttumulaM yuddhaM punareva jayaiShiNAm |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha rAjandurmantrite tava
shlokas.38:
duryodhanastu bhImasya shareNAnataparvaNA |
chichChedAdishya sa~NgrAme dhvajaM hemavibhUShitam
shlokas.39:
saki~NkiNIkajAlena mahatA chArudarshanaH |
papAta ruchiraH siMho bhImasenasya nAnadan
shlokas.40:
punashchAsya dhanushchitraM gajarAjakaropamam |
kShureNa shitadhAreNa prachakarta narAdhipaH
shlokas.41:
sa chChinnadhanvA tejasvI rathashaktyA sutaM tava |
bibhedorasi vikramya sa rathopastha Avishat
shlokas.42:
tasminmohamanuprApte punareva vRRikodaraH |
yantureva shiraH kAyAtkShurapreNAharattadA
shlokas.43:
hatasUtA hayAstasya rathamAdAya bhArata |
vyadravanta disho rAjanhAhAkArastadAbhavat
shlokas.44:
tamabhyadhAvattrANArthaM droNaputro mahArathaH |
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha putraM te.abhiparIpsavaH
shlokas.45:
tasminvilulite sainye trastAstasya padAnugAH |
gANDIvadhanvA visphArya dhanustAnahanachCharaiH
shlokas.46:
yudhiShThirastu madreshamabhyadhAvadamarShitaH |
svayaM sa~nchodayannashvAndantavarNAnmanojavAn
shlokas.47:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma kuntIputre yudhiShThire |
purA bhUtvA mRRidurdAnto yattadA dAruNo.abhavat
shlokas.48:
vivRRitAkShashcha kaunteyo vepamAnashcha manyunA |
chichCheda yodhAnnishitaiH sharaiH shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.49:
yAM yAM pratyudyayau senAM tAM tAM jyeShThaH sa pANDavaH |
sharairapAtayadrAjangirInvajrairivottamaiH
shlokas.50:
sAshvasUtadhvajarathAnrathinaH pAtayanbahUn |
AkrIDadeko balavAnpavanastoyadAniva
shlokas.51:
sAshvArohA.nshcha turagAnpattI.nshchaiva sahasrashaH |
vyapothayata sa~NgrAme kruddho rudraH pashUniva
shlokas.52:
shUnyamAyodhanaM kRRitvA sharavarShaiH samantataH |
abhyadravata madreshaM tiShTha shalyeti chAbravIt
shlokas.53:
tasya tachcharitaM dRRiShTvA sa~NgrAme bhImakarmaNaH |
vitresustAvakAH sarve shalyastvenaM samabhyayAt
shlokas.54:
tatastau tu susa.nrabdhau pradhmApya salilodbhavau |
samAhUya tadAnyonyaM bhartsayantau samIyatuH
shlokas.55:
shalyastu sharavarSheNa yudhiShThiramavAkirat |
madrarAjaM cha kaunteyaH sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.56:
vyadRRishyetAM tadA rAjanka~NkapatribhirAhave |
udbhinnarudhirau shUrau madrarAjayudhiShThirau
shlokas.57:
puShpitAviva rejAte vane shalmaliki.nshukA |
dIpyamAnau mahAtmAnau prANayoryuddhadurmadau
shlokas.58:
dRRiShTvA sarvANi sainyAni nAdhyavasya.nstayorjayam |
hatvA madrAdhipaM pArtho bhokShyate.adya vasundharAm
shlokas.59:
shalyo vA pANDavaM hatvA dadyAdduryodhanAya gAm |
itIva nishchayo nAbhUdyodhAnAM tatra bhArata
shlokas.61:
pradakShiNamabhUtsarvaM dharmarAjasya yudhyataH |
tataH sharashataM shalyo mumochAshu yudhiShThire |
dhanushchAsya shitAgreNa bANena nirakRRintata
shlokas.62:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya shalyaM sharashataistribhiH |
avidhyatkArmukaM chAsya kShureNa nirakRRintata
shlokas.63:
athAsya nijaghAnAshvA.nshchaturo nataparvabhiH |
dvAbhyAmatha shitAgrAbhyAmubhau cha pArShNisArathI
shlokas.64:
tato.asya dIpyamAnena pItena nishitena cha |
pramukhe vartamAnasya bhallenApAharaddhvajam
tataH prabhagnaM tatsainyaM dauryodhanamari.ndama
shlokas.65:
tato madrAdhipaM drauNirabhyadhAvattathAkRRitam |
Aropya chainaM svarathaM tvaramANaH pradudruve
shlokas.66:
muhUrtamiva tau gatvA nardamAne yudhiShThire |
sthitvA tato madrapatiranyaM syandanamAsthitaH
shlokas.67:
vidhivatkalpitaM shubhraM mahAmbudaninAdinam |
sajjayantropakaraNaM dviShatAM romaharShaNam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
athAnyaddhanurAdAya balavadvegavattaram |
yudhiShThiraM madrapatirviddhvA siMha ivAnadat
shlokas.2:
tataH sa sharavarSheNa parjanya iva vRRiShTimAn |
abhyavarShadameyAtmA kShatriyAnkShatriyarShabhaH
shlokas.3:
sAtyakiM dashabhirviddhvA bhImasenaM tribhiH sharaiH |
sahadevaM tribhirviddhvA yudhiShThiramapIDayat
shlokas.4:
tA.nstAnanyAnmaheShvAsAnsAshvAnsarathaku~njarAn |
ku~njarAnku~njarArohAnashvAnashvaprayAyinaH
rathA.nshcha rathibhiH sArdhaM jaghAna rathinAM varaH
shlokas.5:
bAhU.nshchichCheda cha tathA sAyudhAnketanAni cha |
chakAra cha mahIM yodhaistIrNAM vedIM kushairiva
shlokas.6:
tathA tamarisainyAni ghnantaM mRRityumivAntakam |
parivavrurbhRRishaM kruddhAH pANDupA~nchAlasomakAH
shlokas.7:
taM bhImasenashcha shineshcha naptA; mAdryAshcha putrau puruShapravIrau |
samAgataM bhImabalena rAj~nA; paryApuranyonyamathAhvayantaH
shlokas.8:
tatastu shUrAH samare narendraM; madreshvaraM prApya yudhAM variShTham |
AvArya chainaM samare nRRivIrA; jaghnuH sharaiH patribhirugravegaiH
shlokas.9:
sa.nrakShito bhImasenena rAjA; mAdrIsutAbhyAmatha mAdhavena |
madrAdhipaM patribhirugravegaiH; stanAntare dharmasuto nijaghne
shlokas.10:
tato raNe tAvakAnAM rathaughAH; samIkShya madrAdhipatiM sharArtam |
paryAvavruH pravarAH sarvashashcha; duryodhanasyAnumate samantAt
shlokas.11:
tato drutaM madrajanAdhipo raNe; yudhiShThiraM saptabhirabhyavidhyat |
taM chApi pArtho navabhiH pRRiShatkai;rvivyAdha rAja.nstumule mahAtmA
shlokas.12:
AkarNapUrNAyatasamprayuktaiH; sharaistadA sa.nyati tailadhautaiH |
anyonyamAchChAdayatAM mahArathau; madrAdhipashchApi yudhiShThirashcha
shlokas.13:
tatastu tUrNaM samare mahArathau; parasparasyAntaramIkShamANau |
sharairbhRRishaM vivyadhaturnRRipottamau; mahAbalau shatrubhirapradhRRiShyau
shlokas.14:
tayordhanurjyAtalanisvano mahA;nmahendravajrAshanitulyanisvanaH |
parasparaM bANagaNairmahAtmanoH; pravarShatormadrapapANDuvIrayoH
shlokas.15:
tau cheraturvyAghrashishuprakAshau; mahAvaneShvAmiShagRRiddhinAviva |
viShANinau nAgavarAvivobhau; tatakShatuH sa.nyugajAtadarpau
shlokas.16:
tatastu madrAdhipatirmahAtmA; yudhiShThiraM bhImabalaM prasahya |
vivyAdha vIraM hRRidaye.ativegaM; shareNa sUryAgnisamaprabheNa
shlokas.17:
tato.atividdho.atha yudhiShThiro.api; susamprayuktena shareNa rAjan |
jaghAna madrAdhipatiM mahAtmA; mudaM cha lebhe RRiShabhaH kurUNAm
shlokas.18:
tato muhUrtAdiva pArthivendro; labdhvA sa~nj~nAM krodhasa.nraktanetraH |
shatena pArthaM tvarito jaghAna; sahasranetrapratimaprabhAvaH
shlokas.19:
tvara.nstato dharmasuto mahAtmA; shalyasya kruddho navabhiH pRRiShatkaiH |
bhittvA hyurastapanIyaM cha varma; jaghAna ShaDbhistvaparaiH pRRiShatkaiH
shlokas.20:
tatastu madrAdhipatiH prahRRiShTo; dhanurvikRRiShya vyasRRijatpRRiShatkAn |
dvAbhyAM kShurAbhyAM cha tathaiva rAj~na;shchichCheda chApaM kurupu~Ngavasya
shlokas.21:
navaM tato.anyatsamare pragRRihya; rAjA dhanurghorataraM mahAtmA |
shalyaM tu viddhvA nishitaiH samantA;dyathA mahendro namuchiM shitAgraiH
shlokas.22:
tatastu shalyo navabhiH pRRiShatkai;rbhImasya rAj~nashcha yudhiShThirasya |
nikRRitya raukme paTuvarmaNI tayo;rvidArayAmAsa bhujau mahAtmA
shlokas.23:
tato.apareNa jvalitArkatejasA; kShureNa rAj~no dhanurunmamAtha |
kRRipashcha tasyaiva jaghAna sUtaM; ShaDbhiH sharaiH so.abhimukhaM papAta
shlokas.24:
madrAdhipashchApi yudhiShThirasya; sharaishchaturbhirnijaghAna vAhAn |
vAhA.nshcha hatvA vyakaronmahAtmA; yodhakShayaM dharmasutasya rAj~naH
shlokas.25:
tathA kRRite rAjani bhImaseno; madrAdhipasyAshu tato mahAtmA |
ChittvA dhanurvegavatA shareNa; dvAbhyAmavidhyatsubhRRishaM narendram
shlokas.26:
athApareNAsya jahAra yantuH; kAyAchChiraH saMnahanIyamadhyAt |
jaghAna chAshvA.nshchaturaH sa shIghraM; tathA bhRRishaM kupito bhImasenaH
shlokas.27:
tamagraNIH sarvadhanurdharANA;mekaM charantaM samare.ativegam |
bhImaH shatena vyakirachCharANAM; mAdrIputraH sahadevastathaiva
shlokas.28:
taiH sAyakairmohitaM vIkShya shalyaM; bhImaH sharairasya chakarta varma |
sa bhImasenena nikRRittavarmA; madrAdhipashcharma sahasratAram
shlokas.29:
pragRRihya khaDgaM cha rathAnmahAtmA; praskandya kuntIsutamabhyadhAvat |
ChittvA ratheShAM nakulasya so.atha; yudhiShThiraM bhImabalo.abhyadhAvat
shlokas.30:
taM chApi rAjAnamathotpatantaM; kruddhaM yathaivAntakamApatantam |
dhRRiShTadyumno draupadeyAH shikhaNDI; shineshcha naptA sahasA parIyuH
shlokas.31:
athAsya charmApratimaM nyakRRinta;dbhImo mahAtmA dashabhiH pRRiShatkaH |
khaDgaM cha bhallairnichakarta muShTau; nadanprahRRiShTastava sainyamadhye
shlokas.32:
tatkarma bhImasya samIkShya hRRiShTA;ste pANDavAnAM pravarA rathaughAH |
nAdaM cha chakrurbhRRishamutsmayantaH; sha~NkhA.nshcha dadhmuH shashisaMnikAshAn
shlokas.33:
tenAtha shabdena vibhIShaNena; tavAbhitaptaM balamaprahRRiShTam |
svedAbhibhUtaM rudhirokShitA~NgaM; visa~nj~nakalpaM cha tathA viShaNNam
shlokas.34:
sa madrarAjaH sahasAvakIrNo; bhImAgragaiH pANDavayodhamukhyaiH |
yudhiShThirasyAbhimukhaM javena; siMho yathA mRRigahetoH prayAtaH
shlokas.35:
sa dharmarAjo nihatAshvasUtaM; krodhena dIptajvalanaprakAsham |
dRRiShTvA tu madrAdhipatiM sa tUrNaM; samabhyadhAvattamariM balena
shlokas.36:
govindavAkyaM tvaritaM vichintya; dadhre matiM shalyavinAshanAya |
sa dharmarAjo nihatAshvasUte; rathe tiShTha~nshaktimevAbhikA~NkShan
shlokas.37:
tachchApi shalyasya nishamya karma; mahAtmano bhAgamathAvashiShTam |
smRRitvA manaH shalyavadhe yatAtmA; yathoktamindrAvarajasya chakre
shlokas.38:
sa dharmarAjo maNihemadaNDAM; jagrAha shaktiM kanakaprakAshAm |
netre cha dIpte sahasA vivRRitya; madrAdhipaM kruddhamanA niraikShat
shlokas.39:
nirIkShito vai naradeva rAj~nA; pUtAtmanA nirhRRitakalmaSheNa |
abhUnna yadbhasmasAnmadrarAja;stadadbhutaM me pratibhAti rAjan
shlokas.40:
tatastu shaktiM ruchirogradaNDAM; maNipravAlojjvalitAM pradIptAm |
chikShepa vegAtsubhRRishaM mahAtmA; madrAdhipAya pravaraH kurUNAm
shlokas.41:
dIptAmathainAM mahatA balena; savisphuli~NgAM sahasA patantIm |
praikShanta sarve kuravaH sametA; yathA yugAnte mahatImivolkAm
shlokas.42:
tAM kAlarAtrImiva pAshahastAM; yamasya dhAtrImiva chograrUpAm |
sabrahmadaNDapratimAmamoghAM; sasarja yatto yudhi dharmarAjaH
shlokas.43:
gandhasragagryAsanapAnabhojanai;rabhyarchitAM pANDusutaiH prayatnAt |
sa.nvartakAgnipratimAM jvalantIM; kRRityAmatharvA~NgirasImivogrAm
shlokas.44:
IshAnahetoH pratinirmitAM tAM; tvaShTrA ripUNAmasudehabhakShAm |
bhUmyantarikShAdijalAshayAni; prasahya bhUtAni nihantumIshAm
shlokas.45:
ghaNTApatAkAmaNivajrabhAjaM; vaiDUryachitrAM tapanIyadaNDAm |
tvaShTrA prayatnAnniyamena kL^iptAM; brahmadviShAmantakarImamoghAm
shlokas.46:
balaprayatnAdadhirUDhavegAM; mantraishcha ghorairabhimantrayitvA |
sasarja mArgeNa cha tAM pareNa; vadhAya madrAdhipatestadAnIm
shlokas.47:
hato.asyasAvityabhigarjamAno; rudro.antakAyAntakaraM yatheShum |
prasArya bAhuM sudRRiDhaM supANiM; krodhena nRRityanniva dharmarAjaH
shlokas.48:
tAM sarvashaktyA prahitAM sa shaktiM; yudhiShThireNAprativAryavIryAm |
pratigrahAyAbhinanarda shalyaH; samyagghutAmagnirivAjyadhArAm
shlokas.49:
sA tasya marmANi vidArya shubhra;muro vishAlaM cha tathaiva varma |
vivesha gAM toyamivAprasaktA; yasho vishAlaM nRRipaterdahantI
shlokas.50:
nAsAkShikarNAsyaviniHsRRitena; prasyandatA cha vraNasambhavena |
sa.nsiktagAtro rudhireNa so.abhU;tkrau~ncho yathA skandahato mahAdriH
shlokas.51:
prasArya bAhU sa rathAdgato gAM; sa~nChinnavarmA kurunandanena |
mahendravAhapratimo mahAtmA; vajrAhataM shRRi~NgamivAchalasya
shlokas.52:
bAhU prasAryAbhimukho dharmarAjasya madrarAT |
tato nipatito bhUmAvindradhvaja ivochChritaH
shlokas.53:
sa tathA bhinnasarvA~Ngo rudhireNa samukShitaH |
pratyudgata iva premNA bhUmyA sa narapu~NgavaH
shlokas.54:
priyayA kAntayA kAntaH patamAna ivorasi |
chiraM bhuktvA vasumatIM priyAM kAntAmiva prabhuH
sarvaira~NgaiH samAshliShya prasupta iva so.abhavat
shlokas.55:
dharmye dharmAtmanA yuddhe nihato dharmasUnunA |
samyagghuta iva sviShTaH prashAnto.agnirivAdhvare
shlokas.56:
shaktyA vibhinnahRRidayaM vipraviddhAyudhadhvajam |
sa.nshAntamapi madreshaM lakShmIrnaiva vyamu~nchata
shlokas.57:
tato yudhiShThirashchApamAdAyendradhanuShprabham |
vyadhamaddviShataH sa~Nkhye khagarADiva pannagAn
dehAsUnnishitairbhallai ripUNAM nAshayankShaNAt
shlokas.58:
tataH pArthasya bANaughairAvRRitAH sainikAstava |
nimIlitAkShAH kShiNvanto bhRRishamanyonyamarditAH
saMnyastakavachA dehairvipatrAyudhajIvitAH
shlokas.59:
tataH shalye nipatite madrarAjAnujo yuvA |
bhrAtuH sarvairguNaistulyo rathI pANDavamabhyayAt
shlokas.60:
vivyAdha cha narashreShTho nArAchairbahubhistvaran |
hatasyApachitiM bhrAtushchikIrShuryuddhadurmadaH
shlokas.61:
taM vivyAdhAshugaiH ShaDbhirdharmarAjastvaranniva |
kArmukaM chAsya chichCheda kShurAbhyAM dhvajameva cha
shlokas.62:
tato.asya dIpyamAnena sudRRiDhena shitena cha |
pramukhe vartamAnasya bhallenApAharachChiraH
shlokas.63:
sakuNDalaM taddadRRishe patamAnaM shiro rathAt |
puNyakShayamiva prApya patantaM svargavAsinam
shlokas.64:
tasyApakRRiShTashIrShaM tachCharIraM patitaM rathAt |
rudhireNAvasiktA~NgaM dRRiShTvA sainyamabhajyata
shlokas.65:
vichitrakavache tasminhate madranRRipAnuje |
hAhAkAraM vikurvANAH kuravo vipradudruvuH
shlokas.66:
shalyAnujaM hataM dRRiShTvA tAvakAstyaktajIvitAH |
vitresuH pANDavabhayAdrajodhvastAstathA bhRRisham
shlokas.69:
tau sametau mahAtmAnau vArShNeyAvaparAjitau |
hArdikyaH sAtyakishchaiva siMhAviva madotkaTau
shlokas.72:
sAtyakiM dashabhirviddhvA hayA.nshchAsya tribhiH sharaiH |
chApamekena chichCheda hArdikyo nataparvaNA
shlokas.73:
tannikRRittaM dhanuH shreShThamapAsya shinipu~NgavaH |
anyadAdatta vegena vegavattaramAyudham
shlokas.74:
tadAdAya dhanuH shreShThaM variShThaH sarvadhanvinAm |
hArdikyaM dashabhirbANaiH pratyavidhyatstanAntare
shlokas.75:
tato rathaM yugeShAM cha ChittvA bhallaiH susa.nyataiH |
ashvA.nstasyAvadhIttUrNamubhau cha pArShNisArathI
shlokas.76:
madrarAje hate rAjanvirathe kRRitavarmaNi |
duryodhanabalaM sarvaM punarAsItparA~Nmukham
shlokas.77:
tatpare nAvabudhyanta sainyena rajasA vRRite |
balaM tu hatabhUyiShThaM tattadAsItparA~Nmukham
shlokas.78:
tato muhUrtAtte.apashyanrajo bhaumaM samutthitam |
vividhaiH shoNitasrAvaiH prashAntaM puruSharShabha
shlokas.79:
tato duryodhano dRRiShTvA bhagnaM svabalamantikAt |
javenApatataH pArthAnekaH sarvAnavArayat
shlokas.80:
pANDavAnsarathAndRRiShTvA dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pArShatam |
AnartaM cha durAdharShaM shitairbANairavAkirat
shlokas.81:
taM pare nAbhyavartanta martyA mRRityumivAgatam |
athAnyaM rathamAsthAya hArdikyo.api nyavartata
shlokas.82:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA tvaramANo mahArathaH |
chaturbhirnijaghAnAshvAnpatribhiH kRRitavarmaNaH
vivyAdha gautamaM chApi ShaDbhirbhallaiH sutejanaiH
shlokas.83:
ashvatthAmA tato rAj~nA hatAshvaM virathIkRRitam |
samapovAha hArdikyaM svarathena yudhiShThirAt
shlokas.84:
tataH shAradvato.aShTAbhiH pratyavidhyadyudhiShThiram |
vivyAdha chAshvAnnishitaistasyAShTAbhiH shilImukhaiH
shlokas.85:
evametanmahArAja yuddhasheShamavartata |
tava durmantrite rAjansahaputrasya bhArata
shlokas.86:
tasminmaheShvAsavare vishaste; sa~NgrAmamadhye kurupu~Ngavena |
pArthAH sametAH paramaprahRRiShTAH; sha~NkhAnpradadhmurhatamIkShya shalyam
shlokas.87:
yudhiShThiraM cha prashasha.nsurAjau; purA surA vRRitravadhe yathendram |
chakrushcha nAnAvidhavAdyashabdA;nninAdayanto vasudhAM samantAt

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shalye tu nihate rAjanmadrarAjapadAnugAH |
rathAH saptashatA vIrA niryayurmahato balAt
shlokas.2:
duryodhanastu dviradamAruhyAchalasaMnibham |
ChatreNa dhriyamANena vIjyamAnashcha chAmaraiH
na gantavyaM na gantavyamiti madrAnavArayat
shlokas.3:
duryodhanena te vIrA vAryamANAH punaH punaH |
yudhiShThiraM jighA.nsantaH pANDUnAM prAvishanbalam
shlokas.4:
te tu shUrA mahArAja kRRitachittAH sma yodhane |
dhanuHshabdaM mahatkRRitvA sahAyudhyanta pANDavaiH
shlokas.5:
shrutvA tu nihataM shalyaM dharmaputraM cha pIDitam |
madrarAjapriye yuktairmadrakANAM mahArathaiH
shlokas.6:
AjagAma tataH pArtho gANDIvaM vikShipandhanuH |
pUrayanrathaghoSheNa dishaH sarvA mahArathaH
shlokas.7:
tato.arjunashcha bhImashcha mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
sAtyakishcha naravyAghro draupadeyAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.8:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha pA~nchAlAH saha somakaiH |
yudhiShThiraM parIpsantaH samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.9:
te samantAtparivRRitAH pANDavaiH puruSharShabhAH |
kShobhayanti sma tAM senAM makarAH sAgaraM yathA
shlokas.10:
purovAtena ga~Ngeva kShobhyamAnA mahAnadI |
akShobhyata tadA rAjanpANDUnAM dhvajinI punaH
shlokas.11:
praskandya senAM mahatIM tyaktAtmAno mahArathAH |
vRRikShAniva mahAvAtAH kampayanti sma tAvakAH
shlokas.12:
bahavashchukrushustatra kva sa rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtaro vAsya te shUrA dRRishyante neha kechana
shlokas.13:
pA~nchAlAnAM mahAvIryAH shikhaNDI cha mahArathaH |
dhRRiShTadyumno.atha shaineyo draupadeyAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.14:
evaM tAnvAdinaH shUrAndraupadeyA mahArathAH |
abhyaghnanyuyudhAnashcha madrarAjapadAnugAn
shlokas.15:
chakrairvimathitaiH kechitkechichChinnairmahAdhvajaiH |
pratyadRRishyanta samare tAvakA nihatAH paraiH
shlokas.16:
Alokya pANDavAnyuddhe yodhA rAjansamantataH |
vAryamANA yayurvegAttava putreNa bhArata
shlokas.17:
duryodhanastu tAnvIrAnvArayAmAsa sAntvayan |
na chAsya shAsanaM kashchittatra chakre mahArathaH
shlokas.18:
tato gAndhArarAjasya putraH shakunirabravIt |
duryodhanaM mahArAja vachanaM vachanakShamaH
shlokas.19:
kiM naH samprekShamANAnAM madrANAM hanyate balam |
na yuktametatsamare tvayi tiShThati bhArata
shlokas.20:
sahitairnAma yoddhavyamityeSha samayaH kRRitaH |
atha kasmAtparAneva ghnato marShayase nRRipa
shlokas.21:
duryodhana uvAcha||
vAryamANA mayA pUrvaM naite chakrurvacho mama |
ete hi nihatAH sarve praskannAH pANDuvAhinIm
shlokas.22:
shakuniruvAcha||
na bhartuH shAsanaM vIrA raNe kurvantyamarShitAH |
alaM kroddhuM tathaiteShAM nAyaM kAla upekShitum
shlokas.23:
yAmaH sarve.atra sambhUya savAjirathaku~njarAH |
paritrAtuM maheShvAsAnmadrarAjapadAnugAn
shlokas.24:
anyonyaM parirakShAmo yatnena mahatA nRRipa |
evaM sarve.anusa~nchintya prayayuryatra sainikAH
shlokas.25:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktastato rAjA balena mahatA vRRitaH |
prayayau siMhanAdena kampayanvai vasundharAm
shlokas.26:
hata vidhyata gRRihNIta praharadhvaM nikRRintata |
ityAsIttumulaH shabdastava sainyasya bhArata
shlokas.27:
pANDavAstu raNe dRRiShTvA madrarAjapadAnugAn |
sahitAnabhyavartanta gulmamAsthAya madhyamam
shlokas.28:
te muhUrtAdraNe vIrA hastAhastaM vishAM pate |
nihatAH pratyadRRishyanta madrarAjapadAnugAH
shlokas.29:
tato naH samprayAtAnAM hatAmitrAstarasvinaH |
hRRiShTAH kilakilAshabdamakurvansahitAH pare
shlokas.30:
athotthitAni ruNDAni samadRRishyanta sarvashaH |
papAta mahatI cholkA madhyenAdityamaNDalam
shlokas.31:
rathairbhagnairyugAkShaishcha nihataishcha mahArathaiH |
ashvairnipatitaishchaiva sa~nChannAbhUdvasundharA
shlokas.32:
vAtAyamAnaisturagairyugAsaktaistura~NgamaiH |
adRRishyanta mahArAja yodhAstatra raNAjire
shlokas.33:
bhagnachakrAnrathAnkechidavaha.nsturagA raNe |
rathArdhaM kechidAdAya disho dasha vibabhramuH
tatra tatra cha dRRishyante yoktraiH shliShTAH sma vAjinaH
shlokas.34:
rathinaH patamAnAshcha vyadRRishyanta narottama |
gaganAtprachyutAH siddhAH puNyAnAmiva sa~NkShaye
shlokas.35:
nihateShu cha shUreShu madrarAjAnugeShu cha |
asmAnApatatashchApi dRRiShTvA pArthA mahArathAH
shlokas.36:
abhyavartanta vegena jayagRRidhrAH prahAriNaH |
bANashabdaravAnkRRitvA vimishrA~nsha~NkhanisvanaiH
shlokas.37:
asmA.nstu punarAsAdya labdhalakShAH prahAriNaH |
sharAsanAni dhunvAnAH siMhanAdAnprachukrushuH
shlokas.38:
tato hatamabhiprekShya madrarAjabalaM mahat |
madrarAjaM cha samare dRRiShTvA shUraM nipAtitam
duryodhanabalaM sarvaM punarAsItparA~Nmukham
shlokas.39:
vadhyamAnaM mahArAja pANDavairjitakAshibhiH |
disho bheje.atha sambhrAntaM trAsitaM dRRiDhadhanvibhiH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pAtite yudhi durdharShe madrarAje mahArathe |
tAvakAstava putrAshcha prAyasho vimukhAbhavan
shlokas.2:
vaNijo nAvi bhinnAyAM yathAgAdhe.aplave.arNave |
apAre pAramichChanto hate shUre mahAtmani
shlokas.3:
madrarAje mahArAja vitrastAH sharavikShatAH |
anAthA nAthamichChanto mRRigAH siMhArditA iva
shlokas.4:
vRRiShA yathA bhagnashRRi~NgAH shIrNadantA gajA iva |
madhyAhne pratyapAyAma nirjitA dharmasUnunA
shlokas.5:
na sandhAtumanIkAni na cha rAjanparAkrame |
AsIdbuddhirhate shalye tava yodhasya kasyachit
shlokas.6:
bhIShme droNe cha nihate sUtaputre cha bhArata |
yadduHkhaM tava yodhAnAM bhayaM chAsIdvishAM pate
tadbhayaM sa cha naH shoko bhUya evAbhyavartata
shlokas.7:
nirAshAshcha jaye tasminhate shalye mahArathe |
hatapravIrA vidhvastA vikRRittAshcha shitaiH sharaiH
madrarAje hate rAjanyodhAste prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.8:
ashvAnanye gajAnanye rathAnanye mahArathAH |
Aruhya javasampannAH pAdAtAH prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.9:
dvisAhasrAshcha mAta~NgA girirUpAH prahAriNaH |
samprAdravanhate shalye a~NkushA~NguShThachoditAH
shlokas.10:
te raNAdbharatashreShTha tAvakAH prAdravandishaH |
dhAvantashchApyadRRishyanta shvasamAnAH sharAturAH
shlokas.11:
tAnprabhagnAndrutAndRRiShTvA hatotsAhAnparAjitAn |
abhyadravanta pA~nchAlAH pANDavAshcha jayaiShiNaH
shlokas.12:
bANashabdaravashchApi siMhanAdashcha puShkalaH |
sha~Nkhashabdashcha shUrANAM dAruNaH samapadyata
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvA tu kauravaM sainyaM bhayatrastaM pravidrutam |
anyonyaM samabhAShanta pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.14:
adya rAjA satyadhRRitirjitAmitro yudhiShThiraH |
adya duryodhano hIno dIptayA nRRipatishriyA
shlokas.15:
adya shrutvA hataM putraM dhRRitarAShTro janeshvaraH |
niHsa~nj~naH patito bhUmau kilbiShaM pratipadyatAm
shlokas.16:
adya jAnAtu kaunteyaM samarthaM sarvadhanvinAm |
adyAtmAnaM cha durmedhA garhayiShyati pApakRRit
adya kShatturvachaH satyaM smaratAM bruvato hitam
shlokas.17:
adyaprabhRRiti pArthA.nshcha preShyabhUta upAcharan |
vijAnAtu nRRipo duHkhaM yatprAptaM pANDunandanaiH
shlokas.18:
adya kRRiShNasya mAhAtmyaM jAnAtu sa mahIpatiH |
adyArjunadhanurghoShaM ghoraM jAnAtu sa.nyuge
shlokas.19:
astrANAM cha balaM sarvaM bAhvoshcha balamAhave |
adya j~nAsyati bhImasya balaM ghoraM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
hate duryodhane yuddhe shakreNevAsure maye |
yatkRRitaM bhImasenena duHshAsanavadhe tadA
nAnyaH kartAsti loke tadRRite bhImaM mahAbalam
shlokas.21:
jAnItAmadya jyeShThasya pANDavasya parAkramam |
madrarAjaM hataM shrutvA devairapi suduHsaham
shlokas.22:
adya j~nAsyati sa~NgrAme mAdrIputrau mahAbalau |
nihate saubale shUre gAndhAreShu cha sarvashaH
shlokas.23:
kathaM teShAM jayo na syAdyeShAM yoddhA dhana~njayaH |
sAtyakirbhImasenashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH
shlokas.24:
draupadyAstanayAH pa~ncha mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
shikhaNDI cha maheShvAso rAjA chaiva yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.25:
yeShAM cha jagatAM nAtho nAthaH kRRiShNo janArdanaH |
kathaM teShAM jayo na syAdyeShAM dharmo vyapAshrayaH
shlokas.26:
bhIShmaM droNaM cha karNaM cha madrarAjAnameva cha |
tathAnyAnnRRipatInvIrA~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.27:
ko.anyaH shakto raNe jetumRRite pArthaM yudhiShThiram |
yasya nAtho hRRiShIkeshaH sadA dharmayashonidhiH
shlokas.28:
ityevaM vadamAnAste harSheNa mahatA yutAH |
prabhagnA.nstAvakAnrAjansRRi~njayAH pRRiShThato.anvayuH
shlokas.29:
dhana~njayo rathAnIkamabhyavartata vIryavAn |
mAdrIputrau cha shakuniM sAtyakishcha mahArathaH
shlokas.30:
tAnprekShya dravataH sarvAnbhImasenabhayArditAn |
duryodhanastadA sUtamabravIdutsmayanniva
shlokas.31:
na mAtikramate pArtho dhanuShpANimavasthitam |
jaghane sarvasainyAnAM mamAshvAnpratipAdaya
shlokas.32:
jaghane yudhyamAnaM hi kaunteyo mAM dhana~njayaH |
notsahetAbhyatikrAntuM velAmiva mahodadhiH
shlokas.33:
pashya sainyaM mahatsUta pANDavaiH samabhidrutam |
sainyareNuM samuddhUtaM pashyasvainaM samantataH
shlokas.34:
siMhanAdA.nshcha bahushaH shRRiNu ghorAnbhayAnakAn |
tasmAdyAhi shanaiH sUta jaghanaM paripAlaya
shlokas.35:
mayi sthite cha samare niruddheShu cha pANDuShu |
punarAvartate tUrNaM mAmakaM balamojasA
shlokas.36:
tachChrutvA tava putrasya shUrAgryasadRRishaM vachaH |
sArathirhemasa~nChannA~nshanairashvAnachodayat
shlokas.37:
gajAshvarathibhirhInAstyaktAtmAnaH padAtayaH |
ekavi.nshatisAhasrAH sa.nyugAyAvatasthire
shlokas.38:
nAnAdeshasamudbhUtA nAnAra~njitavAsasaH |
avasthitAstadA yodhAH prArthayanto mahadyashaH
shlokas.39:
teShAmApatatAM tatra saMhRRiShTAnAM parasparam |
saMmardaH sumahA~njaj~ne ghorarUpo bhayAnakaH
shlokas.40:
bhImasenaM tadA rAjandhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pArShatam |
balena chatura~NgeNa nAnAdeshyA nyavArayan
shlokas.41:
bhImamevAbhyavartanta raNe.anye tu padAtayaH |
prakShveDyAsphoTya saMhRRiShTA vIralokaM yiyAsavaH
shlokas.42:
AsAdya bhImasenaM tu sa.nrabdhA yuddhadurmadAH |
dhArtarAShTrA vinedurhi nAnyAM chAkathayankathAm
parivArya raNe bhImaM nijaghnuste samantataH
shlokas.43:
sa vadhyamAnaH samare padAtigaNasa.nvRRitaH |
na chachAla rathopasthe mainAka iva parvataH
shlokas.44:
te tu kruddhA mahArAja pANDavasya mahAratham |
nigrahItuM prachakrurhi yodhA.nshchAnyAnavArayan
shlokas.45:
akrudhyata raNe bhImastaistadA paryavasthitaiH |
so.avatIrya rathAttUrNaM padAtiH samavasthitaH
shlokas.46:
jAtarUpaparichChannAM pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm |
avadhIttAvakAnyodhAndaNDapANirivAntakaH
shlokas.47:
rathAshvadvipahInA.nstu tAnbhImo gadayA balI |
ekavi.nshatisAhasrAnpadAtInavapothayat
shlokas.48:
hatvA tatpuruShAnIkaM bhImaH satyaparAkramaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM puraskRRitya nachirAtpratyadRRishyata
shlokas.49:
pAdAtA nihatA bhUmau shishyire rudhirokShitAH |
sambhagnA iva vAtena karNikArAH supuShpitAH
shlokas.50:
nAnApuShpasrajopetA nAnAkuNDaladhAriNaH |
nAnAjAtyA hatAstatra nAnAdeshasamAgatAH
shlokas.51:
patAkAdhvajasa~nChannaM padAtInAM mahadbalam |
nikRRittaM vibabhau tatra ghorarUpaM bhayAnakam
shlokas.52:
yudhiShThirapurogAstu sarvasainyamahArathAH |
abhyadhAvanmahAtmAnaM putraM duryodhanaM tava
shlokas.53:
te sarve tAvakAndRRiShTvA maheShvAsAnparA~NmukhAn |
nAbhyavartanta te putraM veleva makarAlayam
shlokas.54:
tadadbhutamapashyAma tava putrasya pauruSham |
yadekaM sahitAH pArthA na shekurativartitum
shlokas.55:
nAtidUrApayAtaM tu kRRitabuddhiM palAyane |
duryodhanaH svakaM sainyamabravIdbhRRishavikShatam
shlokas.56:
na taM deshaM prapashyAmi pRRithivyAM parvateShu vA |
yatra yAtAnna vo hanyuH pANDavAH kiM sRRitena vaH
shlokas.57:
alpaM cha balameteShAM kRRiShNau cha bhRRishavikShatau |
yadi sarve.atra tiShThAmo dhruvo no vijayo bhavet
shlokas.58:
viprayAtA.nstu vo bhinnAnpANDavAH kRRitakilbiShAn |
anusRRitya haniShyanti shreyo naH samare sthitam
shlokas.59:
shRRiNudhvaM kShatriyAH sarve yAvantaH stha samAgatAH |
yadA shUraM cha bhIruM cha mArayatyantakaH sadA
ko nu mUDho na yudhyeta puruShaH kShatriyabruvaH
shlokas.60:
shreyo no bhImasenasya kruddhasya pramukhe sthitam |
sukhaH sA~NgrAmiko mRRityuH kShatradharmeNa yudhyatAm
jitveha sukhamApnoti hataH pretya mahatphalam
shlokas.61:
na yuddhadharmAchChreyAnvai panthAH svargasya kauravAH |
achireNa jitA.NllokAnhato yuddhe samashnute
shlokas.62:
shrutvA tu vachanaM tasya pUjayitvA cha pArthivAH |
punarevAnvavartanta pANDavAnAtatAyinaH
shlokas.63:
tAnApatata evAshu vyUDhAnIkAH prahAriNaH |
pratyudyayustadA pArthA jayagRRidhrAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.64:
dhana~njayo rathenAjAvabhyavartata vIryavAn |
vishrutaM triShu lokeShu gANDIvaM vikShipandhanuH
shlokas.65:
mAdrIputrau cha shakuniM sAtyakishcha mahAbalaH |
javenAbhyapatanhRRiShTA yato vai tAvakaM balam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
saMnivRRitte balaughe tu shAlvo mlechChagaNAdhipaH |
abhyavartata sa~NkruddhaH pANDUnAM sumahadbalam
shlokas.2:
AsthAya sumahAnAgaM prabhinnaM parvatopamam |
dRRiptamairAvataprakhyamamitragaNamardanam
shlokas.3:
yo.asau mahAbhadrakulaprasUtaH; supUjito dhArtarAShTreNa nityam |
sukalpitaH shAstravinishchayaj~naiH; sadopavAhyaH samareShu rAjan
shlokas.4:
tamAsthito rAjavaro babhUva; yathodayasthaH savitA kShapAnte |
sa tena nAgapravareNa rAja;nnabhyudyayau pANDusutAnsamantAt
shitaiH pRRiShatkairvidadAra chApi; mahendravajrapratimaiH sughoraiH
shlokas.5:
tataH sharAnvai sRRijato mahAraNe; yodhA.nshcha rAjannayato yamAya |
nAsyAntaraM dadRRishuH sve pare vA; yathA purA vajradharasya daityAH
shlokas.6:
te pANDavAH somakAH sRRi~njayAshcha; tameva nAgaM dadRRishuH samantAt |
sahasrasho vai vicharantamekaM; yathA mahendrasya gajaM samIpe
shlokas.7:
sa.ndrAvyamANaM tu balaM pareShAM; parItakalpaM vibabhau samantAt |
naivAvatasthe samare bhRRishaM bhayA;dvimardamAnaM tu parasparaM tadA
shlokas.8:
tataH prabhagnA sahasA mahAchamUH; sA pANDavI tena narAdhipena |
dishashchatasraH sahasA pradhAvitA; gajendravegaM tamapArayantI
shlokas.9:
dRRiShTvA cha tAM vegavatA prabhagnAM; sarve tvadIyA yudhi yodhamukhyAH |
apUjaya.nstatra narAdhipaM taM; dadhmushcha sha~NkhA~nshashisaMnikAshAn
shlokas.10:
shrutvA ninAdaM tvatha kauravANAM; harShAdvimuktaM saha sha~NkhashabdaiH |
senApatiH pANDavasRRi~njayAnAM; pA~nchAlaputro na mamarSha roShAt
shlokas.11:
tatastu taM vai dviradaM mahAtmA; pratyudyayau tvaramANo jayAya |
jambho yathA shakrasamAgame vai; nAgendramairAvaNamindravAhyam
shlokas.12:
tamApatantaM sahasA tu dRRiShTvA; pA~nchAlarAjaM yudhi rAjasiMhaH |
taM vai dvipaM preShayAmAsa tUrNaM; vadhAya rAjandrupadAtmajasya
shlokas.13:
sa taM dvipaM sahasAbhyApatanta;mavidhyadarkapratimaiH pRRiShatkaiH |
karmAradhautairnishitairjvaladbhi;rnArAchamukhyaistribhirugravegaiH
shlokas.14:
tato.aparAnpa~ncha shitAnmahAtmA; nArAchamukhyAnvisasarja kumbhe |
sa taistu viddhaH paramadvipo raNe; tadA parAvRRitya bhRRishaM pradudruve
shlokas.15:
taM nAgarAjaM sahasA praNunnaM; vidrAvyamANaM cha nigRRihya shAlvaH |
tottrA~NkushaiH preShayAmAsa tUrNaM; pA~nchAlarAjasya rathaM pradishya
shlokas.16:
dRRiShTvApatantaM sahasA tu nAgaM; dhRRiShTadyumnaH svarathAchChIghrameva |
gadAM pragRRihyAshu javena vIro; bhUmiM prapanno bhayavihvalA~NgaH
shlokas.17:
sa taM rathaM hemavibhUShitA~NgaM; sAshvaM sasUtaM sahasA vimRRidya |
utkShipya hastena tadA mahAdvipo; vipothayAmAsa vasundharAtale
shlokas.18:
pA~nchAlarAjasya sutaM sa dRRiShTvA; tadArditaM nAgavareNa tena |
tamabhyadhAvatsahasA javena; bhImaH shikhaNDI cha shineshcha naptA
shlokas.19:
sharaishcha vegaM sahasA nigRRihya; tasyAbhito.abhyApatato gajasya |
sa sa~NgRRihIto rathibhirgajo vai; chachAla tairvAryamANashcha sa~Nkhye
shlokas.20:
tataH pRRiShatkAnpravavarSha rAjA; sUryo yathA rashmijAlaM samantAt |
tenAshugairvadhyamAnA rathaughAH; pradudruvustatra tatastu sarve
shlokas.21:
tatkarma shAlvasya samIkShya sarve; pA~nchAlamatsyA nRRipa sRRi~njayAshcha |
hAhAkArairnAdayantaH sma yuddhe; dvipaM samantAdrurudhurnarAgryAH
shlokas.22:
pA~nchAlarAjastvaritastu shUro; gadAM pragRRihyAchalashRRi~NgakalpAm |
asambhramaM bhArata shatrughAtI; javena vIro.anusasAra nAgam
shlokas.23:
tato.atha nAgaM dharaNIdharAbhaM; madaM sravantaM jaladaprakAsham |
gadAM samAvidhya bhRRishaM jaghAna; pA~nchAlarAjasya sutastarasvI
shlokas.24:
sa bhinnakumbhaH sahasA vinadya; mukhAtprabhUtaM kShatajaM vimu~nchan |
papAta nAgo dharaNIdharAbhaH; kShitiprakampAchchalito yathAdriH
shlokas.25:
nipAtyamAne tu tadA gajendre; hAhAkRRite tava putrasya sainye |
sa shAlvarAjasya shinipravIro; jahAra bhallena shiraH shitena
shlokas.26:
hRRitottamA~Ngo yudhi sAtvatena; papAta bhUmau saha nAgarAj~nA |
yathAdrishRRi~NgaM sumahatpraNunnaM; vajreNa devAdhipachoditena

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasmi.nstu nihate shUre shAlve samitishobhane |
tavAbhajyadbalaM vegAdvAteneva mahAdrumaH
shlokas.2:
tatprabhagnaM balaM dRRiShTvA kRRitavarmA mahArathaH |
dadhAra samare shUraH shatrusainyaM mahAbalaH
shlokas.3:
saMnivRRittAstu te shUrA dRRiShTvA sAtvatamAhave |
shailopamaM sthitaM rAjankIryamANaM sharairyudhi
shlokas.4:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM kurUNAM pANDavaiH saha |
nivRRittAnAM mahArAja mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam
shlokas.5:
tatrAshcharyamabhUdyuddhaM sAtvatasya paraiH saha |
yadeko vArayAmAsa pANDusenAM durAsadAm
shlokas.6:
teShAmanyonyasuhRRidAM kRRite karmaNi duShkare |
siMhanAdaH prahRRiShTAnAM divaHspRRiksumahAnabhUt
shlokas.7:
tena shabdena vitrastAnpA~nchAlAnbharatarShabha |
shinernaptA mahAbAhuranvapadyata sAtyakiH
shlokas.8:
sa samAsAdya rAjAnaM kShemadhUrtiM mahAbalam |
saptabhirnishitairbANairanayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.9:
tamAyAntaM mahAbAhuM pravapantaM shitA~nsharAn |
javenAbhyapataddhImAnhArdikyaH shinipu~Ngavam
shlokas.10:
tau siMhAviva nardantau dhanvinau rathinAM varau |
anyonyamabhyadhAvetAM shastrapravaradhAriNau
shlokas.11:
pANDavAH saha pA~nchAlairyodhAshchAnye nRRipottamAH |
prekShakAH samapadyanta tayoH puruShasiMhayoH
shlokas.12:
nArAchairvatsadantaishcha vRRiShNyandhakamahArathau |
abhijaghnaturanyonyaM prahRRiShTAviva ku~njarau
shlokas.13:
charantau vividhAnmArgAnhArdikyashinipu~Ngavau |
muhurantardadhAte tau bANavRRiShTyA parasparam
shlokas.14:
chApavegabaloddhUtAnmArgaNAnvRRiShNisiMhayoH |
AkAshe samapashyAma pata~NgAniva shIghragAn
shlokas.15:
tamekaM satyakarmANamAsAdya hRRidikAtmajaH |
avidhyannishitairbANaishchaturbhishchaturo hayAn
shlokas.16:
sa dIrghabAhuH sa~NkruddhastottrArdita iva dvipaH |
aShTAbhiH kRRitavarmANamavidhyatparameShubhiH
shlokas.17:
tataH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTaiH kRRitavarmA shilAshitaiH |
sAtyakiM tribhirAhatya dhanurekena chichChide
shlokas.18:
nikRRittaM taddhanuHshreShThamapAsya shinipu~NgavaH |
anyadAdatta vegena shaineyaH sasharaM dhanuH
shlokas.19:
tadAdAya dhanuHshreShThaM variShThaH sarvadhanvinAm |
Aropya cha mahAvIryo mahAbuddhirmahAbalaH
shlokas.20:
amRRiShyamANo dhanuShashChedanaM kRRitavarmaNA |
kupito.atirathaH shIghraM kRRitavarmANamabhyayAt
shlokas.21:
tataH sunishitairbANairdashabhiH shinipu~NgavaH |
jaghAna sUtamashvA.nshcha dhvajaM cha kRRitavarmaNaH
shlokas.22:
tato rAjanmaheShvAsaH kRRitavarmA mahArathaH |
hatAshvasUtaM samprekShya rathaM hemapariShkRRitam
shlokas.23:
roSheNa mahatAviShTaH shUlamudyamya mAriSha |
chikShepa bhujavegena jighA.nsuH shinipu~Ngavam
shlokas.24:
tachChUlaM sAtvato hyAjau nirbhidya nishitaiH sharaiH |
chUrNitaM pAtayAmAsa mohayanniva mAdhavam
tato.apareNa bhallena hRRidyenaM samatADayat
shlokas.25:
sa yuddhe yuyudhAnena hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
kRRitavarmA kRRitAstreNa dharaNImanvapadyata
shlokas.26:
tasminsAtyakinA vIre dvairathe virathIkRRite |
samapadyata sarveShAM sainyAnAM sumahadbhayam
shlokas.27:
putrasya tava chAtyarthaM viShAdaH samapadyata |
hatasUte hatAshve cha virathe kRRitavarmaNi
shlokas.28:
hatAshvaM cha samAlakShya hatasUtamari.ndamam |
abhyadhAvatkRRipo rAja~njighA.nsuH shinipu~Ngavam
shlokas.29:
tamAropya rathopasthe miShatAM sarvadhanvinAm |
apovAha mahAbAhustUrNamAyodhanAdapi
shlokas.30:
shaineye.adhiShThite rAjanvirathe kRRitavarmaNi |
duryodhanabalaM sarvaM punarAsItparA~Nmukham
shlokas.31:
tatpare nAvabudhyanta sainyena rajasAvRRite |
tAvakAH pradrutA rAjanduryodhanamRRite nRRipam
shlokas.32:
duryodhanastu samprekShya bhagnaM svabalamantikAt |
javenAbhyapatattUrNaM sarvA.nshchaiko nyavArayat
shlokas.33:
pANDU.nshcha sarvAnsa~Nkruddho dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pArShatam |
shikhaNDinaM draupadeyAnpA~nchAlAnAM cha ye gaNAH
shlokas.34:
kekayAnsomakA.nshchaiva pA~nchAlA.nshchaiva mAriSha |
asambhramaM durAdharShaH shitairastrairavArayat
shlokas.35:
atiShThadAhave yattaH putrastava mahAbalaH |
yathA yaj~ne mahAnagnirmantrapUtaH prakAshayan
shlokas.36:
taM pare nAbhyavartanta martyA mRRityumivAhave |
athAnyaM rathamAsthAya hArdikyaH samapadyata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
putrastu te mahArAja rathastho rathinAM varaH |
durutsaho babhau yuddhe yathA rudraH pratApavAn
shlokas.2:
tasya bANasahasraistu prachChannA hyabhavanmahI |
parA.nshcha siShiche bANairdhArAbhiriva parvatAn
shlokas.3:
na cha so.asti pumAnkashchitpANDavAnAM mahAhave |
hayo gajo ratho vApi yo.asya bANairavikShataH
shlokas.4:
yaM yaM hi samare yodhaM prapashyAmi vishAM pate |
sa sa bANaishchito.abhUdvai putreNa tava bhArata
shlokas.5:
yathA sainyena rajasA samuddhUtena vAhinI |
pratyadRRishyata sa~nChannA tathA bANairmahAtmanaH
shlokas.6:
bANabhUtAmapashyAma pRRithivIM pRRithivIpate |
duryodhanena prakRRitAM kShiprahastena dhanvinA
shlokas.7:
teShu yodhasahasreShu tAvakeShu pareShu cha |
eko duryodhano hyAsItpumAniti matirmama
shlokas.8:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma tava putrasya vikramam |
yadekaM sahitAH pArthA nAtyavartanta bhArata
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThiraM shatenAjau vivyAdha bharatarShabha |
bhImasenaM cha saptatyA sahadevaM cha saptabhiH
shlokas.10:
nakulaM cha chatuHShaShTyA dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pa~nchabhiH |
saptabhirdraupadeyA.nshcha tribhirvivyAdha sAtyakim
dhanushchichCheda bhallena sahadevasya mAriSha
shlokas.11:
tadapAsya dhanushChinnaM mAdrIputraH pratApavAn |
abhyadhAvata rAjAnaM pragRRihyAnyanmahaddhanuH
tato duryodhanaM sa~Nkhye vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.12:
nakulashcha tato vIro rAjAnaM navabhiH sharaiH |
ghorarUpairmaheShvAso vivyAdha cha nanAda cha
shlokas.13:
sAtyakishchApi rAjAnaM shareNAnataparvaNA |
draupadeyAstrisaptatyA dharmarAjashcha saptabhiH
ashItyA bhImasenashcha sharai rAjAnamArdayat
shlokas.14:
samantAtkIryamANastu bANasa~NghairmahAtmabhiH |
na chachAla mahArAja sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.15:
lAghavaM sauShThavaM chApi vIryaM chaiva mahAtmanaH |
ati sarvANi bhUtAni dadRRishuH sarvamAnavAH
shlokas.16:
dhArtarAShTrAstu rAjendra yAtvA tu svalpamantaram |
apashyamAnA rAjAnaM paryavartanta da.nshitAH
shlokas.17:
teShAmApatatAM ghorastumulaH samajAyata |
kShubdhasya hi samudrasya prAvRRiTkAle yathA nishi
shlokas.18:
samAsAdya raNe te tu rAjAnamaparAjitam |
pratyudyayurmaheShvAsAH pANDavAnAtatAyinaH
shlokas.19:
bhImasenaM raNe kruddhaM droNaputro nyavArayat |
tato bANairmahArAja pramuktaiH sarvatodisham
nAj~nAyanta raNe vIrA na dishaH pradishastathA
shlokas.20:
tAvubhau krUrakarmANAvubhau bhArata duHsahau |
ghorarUpamayudhyetAM kRRitapratikRRitaiShiNau
trAsayantau jagatsarvaM jyAkShepavihatatvachau
shlokas.21:
shakunistu raNe vIro yudhiShThiramapIDayat |
tasyAshvA.nshchaturo hatvA subalasya suto vibhuH
nAdaM chakAra balavAnsarvasainyAni kampayan
shlokas.22:
etasminnantare vIraM rAjAnamaparAjitam |
apovAha rathenAjau sahadevaH pratApavAn
shlokas.23:
athAnyaM rathamAsthAya dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
shakuniM navabhirviddhvA punarvivyAdha pa~nchabhiH
nanAda cha mahAnAdaM pravaraH sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.24:
tadyuddhamabhavachchitraM ghorarUpaM cha mAriSha |
IkShitRRiprItijananaM siddhachAraNasevitam
shlokas.25:
ulUkastu maheShvAsaM nakulaM yuddhadurmadam |
abhyadravadameyAtmA sharavarShaiH samantataH
shlokas.26:
tathaiva nakulaH shUraH saubalasya sutaM raNe |
sharavarSheNa mahatA samantAtparyavArayat
shlokas.27:
tau tatra samare vIrau kulaputrau mahArathau |
yodhayantAvapashyetAM parasparakRRitAgasau
shlokas.28:
tathaiva kRRitavarmA tu shaineyaM shatrutApanam |
yodhaya~nshushubhe rAjanbalaM shakra ivAhave
shlokas.29:
duryodhano dhanushChittvA dhRRiShTadyumnasya sa.nyuge |
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.30:
dhRRiShTadyumno.api samare pragRRihya paramAyudham |
rAjAnaM yodhayAmAsa pashyatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.31:
tayoryuddhaM mahachchAsItsa~NgrAme bharatarShabha |
prabhinnayoryathA saktaM mattayorvarahastinoH
shlokas.32:
gautamastu raNe kruddho draupadeyAnmahAbalAn |
vivyAdha bahubhiH shUraH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.33:
tasya tairabhavadyuddhamindriyairiva dehinaH |
ghorarUpamasa.nvAryaM nirmaryAdamatIva cha
shlokas.34:
te cha taM pIDayAmAsurindriyANIva bAlisham |
sa cha tAnpratisa.nrabdhaH pratyayodhayadAhave
shlokas.35:
evaM chitramabhUdyuddhaM tasya taiH saha bhArata |
utthAyotthAya hi yathA dehinAmindriyairvibho
shlokas.36:
narAshchaiva naraiH sArdhaM dantino dantibhistathA |
hayA hayaiH samAsaktA rathino rathibhistathA
sa~NkulaM chAbhavadbhUyo ghorarUpaM vishAM pate
shlokas.37:
idaM chitramidaM ghoramidaM raudramiti prabho |
yuddhAnyAsanmahArAja ghorANi cha bahUni cha
shlokas.38:
te samAsAdya samare parasparamari.ndamAH |
vivyadhushchaiva jaghnushcha samAsAdya mahAhave
shlokas.39:
teShAM shastrasamudbhUtaM rajastIvramadRRishyata |
pravAtenoddhataM rAjandhAvadbhishchAshvasAdibhiH
shlokas.40:
rathanemisamudbhUtaM niHshvAsaishchApi dantinAm |
rajaH sandhyAbhrakapilaM divAkarapathaM yayau
shlokas.41:
rajasA tena sampRRikte bhAskare niShprabhIkRRite |
sa~nChAditAbhavadbhUmiste cha shUrA mahArathAH
shlokas.42:
muhUrtAdiva sa.nvRRittaM nIrajaskaM samantataH |
vIrashoNitasiktAyAM bhUmau bharatasattama
upAshAmyattatastIvraM tadrajo ghoradarshanam
shlokas.43:
tato.apashyaM mahArAja dva.ndvayuddhAni bhArata |
yathAprAgryaM yathAjyeShThaM madhyAhne vai sudAruNe
varmaNAM tatra rAjendra vyadRRishyantojjvalAH prabhAH
shlokas.44:
shabdaH sutumulaH sa~Nkhye sharANAM patatAmabhUt |
mahAveNuvanasyeva dahyamAnasya sarvataH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vartamAne tathA yuddhe ghorarUpe bhayAnake |
abhajyata balaM tatra tava putrasya pANDavaiH
shlokas.2:
tA.nstu yatnena mahatA saMnivArya mahArathAn |
putraste yodhayAmAsa pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.3:
nivRRittAH sahasA yodhAstava putrapriyaiShiNaH |
saMnivRRitteShu teShvevaM yuddhamAsItsudAruNam
shlokas.4:
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha devAsuraraNopamam |
pareShAM tava sainye cha nAsItkashchitparA~NmukhaH
shlokas.5:
anumAnena yudhyante sa~nj~nAbhishcha parasparam |
teShAM kShayo mahAnAsIdyudhyatAmitaretaram
shlokas.6:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA krodhena mahatA yutaH |
jigIShamANaH sa~NgrAme dhArtarAShTrAnsarAjakAn
shlokas.7:
tribhiH shAradvataM viddhvA rukmapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
chaturbhirnijaghAnAshvAnkalyANAnkRRitavarmaNaH
shlokas.8:
ashvatthAmA tu hArdikyamapovAha yashasvinam |
atha shAradvato.aShTAbhiH pratyavidhyadyudhiShThiram
shlokas.9:
tato duryodhano rAjA rathAnsaptashatAnraNe |
preShayadyatra rAjAsau dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.10:
te rathA rathibhiryuktA manomArutaraMhasaH |
abhyadravanta sa~NgrAme kaunteyasya rathaM prati
shlokas.11:
te samantAnmahArAja parivArya yudhiShThiram |
adRRishyaM sAyakaishchakrurmeghA iva divAkaram
shlokas.12:
nAmRRiShyanta susa.nrabdhAH shikhaNDipramukhA rathAH |
rathairagryajavairyuktaiH ki~NkiNIjAlasa.nvRRitaiH
AjagmurabhirakShantaH kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.13:
tataH pravavRRite raudraH sa~NgrAmaH shoNitodakaH |
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha yamarAShTravivardhanaH
shlokas.14:
rathAnsaptashatAnhatvA kurUNAmAtatAyinAm |
pANDavAH saha pA~nchAlaiH punarevAbhyavArayan
shlokas.15:
tatra yuddhaM mahachchAsIttava putrasya pANDavaiH |
na cha nastAdRRishaM dRRiShTaM naiva chApi parishrutam
shlokas.16:
vartamAne tathA yuddhe nirmaryAde samantataH |
vadhyamAneShu yodheShu tAvakeShvitareShu cha
shlokas.17:
ninadatsu cha yodheShu sha~Nkhavaryaishcha pUritaiH |
utkRRiShTaiH siMhanAdaishcha garjitena cha dhanvinAm
shlokas.18:
atipravRRiddhe yuddhe cha ChidyamAneShu marmasu |
dhAvamAneShu yodheShu jayagRRiddhiShu mAriSha
shlokas.19:
saMhAre sarvato jAte pRRithivyAM shokasambhave |
bahvInAmuttamastrINAM sImantoddharaNe tathA
shlokas.20:
nirmaryAde tathA yuddhe vartamAne sudAruNe |
prAdurAsanvinAshAya tadotpAtAH sudAruNAH
chachAla shabdaM kurvANA saparvatavanA mahI
shlokas.21:
sadaNDAH solmukA rAja~nshIryamANAH samantataH |
ulkAH peturdivo bhUmAvAhatya ravimaNDalam
shlokas.22:
viShvagvAtAH prAdurAsannIchaiH sharkaravarShiNaH |
ashrUNi mumuchurnAgA vepathushchAspRRishadbhRRisham
shlokas.23:
etAnghorAnanAdRRitya samutpAtAnsudAruNAn |
punaryuddhAya saMmantrya kShatriyAstasthuravyathAH
ramaNIye kurukShetre puNye svargaM yiyAsavaH
shlokas.24:
tato gAndhArarAjasya putraH shakunirabravIt |
yudhyadhvamagrato yAvatpRRiShThato hanmi pANDavAn
shlokas.25:
tato naH samprayAtAnAM madrayodhAstarasvinaH |
hRRiShTAH kilakilAshabdamakurvantApare tathA
shlokas.26:
asmA.nstu punarAsAdya labdhalakShA durAsadAH |
sharAsanAni dhunvantaH sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.27:
tato hataM paraistatra madrarAjabalaM tadA |
duryodhanabalaM dRRiShTvA punarAsItparA~Nmukham
shlokas.28:
gAndhArarAjastu punarvAkyamAha tato balI |
nivartadhvamadharmaj~nA yudhyadhvaM kiM sRRitena vaH
shlokas.29:
anIkaM dashasAhasramashvAnAM bharatarShabha |
AsIdgAndhArarAjasya vimalaprAsayodhinAm
shlokas.30:
balena tena vikramya vartamAne janakShaye |
pRRiShThataH pANDavAnIkamabhyaghnannishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.31:
tadabhramiva vAtena kShipyamANaM samantataH |
abhajyata mahArAja pANDUnAM sumahadbalam
shlokas.32:
tato yudhiShThiraH prekShya bhagnaM svabalamantikAt |
abhyachodayadavyagraH sahadevaM mahAbalam
shlokas.33:
asau subalaputro no jaghanaM pIDya da.nshitaH |
senAM nisUdayantyeSha pashya pANDava durmatim
shlokas.34:
gachCha tvaM draupadeyAshcha shakuniM saubalaM jahi |
rathAnIkamahaM rakShye pA~nchAlasahito.anagha
shlokas.35:
gachChantu ku~njarAH sarve vAjinashcha saha tvayA |
pAdAtAshcha trisAhasrAH shakuniM saubalaM jahi
shlokas.36:
tato gajAH saptashatAshchApapANibhirAsthitAH |
pa~ncha chAshvasahasrANi sahadevashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.37:
pAdAtAshcha trisAhasrA draupadeyAshcha sarvashaH |
raNe hyabhyadrava.nste tu shakuniM yuddhadurmadam
shlokas.38:
tatastu saubalo rAjannabhyatikramya pANDavAn |
jaghAna pRRiShThataH senAM jayagRRidhraH pratApavAn
shlokas.39:
ashvArohAstu sa.nrabdhAH pANDavAnAM tarasvinAm |
prAvishansaubalAnIkamabhyatikramya tAnrathAn
shlokas.40:
te tatra sAdinaH shUrAH saubalasya mahadbalam |
gajamadhye.avatiShThantaH sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.41:
tadudyatagadAprAsamakApuruShasevitam |
prAvartata mahadyuddhaM rAjandurmantrite tava
shlokas.42:
upAramanta jyAshabdAH prekShakA rathino.abhavan |
na hi sveShAM pareShAM vA visheShaH pratyadRRishyata
shlokas.43:
shUrabAhuvisRRiShTAnAM shaktInAM bharatarShabha |
jyotiShAmiva sampAtamapashyankurupANDavAH
shlokas.44:
RRiShTibhirvimalAbhishcha tatra tatra vishAM pate |
sampatantIbhirAkAshamAvRRitaM bahvashobhata
shlokas.45:
prAsAnAM patatAM rAjanrUpamAsItsamantataH |
shalabhAnAmivAkAshe tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.46:
rudhirokShitasarvA~NgA vipraviddhairniyantRRibhiH |
hayAH paripatanti sma shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.47:
anyonyaparipiShTAshcha samAsAdya parasparam |
avikShatAH sma dRRishyante vamanto rudhiraM mukhaiH
shlokas.48:
tato.abhavattamo ghoraM sainyena rajasA vRRite |
tAnapAkramato.adrAkShaM tasmAddeshAdari.ndamAn
ashvAnrAjanmanuShyA.nshcha rajasA sa.nvRRite sati
shlokas.49:
bhUmau nipatitAshchAnye vamanto rudhiraM bahu |
keshAkeshisamAlagnA na shekushcheShTituM janAH
shlokas.50:
anyonyamashvapRRiShThebhyo vikarShanto mahAbalAH |
mallA iva samAsAdya nijaghnuritaretaram
ashvaishcha vyapakRRiShyanta bahavo.atra gatAsavaH
shlokas.51:
bhUmau nipatitAshchAnye bahavo vijayaiShiNaH |
tatra tatra vyadRRishyanta puruShAH shUramAninaH
shlokas.52:
raktokShitaishChinnabhujairapakRRiShTashiroruhaiH |
vyadRRishyata mahI kIrNA shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.53:
dUraM na shakyaM tatrAsIdgantumashvena kenachit |
sAshvArohairhatairashvairAvRRite vasudhAtale
shlokas.54:
rudhirokShitasaMnAhairAttashastrairudAyudhaiH |
nAnApraharaNairghoraiH parasparavadhaiShibhiH
susaMnikRRiShTaiH sa~NgrAme hatabhUyiShThasainikaiH
shlokas.55:
sa muhUrtaM tato yuddhvA saubalo.atha vishAM pate |
ShaTsahasrairhayaiH shiShTairapAyAchChakunistataH
shlokas.56:
tathaiva pANDavAnIkaM rudhireNa samukShitam |
ShaTsahasrairhayaiH shiShTairapAyAchChrAntavAhanam
shlokas.57:
ashvArohAstu pANDUnAmabruvanrudhirokShitAH |
susaMnikRRiShTAH sa~NgrAme bhUyiShThaM tyaktajIvitAH
shlokas.58:
neha shakyaM rathairyoddhuM kuta eva mahAgajaiH |
rathAneva rathA yAntu ku~njarAH ku~njarAnapi
shlokas.59:
pratiyAto hi shakuniH svamanIkamavasthitaH |
na punaH saubalo rAjA yuddhamabhyAgamiShyati
shlokas.60:
tatastu draupadeyAshcha te cha mattA mahAdvipAH |
prayayuryatra pA~nchAlyo dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH
shlokas.61:
sahadevo.api kauravya rajomeghe samutthite |
ekAkI prayayau tatra yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.62:
tatasteShu prayAteShu shakuniH saubalaH punaH |
pArshvato.abhyahanatkruddho dhRRiShTadyumnasya vAhinIm
shlokas.63:
tatpunastumulaM yuddhaM prANA.nstyaktvAbhyavartata |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha parasparavadhaiShiNAm
shlokas.64:
te hyanyonyamavekShanta tasminvIrasamAgame |
yodhAH paryapatanrAja~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.66:
vimuktAnAM sharIrANAM bhinnAnAM patatAM bhuvi |
sAyudhAnAM cha bAhUnAmurUNAM cha vishAM pate
AsItkaTakaTAshabdaH sumahAnromaharShaNaH
shlokas.67:
nighnanto nishitaiH shastrairbhrAtR^InputrAnsakhInapi |
yodhAH paripatanti sma yathAmiShakRRite khagAH
shlokas.68:
anyonyaM pratisa.nrabdhAH samAsAdya parasparam |
ahaM pUrvamahaM pUrvamiti nyaghnansahasrashaH
shlokas.70:
sphuratAM pratipiShTAnAmashvAnAM shIghrasAriNAm |
stanatAM cha manuShyANAM saMnaddhAnAM vishAM pate
shlokas.71:
shaktyRRiShTiprAsashabdashcha tumulaH samajAyata |
bhindatAM paramarmANi rAjandurmantrite tava
shlokas.72:
shramAbhibhUtAH sa.nrabdhAH shrAntavAhAH pipAsitAH |
vikShatAshcha shitaiH shastrairabhyavartanta tAvakAH
shlokas.73:
mattA rudhiragandhena bahavo.atra vichetasaH |
jaghnuH parAnsvakA.nshchaiva prAptAnprAptAnanantarAn
shlokas.75:
vRRikagRRidhrashRRigAlAnAM tumule modane.ahani |
AsIdbalakShayo ghorastava putrasya pashyataH
shlokas.76:
narAshvakAyasa~nChannA bhUmirAsIdvishAM pate |
rudhirodakachitrA cha bhIrUNAM bhayavardhinI
shlokas.77:
asibhiH paTTishaiH shUlaistakShamANAH punaH punaH |
tAvakAH pANDavAshchaiva nAbhyavartanta bhArata
shlokas.78:
praharanto yathAshakti yAvatprANasya dhAraNam |
yodhAH paripatanti sma vamanto rudhiraM vraNaiH
shlokas.79:
shiro gRRihItvA kesheShu kabandhaH samadRRishyata |
udyamya nishitaM khaDgaM rudhireNa samukShitam
shlokas.80:
athotthiteShu bahuShu kabandheShu janAdhipa |
tathA rudhiragandhena yodhAH kashmalamAvishan
shlokas.81:
mandIbhUte tataH shabde pANDavAnAM mahadbalam |
alpAvashiShTaisturagairabhyavartata saubalaH
shlokas.82:
tato.abhyadhAva.nstvaritAH pANDavA jayagRRiddhinaH |
padAtayashcha nAgAshcha sAdinashchodyatAyudhAH
shlokas.83:
koShTakIkRRitya chApyenaM parikShipya cha sarvashaH |
shastrairnAnAvidhairjaghnuryuddhapAraM titIrShavaH
shlokas.84:
tvadIyAstA.nstu samprekShya sarvataH samabhidrutAn |
sAshvapattidviparathAH pANDavAnabhidudruvuH
shlokas.85:
kechitpadAtayaH padbhirmuShTibhishcha parasparam |
nijaghnuH samare shUrAH kShINashastrAstato.apatan
shlokas.86:
rathebhyo rathinaH peturdvipebhyo hastisAdinaH |
vimAnebhya iva bhraShTAH siddhAH puNyakShayAdyathA
shlokas.87:
evamanyonyamAyastA yodhA jaghnurmahAmRRidhe |
pitR^InbhrAtR^InvayasyA.nshcha putrAnapi tathApare
shlokas.88:
evamAsIdamaryAdaM yuddhaM bharatasattama |
prAsAsibANakalile vartamAne sudAruNe

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasmi~nshabde mRRidau jAte pANDavairnihate bale |
ashvaiH saptashataiH shiShTairupAvartata saubalaH
shlokas.2:
sa yAtvA vAhinIM tUrNamabravIttvarayanyudhi |
yudhyadhvamiti saMhRRiShTAH punaH punarari.ndamaH
apRRichChatkShatriyA.nstatra kva nu rAjA mahArathaH
shlokas.3:
shakunestu vachaH shrutvA ta UchurbharatarShabha |
asau tiShThati kauravyo raNamadhye mahArathaH
shlokas.4:
yatraitatsumahachChatraM pUrNachandrasamaprabham |
yatraite satalatrANA rathAstiShThanti da.nshitAH
shlokas.5:
yatraiSha shabdastumulaH parjanyaninadopamaH |
tatra gachCha drutaM rAja.nstato drakShyasi kauravam
shlokas.6:
evamuktastu taiH shUraiH shakuniH saubalastadA |
prayayau tatra yatrAsau putrastava narAdhipa
sarvataH sa.nvRRito vIraiH samareShvanivartibhiH
shlokas.7:
tato duryodhanaM dRRiShTvA rathAnIke vyavasthitam |
sarathA.nstAvakAnsarvAnharShaya~nshakunistataH
shlokas.8:
duryodhanamidaM vAkyaM hRRiShTarUpo vishAM pate |
kRRitakAryamivAtmAnaM manyamAno.abravInnRRipam
shlokas.9:
jahi rAjanrathAnIkamashvAH sarve jitA mayA |
nAtyaktvA jIvitaM sa~Nkhye shakyo jetuM yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.10:
hate tasminrathAnIke pANDavenAbhipAlite |
gajAnetAnhaniShyAmaH padAtI.nshchetarA.nstathA
shlokas.11:
shrutvA tu vachanaM tasya tAvakA jayagRRiddhinaH |
javenAbhyapatanhRRiShTAH pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.12:
sarve vivRRitatUNIrAH pragRRihItasharAsanAH |
sharAsanAni dhunvAnAH siMhanAdaM prachakrire
shlokas.13:
tato jyAtalanirghoShaH punarAsIdvishAM pate |
prAdurAsIchCharANAM cha sumuktAnAM sudAruNaH
shlokas.14:
tAnsamIpagatAndRRiShTvA javenodyatakArmukAn |
uvAcha devakIputraM kuntIputro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.15:
chodayAshvAnasambhrAntaH pravishaitadbalArNavam |
antamadya gamiShyAmi shatrUNAM nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.16:
aShTAdasha dinAnyadya yuddhasyAsya janArdana |
vartamAnasya mahataH samAsAdya parasparam
shlokas.17:
anantakalpA dhvajinI bhUtvA hyeShAM mahAtmanAm |
kShayamadya gatA yuddhe pashya daivaM yathAvidham
shlokas.18:
samudrakalpaM tu balaM dhArtarAShTrasya mAdhava |
asmAnAsAdya sa~njAtaM goShpadopamamachyuta
shlokas.19:
hate bhIShme cha sa.ndadhyAchChivaM syAdiha mAdhava |
na cha tatkRRitavAnmUDho dhArtarAShTraH subAlishaH
shlokas.20:
uktaM bhIShmeNa yadvAkyaM hitaM pathyaM cha mAdhava |
tachchApi nAsau kRRitavAnvItabuddhiH suyodhanaH
shlokas.21:
tasmi.nstu patite bhIShme prachyute pRRithivItale |
na jAne kAraNaM kiM nu yena yuddhamavartata
shlokas.22:
mUDhA.nstu sarvathA manye dhArtarAShTrAnsubAlishAn |
patite shantanoH putre ye.akArShuH sa.nyugaM punaH
shlokas.23:
anantaraM cha nihate droNe brahmavidAM vare |
rAdheye cha vikarNe cha naivAshAmyata vaishasam
shlokas.24:
alpAvashiShTe sainye.asminsUtaputre cha pAtite |
saputre vai naravyAghre naivAshAmyata vaishasam
shlokas.25:
shrutAyuShi hate shUre jalasandhe cha paurave |
shrutAyudhe cha nRRipatau naivAshAmyata vaishasam
shlokas.26:
bhUrishravasi shalye cha shAlve chaiva janArdana |
AvantyeShu cha vIreShu naivAshAmyata vaishasam
shlokas.27:
jayadrathe cha nihate rAkShase chApyalAyudhe |
bAhlike somadatte cha naivAshAmyata vaishasam
shlokas.28:
bhagadatte hate shUre kAmboje cha sudakShiNe |
duHshAsane cha nihate naivAshAmyata vaishasam
shlokas.29:
dRRiShTvA cha nihatA~nshUrAnpRRitha~NmANDalikAnnRRipAn |
balinashcha raNe kRRiShNa naivAshAmyata vaishasam
shlokas.30:
akShauhiNIpatIndRRiShTvA bhImasenena pAtitAn |
mohAdvA yadi vA lobhAnnaivAshAmyata vaishasam
shlokas.31:
ko nu rAjakule jAtaH kauraveyo visheShataH |
nirarthakaM mahadvairaM kuryAdanyaH suyodhanAt
shlokas.32:
guNato.abhyadhikaM j~nAtvA balataH shauryato.api vA |
amUDhaH ko nu yudhyeta jAnanprAj~no hitAhitam
shlokas.33:
yanna tasya mano hyAsIttvayoktasya hitaM vachaH |
prashame pANDavaiH sArdhaM so.anyasya shRRiNuyAtkatham
shlokas.34:
yena shAntanavo bhIShmo droNo vidura eva cha |
pratyAkhyAtAH shamasyArthe kiM nu tasyAdya bheShajam
shlokas.35:
maurkhyAdyena pitA vRRiddhaH pratyAkhyAto janArdana |
tathA mAtA hitaM vAkyaM bhAShamANA hitaiShiNI
pratyAkhyAtA hyasatkRRitya sa kasmai rochayedvachaH
shlokas.36:
kulAntakaraNo vyaktaM jAta eSha janArdana |
tathAsya dRRishyate cheShTA nItishchaiva vishAM pate
naiSha dAsyati no rAjyamiti me matirachyuta
shlokas.37:
ukto.ahaM bahushastAta vidureNa mahAtmanA |
na jIvandAsyate bhAgaM dhArtarAShTraH katha~nchana
shlokas.38:
yAvatprANA dhamiShyanti dhArtarAShTrasya mAnada |
tAvadyuShmAsvapApeShu prachariShyati pAtakam
shlokas.39:
na sa yukto.anyathA jetumRRite yuddhena mAdhava |
ityabravItsadA mAM hi viduraH satyadarshanaH
shlokas.40:
tatsarvamadya jAnAmi vyavasAyaM durAtmanaH |
yaduktaM vachanaM tena vidureNa mahAtmanA
shlokas.41:
yo hi shrutvA vachaH pathyaM jAmadagnyAdyathAtatham |
avAmanyata durbuddhirdhruvaM nAshamukhe sthitaH
shlokas.42:
uktaM hi bahubhiH siddhairjAtamAtre suyodhane |
enaM prApya durAtmAnaM kShayaM kShatraM gamiShyati
shlokas.43:
tadidaM vachanaM teShAM niruktaM vai janArdana |
kShayaM yAtA hi rAjAno duryodhanakRRite bhRRisham
shlokas.44:
so.adya sarvAnraNe yodhAnnihaniShyAmi mAdhava |
kShatriyeShu hateShvAshu shUnye cha shibire kRRite
shlokas.45:
vadhAya chAtmano.asmAbhiH sa.nyugaM rochayiShyati |
tadantaM hi bhavedvairamanumAnena mAdhava
shlokas.46:
evaM pashyAmi vArShNeya chintayanpraj~nayA svayA |
vidurasya cha vAkyena cheShTayA cha durAtmanaH
shlokas.47:
sa.nyAhi bhAratIM vIra yAvaddhanmi shitaiH sharaiH |
duryodhanaM durAtmAnaM vAhinIM chAsya sa.nyuge
shlokas.48:
kShemamadya kariShyAmi dharmarAjasya mAdhava |
hatvaitaddurbalaM sainyaM dhArtarAShTrasya pashyataH
shlokas.49:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
abhIshuhasto dAshArhastathoktaH savyasAchinA |
tadbalaughamamitrANAmabhItaH prAvishadraNe
shlokas.50:
sharAsanavaraM ghoraM shaktikaNTakasa.nvRRitam |
gadAparighapanthAnaM rathanAgamahAdrumam
shlokas.51:
hayapattilatAkIrNaM gAhamAno mahAyashAH |
vyacharattatra govindo rathenAtipatAkinA
shlokas.52:
te hayAH pANDurA rAjanvahanto.arjunamAhave |
dikShu sarvAsvadRRishyanta dAshArheNa prachoditAH
shlokas.53:
tataH prAyAdrathenAjau savyasAchI parantapaH |
kira~nsharashatA.nstIkShNAnvAridhArA ivAmbudaH
shlokas.54:
prAdurAsInmahA~nshabdaH sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
iShubhishChAdyamAnAnAM samare savyasAchinA
shlokas.55:
asajjantastanutreShu sharaughAH prApatanbhuvi |
indrAshanisamasparshA gANDIvapreShitAH sharAH
shlokas.56:
narAnnAgAnsamAhatya hayA.nshchApi vishAM pate |
apatanta raNe bANAH pata~NgA iva ghoShiNaH
shlokas.57:
AsItsarvamavachChannaM gANDIvapreShitaiH sharaiH |
na prAj~nAyanta samare disho vA pradisho.api vA
shlokas.58:
sarvamAsIjjagatpUrNaM pArthanAmA~NkitaiH sharaiH |
rukmapu~NkhaistailadhautaiH karmAraparimArjitaiH
shlokas.59:
te dahyamAnAH pArthena pAvakeneva ku~njarAH |
samAsIdanta kauravyA vadhyamAnAH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.60:
sharachApadharaH pArthaH prajvalanniva bhArata |
dadAha samare yodhAnkakShamagniriva jvalan
shlokas.61:
yathA vanAnte vanapairvisRRiShTaH; kakShaM dahetkRRiShNagatiH saghoShaH |
bhUridrumaM shuShkalatAvitAnaM; bhRRishaM samRRiddho jvalanaH pratApI
shlokas.62:
evaM sa nArAchagaNapratApI; sharArchiruchchAvachatigmatejAH |
dadAha sarvAM tava putrasenA;mamRRiShyamANastarasA tarasvI
shlokas.63:
tasyeShavaH prANaharAH sumuktA; nAsajjanvai varmasu rukmapu~NkhAH |
na cha dvitIyaM pramumocha bANaM; nare haye vA paramadvipe vA
shlokas.64:
anekarUpAkRRitibhirhi bANai;rmahArathAnIkamanupravishya |
sa eva ekastava putrasenAM; jaghAna daityAniva vajrapANiH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
asyatAM yatamAnAnAM shUrANAmanivartinAm |
sa~NkalpamakaronmoghaM gANDIvena dhana~njayaH
shlokas.2:
indrAshanisamasparshAnaviShahyAnmahaujasaH |
visRRijandRRishyate bANAndhArA mu~nchannivAmbudaH
shlokas.3:
tatsainyaM bharatashreShTha vadhyamAnaM kirITinA |
sampradudrAva sa~NgrAmAttava putrasya pashyataH
shlokas.4:
hatadhuryA rathAH kechiddhatasUtAstathApare |
bhagnAkShayugachakreShAH kechidAsanvishAM pate
shlokas.5:
anyeShAM sAyakAH kShINAstathAnye sharapIDitAH |
akShatA yugapatkechitprAdravanbhayapIDitAH
shlokas.6:
kechitputrAnupAdAya hatabhUyiShThavAhanAH |
vichukrushuH pitR^Inanye sahAyAnapare punaH
shlokas.7:
bAndhavA.nshcha naravyAghra bhrAtR^InsambandhinastathA |
dudruvuH kechidutsRRijya tatra tatra vishAM pate
shlokas.8:
bahavo.atra bhRRishaM viddhA muhyamAnA mahArathAH |
niShTanantaH sma dRRishyante pArthabANahatA narAH
shlokas.9:
tAnanye rathamAropya samAshvAsya muhUrtakam |
vishrAntAshcha vitRRiShNAshcha punaryuddhAya jagmire
shlokas.10:
tAnapAsya gatAH kechitpunareva yuyutsavaH |
kurvantastava putrasya shAsanaM yuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.11:
pAnIyamapare pItvA paryAshvAsya cha vAhanam |
varmANi cha samAropya kechidbharatasattama
shlokas.12:
samAshvAsyApare bhrAtR^InnikShipya shibire.api cha |
putrAnanye pitR^Inanye punaryuddhamarochayan
shlokas.13:
sajjayitvA rathAnkechidyathAmukhyaM vishAM pate |
Aplutya pANDavAnIkaM punaryuddhamarochayan
shlokas.14:
te shUrAH ki~NkiNIjAlaiH samAchChannA babhAsire |
trailokyavijaye yuktA yathA daiteyadAnavAH
shlokas.15:
Agamya sahasA kechidrathaiH svarNavibhUShitaiH |
pANDavAnAmanIkeShu dhRRiShTadyumnamayodhayan
shlokas.16:
dhRRiShTadyumno.api pA~nchAlyaH shikhaNDI cha mahArathaH |
nAkulishcha shatAnIko rathAnIkamayodhayan
shlokas.17:
pA~nchAlyastu tataH kruddhaH sainyena mahatA vRRitaH |
abhyadravatsusa.nrabdhastAvakAnhantumudyataH
shlokas.18:
tatastvApatatastasya tava putro janAdhipa |
bANasa~NghAnanekAnvai preShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.19:
dhRRiShTadyumnastato rAja.nstava putreNa dhanvinA |
nArAchairbahubhiH kShipraM bAhvorurasi chArpitaH
shlokas.20:
so.atividdho maheShvAsastottrArdita iva dvipaH |
tasyAshvA.nshchaturo bANaiH preShayAmAsa mRRityave
sAratheshchAsya bhallena shiraH kAyAdapAharat
shlokas.21:
tato duryodhano rAjA pRRiShThamAruhya vAjinaH |
apAkrAmaddhataratho nAtidUramari.ndamaH
shlokas.22:
dRRiShTvA tu hatavikrAntaM svamanIkaM mahAbalaH |
tava putro mahArAja prayayau yatra saubalaH
shlokas.23:
tato ratheShu bhagneShu trisAhasrA mahAdvipAH |
pANDavAnrathinaH pa~ncha samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.24:
te vRRitAH samare pa~ncha gajAnIkena bhArata |
ashobhanta naravyAghrA grahA vyAptA ghanairiva
shlokas.25:
tato.arjuno mahArAja labdhalakSho mahAbhujaH |
viniryayau rathenaiva shvetAshvaH kRRiShNasArathiH
shlokas.26:
taiH samantAtparivRRitaH ku~njaraiH parvatopamaiH |
nArAchairvimalaistIkShNairgajAnIkamapothayat
shlokas.27:
tatraikabANanihatAnapashyAma mahAgajAn |
patitAnpAtyamAnA.nshcha vibhinnAnsavyasAchinA
shlokas.28:
bhImasenastu tAndRRiShTvA nAgAnmattagajopamaH |
kareNa gRRihya mahatIM gadAmabhyapatadbalI
avaplutya rathAttUrNaM daNDapANirivAntakaH
shlokas.29:
tamudyatagadaM dRRiShTvA pANDavAnAM mahAratham |
vitresustAvakAH sainyAH shakRRinmUtraM prasusruvuH
AvignaM cha balaM sarvaM gadAhaste vRRikodare
shlokas.30:
gadayA bhImasenena bhinnakumbhAnrajasvalAn |
dhAvamAnAnapashyAma ku~njarAnparvatopamAn
shlokas.31:
pradhAvya ku~njarAste tu bhImasenagadAhatAH |
peturArtasvaraM kRRitvA ChinnapakShA ivAdrayaH
shlokas.32:
tAnbhinnakumbhAnsubahUndravamANAnitastataH |
patamAnA.nshcha samprekShya vitresustava sainikAH
shlokas.33:
yudhiShThiro.api sa~Nkruddho mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
gRRidhrapakShaiH shitairbANairjaghnurvai gajayodhinaH
shlokas.34:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu samare parAjitya narAdhipam |
apakrAnte tava sute hayapRRiShThaM samAshrite
shlokas.35:
dRRiShTvA cha pANDavAnsarvAnku~njaraiH parivAritAn |
dhRRiShTadyumno mahArAja saha sarvaiH prabhadrakaiH
putraH pA~nchAlarAjasya jighA.nsuH ku~njarAnyayau
shlokas.36:
adRRiShTvA tu rathAnIke duryodhanamari.ndamam |
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH
apRRichChankShatriyA.nstatra kva nu duryodhano gataH
shlokas.37:
apashyamAnA rAjAnaM vartamAne janakShaye |
manvAnA nihataM tatra tava putraM mahArathAH
viShaNNavadanA bhUtvA paryapRRichChanta te sutam
shlokas.38:
AhuH kechiddhate sUte prayAto yatra saubalaH |
apare tvabruva.nstatra kShatriyA bhRRishavikShatAH
shlokas.39:
duryodhanena kiM kAryaM drakShyadhvaM yadi jIvati |
yudhyadhvaM sahitAH sarve kiM vo rAjA kariShyati
shlokas.40:
te kShatriyAH kShatairgAtrairhatabhUyiShThavAhanAH |
sharaiH sampIDyamAnAshcha nAtivyaktamivAbruvan
shlokas.41:
idaM sarvaM balaM hanmo yena sma parivAritAH |
ete sarve gajAnhatvA upayAnti sma pANDavAH
shlokas.42:
shrutvA tu vachanaM teShAmashvatthAmA mahAbalaH |
hitvA pA~nchAlarAjasya tadanIkaM durutsaham
shlokas.43:
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha prayayuryatra saubalaH |
rathAnIkaM parityajya shUrAH sudRRiDhadhanvinaH
shlokas.44:
tatasteShu prayAteShu dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH |
AyayuH pANDavA rAjanvinighnantaH sma tAvakAn
shlokas.45:
dRRiShTvA tu tAnApatataH samprahRRiShTAnmahArathAn |
parAkrAntA.nstato vIrAnnirAshA~njIvite tadA
vivarNamukhabhUyiShThamabhavattAvakaM balam
shlokas.46:
parikShINAyudhAndRRiShTvA tAnahaM parivAritAn |
rAjanbalena dvya~Ngena tyaktvA jIvitamAtmanaH
shlokas.47:
AtmanApa~nchamo.ayudhyaM pA~nchAlasya balena ha |
tasmindeshe vyavasthApya yatra shAradvataH sthitaH
shlokas.48:
samprayuddhA vayaM pa~ncha kirITisharapIDitAH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM mahAnIkaM tatra no.abhUdraNo mahAn
jitAstena vayaM sarve vyapayAma raNAttataH
shlokas.49:
athApashyaM sAtyakiM tamupAyAntaM mahAratham |
rathaishchatuHshatairvIro mAM chAbhyadravadAhave
shlokas.50:
dhRRiShTadyumnAdahaM muktaH katha~nchichChrAntavAhanaH |
patito mAdhavAnIkaM duShkRRitI narakaM yathA
tatra yuddhamabhUdghoraM muhUrtamatidAruNam
shlokas.51:
sAtyakistu mahAbAhurmama hatvA parichChadam |
jIvagrAhamagRRihNAnmAM mUrChitaM patitaM bhuvi
shlokas.52:
tato muhUrtAdiva tadgajAnIkamavadhyata |
gadayA bhImasenena nArAchairarjunena cha
shlokas.53:
pratipiShTairmahAnAgaiH samantAtparvatopamaiH |
nAtiprasiddheva gatiH pANDavAnAmajAyata
shlokas.54:
rathamArgA.nstatashchakre bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
pANDavAnAM mahArAja vyapakarShanmahAgajAn
shlokas.55:
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
apashyanto rathAnIke duryodhanamari.ndamam
rAjAnaM mRRigayAmAsustava putraM mahAratham
shlokas.56:
parityajya cha pA~nchAlaM prayAtA yatra saubalaH |
rAj~no.adarshanasa.nvignA vartamAne janakShaye

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
gajAnIke hate tasminpANDuputreNa bhArata |
vadhyamAne bale chaiva bhImasenena sa.nyuge
shlokas.2:
charantaM cha tathA dRRiShTvA bhImasenamari.ndamam |
daNDahastaM yathA kruddhamantakaM prANahAriNam
shlokas.3:
sametya samare rAjanhatasheShAH sutAstava |
adRRishyamAne kauravye putre duryodhane tava
sodaryAH sahitA bhUtvA bhImasenamupAdravan
shlokas.4:
durmarShaNo mahArAja jaitro bhUribalo raviH |
ityete sahitA bhUtvA tava putrAH samantataH
bhImasenamabhidrutya rurudhuH sarvatodisham
shlokas.5:
tato bhImo mahArAja svarathaM punarAsthitaH |
mumocha nishitAnbANAnputrANAM tava marmasu
shlokas.6:
te kIryamANA bhImena putrAstava mahAraNe |
bhImasenamapAsedhanpravaNAdiva ku~njaram
shlokas.7:
tataH kruddho raNe bhImaH shiro durmarShaNasya ha |
kShurapreNa pramathyAshu pAtayAmAsa bhUtale
shlokas.8:
tato.apareNa bhallena sarvAvaraNabhedinA |
shrutAntamavadhIdbhImastava putraM mahArathaH
shlokas.9:
jayatsenaM tato viddhvA nArAchena hasanniva |
pAtayAmAsa kauravyaM rathopasthAdari.ndamaH
sa papAta rathAdrAjanbhUmau tUrNaM mamAra cha
shlokas.10:
shrutarvA tu tato bhImaM kruddho vivyAdha mAriSha |
shatena gRRidhravAjAnAM sharANAM nataparvaNAm
shlokas.11:
tataH kruddho raNe bhImo jaitraM bhUribalaM ravim |
trInetA.nstribhirAnarChadviShAgnipratimaiH sharaiH
shlokas.12:
te hatA nyapatanbhUmau syandanebhyo mahArathAH |
vasante puShpashabalA nikRRittA iva ki.nshukAH
shlokas.13:
tato.apareNa tIkShNena nArAchena parantapaH |
durvimochanamAhatya preShayAmAsa mRRityave
shlokas.14:
sa hataH prApatadbhUmau svarathAdrathinAM varaH |
girestu kUTajo bhagno mAruteneva pAdapaH
shlokas.15:
duShpradharShaM tatashchaiva sujAtaM cha sutau tava |
ekaikaM nyavadhItsa~Nkhye dvAbhyAM dvAbhyAM chamUmukhe
tau shilImukhaviddhA~Ngau petatU rathasattamau
shlokas.16:
tato yatantamaparamabhivIkShya sutaM tava |
bhallena yudhi vivyAdha bhImo durviShahaM raNe
sa papAta hato vAhAtpashyatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.17:
dRRiShTvA tu nihatAnbhrAtR^InbahUnekena sa.nyuge |
amarShavashamApannaH shrutarvA bhImamabhyayAt
shlokas.18:
vikShipansumahachchApaM kArtasvaravibhUShitam |
visRRijansAyakA.nshchaiva viShAgnipratimAnbahUn
shlokas.19:
sa tu rAjandhanushChittvA pANDavasya mahAmRRidhe |
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM vi.nshatyA samavAkirat
shlokas.20:
tato.anyaddhanurAdAya bhImaseno mahArathaH |
avAkirattava sutaM tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.21:
mahadAsIttayoryuddhaM chitrarUpaM bhayAnakam |
yAdRRishaM samare pUrvaM jambhavAsavayorabhUt
shlokas.22:
tayostatra sharairmuktairyamadaNDanibhaiH shubhaiH |
samAchChannA dharA sarvA khaM cha sarvA dishastathA
shlokas.23:
tataH shrutarvA sa~Nkruddho dhanurAyamya sAyakaiH |
bhImasenaM raNe rAjanbAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.24:
so.atividdho mahArAja tava putreNa dhanvinA |
bhImaH sa~nchukShubhe kruddhaH parvaNIva mahodadhiH
shlokas.25:
tato bhImo ruShAviShTaH putrasya tava mAriSha |
sArathiM chaturashchAshvAnbANairninye yamakShayam
shlokas.26:
virathaM taM samAlakShya vishikhairlomavAhibhiH |
avAkiradameyAtmA darshayanpANilAghavam
shlokas.27:
shrutarvA viratho rAjannAdade khaDgacharmaNI |
athAsyAdadataH khaDgaM shatachandraM cha bhAnumat
kShurapreNa shiraH kAyAtpAtayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.28:
ChinnottamA~Ngasya tataH kShurapreNa mahAtmanaH |
papAta kAyaH sa rathAdvasudhAmanunAdayan
shlokas.29:
tasminnipatite vIre tAvakA bhayamohitAH |
abhyadravanta sa~NgrAme bhImasenaM yuyutsavaH
shlokas.30:
tAnApatata evAshu hatasheShAdbalArNavAt |
da.nshitaH pratijagrAha bhImasenaH pratApavAn
te tu taM vai samAsAdya parivavruH samantataH
shlokas.31:
tatastu sa.nvRRito bhImastAvakairnishitaiH sharaiH |
pIDayAmAsa tAnsarvAnsahasrAkSha ivAsurAn
shlokas.32:
tataH pa~nchashatAnhatvA savarUthAnmahArathAn |
jaghAna ku~njarAnIkaM punaH saptashataM yudhi
shlokas.33:
hatvA dasha sahasrANi pattInAM parameShubhiH |
vAjinAM cha shatAnyaShTau pANDavaH sma virAjate
shlokas.34:
bhImasenastu kaunteyo hatvA yuddhe sutA.nstava |
mene kRRitArthamAtmAnaM saphalaM janma cha prabho
shlokas.35:
taM tathA yudhyamAnaM cha vinighnantaM cha tAvakAn |
IkShituM notsahante sma tava sainyAni bhArata
shlokas.36:
vidrAvya tu kurUnsarvA.nstA.nshcha hatvA padAnugAn |
dorbhyAM shabdaM tatashchakre trAsayAno mahAdvipAn
shlokas.37:
hatabhUyiShThayodhA tu tava senA vishAM pate |
ki~nchichCheShA mahArAja kRRipaNA samapadyata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
duryodhano mahArAja sudarshashchApi te sutaH |
hatasheShau tadA sa~Nkhye vAjimadhye vyavasthitau
shlokas.2:
tato duryodhanaM dRRiShTvA vAjimadhye vyavasthitam |
uvAcha devakIputraH kuntIputraM dhana~njayam
shlokas.3:
shatravo hatabhUyiShThA j~nAtayaH paripAlitAH |
gRRihItvA sa~njayaM chAsau nivRRittaH shinipu~NgavaH
shlokas.4:
parishrAntashcha nakulaH sahadevashcha bhArata |
yodhayitvA raNe pApAndhArtarAShTrapadAnugAn
shlokas.5:
suyodhanamabhityajya traya ete vyavasthitAH |
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha drauNishchaiva mahArathaH
shlokas.6:
asau tiShThati pA~nchAlyaH shriyA paramayA yutaH |
duryodhanabalaM hatvA saha sarvaiH prabhadrakaiH
shlokas.7:
asau duryodhanaH pArtha vAjimadhye vyavasthitaH |
ChatreNa dhriyamANena prekShamANo muhurmuhuH
shlokas.8:
prativyUhya balaM sarvaM raNamadhye vyavasthitaH |
enaM hatvA shitairbANaiH kRRitakRRityo bhaviShyasi
shlokas.9:
gajAnIkaM hataM dRRiShTvA tvAM cha prAptamari.ndama |
yAvanna vidravantyete tAvajjahi suyodhanam
shlokas.10:
yAtu kashchittu pA~nchAlyaM kShipramAgamyatAmiti |
parishrAntabalastAta naiSha muchyeta kilbiShI
shlokas.11:
tava hatvA balaM sarvaM sa~NgrAme dhRRitarAShTrajaH |
jitAnpANDusutAnmatvA rUpaM dhArayate mahat
shlokas.12:
nihataM svabalaM dRRiShTvA pIDitaM chApi pANDavaiH |
dhruvameShyati sa~NgrAme vadhAyaivAtmano nRRipaH
shlokas.13:
evamuktaH phalgunastu kRRiShNaM vachanamabravIt |
dhRRitarAShTrasutAH sarve hatA bhImena mAnada
yAvetAvAsthitau kRRiShNa tAvadya na bhaviShyataH
shlokas.14:
hato bhIShmo hato droNaH karNo vaikartano hataH |
madrarAjo hataH shalyo hataH kRRiShNa jayadrathaH
shlokas.15:
hayAH pa~nchashatAH shiShTAH shakuneH saubalasya cha |
rathAnAM tu shate shiShTe dve eva tu janArdana
dantinAM cha shataM sAgraM trisAhasrAH padAtayaH
shlokas.16:
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva trigartAdhipatistathA |
ulUkaH shakunishchaiva kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH
shlokas.17:
etadbalamabhUchCheShaM dhArtarAShTrasya mAdhava |
mokSho na nUnaM kAlAddhi vidyate bhuvi kasyachit
shlokas.18:
tathA vinihate sainye pashya duryodhanaM sthitam |
adyAhnA hi mahArAjo hatAmitro bhaviShyati
shlokas.19:
na hi me mokShyate kashchitpareShAmiti chintaye |
ye tvadya samaraM kRRiShNa na hAsyanti raNotkaTAH
tAnvai sarvAnhaniShyAmi yadyapi syuramAnuShAH
shlokas.20:
adya yuddhe susa~Nkruddho dIrghaM rAj~naH prajAgaram |
apaneShyAmi gAndhAraM pAtayitvA shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.21:
nikRRityA vai durAchAro yAni ratnAni saubalaH |
sabhAyAmaharaddyUte punastAnyAharAmyaham
shlokas.22:
adya tA api vetsyanti sarvA nAgapurastriyaH |
shrutvA patI.nshcha putrA.nshcha pANDavairnihatAnyudhi
shlokas.23:
samAptamadya vai karma sarvaM kRRiShNa bhaviShyati |
adya duryodhano dIptAM shriyaM prANA.nshcha tyakShyati
shlokas.24:
nApayAti bhayAtkRRiShNa sa~NgrAmAdyadi chenmama |
nihataM viddhi vArShNeya dhArtarAShTraM subAlisham
shlokas.25:
mama hyetadashaktaM vai vAjivRRindamari.ndama |
soDhuM jyAtalanirghoShaM yAhi yAvannihanmyaham
shlokas.26:
evamuktastu dAshArhaH pANDavena yashasvinA |
achodayaddhayAnrAjanduryodhanabalaM prati
shlokas.27:
tadanIkamabhiprekShya trayaH sajjA mahArathAH |
bhImaseno.arjunashchaiva sahadevashcha mAriSha
prayayuH siMhanAdena duryodhanajighA.nsayA
shlokas.28:
tAnprekShya sahitAnsarvA~njavenodyatakArmukAn |
saubalo.abhyadravadyuddhe pANDavAnAtatAyinaH
shlokas.29:
sudarshanastava suto bhImasenaM samabhyayAt |
susharmA shakunishchaiva yuyudhAte kirITinA
sahadevaM tava suto hayapRRiShThagato.abhyayAt
shlokas.30:
tato hyayatnataH kShipraM tava putro janAdhipa |
prAsena sahadevasya shirasi prAharadbhRRisham
shlokas.31:
sopAvishadrathopasthe tava putreNa tADitaH |
rudhirAplutasarvA~Nga AshIviSha iva shvasan
shlokas.32:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM sahadevo vishAM pate |
duryodhanaM sharaistIkShNaiH sa~NkruddhaH samavAkirat
shlokas.33:
pArtho.api yudhi vikramya kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
shUrANAmashvapRRiShThebhyaH shirA.nsi nichakarta ha
shlokas.34:
tadanIkaM tadA pArtho vyadhamadbahubhiH sharaiH |
pAtayitvA hayAnsarvA.nstrigartAnAM rathAnyayau
shlokas.35:
tataste sahitA bhUtvA trigartAnAM mahArathAH |
arjunaM vAsudevaM cha sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.36:
satyakarmANamAkShipya kShurapreNa mahAyashAH |
tato.asya syandanasyeShAM chichChide pANDunandanaH
shlokas.37:
shilAshitena cha vibho kShurapreNa mahAyashAH |
shirashchichCheda prahasa.nstaptakuNDalabhUShaNam
shlokas.38:
satyeShumatha chAdatta yodhAnAM miShatAM tataH |
yathA siMho vane rAjanmRRigaM paribubhukShitaH
shlokas.39:
taM nihatya tataH pArthaH susharmANaM tribhiH sharaiH |
viddhvA tAnahanatsarvAnrathAnrukmavibhUShitAn
shlokas.40:
tatastu pratvaranpArtho dIrghakAlaM susambhRRitam |
mu~nchankrodhaviShaM tIkShNaM prasthalAdhipatiM prati
shlokas.41:
tamarjunaH pRRiShatkAnAM shatena bharatarShabha |
pUrayitvA tato vAhAnnyahanattasya dhanvinaH
shlokas.42:
tataH sharaM samAdAya yamadaNDopamaM shitam |
susharmANaM samuddishya chikShepAshu hasanniva
shlokas.43:
sa sharaH preShitastena krodhadIptena dhanvinA |
susharmANaM samAsAdya bibheda hRRidayaM raNe
shlokas.44:
sa gatAsurmahArAja papAta dharaNItale |
nandayanpANDavAnsarvAnvyathaya.nshchApi tAvakAn
shlokas.45:
susharmANaM raNe hatvA putrAnasya mahArathAn |
sapta chAShTau cha tri.nshachcha sAyakairanayatkShayam
shlokas.46:
tato.asya nishitairbANaiH sarvAnhatvA padAnugAn |
abhyagAdbhAratIM senAM hatasheShAM mahArathaH
shlokas.47:
bhImastu samare kruddhaH putraM tava janAdhipa |
sudarshanamadRRishyaM taM sharaishchakre hasanniva
shlokas.48:
tato.asya prahasankruddhaH shiraH kAyAdapAharat |
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena sa hataH prApatadbhuvi
shlokas.49:
tasmi.nstu nihate vIre tatastasya padAnugAH |
parivavrU raNe bhImaM kiranto vishikhA~nshitAn
shlokas.50:
tatastu nishitairbANaistadanIkaM vRRikodaraH |
indrAshanisamasparshaiH samantAtparyavAkirat
tataH kShaNena tadbhImo nyahanadbharatarShabha
shlokas.51:
teShu tUtsAdyamAneShu senAdhyakShA mahAbalAH |
bhImasenaM samAsAdya tato.ayudhyanta bhArata
tA.nstu sarvA~nsharairghorairavAkirata pANDavaH
shlokas.52:
tathaiva tAvakA rAjanpANDaveyAnmahArathAn |
sharavarSheNa mahatA samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.53:
vyAkulaM tadabhUtsarvaM pANDavAnAM paraiH saha |
tAvakAnAM cha samare pANDaveyairyuyutsatAm
shlokas.54:
tatra yodhAstadA petuH parasparasamAhatAH |
ubhayoH senayo rAjansa.nshochantaH sma bAndhavAn

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasminpravRRitte sa~NgrAme naravAjigajakShaye |
shakuniH saubalo rAjansahadevaM samabhyayAt
shlokas.2:
tato.asyApatatastUrNaM sahadevaH pratApavAn |
sharaughAnpreShayAmAsa pata~NgAniva shIghragAn
ulUkashcha raNe bhImaM vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.3:
shakunistu mahArAja bhImaM viddhvA tribhiH sharaiH |
sAyakAnAM navatyA vai sahadevamavAkirat
shlokas.4:
te shUrAH samare rAjansamAsAdya parasparam |
vivyadhurnishitairbANaiH ka~NkabarhiNavAjitaiH
svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAdhautairA karNAtprahitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.5:
teShAM chApabhujotsRRiShTA sharavRRiShTirvishAM pate |
AchChAdayaddishaH sarvA dhArAbhiriva toyadaH
shlokas.6:
tataH kruddho raNe bhImaH sahadevashcha bhArata |
cheratuH kadanaM sa~Nkhye kurvantau sumahAbalau
shlokas.7:
tAbhyAM sharashataishChannaM tadbalaM tava bhArata |
andhakAramivAkAshamabhavattatra tatra ha
shlokas.8:
ashvairviparidhAvadbhiH sharachChannairvishAM pate |
tatra tatra kRRito mArgo vikarShadbhirhatAnbahUn
shlokas.9:
nihatAnAM hayAnAM cha sahaiva hayayodhibhiH |
varmabhirvinikRRittaishcha prAsaishChinnaishcha mAriSha
sa~nChannA pRRithivI jaj~ne kusumaiH shabalA iva
shlokas.10:
yodhAstatra mahArAja samAsAdya parasparam |
vyacharanta raNe kruddhA vinighnantaH parasparam
shlokas.11:
udvRRittanayanai roShAtsa.ndaShTauShThapuTairmukhaiH |
sakuNDalairmahI ChannA padmaki~njalkasaMnibhaiH
shlokas.12:
bhujaishChinnairmahArAja nAgarAjakaropamaiH |
sA~NgadaiH satanutraishcha sAsiprAsaparashvadhaiH
shlokas.13:
kabandhairutthitaishChinnairnRRityadbhishchAparairyudhi |
kravyAdagaNasa~NkIrNA ghorAbhUtpRRithivI vibho
shlokas.14:
alpAvashiShTe sainye tu kauraveyAnmahAhave |
prahRRiShTAH pANDavA bhUtvA ninyire yamasAdanam
shlokas.15:
etasminnantare shUraH saubaleyaH pratApavAn |
prAsena sahadevasya shirasi prAharadbhRRisham
sa vihvalo mahArAja rathopastha upAvishat
shlokas.16:
sahadevaM tathA dRRiShTvA bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
sarvasainyAni sa~Nkruddho vArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.17:
nirbibheda cha nArAchaiH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
vinirbhidyAkarochchaiva siMhanAdamari.ndama
shlokas.18:
tena shabdena vitrastAH sarve sahayavAraNAH |
prAdravansahasA bhItAH shakuneshcha padAnugAH
shlokas.19:
prabhagnAnatha tAndRRiShTvA rAjA duryodhano.abravIt |
nivartadhvamadharmaj~nA yudhyadhvaM kiM sRRitena vaH
shlokas.20:
iha kIrtiM samAdhAya pretya lokAnsamashnute |
prANA~njahAti yo vIro yudhi pRRiShThamadarshayan
shlokas.21:
evamuktAstu te rAj~nA saubalasya padAnugAH |
pANDavAnabhyavartanta mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam
shlokas.22:
dravadbhistatra rAjendra kRRitaH shabdo.atidAruNaH |
kShubdhasAgarasa~NkAshaH kShubhitaH sarvato.abhavat
shlokas.23:
tA.nstadApatato dRRiShTvA saubalasya padAnugAn |
pratyudyayurmahArAja pANDavA vijaye vRRitAH
shlokas.24:
pratyAshvasya cha durdharShaH sahadevo vishAM pate |
shakuniM dashabhirviddhvA hayA.nshchAsya tribhiH sharaiH
dhanushchichCheda cha sharaiH saubalasya hasanniva
shlokas.25:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya shakuniryuddhadurmadaH |
vivyAdha nakulaM ShaShTyA bhImasenaM cha saptabhiH
shlokas.26:
ulUko.api mahArAja bhImaM vivyAdha saptabhiH |
sahadevaM cha saptatyA parIpsanpitaraM raNe
shlokas.27:
taM bhImasenaH samare vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH |
shakuniM cha chatuHShaShTyA pArshvasthA.nshcha tribhistribhiH
shlokas.28:
te hanyamAnA bhImena nArAchaistailapAyitaiH |
sahadevaM raNe kruddhAshChAdaya~nsharavRRiShTibhiH
parvataM vAridhArAbhiH savidyuta ivAmbudAH
shlokas.29:
tato.asyApatataH shUraH sahadevaH pratApavAn |
ulUkasya mahArAja bhallenApAharachChiraH
shlokas.30:
sa jagAma rathAdbhUmiM sahadevena pAtitaH |
rudhirAplutasarvA~Ngo nandayanpANDavAnyudhi
shlokas.31:
putraM tu nihataM dRRiShTvA shakunistatra bhArata |
sAshrukaNTho viniHshvasya kShatturvAkyamanusmaran
shlokas.32:
chintayitvA muhUrtaM sa bAShpapUrNekShaNaH shvasan |
sahadevaM samAsAdya tribhirvivyAdha sAyakaiH
shlokas.33:
tAnapAsya sharAnmuktA~nsharasa~NghaiH pratApavAn |
sahadevo mahArAja dhanushchichCheda sa.nyuge
shlokas.34:
Chinne dhanuShi rAjendra shakuniH saubalastadA |
pragRRihya vipulaM khaDgaM sahadevAya prAhiNot
shlokas.35:
tamApatantaM sahasA ghorarUpaM vishAM pate |
dvidhA chichCheda samare saubalasya hasanniva
shlokas.36:
asiM dRRiShTvA dvidhA ChinnaM pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm |
prAhiNotsahadevAya sA moghA nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.37:
tataH shaktiM mahAghorAM kAlarAtrimivodyatAm |
preShayAmAsa sa~NkruddhaH pANDavaM prati saubalaH
shlokas.38:
tAmApatantIM sahasA sharaiH kA~nchanabhUShaNaiH |
tridhA chichCheda samare sahadevo hasanniva
shlokas.39:
sA papAta tridhA ChinnA bhUmau kanakabhUShaNA |
shIryamANA yathA dIptA gaganAdvai shatahradA
shlokas.40:
shaktiM vinihatAM dRRiShTvA saubalaM cha bhayArditam |
dudruvustAvakAH sarve bhaye jAte sasaubalAH
shlokas.41:
athotkruShTaM mahaddhyAsItpANDavairjitakAshibhiH |
dhArtarAShTrAstataH sarve prAyasho vimukhAbhavan
shlokas.42:
tAnvai vimanaso dRRiShTvA mAdrIputraH pratApavAn |
sharairanekasAhasrairvArayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.43:
tato gAndhArakairguptaM pRRiShThairashvairjaye dhRRitam |
AsasAda raNe yAntaM sahadevo.atha saubalam
shlokas.44:
svama.nshamavashiShTaM sa sa.nsmRRitya shakuniM nRRipa |
