rathena kA~nchanA~Ngena sahadevaH samabhyayAt
adhijyaM balavatkRRitvA vyAkShipansumahaddhanuH
shlokas.45:
sa saubalamabhidrutya gRRidhrapatraiH shilAshitaiH |
bhRRishamabhyahanatkruddhastottrairiva mahAdvipam
shlokas.46:
uvAcha chainaM medhAvI nigRRihya smArayanniva |
kShatradharme sthito bhUtvA yudhyasva puruSho bhava
shlokas.47:
yattadA hRRiShyase mUDha glahannakShaiH sabhAtale |
phalamadya prapadyasva karmaNastasya durmate
shlokas.48:
nihatAste durAtmAno ye.asmAnavahasanpurA |
duryodhanaH kulA~NgAraH shiShTastvaM tasya mAtulaH
shlokas.49:
adya te vihaniShyAmi kShureNonmathitaM shiraH |
vRRikShAtphalamivoddhRRitya laguDena pramAthinA
shlokas.50:
evamuktvA mahArAja sahadevo mahAbalaH |
sa~Nkruddho narashArdUlo vegenAbhijagAma ha
shlokas.51:
abhigamya tu durdharShaH sahadevo yudhAM patiH |
vikRRiShya balavachchApaM krodhena prahasanniva
shlokas.52:
shakuniM dashabhirviddhvA chaturbhishchAsya vAjinaH |
ChatraM dhvajaM dhanushchAsya ChittvA siMha ivAnadat
shlokas.53:
ChinnadhvajadhanushChatraH sahadevena saubalaH |
tato viddhashcha bahubhiH sarvamarmasu sAyakaiH
shlokas.54:
tato bhUyo mahArAja sahadevaH pratApavAn |
shakuneH preShayAmAsa sharavRRiShTiM durAsadAm
shlokas.55:
tatastu kruddhaH subalasya putro; mAdrIsutaM sahadevaM vimarde |
prAsena jAmbUnadabhUShaNena; jighA.nsureko.abhipapAta shIghram
shlokas.56:
mAdrIsutastasya samudyataM taM; prAsaM suvRRittau cha bhujau raNAgre |
bhallaistribhiryugapatsa~nchakarta; nanAda chochchaistarasAjimadhye
shlokas.57:
tasyAshukArI susamAhitena; suvarNapu~Nkhena dRRiDhAyasena |
bhallena sarvAvaraNAtigena; shiraH sharIrAtpramamAtha bhUyaH
shlokas.58:
shareNa kArtasvarabhUShitena; divAkarAbhena susa.nshitena |
hRRitottamA~Ngo yudhi pANDavena; papAta bhUmau subalasya putraH
shlokas.59:
sa tachChiro vegavatA shareNa; suvarNapu~Nkhena shilAshitena |
prAverayatkupitaH pANDuputro; yattatkurUNAmanayasya mUlam
shlokas.60:
hRRitottamA~NgaM shakuniM samIkShya; bhUmau shayAnaM rudhirArdragAtram |
yodhAstvadIyA bhayanaShTasattvA; dishaH prajagmuH pragRRihItashastrAH
shlokas.61:
vipradrutAH shuShkamukhA visa~nj~nA; gANDIvaghoSheNa samAhatAshcha |
bhayArditA bhagnarathAshvanAgAH; padAtayashchaiva sadhArtarAShTrAH
shlokas.62:
tato rathAchChakuniM pAtayitvA; mudAnvitA bhArata pANDaveyAH |
sha~NkhAnpradadhmuH samare prahRRiShTAH; sakeshavAH sainikAnharShayantaH
shlokas.63:
taM chApi sarve pratipUjayanto; hRRiShTA bruvANAH sahadevamAjau |
diShTyA hato naikRRitiko durAtmA; sahAtmajo vIra raNe tvayeti

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH kruddhA mahArAja saubalasya padAnugAH |
tyaktvA jIvitamAkrande pANDavAnparyavArayan
shlokas.2:
tAnarjunaH pratyagRRihNAtsahadevajaye dhRRitaH |
bhImasenashcha tejasvI kruddhAshIviShadarshanaH
shlokas.3:
shaktyRRiShTiprAsahastAnAM sahadevaM jighA.nsatAm |
sa~NkalpamakaronmoghaM gANDIvena dhana~njayaH
shlokas.4:
pragRRihItAyudhAnbAhUnyodhAnAmabhidhAvatAm |
bhallaishchichCheda bIbhatsuH shirA.nsyapi hayAnapi
shlokas.5:
te hatAH pratyapadyanta vasudhAM vigatAsavaH |
tvaritA lokavIreNa prahatAH savyasAchinA
shlokas.6:
tato duryodhano rAjA dRRiShTvA svabalasa~NkShayam |
hatasheShAnsamAnIya kruddho rathashatAnvibho
shlokas.7:
ku~njarA.nshcha hayA.nshchaiva pAdAtA.nshcha parantapa |
uvAcha sahitAnsarvAndhArtarAShTra idaM vachaH
shlokas.8:
samAsAdya raNe sarvAnpANDavAnsasuhRRidgaNAn |
pA~nchAlyaM chApi sabalaM hatvA shIghraM nivartata
shlokas.9:
tasya te shirasA gRRihya vachanaM yuddhadurmadAH |
pratyudyayU raNe pArthA.nstava putrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.10:
tAnabhyApatataH shIghraM hatasheShAnmahAraNe |
sharairAshIviShAkAraiH pANDavAH samavAkiran
shlokas.11:
tatsainyaM bharatashreShTha muhUrtena mahAtmabhiH |
avadhyata raNaM prApya trAtAraM nAbhyavindata
pratiShThamAnaM tu bhayAnnAvatiShThata da.nshitam
shlokas.12:
ashvairviparidhAvadbhiH sainyena rajasA vRRite |
na prAj~nAyanta samare dishashcha pradishastathA
shlokas.13:
tatastu pANDavAnIkAnniHsRRitya bahavo janAH |
abhyaghna.nstAvakAnyuddhe muhUrtAdiva bhArata
tato niHsheShamabhavattatsainyaM tava bhArata
shlokas.14:
akShauhiNyaH sametAstu tava putrasya bhArata |
ekAdasha hatA yuddhe tAH prabho pANDusRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.15:
teShu rAjasahasreShu tAvakeShu mahAtmasu |
eko duryodhano rAjannadRRishyata bhRRishaM kShataH
shlokas.16:
tato vIkShya dishaH sarvA dRRiShTvA shUnyAM cha medinIm |
vihInaH sarvayodhaishcha pANDavAnvIkShya sa.nyuge
shlokas.17:
muditAnsarvasiddhArthAnnardamAnAnsamantataH |
bANashabdaravA.nshchaiva shrutvA teShAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.18:
duryodhano mahArAja kashmalenAbhisa.nvRRitaH |
apayAne manashchakre vihInabalavAhanaH
shlokas.19:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
nihate mAmake sainye niHsheShe shibire kRRite |
pANDavAnAM balaM sUta kiM nu sheShamabhUttadA
etanme pRRichChato brUhi kushalo hyasi sa~njaya
shlokas.20:
yachcha duryodhano mandaH kRRitavA.nstanayo mama |
balakShayaM tathA dRRiShTvA sa ekaH pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.21:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rathAnAM dve sahasre tu sapta nAgashatAni cha |
pa~ncha chAshvasahasrANi pattInAM cha shataM shatAH
shlokas.22:
etachCheShamabhUdrAjanpANDavAnAM mahadbalam |
parigRRihya hi yadyuddhe dhRRiShTadyumno vyavasthitaH
shlokas.23:
ekAkI bharatashreShTha tato duryodhano nRRipaH |
nApashyatsamare ka~nchitsahAyaM rathinAM varaH
shlokas.24:
nardamAnAnparA.nshchaiva svabalasya cha sa~NkShayam |
hataM svahayamutsRRijya prA~NmukhaH prAdravadbhayAt
shlokas.25:
ekAdashachamUbhartA putro duryodhanastava |
gadAmAdAya tejasvI padAtiH prasthito hradam
shlokas.26:
nAtidUraM tato gatvA padbhyAmeva narAdhipaH |
sasmAra vachanaM kShatturdharmashIlasya dhImataH
shlokas.27:
idaM nUnaM mahAprAj~no viduro dRRiShTavAnpurA |
mahadvaishasamasmAkaM kShatriyANAM cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.28:
evaM vichintayAnastu pravivikShurhradaM nRRipaH |
duHkhasantaptahRRidayo dRRiShTvA rAjanbalakShayam
shlokas.29:
pANDavAshcha mahArAja dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH |
abhyadhAvanta sa~NkruddhAstava rAjanbalaM prati
shlokas.30:
shaktyRRiShTiprAsahastAnAM balAnAmabhigarjatAm |
sa~NkalpamakaronmoghaM gANDIvena dhana~njayaH
shlokas.31:
tAnhatvA nishitairbANaiH sAmAtyAnsaha bandhubhiH |
rathe shvetahaye tiShThannarjuno bahvashobhata
shlokas.32:
subalasya hate putre savAjirathaku~njare |
mahAvanamiva ChinnamabhavattAvakaM balam
shlokas.33:
anekashatasAhasre bale duryodhanasya ha |
nAnyo mahAratho rAja~njIvamAno vyadRRishyata
shlokas.34:
droNaputrAdRRite vIrAttathaiva kRRitavarmaNaH |
kRRipAchcha gautamAdrAjanpArthivAchcha tavAtmajAt
shlokas.35:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu mAM dRRiShTvA hasansAtyakimabravIt |
kimanena gRRihItena nAnenArtho.asti jIvatA
shlokas.36:
dhRRiShTadyumnavachaH shrutvA shinernaptA mahArathaH |
udyamya nishitaM khaDgaM hantuM mAmudyatastadA
shlokas.37:
tamAgamya mahAprAj~naH kRRiShNadvaipAyano.abravIt |
muchyatAM sa~njayo jIvanna hantavyaH katha~nchana
shlokas.38:
dvaipAyanavachaH shrutvA shinernaptA kRRitA~njaliH |
tato mAmabravInmuktvA svasti sa~njaya sAdhaya
shlokas.39:
anuj~nAtastvahaM tena nyastavarmA nirAyudhaH |
prAtiShThaM yena nagaraM sAyAhne rudhirokShitaH
shlokas.40:
kroshamAtramapakrAntaM gadApANimavasthitam |
ekaM duryodhanaM rAjannapashyaM bhRRishavikShatam
shlokas.41:
sa tu mAmashrupUrNAkSho nAshaknodabhivIkShitum |
upapraikShata mAM dRRiShTvA tadA dInamavasthitam
shlokas.42:
taM chAhamapi shochantaM dRRiShTvaikAkinamAhave |
muhUrtaM nAshakaM vaktuM ki~nchidduHkhapariplutaH
shlokas.43:
tato.asmai tadahaM sarvamuktavAngrahaNaM tadA |
dvaipAyanaprasAdAchcha jIvato mokShamAhave
shlokas.44:
muhUrtamiva cha dhyAtvA pratilabhya cha chetanAm |
bhrAtR^I.nshcha sarvasainyAni paryapRRichChata mAM tataH
shlokas.45:
tasmai tadahamAchakShaM sarvaM pratyakShadarshivAn |
bhrAtR^I.nshcha nihatAnsarvAnsainyaM cha vinipAtitam
shlokas.46:
trayaH kila rathAH shiShTAstAvakAnAM narAdhipa |
iti prasthAnakAle mAM kRRiShNadvaipAyano.abravIt
shlokas.47:
sa dIrghamiva niHshvasya viprekShya cha punaH punaH |
a.nse mAM pANinA spRRiShTvA putraste paryabhAShata
shlokas.48:
tvadanyo neha sa~NgrAme kashchijjIvati sa~njaya |
dvitIyaM neha pashyAmi sasahAyAshcha pANDavAH
shlokas.49:
brUyAH sa~njaya rAjAnaM praj~nAchakShuShamIshvaram |
duryodhanastava sutaH praviShTo hradamityuta
shlokas.50:
suhRRidbhistAdRRishairhInaH putrairbhrAtRRibhireva cha |
pANDavaishcha hRRite rAjye ko nu jIvati mAdRRishaH
shlokas.51:
AchakShethAH sarvamidaM mAM cha muktaM mahAhavAt |
asmi.nstoyahrade suptaM jIvantaM bhRRishavikShatam
shlokas.52:
evamuktvA mahArAja prAvishattaM hradaM nRRipaH |
astambhayata toyaM cha mAyayA manujAdhipaH
shlokas.53:
tasminhradaM praviShTe tu trInrathA~nshrAntavAhanAn |
apashyaM sahitAnekastaM deshaM samupeyuShaH
shlokas.54:
kRRipaM shAradvataM vIraM drauNiM cha rathinAM varam |
bhojaM cha kRRitavarmANaM sahitA~nsharavikShatAn
shlokas.55:
te sarve mAmabhiprekShya tUrNamashvAnachodayan |
upayAya cha mAmUchurdiShTyA jIvasi sa~njaya
shlokas.56:
apRRichCha.nshchaiva mAM sarve putraM tava janAdhipam |
kachchidduryodhano rAjA sa no jIvati sa~njaya
shlokas.57:
AkhyAtavAnahaM tebhyastadA kushalinaM nRRipam |
tachchaiva sarvamAchakShaM yanmAM duryodhano.abravIt
hradaM chaivAhamAchaShTa yaM praviShTo narAdhipaH
shlokas.58:
ashvatthAmA tu tadrAjannishamya vachanaM mama |
taM hradaM vipulaM prekShya karuNaM paryadevayat
shlokas.59:
aho dhi~Nna sa jAnAti jIvato.asmAnnarAdhipaH |
paryAptA hi vayaM tena saha yodhayituM parAn
shlokas.60:
te tu tatra chiraM kAlaM vilapya cha mahArathAH |
prAdravanrathinAM shreShThA dRRiShTvA pANDusutAnraNe
shlokas.61:
te tu mAM rathamAropya kRRipasya supariShkRRitam |
senAniveshamAjagmurhatasheShAstrayo rathAH
shlokas.62:
tatra gulmAH paritrastAH sUrye chAstamite sati |
sarve vichukrushuH shrutvA putrANAM tava sa~NkShayam
shlokas.63:
tato vRRiddhA mahArAja yoShitAM rakShaNo narAH |
rAjadArAnupAdAya prayayurnagaraM prati
shlokas.64:
tatra vikroshatInAM cha rudatInAM cha sarvashaH |
prAdurAsInmahA~nshabdaH shrutvA tadbalasa~NkShayam
shlokas.65:
tatastA yoShito rAjankrandantyo vai muhurmuhuH |
kurarya iva shabdena nAdayantyo mahItalam
shlokas.66:
AjaghnuH karajaishchApi pANibhishcha shirA.nsyuta |
luluvushcha tadA keshAnkroshantyastatra tatra ha
shlokas.67:
hAhAkAravinAdinyo vinighnantya urA.nsi cha |
kroshantyastatra ruruduH krandamAnA vishAM pate
shlokas.68:
tato duryodhanAmAtyAH sAshrukaNThA bhRRishAturAH |
rAjadArAnupAdAya prayayurnagaraM prati
shlokas.69:
vetrajarjharahastAshcha dvArAdhyakShA vishAM pate |
shayanIyAni shubhrANi spardhyAstaraNavanti cha
samAdAya yayustUrNaM nagaraM dArarakShiNaH
shlokas.71:
adRRiShTapUrvA yA nAryo bhAskareNApi veshmasu |
dadRRishustA mahArAja janA yAntIH puraM prati
shlokas.72:
tAH striyo bharatashreShTha saukumAryasamanvitAH |
prayayurnagaraM tUrNaM hatasvajanabAndhavAH
shlokas.73:
A gopAlAvipAlebhyo dravanto nagaraM prati |
yayurmanuShyAH sambhrAntA bhImasenabhayArditAH
shlokas.74:
api chaiShAM bhayaM tIvraM pArthebhyo.abhUtsudAruNam |
prekShamANAstadAnyonyamAdhAvannagaraM prati
shlokas.75:
tasmi.nstadA vartamAne vidrave bhRRishadAruNe |
yuyutsuH shokasaMmUDhaH prAptakAlamachintayat
shlokas.76:
jito duryodhanaH sa~Nkhye pANDavairbhImavikramaiH |
ekAdashachamUbhartA bhrAtarashchAsya sUditAH
hatAshcha kuravaH sarve bhIShmadroNapuraHsarAH
shlokas.77:
ahameko vimuktastu bhAgyayogAdyadRRichChayA |
vidrutAni cha sarvANi shibirANi samantataH
shlokas.78:
duryodhanasya sachivA ye kechidavasheShitAH |
rAjadArAnupAdAya vyadhAvannagaraM prati
shlokas.79:
prAptakAlamahaM manye praveshaM taiH sahAbhibho |
yudhiShThiramanuj~nApya bhImasenaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.80:
etamarthaM mahAbAhurubhayoH sa nyavedayat |
tasya prIto.abhavadrAjA nityaM karuNaveditA
pariShvajya mahAbAhurvaishyAputraM vyasarjayat
shlokas.81:
tataH sa rathamAsthAya drutamashvAnachodayat |
asambhAvitavA.nshchApi rAjadArAnpuraM prati
shlokas.82:
taishchaiva sahitaH kShipramastaM gachChati bhAskare |
praviShTo hAstinapuraM bAShpakaNTho.ashrulochanaH
shlokas.83:
apashyata mahAprAj~naM viduraM sAshrulochanam |
rAj~naH samIpAnniShkrAntaM shokopahatachetasam
shlokas.84:
tamabravItsatyadhRRitiH praNataM tvagrataH sthitam |
asminkurukShaye vRRitte diShTyA tvaM putra jIvasi
shlokas.85:
vinA rAj~naH praveshAdvai kimasi tvamihAgataH |
etanme kAraNaM sarvaM vistareNa nivedaya
shlokas.86:
yuyutsuruvAcha||
nihate shakunau tAta saj~nAtisutabAndhave |
hatasheShaparIvAro rAjA duryodhanastataH
svakaM sa hayamutsRRijya prA~NmukhaH prAdravadbhayAt
shlokas.87:
apakrAnte tu nRRipatau skandhAvAraniveshanAt |
bhayavyAkulitaM sarvaM prAdravannagaraM prati
shlokas.88:
tato rAj~naH kalatrANi bhrAtR^INAM chAsya sarvashaH |
vAhaneShu samAropya stryadhyakShAH prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.89:
tato.ahaM samanuj~nApya rAjAnaM sahakeshavam |
praviShTo hAstinapuraM rakSha.NllokAddhi vAchyatAm
shlokas.90:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM vaishyAputreNa bhAShitam |
prAptakAlamiti j~nAtvA viduraH sarvadharmavit
apUjayadameyAtmA yuyutsuM vAkyakovidam
shlokas.91:
prAptakAlamidaM sarvaM bhavato bharatakShaye |
adya tvamiha vishrAntaH shvo.abhigantA yudhiShThiram
shlokas.92:
etAvaduktvA vachanaM viduraH sarvadharmavit |
yuyutsuM samanuj~nApya pravivesha nRRipakShayam
yuyutsurapi tAM rAtriM svagRRihe nyavasattadA

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
hateShu sarvasainyeShu pANDuputrai raNAjire |
mama sainyAvashiShTAste kimakurvata sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
kRRitavarmA kRRipashchaiva droNaputrashcha vIryavAn |
duryodhanashcha mandAtmA rAjA kimakarottadA
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
samprAdravatsu dAreShu kShatriyANAM mahAtmanAm |
vidrute shibire shUnye bhRRishodvignAstrayo rathAH
shlokas.4:
nishamya pANDuputrANAM tadA vijayinAM svanam |
vidrutaM shibiraM dRRiShTvA sAyAhne rAjagRRiddhinaH
sthAnaM nArochaya.nstatra tataste hradamabhyayuH
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThiro.api dharmAtmA bhrAtRRibhiH sahito raNe |
hRRiShTaH paryapatadrAjanduryodhanavadhepsayA
shlokas.6:
mArgamANAstu sa~NkruddhAstava putraM jayaiShiNaH |
yatnato.anveShamANAstu naivApashya~njanAdhipam
shlokas.7:
sa hi tIvreNa vegena gadApANirapAkramat |
taM hradaM prAvishachchApi viShTabhyApaH svamAyayA
shlokas.8:
yadA tu pANDavAH sarve suparishrAntavAhanAH |
tataH svashibiraM prApya vyatiShThansahasainikAH
shlokas.9:
tataH kRRipashcha drauNishcha kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
saMniviShTeShu pArtheShu prayAtAstaM hradaM shanaiH
shlokas.10:
te taM hradaM samAsAdya yatra shete janAdhipaH |
abhyabhAShanta durdharShaM rAjAnaM suptamambhasi
shlokas.11:
rAjannuttiShTha yudhyasva sahAsmAbhiryudhiShThiram |
jitvA vA pRRithivIM bhu~NkShva hato vA svargamApnuhi
shlokas.12:
teShAmapi balaM sarvaM hataM duryodhana tvayA |
pratirabdhAshcha bhUyiShThaM ye shiShTAstatra sainikAH
shlokas.13:
na te vegaM viShahituM shaktAstava vishAM pate |
asmAbhirabhiguptasya tasmAduttiShTha bhArata
shlokas.14:
duryodhana uvAcha||
diShTyA pashyAmi vo muktAnIdRRishAtpuruShakShayAt |
pANDukauravasaMmardAjjIvamAnAnnararShabhAn
shlokas.15:
vijeShyAmo vayaM sarve vishrAntA vigataklamAH |
bhavantashcha parishrAntA vayaM cha bhRRishavikShatAH
udIrNaM cha balaM teShAM tena yuddhaM na rochaye
shlokas.16:
na tvetadadbhutaM vIrA yadvo mahadidaM manaH |
asmAsu cha parA bhaktirna tu kAlaH parAkrame
shlokas.17:
vishramyaikAM nishAmadya bhavadbhiH sahito raNe |
pratiyotsyAmyahaM shatrU~nshvo na me.astyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.18:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamukto.abravIddrauNI rAjAnaM yuddhadurmadam |
uttiShTha rAjanbhadraM te vijeShyAmo raNe parAn
shlokas.19:
iShTApUrtena dAnena satyena cha japena cha |
shape rAjanyathA hyadya nihaniShyAmi somakAn
shlokas.20:
mA sma yaj~nakRRitAM prItiM prApnuyAM sajjanochitAm |
yadImAM rajanIM vyuShTAM na nihanmi parAnraNe
shlokas.21:
nAhatvA sarvapA~nchAlAnvimokShye kavachaM vibho |
iti satyaM bravImyetattanme shRRiNu janAdhipa
shlokas.22:
teShu sambhAShamANeShu vyAdhAstaM deshamAyayuH |
mA.nsabhAraparishrAntAH pAnIyArthaM yadRRichChayA
shlokas.23:
te hi nityaM mahArAja bhImasenasya lubdhakAH |
mA.nsabhArAnupAjahrurbhaktyA paramayA vibho
shlokas.24:
te tatra viShThitAsteShAM sarvaM tadvachanaM rahaH |
duryodhanavachashchaiva shushruvuH sa~NgatA mithaH
shlokas.25:
te.api sarve maheShvAsA ayuddhArthini kaurave |
nirbandhaM paramaM chakrustadA vai yuddhakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.26:
tA.nstathA samudIkShyAtha kauravANAM mahArathAn |
ayuddhamanasaM chaiva rAjAnaM sthitamambhasi
shlokas.27:
teShAM shrutvA cha sa.nvAdaM rAj~nashcha salile sataH |
vyAdhAbhyajAnanrAjendra salilasthaM suyodhanam
shlokas.28:
te pUrvaM pANDuputreNa pRRiShTA hyAsansutaM tava |
yadRRichChopagatAstatra rAjAnaM parimArgitAH
shlokas.29:
tataste pANDuputrasya smRRitvA tadbhAShitaM tadA |
anyonyamabruvanrAjanmRRigavyAdhAH shanairidam
shlokas.30:
duryodhanaM khyApayAmo dhanaM dAsyati pANDavaH |
suvyaktamiti naH khyAto hrade duryodhano nRRipaH
shlokas.31:
tasmAdgachChAmahe sarve yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
AkhyAtuM salile suptaM duryodhanamamarShaNam
shlokas.32:
dhRRitarAShTrAtmajaM tasmai bhImasenAya dhImate |
shayAnaM salile sarve kathayAmo dhanurbhRRite
shlokas.33:
sa no dAsyati suprIto dhanAni bahulAnyuta |
kiM no mA.nsena shuShkeNa parikliShTena shoShiNA
shlokas.34:
evamuktvA tato vyAdhAH samprahRRiShTA dhanArthinaH |
mA.nsabhArAnupAdAya prayayuH shibiraM prati
shlokas.35:
pANDavAshcha mahArAja labdhalakShAH prahAriNaH |
apashyamAnAH samare duryodhanamavasthitam
shlokas.36:
nikRRitestasya pApasya te pAraM gamanepsavaH |
chArAnsampreShayAmAsuH samantAttadraNAjiram
shlokas.37:
Agamya tu tataH sarve naShTaM duryodhanaM nRRipam |
nyavedayanta sahitA dharmarAjasya sainikAH
shlokas.38:
teShAM tadvachanaM shrutvA chArANAM bharatarShabha |
chintAmabhyagamattIvrAM nishashvAsa cha pArthivaH
shlokas.39:
atha sthitAnAM pANDUnAM dInAnAM bharatarShabha |
tasmAddeshAdapakramya tvaritA lubdhakA vibho
shlokas.40:
AjagmuH shibiraM hRRiShTA dRRiShTvA duryodhanaM nRRipam |
vAryamANAH praviShTAshcha bhImasenasya pashyataH
shlokas.41:
te tu pANDavamAsAdya bhImasenaM mahAbalam |
tasmai tatsarvamAchakhyuryadvRRittaM yachcha vai shrutam
shlokas.42:
tato vRRikodaro rAjandattvA teShAM dhanaM bahu |
dharmarAjAya tatsarvamAchachakShe parantapaH
shlokas.43:
asau duryodhano rAjanvij~nAto mama lubdhakaiH |
sa.nstabhya salilaM shete yasyArthe paritapyase
shlokas.44:
tadvacho bhImasenasya priyaM shrutvA vishAM pate |
ajAtashatruH kaunteyo hRRiShTo.abhUtsaha sodaraiH
shlokas.45:
taM cha shrutvA maheShvAsaM praviShTaM salilahradam |
kShiprameva tato.agachChatpuraskRRitya janArdanam
shlokas.46:
tataH kilakilAshabdaH prAdurAsIdvishAM pate |
pANDavAnAM prahRRiShTAnAM pA~nchAlAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.47:
siMhanAdA.nstatashchakruH kShveDA.nshcha bharatarShabha |
tvaritAH kShatriyA rAja~njagmurdvaipAyanaM hradam
shlokas.48:
j~nAtaH pApo dhArtarAShTro dRRiShTashchetyasakRRidraNe |
prAkroshansomakAstatra hRRiShTarUpAH samantataH
shlokas.49:
teShAmAshu prayAtAnAM rathAnAM tatra veginAm |
babhUva tumulaH shabdo divaspRRikpRRithivIpate
shlokas.50:
duryodhanaM parIpsantastatra tatra yudhiShThiram |
anvayustvaritAste vai rAjAnaM shrAntavAhanAH
shlokas.51:
arjuno bhImasenashcha mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pA~nchAlyaH shikhaNDI chAparAjitaH
shlokas.52:
uttamaujA yudhAmanyuH sAtyakishchAparAjitaH |
pA~nchAlAnAM cha ye shiShTA draupadeyAshcha bhArata
hayAshcha sarve nAgAshcha shatashashcha padAtayaH
shlokas.53:
tataH prApto mahArAja dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
dvaipAyanahradaM khyAtaM yatra duryodhano.abhavat
shlokas.54:
shItAmalajalaM hRRidyaM dvitIyamiva sAgaram |
mAyayA salilaM stabhya yatrAbhUtte sutaH sthitaH
shlokas.55:
atyadbhutena vidhinA daivayogena bhArata |
salilAntargataH shete durdarshaH kasyachitprabho
mAnuShasya manuShyendra gadAhasto janAdhipaH
shlokas.56:
tato duryodhano rAjA salitAntargato vasan |
shushruve tumulaM shabdaM jaladopamaniHsvanam
shlokas.57:
yudhiShThirastu rAjendra hradaM taM saha sodaraiH |
AjagAma mahArAja tava putravadhAya vai
shlokas.58:
mahatA sha~NkhanAdena rathanemisvanena cha |
uddhunva.nshcha mahAreNuM kampaya.nshchApi medinIm
shlokas.59:
yaudhiShThirasya sainyasya shrutvA shabdaM mahArathAH |
kRRitavarmA kRRipo drauNI rAjAnamidamabruvan
shlokas.60:
ime hyAyAnti saMhRRiShTAH pANDavA jitakAshinaH |
apayAsyAmahe tAvadanujAnAtu no bhavAn
shlokas.61:
duryodhanastu tachChrutvA teShAM tatra yashasvinAm |
tathetyuktvA hradaM taM vai mAyayAstambhayatprabho
shlokas.62:
te tvanuj~nApya rAjAnaM bhRRishaM shokaparAyaNAH |
jagmurdUraM mahArAja kRRipaprabhRRitayo rathAH
shlokas.63:
te gatvA dUramadhvAnaM nyagrodhaM prekShya mAriSha |
nyavishanta bhRRishaM shrAntAshchintayanto nRRipaM prati
shlokas.64:
viShTabhya salilaM supto dhArtarAShTro mahAbalaH |
pANDavAshchApi samprAptAstaM deshaM yuddhamIpsavaH
shlokas.65:
kathaM nu yuddhaM bhavitA kathaM rAjA bhaviShyati |
kathaM nu pANDavA rAjanpratipatsyanti kauravam
shlokas.66:
ityevaM chintayantaste rathebhyo.ashvAnvimuchya ha |
tatrAsAM chakrire rAjankRRipaprabhRRitayo rathAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tatasteShvapayAteShu ratheShu triShu pANDavAH |
taM hradaM pratyapadyanta yatra duryodhano.abhavat
shlokas.2:
AsAdya cha kurushreShTha tadA dvaipAyanahradam |
stambhitaM dhArtarAShTreNa dRRiShTvA taM salilAshayam
vAsudevamidaM vAkyamabravItkurunandanaH
shlokas.3:
pashyemAM dhArtarAShTreNa mAyAmapsu prayojitAm |
viShTabhya salilaM shete nAsya mAnuShato bhayam
shlokas.4:
daivIM mAyAmimAM kRRitvA salilAntargato hyayam |
nikRRityA nikRRitipraj~no na me jIvanvimokShyate
shlokas.5:
yadyasya samare sAhyaM kurute vajrabhRRitsvayam |
tathApyenaM hataM yuddhe loko drakShyati mAdhava
shlokas.6:
shrIvAsudeva uvAcha||
mAyAvina imAM mAyAM mAyayA jahi bhArata |
mAyAvI mAyayA vadhyaH satyametadyudhiShThira
shlokas.7:
kriyAbhyupAyairbahulairmAyAmapsu prayojya ha |
jahi tvaM bharatashreShTha pApAtmAnaM suyodhanam
shlokas.8:
kriyAbhyupAyairindreNa nihatA daityadAnavAH |
kriyAbhyupAyairbahubhirbalirbaddho mahAtmanA
shlokas.9:
kriyAbhyupAyaiH pUrvaM hi hiraNyAkSho mahAsuraH |
hiraNyakashipushchaiva kriyayaiva niShUditau
vRRitrashcha nihato rAjankriyayaiva na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.10:
tathA paulastyatanayo rAvaNo nAma rAkShasaH |
rAmeNa nihato rAjansAnubandhaH sahAnugaH
kriyayA yogamAsthAya tathA tvamapi vikrama
shlokas.11:
kriyAbhyupAyairnihato mayA rAjanpurAtane |
tArakashcha mahAdaityo viprachittishcha vIryavAn
shlokas.12:
vAtApirilvalashchaiva trishirAshcha tathA vibho |
sundopasundAvasurau kriyayaiva niShUditau
shlokas.13:
kriyAbhyupAyairindreNa tridivaM bhujyate vibho |
kriyA balavatI rAjannAnyatki~nchidyudhiShThira
shlokas.14:
daityAshcha dAnavAshchaiva rAkShasAH pArthivAstathA |
kriyAbhyupAyairnihatAH kriyAM tasmAtsamAchara
shlokas.15:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ityukto vAsudevena pANDavaH sa.nshitavrataH |
jalasthaM taM mahArAja tava putraM mahAbalam
abhyabhAShata kaunteyaH prahasanniva bhArata
shlokas.16:
suyodhana kimartho.ayamArambho.apsu kRRitastvayA |
sarvaM kShatraM ghAtayitvA svakulaM cha vishAM pate
shlokas.17:
jalAshayaM praviShTo.adya vA~nCha~njIvitamAtmanaH |
uttiShTha rAjanyudhyasva sahAsmAbhiH suyodhana
shlokas.18:
sa cha darpo narashreShTha sa cha mAnaH kva te gataH |
yastvaM sa.nstabhya salilaM bhIto rAjanvyavasthitaH
shlokas.19:
sarve tvAM shUra ityeva janA jalpanti sa.nsadi |
vyarthaM tadbhavato manye shauryaM salilashAyinaH
shlokas.20:
uttiShTha rAjanyudhyasva kShatriyo.asi kulodbhavaH |
kauraveyo visheSheNa kule janma cha sa.nsmara
shlokas.21:
sa kathaM kaurave va.nshe prasha.nsa~njanma chAtmanaH |
yuddhAdbhItastatastoyaM pravishya pratitiShThasi
shlokas.22:
ayuddhamavyavasthAnaM naiSha dharmaH sanAtanaH |
anAryajuShTamasvargyaM raNe rAjanpalAyanam
shlokas.23:
kathaM pAramagatvA hi yuddhe tvaM vai jijIviShuH |
imAnnipatitAndRRiShTvA putrAnbhrAtR^InpitR^I.nstathA
shlokas.24:
sambandhino vayasyA.nshcha mAtulAnbAndhavA.nstathA |
ghAtayitvA kathaM tAta hrade tiShThasi sAmpratam
shlokas.25:
shUramAnI na shUrastvaM mithyA vadasi bhArata |
shUro.ahamiti durbuddhe sarvalokasya shRRiNvataH
shlokas.26:
na hi shUrAH palAyante shatrUndRRiShTvA katha~nchana |
brUhi vA tvaM yayA dhRRityA shUra tyajasi sa~Ngaram
shlokas.27:
sa tvamuttiShTha yudhyasva vinIya bhayamAtmanaH |
ghAtayitvA sarvasainyaM bhrAtR^I.nshchaiva suyodhana
shlokas.28:
nedAnIM jIvite buddhiH kAryA dharmachikIrShayA |
kShatradharmamapAshritya tvadvidhena suyodhana
shlokas.29:
yattatkarNamupAshritya shakuniM chApi saubalam |
amartya iva saMmohAttvamAtmAnaM na buddhavAn
shlokas.30:
tatpApaM sumahatkRRitvA pratiyudhyasva bhArata |
kathaM hi tvadvidho mohAdrochayeta palAyanam
shlokas.31:
kva te tatpauruShaM yAtaM kva cha mAnaH suyodhana |
kva cha vikrAntatA yAtA kva cha visphUrjitaM mahat
shlokas.32:
kva te kRRitAstratA yAtA kiM cha sheShe jalAshaye |
sa tvamuttiShTha yudhyasva kShatradharmeNa bhArata
shlokas.33:
asmAnvA tvaM parAjitya prashAdhi pRRithivImimAm |
atha vA nihato.asmAbhirbhUmau svapsyasi bhArata
shlokas.34:
eSha te prathamo dharmaH sRRiShTo dhAtrA mahAtmanA |
taM kuruShva yathAtathyaM rAjA bhava mahAratha
shlokas.35:
duryodhana uvAcha||
naitachchitraM mahArAja yadbhIH prANinamAvishet |
na cha prANabhayAdbhIto vyapayAto.asmi bhArata
shlokas.36:
arathashchAniSha~NgI cha nihataH pArShNisArathiH |
ekashchApyagaNaH sa~Nkhye pratyAshvAsamarochayam
shlokas.37:
na prANahetorna bhayAnna viShAdAdvishAM pate |
idamambhaH praviShTo.asmi shramAttvidamanuShThitam
shlokas.38:
tvaM chAshvasihi kaunteya ye chApyanugatAstava |
ahamutthAya vaH sarvAnpratiyotsyAmi sa.nyuge
shlokas.39:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AshvastA eva sarve sma chiraM tvAM mRRigayAmahe |
tadidAnIM samuttiShTha yudhyasveha suyodhana
shlokas.40:
hatvA vA samare pArthAnsphItaM rAjyamavApnuhi |
nihato vA raNe.asmAbhirvIralokamavApsyasi
shlokas.41:
duryodhana uvAcha||
yadarthaM rAjyamichChAmi kurUNAM kurunandana |
ta ime nihatAH sarve bhrAtaro me janeshvara
shlokas.42:
kShINaratnAM cha pRRithivIM hatakShatriyapu~NgavAm |
nAbhyutsahAmyahaM bhoktuM vidhavAmiva yoShitam
shlokas.43:
adyApi tvahamAsha.nse tvAM vijetuM yudhiShThira |
bha~NktvA pA~nchAlapANDUnAmutsAhaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.44:
na tvidAnImahaM manye kAryaM yuddhena karhichit |
droNe karNe cha sa.nshAnte nihate cha pitAmahe
shlokas.45:
astvidAnImiyaM rAjankevalA pRRithivI tava |
asahAyo hi ko rAjA rAjyamichChetprashAsitum
shlokas.46:
suhRRidastAdRRishAnhitvA putrAnbhrAtR^InpitR^Inapi |
bhavadbhishcha hRRite rAjye ko nu jIveta mAdRRishaH
shlokas.47:
ahaM vanaM gamiShyAmi hyajinaiH prativAsitaH |
ratirhi nAsti me rAjye hatapakShasya bhArata
shlokas.48:
hatabAndhavabhUyiShThA hatAshvA hataku~njarA |
eShA te pRRithivI rAjanbhu~NkShvainAM vigatajvaraH
shlokas.49:
vanameva gamiShyAmi vasAno mRRigacharmaNI |
na hi me nirjitasyAsti jIvite.adya spRRihA vibho
shlokas.50:
gachCha tvaM bhu~NkShva rAjendra pRRithivIM nihateshvarAm |
hatayodhAM naShTaratnAM kShINavaprAM yathAsukham
shlokas.51:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ArtapralApAnmA tAta salilasthaH prabhAShathAH |
naitanmanasi me rAjanvAshitaM shakuneriva
shlokas.52:
yadi chApi samarthaH syAstvaM dAnAya suyodhana |
nAhamichCheyamavaniM tvayA dattAM prashAsitum
shlokas.53:
adharmeNa na gRRihNIyAM tvayA dattAM mahImimAm |
na hi dharmaH smRRito rAjankShatriyasya pratigrahaH
shlokas.54:
tvayA dattAM na chechCheyaM pRRithivImakhilAmaham |
tvAM tu yuddhe vinirjitya bhoktAsmi vasudhAmimAm
shlokas.55:
anIshvarashcha pRRithivIM kathaM tvaM dAtumichChasi |
tvayeyaM pRRithivI rAjankiM na dattA tadaiva hi
shlokas.56:
dharmato yAchamAnAnAM shamArthaM cha kulasya naH |
vArShNeyaM prathamaM rAjanpratyAkhyAya mahAbalam
shlokas.57:
kimidAnIM dadAsi tvaM ko hi te chittavibhramaH |
abhiyuktastu ko rAjA dAtumichCheddhi medinIm
shlokas.58:
na tvamadya mahIM dAtumIshaH kauravanandana |
AchChettuM vA balAdrAjansa kathaM dAtumichChasi
mAM tu nirjitya sa~NgrAme pAlayemAM vasundharAm
shlokas.59:
sUchyagreNApi yadbhUmerapi dhrIyeta bhArata |
tanmAtramapi no mahyaM na dadAti purA bhavAn
shlokas.60:
sa kathaM pRRithivImetAM pradadAsi vishAM pate |
sUchyagraM nAtyajaH pUrvaM sa kathaM tyajasi kShitim
shlokas.61:
evamaishvaryamAsAdya prashAsya pRRithivImimAm |
ko hi mUDho vyavasyeta shatrordAtuM vasundharAm
shlokas.62:
tvaM tu kevalamaurkhyeNa vimUDho nAvabudhyase |
pRRithivIM dAtukAmo.api jIvitenAdya mokShyase
shlokas.63:
asmAnvA tvaM parAjitya prashAdhi pRRithivImimAm |
atha vA nihato.asmAbhirvraja lokAnanuttamAn
shlokas.64:
AvayorjIvato rAjanmayi cha tvayi cha dhruvam |
sa.nshayaH sarvabhUtAnAM vijaye no bhaviShyati
shlokas.65:
jIvitaM tava duShpraj~na mayi samprati vartate |
jIvayeyaM tvahaM kAmaM na tu tvaM jIvituM kShamaH
shlokas.66:
dahane hi kRRito yatnastvayAsmAsu visheShataH |
AshIviShairviShaishchApi jale chApi praveshanaiH
tvayA vinikRRitA rAjanrAjyasya haraNena cha
shlokas.67:
etasmAtkAraNAtpApa jIvitaM te na vidyate |
uttiShThottiShTha yudhyasva tatte shreyo bhaviShyati
shlokas.68:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evaM tu vividhA vAcho jayayuktAH punaH punaH |
kIrtayanti sma te vIrAstatra tatra janAdhipa

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
evaM santarjyamAnastu mama putro mahIpatiH |
prakRRityA manyumAnvIraH kathamAsItparantapaH
shlokas.2:
na hi santarjanA tena shrutapUrvA kadAchana |
rAjabhAvena mAnyashcha sarvalokasya so.abhavat
shlokas.3:
iyaM cha pRRithivI sarvA samlechChATavikA bhRRisham |
prasAdAddhriyate yasya pratyakShaM tava sa~njaya
shlokas.4:
sa tathA tarjyamAnastu pANDuputrairvisheShataH |
vihInashcha svakairbhRRityairnirjane chAvRRito bhRRisham
shlokas.5:
shrutvA sa kaTukA vAcho jayayuktAH punaH punaH |
kimabravItpANDaveyA.nstanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.6:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tarjyamAnastadA rAjannudakasthastavAtmajaH |
yudhiShThireNa rAjendra bhrAtRRibhiH sahitena ha
shlokas.7:
shrutvA sa kaTukA vAcho viShamastho janAdhipaH |
dIrghamuShNaM cha niHshvasya salilasthaH punaH punaH
shlokas.8:
salilAntargato rAjA dhunvanhastau punaH punaH |
manashchakAra yuddhAya rAjAnaM chAbhyabhAShata
shlokas.9:
yUyaM sasuhRRidaH pArthAH sarve sarathavAhanAH |
ahamekaH paridyUno viratho hatavAhanaH
shlokas.10:
Attashastrai rathagatairbahubhiH parivAritaH |
kathamekaH padAtiH sannashastro yoddhumutsahe
shlokas.11:
ekaikena tu mAM yUyaM yodhayadhvaM yudhiShThira |
na hyeko bahubhirvIrairnyAyyaM yodhayituM yudhi
shlokas.12:
visheShato vikavachaH shrAntashchApaH samAshritaH |
bhRRishaM vikShatagAtrashcha shrAntavAhanasainikaH
shlokas.13:
na me tvatto bhayaM rAjanna cha pArthAdvRRikodarAt |
phalgunAdvAsudevAdvA pA~nchAlebhyo.atha vA punaH
shlokas.14:
yamAbhyAM yuyudhAnAdvA ye chAnye tava sainikAH |
ekaH sarvAnahaM kruddho na tAnyoddhumihotsahe
shlokas.15:
dharmamUlA satAM kIrtirmanuShyANAM janAdhipa |
dharmaM chaiveha kIrtiM cha pAlayanprabravImyaham
shlokas.16:
ahamutthAya vaH sarvAnpratiyotsyAmi sa.nyuge |
anva.nshAbhyAgatAnsarvAnRRitUnsa.nvatsaro yathA
shlokas.17:
adya vaH sarathAnsAshvAnashastro viratho.api san |
nakShatrANIva sarvANi savitA rAtrisa~NkShaye
tejasA nAshayiShyAmi sthirIbhavata pANDavAH
shlokas.18:
adyAnRRiNyaM gamiShyAmi kShatriyANAM yashasvinAm |
bAhlIkadroNabhIShmANAM karNasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.19:
jayadrathasya shUrasya bhagadattasya chobhayoH |
madrarAjasya shalyasya bhUrishravasa eva cha
shlokas.20:
putrANAM bharatashreShTha shakuneH saubalasya cha |
mitrANAM suhRRidAM chaiva bAndhavAnAM tathaiva cha
shlokas.21:
AnRRiNyamadya gachChAmi hatvA tvAM bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
etAvaduktvA vachanaM virarAma janAdhipaH
shlokas.22:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
diShTyA tvamapi jAnIShe kShatradharmaM suyodhana |
diShTyA te vartate buddhiryuddhAyaiva mahAbhuja
shlokas.23:
diShTyA shUro.asi kauravya diShTyA jAnAsi sa~Ngaram |
yastvameko hi naH sarvAnsa.nyuge yoddhumichChasi
shlokas.24:
eka ekena sa~Ngamya yatte saMmatamAyudham |
tattvamAdAya yudhyasva prekShakAste vayaM sthitAH
shlokas.25:
ayamiShTaM cha te kAmaM vIra bhUyo dadAmyaham |
hatvaikaM bhavato rAjyaM hato vA svargamApnuhi
shlokas.26:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ekashchedyoddhumAkrande varo.adya mama dIyate |
AyudhAnAmiyaM chApi vRRitA tvatsaMmate gadA
shlokas.27:
bhrAtR^INAM bhavatAmekaH shakyaM mAM yo.abhimanyate |
padAtirgadayA sa~Nkhye sa yudhyatu mayA saha
shlokas.28:
vRRittAni rathayuddhAni vichitrANi pade pade |
idamekaM gadAyuddhaM bhavatvadyAdbhutaM mahat
shlokas.29:
annAnAmapi paryAyaM kartumichChanti mAnavAH |
yuddhAnAmapi paryAyo bhavatvanumate tava
shlokas.30:
gadayA tvAM mahAbAho vijeShyAmi sahAnujam |
pA~nchAlAnsRRi~njayA.nshchaiva ye chAnye tava sainikAH
shlokas.31:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
uttiShThottiShTha gAndhAre mAM yodhaya suyodhana |
eka ekena sa~Ngamya sa.nyuge gadayA balI
shlokas.32:
puruSho bhava gAndhAre yudhyasva susamAhitaH |
adya te jIvitaM nAsti yadyapi tvaM manojavaH
shlokas.33:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etatsa narashArdUlo nAmRRiShyata tavAtmajaH |
salilAntargataH shvabhre mahAnAga iva shvasan
shlokas.34:
tathAsau vAkpratodena tudyamAnaH punaH punaH |
vAchaM na mamRRiShe dhImAnuttamAshvaH kashAmiva
shlokas.35:
sa~NkShobhya salilaM vegAdgadAmAdAya vIryavAn |
adrisAramayIM gurvIM kA~nchanA~NgadabhUShaNAm
antarjalAtsamuttasthau nAgendra iva niHshvasan
shlokas.36:
sa bhittvA stambhitaM toyaM skandhe kRRitvAyasIM gadAm |
udatiShThata putraste pratapanrashmimAniva
shlokas.37:
tataH shaikyAyasIM gurvIM jAtarUpapariShkRRitAm |
gadAM parAmRRishaddhImAndhArtarAShTro mahAbalaH
shlokas.38:
gadAhastaM tu taM dRRiShTvA sashRRi~Ngamiva parvatam |
prajAnAmiva sa~NkruddhaM shUlapANimavasthitam
sagado bhArato bhAti pratapanbhAskaro yathA
shlokas.39:
tamuttIrNaM mahAbAhuM gadAhastamari.ndamam |
menire sarvabhUtAni daNDahastamivAntakam
shlokas.40:
vajrahastaM yathA shakraM shUlahastaM yathA haram |
dadRRishuH sarvapA~nchAlAH putraM tava janAdhipa
shlokas.41:
tamuttIrNaM tu samprekShya samahRRiShyanta sarvashaH |
pA~nchAlAH pANDaveyAshcha te.anyonyasya talAndaduH
shlokas.42:
avahAsaM tu taM matvA putro duryodhanastava |
udvRRitya nayane kruddho didhakShuriva pANDavAn
shlokas.43:
trishikhAM bhrukuTIM kRRitvA sa.ndaShTadashanachChadaH |
pratyuvAcha tatastAnvai pANDavAnsahakeshavAn
shlokas.44:
avahAsasya vo.asyAdya prativaktAsmi pANDavAH |
gamiShyatha hatAH sadyaH sapA~nchAlA yamakShayam
shlokas.45:
utthitastu jalAttasmAtputro duryodhanastava |
atiShThata gadApANI rudhireNa samukShitaH
shlokas.46:
tasya shoNitadigdhasya salilena samukShitam |
sharIraM sma tadA bhAti sravanniva mahIdharaH
shlokas.47:
tamudyatagadaM vIraM menire tatra pANDavAH |
vaivasvatamiva kruddhaM ki~NkarodyatapANinam
shlokas.48:
sa meghaninado harShAnnadanniva cha govRRiShaH |
AjuhAva tataH pArthAngadayA yudhi vIryavAn
shlokas.49:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ekaikena cha mAM yUyamAsIdata yudhiShThira |
na hyeko bahubhirnyAyyo vIra yodhayituM yudhi
shlokas.50:
nyastavarmA visheSheNa shrAntashchApsu pariplutaH |
bhRRishaM vikShatagAtrashcha hatavAhanasainikaH
shlokas.51:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
nAbhUdiyaM tava praj~nA kathamevaM suyodhana |
yadAbhimanyuM bahavo jaghnuryudhi mahArathAH
shlokas.52:
Amu~ncha kavachaM vIra mUrdhajAnyamayasva cha |
yachchAnyadapi te nAsti tadapyAdatsva bhArata
imamekaM cha te kAmaM vIra bhUyo dadAmyaham
shlokas.53:
pa~nchAnAM pANDaveyAnAM yena yoddhumihechChasi |
taM hatvA vai bhavAnrAjA hato vA svargamApnuhi
RRite cha jIvitAdvIra yuddhe kiM kurma te priyam
shlokas.54:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tatastava suto rAjanvarma jagrAha kA~nchanam |
vichitraM cha shirastrANaM jAmbUnadapariShkRRitam
shlokas.55:
so.avabaddhashirastrANaH shubhakA~nchanavarmabhRRit |
rarAja rAjanputraste kA~nchanaH shailarADiva
shlokas.56:
saMnaddhaH sa gadI rAjansajjaH sa~NgrAmamUrdhani |
abravItpANDavAnsarvAnputro duryodhanastava
shlokas.57:
bhrAtR^INAM bhavatAmeko yudhyatAM gadayA mayA |
sahadevena vA yotsye bhImena nakulena vA
shlokas.58:
atha vA phalgunenAdya tvayA vA bharatarShabha |
yotsye.ahaM sa~NgaraM prApya vijeShye cha raNAjire
shlokas.59:
ahamadya gamiShyAmi vairasyAntaM sudurgamam |
gadayA puruShavyAghra hemapaTTavinaddhayA
shlokas.60:
gadAyuddhe na me kashchitsadRRisho.astIti chintaya |
gadayA vo haniShyAmi sarvAneva samAgatAn
gRRihNAtu sa gadAM yo vai yudhyate.adya mayA saha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evaM duryodhane rAjangarjamAne muhurmuhuH |
yudhiShThirasya sa~Nkruddho vAsudevo.abravIdidam
shlokas.2:
yadi nAma hyayaM yuddhe varayettvAM yudhiShThira |
arjunaM nakulaM vApi sahadevamathApi vA
shlokas.3:
kimidaM sAhasaM rAja.nstvayA vyAhRRitamIdRRisham |
ekameva nihatyAjau bhava rAjA kuruShviti
shlokas.4:
etena hi kRRitA yogyA varShANIha trayodasha |
Ayase puruShe rAjanbhImasenajighA.nsayA
shlokas.5:
kathaM nAma bhavetkAryamasmAbhirbharatarShabha |
sAhasaM kRRitavA.nstvaM tu hyanukroshAnnRRipottama
shlokas.6:
nAnyamasyAnupashyAmi pratiyoddhAramAhave |
RRite vRRikodarAtpArthAtsa cha nAtikRRitashramaH
shlokas.7:
tadidaM dyUtamArabdhaM punareva yathA purA |
viShamaM shakuneshchaiva tava chaiva vishAM pate
shlokas.8:
balI bhImaH samarthashcha kRRitI rAjA suyodhanaH |
balavAnvA kRRitI veti kRRitI rAjanvishiShyate
shlokas.9:
so.ayaM rAja.nstvayA shatruH same pathi niveshitaH |
nyastashchAtmA suviShame kRRichChramApAditA vayam
shlokas.10:
ko nu sarvAnvinirjitya shatrUnekena vairiNA |
paNitvA chaikapANena rochayedevamAhavam
shlokas.11:
na hi pashyAmi taM loke gadAhastaM narottamam |
yudhyedduryodhanaM sa~Nkhye kRRititvAddhi visheShayet
shlokas.12:
phalgunaM vA bhavantaM vA mAdrIputrAvathApi vA |
na samarthAnahaM manye gadAhastasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.13:
sa kathaM vadase shatruM yudhyasva gadayeti ha |
ekaM cha no nihatyAjau bhava rAjeti bhArata
shlokas.14:
vRRikodaraM samAsAdya sa.nshayo vijaye hi naH |
nyAyato yudhyamAnAnAM kRRitI hyeSha mahAbalaH
shlokas.15:
bhIma uvAcha||
madhusUdana mA kArShIrviShAdaM yadunandana |
adya pAraM gamiShyAmi vairasya bhRRishadurgamam
shlokas.16:
ahaM suyodhanaM sa~Nkhye haniShyAmi na sa.nshayaH |
vijayo vai dhruvaM kRRiShNa dharmarAjasya dRRishyate
shlokas.17:
adhyardhena guNeneyaM gadA gurutarI mama |
na tathA dhArtarAShTrasya mA kArShIrmAdhava vyathAm
shlokas.18:
sAmarAnapi lokA.nstrInnAnAshastradharAnyudhi |
yodhayeyaM raNe hRRiShTaH kimutAdya suyodhanam
shlokas.19:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathA sambhAShamANaM tu vAsudevo vRRikodaram |
hRRiShTaH sampUjayAmAsa vachanaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.20:
tvAmAshritya mahAbAho dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
nihatAriH svakAM dIptAM shriyaM prApto na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.21:
tvayA vinihatAH sarve dhRRitarAShTrasutA raNe |
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha nAgAshcha vinipAtitAH
shlokas.22:
kali~NgA mAgadhAH prAchyA gAndhArAH kuravastathA |
tvAmAsAdya mahAyuddhe nihatAH pANDunandana
shlokas.23:
hatvA duryodhanaM chApi prayachChorvIM sasAgarAm |
dharmarAjAya kaunteya yathA viShNuH shachIpateH
shlokas.24:
tvAM cha prApya raNe pApo dhArtarAShTro vina~NkShyati |
tvamasya sakthinI bha~NktvA pratij~nAM pArayiShyasi
shlokas.25:
yatnena tu sadA pArtha yoddhavyo dhRRitarAShTrajaH |
kRRitI cha balavA.nshchaiva yuddhashauNDashcha nityadA
shlokas.26:
tatastu sAtyakI rAjanpUjayAmAsa pANDavam |
vividhAbhishcha tAM vAgbhiH pUjayAmAsa mAdhavaH
shlokas.27:
pA~nchAlAH pANDaveyAshcha dharmarAjapurogamAH |
tadvacho bhImasenasya sarva evAbhyapUjayan
shlokas.28:
tato bhImabalo bhImo yudhiShThiramathAbravIt |
sRRi~njayaiH saha tiShThantaM tapantamiva bhAskaram
shlokas.29:
ahametena sa~Ngamya sa.nyuge yoddhumutsahe |
na hi shakto raNe jetuM mAmeSha puruShAdhamaH
shlokas.30:
adya krodhaM vimokShyAmi nihitaM hRRidaye bhRRisham |
suyodhane dhArtarAShTre khANDave.agnimivArjunaH
shlokas.31:
shalyamadyoddhariShyAmi tava pANDava hRRichChayam |
nihatya gadayA pApamadya rAjansukhI bhava
shlokas.32:
adya kIrtimayIM mAlAM pratimokShye tavAnagha |
prANA~nshriyaM cha rAjyaM cha mokShyate.adya suyodhanaH
shlokas.33:
rAjA cha dhRRitarAShTro.adya shrutvA putraM mayA hatam |
smariShyatyashubhaM karma yattachChakunibuddhijam
shlokas.34:
ityuktvA bharatashreShTho gadAmudyamya vIryavAn |
udatiShThata yuddhAya shakro vRRitramivAhvayan
shlokas.35:
tamekAkinamAsAdya dhArtarAShTraM mahAbalam |
niryUthamiva mAta~NgaM samahRRiShyanta pANDavAH
shlokas.36:
tamudyatagadaM dRRiShTvA kailAsamiva shRRi~NgiNam |
bhImasenastadA rAjanduryodhanamathAbravIt
shlokas.37:
rAj~nApi dhRRitarAShTreNa tvayA chAsmAsu yatkRRitam |
smara tadduShkRRitaM karma yadvRRittaM vAraNAvate
shlokas.38:
draupadI cha parikliShTA sabhAmadhye rajasvalA |
dyUte yadvijito rAjA shakunerbuddhinishchayAt
shlokas.39:
yAni chAnyAni duShTAtmanpApAni kRRitavAnasi |
anAgaHsu cha pArtheShu tasya pashya mahatphalam
shlokas.40:
tvatkRRite nihataH shete sharatalpe mahAyashAH |
gA~Ngeyo bharatashreShThaH sarveShAM naH pitAmahaH
shlokas.41:
hato droNashcha karNashcha hataH shalyaH pratApavAn |
vairasya chAdikartAsau shakunirnihato yudhi
shlokas.42:
bhrAtaraste hatAH shUrAH putrAshcha sahasainikAH |
rAjAnashcha hatAH shUrAH samareShvanivartinaH
shlokas.43:
ete chAnye cha nihatA bahavaH kShatriyarShabhAH |
prAtikAmI tathA pApo draupadyAH kleshakRRiddhataH
shlokas.44:
avashiShTastvamevaikaH kulaghno.adhamapUruShaH |
tvAmapyadya haniShyAmi gadayA nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.45:
adya te.ahaM raNe darpaM sarvaM nAshayitA nRRipa |
rAjyAshAM vipulAM rAjanpANDaveShu cha duShkRRitam
shlokas.46:
duryodhana uvAcha||
kiM katthitena bahudhA yudhyasvAdya mayA saha |
adya te.ahaM vineShyAmi yuddhashraddhAM vRRikodara
shlokas.47:
kiM na pashyasi mAM pApa gadAyuddhe vyavasthitam |
himavachChikharAkArAM pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm
shlokas.48:
gadinaM ko.adya mAM pApa jetumutsahate ripuH |
nyAyato yudhyamAnasya deveShvapi pura.ndaraH
shlokas.49:
mA vRRithA garja kaunteya shAradAbhramivAjalam |
darshayasva balaM yuddhe yAvattatte.adya vidyate
shlokas.50:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA pA~nchAlAH sahasRRi~njayAH |
sarve sampUjayAmAsustadvacho vijigIShavaH
shlokas.51:
taM mattamiva mAta~NgaM talashabdena mAnavAH |
bhUyaH saMharShayAmAsU rAjanduryodhanaM nRRipam
shlokas.52:
bRRiMhanti ku~njarAstatra hayA heShanti chAsakRRit |
shastrANi sampradIpyante pANDavAnAM jayaiShiNAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasminyuddhe mahArAja sampravRRitte sudAruNe |
upaviShTeShu sarveShu pANDaveShu mahAtmasu
shlokas.2:
tatastAladhvajo rAmastayoryuddha upasthite |
shrutvA tachChiShyayo rAjannAjagAma halAyudhaH
shlokas.3:
taM dRRiShTvA paramaprItAH pUjayitvA narAdhipAH |
shiShyayoH kaushalaM yuddhe pashya rAmeti chAbruvan
shlokas.4:
abravIchcha tadA rAmo dRRiShTvA kRRiShNaM cha pANDavam |
duryodhanaM cha kauravyaM gadApANimavasthitam
shlokas.5:
chatvAri.nshadahAnyadya dve cha me niHsRRitasya vai |
puShyeNa samprayAto.asmi shravaNe punarAgataH
shiShyayorvai gadAyuddhaM draShTukAmo.asmi mAdhava
shlokas.6:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA pariShvajya halAyudham |
svAgataM kushalaM chAsmai paryapRRichChadyathAtatham
shlokas.7:
kRRiShNau chApi maheShvAsAvabhivAdya halAyudham |
sasvajAte pariprItau priyamANau yashasvinau
shlokas.8:
mAdrIputrau tathA shUrau draupadyAH pa~ncha chAtmajAH |
abhivAdya sthitA rAjanrauhiNeyaM mahAbalam
shlokas.9:
bhImaseno.atha balavAnputrastava janAdhipa |
tathaiva chodyatagadau pUjayAmAsaturbalam
shlokas.10:
svAgatena cha te tatra pratipUjya punaH punaH |
pashya yuddhaM mahAbAho iti te rAmamabruvan
evamUchurmahAtmAnaM rauhiNeyaM narAdhipAH
shlokas.11:
pariShvajya tadA rAmaH pANDavAnsRRi~njayAnapi |
apRRichChatkushalaM sarvAnpANDavA.nshchAmitaujasaH
tathaiva te samAsAdya paprachChustamanAmayam
shlokas.12:
pratyabhyarchya halI sarvAnkShatriyA.nshcha mahAmanAH |
kRRitvA kushalasa.nyuktAM sa.nvidaM cha yathAvayaH
shlokas.13:
janArdanaM sAtyakiM cha premNA sa pariShasvaje |
mUrdhni chaitAvupAghrAya kushalaM paryapRRichChata
shlokas.14:
tau chainaM vidhivadrAjanpUjayAmAsaturgurum |
brahmANamiva deveshamindropendrau mudA yutau
shlokas.15:
tato.abravIddharmasuto rauhiNeyamari.ndamam |
idaM bhrAtrormahAyuddhaM pashya rAmeti bhArata
shlokas.16:
teShAM madhye mahAbAhuH shrImAnkeshavapUrvajaH |
nyavishatparamaprItaH pUjyamAno mahArathaiH
shlokas.17:
sa babhau rAjamadhyastho nIlavAsAH sitaprabhaH |
divIva nakShatragaNaiH parikIrNo nishAkaraH
shlokas.18:
tatastayoH saMnipAtastumulo romaharShaNaH |
AsIdantakaro rAjanvairasya tava putrayoH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
pUrvameva yadA rAmastasminyuddha upasthite |
Amantrya keshavaM yAto vRRiShNibhiH sahitaH prabhuH
shlokas.2:
sAhAyyaM dhArtarAShTrasya na cha kartAsmi keshava |
na chaiva pANDuputrANAM gamiShyAmi yathAgatam
shlokas.3:
evamuktvA tadA rAmo yAtaH shatrunibarhaNaH |
tasya chAgamanaM bhUyo brahma~nsha.nsitumarhasi
shlokas.4:
AkhyAhi me vistarataH kathaM rAma upasthitaH |
kathaM cha dRRiShTavAnyuddhaM kushalo hyasi sattama
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
upaplavye niviShTeShu pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
preShito dhRRitarAShTrasya samIpaM madhusUdanaH
shamaM prati mahAbAho hitArthaM sarvadehinAm
shlokas.6:
sa gatvA hAstinapuraM dhRRitarAShTraM sametya cha |
uktavAnvachanaM tathyaM hitaM chaiva visheShataH
na cha tatkRRitavAnrAjA yathAkhyAtaM hi te purA
shlokas.7:
anavApya shamaM tatra kRRiShNaH puruShasattamaH |
AgachChata mahAbAhurupaplavyaM janAdhipa
shlokas.8:
tataH pratyAgataH kRRiShNo dhArtarAShTravisarjitaH |
akriyAyAM naravyAghra pANDavAnidamabravIt
shlokas.9:
na kurvanti vacho mahyaM kuravaH kAlachoditAH |
nirgachChadhvaM pANDaveyAH puShyeNa sahitA mayA
shlokas.10:
tato vibhajyamAneShu baleShu balinAM varaH |
provAcha bhrAtaraM kRRiShNaM rauhiNeyo mahAmanAH
shlokas.11:
teShAmapi mahAbAho sAhAyyaM madhusUdana |
kriyatAmiti tatkRRiShNo nAsya chakre vachastadA
shlokas.12:
tato manyuparItAtmA jagAma yadunandanaH |
tIrthayAtrAM haladharaH sarasvatyAM mahAyashAH
maitre nakShatrayoge sma sahitaH sarvayAdavaiH
shlokas.13:
AshrayAmAsa bhojastu duryodhanamari.ndamaH |
yuyudhAnena sahito vAsudevastu pANDavAn
shlokas.14:
rauhiNeye gate shUre puShyeNa madhusUdanaH |
pANDaveyAnpuraskRRitya yayAvabhimukhaH kurUn
shlokas.15:
gachChanneva pathisthastu rAmaH preShyAnuvAcha ha |
sambhArA.nstIrthayAtrAyAM sarvopakaraNAni cha
AnayadhvaM dvArakAyA agnInvai yAjakA.nstathA
shlokas.16:
suvarNaM rajataM chaiva dhenUrvAsA.nsi vAjinaH |
ku~njarA.nshcha rathA.nshchaiva kharoShTraM vAhanAni cha
kShipramAnIyatAM sarvaM tIrthahetoH parichChadam
shlokas.17:
pratisrotaH sarasvatyA gachChadhvaM shIghragAminaH |
RRitvijashchAnayadhvaM vai shatashashcha dvijarShabhAn
shlokas.18:
evaM sa.ndishya tu preShyAnbaladevo mahAbalaH |
tIrthayAtrAM yayau rAjankurUNAM vaishase tadA
sarasvatIM pratisrotaH samudrAdabhijagmivAn
shlokas.19:
RRitvigbhishcha suhRRidbhishcha tathAnyairdvijasattamaiH |
rathairgajaistathAshvaishcha preShyaishcha bharatarShabha
gokharoShTraprayuktaishcha yAnaishcha bahubhirvRRitaH
shlokas.20:
shrAntAnAM klAntavapuShAM shishUnAM vipulAyuShAm |
tAni yAnAni desheShu pratIkShyante sma bhArata
bubhukShitAnAmarthAya kL^iptamannaM samantataH
shlokas.21:
yo yo yatra dvijo bhoktuM kAmaM kAmayate tadA |
tasya tasya tu tatraivamupajahrustadA nRRipa
shlokas.22:
tatra sthitA narA rAjanrauhiNeyasya shAsanAt |
bhakShyapeyasya kurvanti rAshI.nstatra samantataH
shlokas.23:
vAsA.nsi cha mahArhANi parya~NkAstaraNAni cha |
pUjArthaM tatra kL^iptAni viprANAM sukhamichChatAm
shlokas.24:
yatra yaH svapate vipraH kShatriyo vApi bhArata |
tatra tatra tu tasyaiva sarvaM kL^iptamadRRishyata
shlokas.25:
yathAsukhaM janaH sarvastiShThate yAti vA tadA |
yAtukAmasya yAnAni pAnAni tRRiShitasya cha
shlokas.26:
bubhukShitasya chAnnAni svAdUni bharatarShabha |
upajahrurnarAstatra vastrANyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.27:
sa panthAH prababhau rAjansarvasyaiva sukhAvahaH |
svargopamastadA vIra narANAM tatra gachChatAm
shlokas.28:
nityapramuditopetaH svAdubhakShaH shubhAnvitaH |
vipaNyApaNapaNyAnAM nAnAjanashatairvRRitaH
nAnAdrumalatopeto nAnAratnavibhUShitaH
shlokas.29:
tato mahAtmA niyame sthitAtmA; puNyeShu tIrtheShu vasUni rAjan |
dadau dvijebhyaH kratudakShiNAshcha; yadupravIro halabhRRitpratItaH
shlokas.30:
dogdhrIshcha dhenUshcha sahasrasho vai; suvAsasaH kA~nchanabaddhashRRi~NgIH |
hayA.nshcha nAnAvidhadeshajAtA;nyAnAni dAsIshcha tathA dvijebhyaH
shlokas.31:
ratnAni muktAmaNividrumaM cha; shRRi~NgIsuvarNaM rajataM cha shubhram |
ayasmayaM tAmramayaM cha bhANDaM; dadau dvijAtipravareShu rAmaH
shlokas.32:
evaM sa vittaM pradadau mahAtmA; sarasvatItIrthavareShu bhUri |
yayau krameNApratimaprabhAva;stataH kurukShetramudAravRRittaH
shlokas.33:
janamejaya uvAcha||
sArasvatAnAM tIrthAnAM guNotpattiM vadasva me |
phalaM cha dvipadAM shreShTha karmanirvRRittimeva cha
shlokas.34:
yathAkramaM cha bhagava.nstIrthAnAmanupUrvashaH |
brahmanbrahmavidAM shreShTha paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.35:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tIrthAnAM vistaraM rAjanguNotpattiM cha sarvashaH |
mayochyamAnAM shRRiNu vai puNyAM rAjendra kRRitsnashaH
shlokas.36:
pUrvaM mahArAja yadupravIra; RRitviksuhRRidvipragaNaishcha sArdham |
puNyaM prabhAsaM samupAjagAma; yatroDurADyakShmaNA klishyamAnaH
shlokas.37:
vimuktashApaH punarApya tejaH; sarvaM jagadbhAsayate narendra |
evaM tu tIrthapravaraM pRRithivyAM; prabhAsanAttasya tataH prabhAsaH
shlokas.38:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kimarthaM bhagavAnsomo yakShmaNA samagRRihyata |
kathaM cha tIrthapravare tasmi.nshchandro nyamajjata
shlokas.39:
kathamAplutya tasmi.nstu punarApyAyitaH shashI |
etanme sarvamAchakShva vistareNa mahAmune
shlokas.40:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dakShasya tanayA yAstAH prAdurAsanvishAM pate |
sa saptavi.nshatiM kanyA dakShaH somAya vai dadau
shlokas.41:
nakShatrayoganiratAH sa~NkhyAnArthaM cha bhArata |
patnyo vai tasya rAjendra somasya shubhalakShaNAH
shlokas.42:
tAstu sarvA vishAlAkShyo rUpeNApratimA bhuvi |
atyarichyata tAsAM tu rohiNI rUpasampadA
shlokas.43:
tatastasyAM sa bhagavAnprItiM chakre nishAkaraH |
sAsya hRRidyA babhUvAtha tasmAttAM bubhuje sadA
shlokas.44:
purA hi somo rAjendra rohiNyAmavasachchiram |
tato.asya kupitAnyAsannakShatrANi mahAtmanaH
shlokas.45:
tA gatvA pitaraM prAhuH prajApatimatandritAH |
somo vasati nAsmAsu rohiNIM bhajate sadA
shlokas.46:
tA vayaM sahitAH sarvAstvatsakAshe prajeshvara |
vatsyAmo niyatAhArAstapashcharaNatatparAH
shlokas.47:
shrutvA tAsAM tu vachanaM dakShaH somamathAbravIt |
samaM vartasva bhAryAsu mA tvAdharmo mahAnspRRishet
shlokas.48:
tAshcha sarvAbravIddakSho gachChadhvaM somamantikAt |
samaM vatsyati sarvAsu chandramA mama shAsanAt
shlokas.49:
visRRiShTAstAstadA jagmuH shItA.nshubhavanaM tadA |
tathApi somo bhagavAnpunareva mahIpate
rohiNIM nivasatyeva prIyamANo muhurmuhuH
shlokas.50:
tatastAH sahitAH sarvA bhUyaH pitaramabruvan |
tava shushrUShaNe yuktA vatsyAmo hi tavAshrame
somo vasati nAsmAsu nAkarodvachanaM tava
shlokas.51:
tAsAM tadvachanaM shrutvA dakShaH somamathAbravIt |
samaM vartasva bhAryAsu mA tvAM shapsye virochana
shlokas.52:
anAdRRitya tu tadvAkyaM dakShasya bhagavA~nshashI |
rohiNyA sArdhamavasattatastAH kupitAH punaH
shlokas.53:
gatvA cha pitaraM prAhuH praNamya shirasA tadA |
somo vasati nAsmAsu tasmAnnaH sharaNaM bhava
shlokas.54:
rohiNyAmeva bhagavansadA vasati chandramAH |
tasmAnnastrAhi sarvA vai yathA naH soma Avishet
shlokas.55:
tachChrutvA bhagavAnkruddho yakShmANaM pRRithivIpate |
sasarja roShAtsomAya sa choDupatimAvishat
shlokas.56:
sa yakShmaNAbhibhUtAtmAkShIyatAharahaH shashI |
yatnaM chApyakarodrAjanmokShArthaM tasya yakShmaNaH
shlokas.57:
iShTveShTibhirmahArAja vividhAbhirnishAkaraH |
na chAmuchyata shApAdvai kShayaM chaivAbhyagachChata
shlokas.58:
kShIyamANe tataH some oShadhyo na prajaj~nire |
nirAsvAdarasAH sarvA hatavIryAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.59:
oShadhInAM kShaye jAte prANinAmapi sa~NkShayaH |
kRRishAshchAsanprajAH sarvAH kShIyamANe nishAkare
shlokas.60:
tato devAH samAgamya somamUchurmahIpate |
kimidaM bhavato rUpamIdRRishaM na prakAshate
shlokas.61:
kAraNaM brUhi naH sarvaM yenedaM te mahadbhayam |
shrutvA tu vachanaM tvatto vidhAsyAmastato vayam
shlokas.62:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha sarvA.nstA~nshashalakShaNaH |
shApaM cha kAraNaM chaiva yakShmANaM cha tathAtmanaH
shlokas.63:
devAstasya vachaH shrutvA gatvA dakShamathAbruvan |
prasIda bhagavansome shApashchaiSha nivartyatAm
shlokas.64:
asau hi chandramAH kShINaH ki~nchichCheSho hi lakShyate |
kShayAchchaivAsya devesha prajAshchApi gatAH kShayam
shlokas.65:
vIrudoShadhayashchaiva bIjAni vividhAni cha |
tathA vayaM lokaguro prasAdaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.66:
evamuktastadA chintya prAha vAkyaM prajApatiH |
naitachChakyaM mama vacho vyAvartayitumanyathA
hetunA tu mahAbhAgA nivartiShyati kenachit
shlokas.67:
samaM vartatu sarvAsu shashI bhAryAsu nityashaH |
sarasvatyA vare tIrthe unmajja~nshashalakShaNaH
punarvardhiShyate devAstadvai satyaM vacho mama
shlokas.68:
mAsArdhaM cha kShayaM somo nityameva gamiShyati |
mAsArdhaM cha sadA vRRiddhiM satyametadvacho mama
shlokas.69:
sarasvatIM tataH somo jagAma RRiShishAsanAt |
prabhAsaM paramaM tIrthaM sarasvatyA jagAma ha
shlokas.71:
devAshcha sarve rAjendra prabhAsaM prApya puShkalam |
somena sahitA bhUtvA dakShasya pramukhe.abhavan
shlokas.72:
tataH prajApatiH sarvA visasarjAtha devatAH |
somaM cha bhagavAnprIto bhUyo vachanamabravIt
shlokas.73:
mAvama.nsthAH striyaH putra mA cha viprAnkadAchana |
gachCha yuktaH sadA bhUtvA kuru vai shAsanaM mama
shlokas.74:
sa visRRiShTo mahArAja jagAmAtha svamAlayam |
prajAshcha muditA bhUtvA bhojane cha yathA purA
shlokas.75:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yathA shapto nishAkaraH |
prabhAsaM cha yathA tIrthaM tIrthAnAM pravaraM hyabhUt
shlokas.76:
amAvAsyAM mahArAja nityashaH shashalakShaNaH |
snAtvA hyApyAyate shrImAnprabhAse tIrtha uttame
shlokas.77:
atashchainaM prajAnanti prabhAsamiti bhUmipa |
prabhAM hi paramAM lebhe tasminnunmajjya chandramAH
shlokas.78:
tatastu chamasodbhedamachyutastvagamadbalI |
chamasodbheda ityevaM yaM janAH kathayantyuta
shlokas.79:
tatra dattvA cha dAnAni vishiShTAni halAyudhaH |
uShitvA rajanImekAM snAtvA cha vidhivattadA
shlokas.80:
udapAnamathAgachChattvarAvAnkeshavAgrajaH |
AdyaM svastyayanaM chaiva tatrAvApya mahatphalam
shlokas.81:
snigdhatvAdoShadhInAM cha bhUmeshcha janamejaya |
jAnanti siddhA rAjendra naShTAmapi sarasvatIm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasmAnnadIgataM chApi udapAnaM yashasvinaH |
tritasya cha mahArAja jagAmAtha halAyudhaH
shlokas.2:
tatra dattvA bahu dravyaM pUjayitvA tathA dvijAn |
upaspRRishya cha tatraiva prahRRiShTo musalAyudhaH
shlokas.3:
tatra dharmaparo hyAsIttritaH sa sumahAtapAH |
kUpe cha vasatA tena somaH pIto mahAtmanA
shlokas.4:
tatra chainaM samutsRRijya bhrAtarau jagmaturgRRihAn |
tatastau vai shashApAtha trito brAhmaNasattamaH
shlokas.5:
janamejaya uvAcha||
udapAnaM kathaM brahmankathaM cha sumahAtapAH |
patitaH kiM cha santyakto bhrAtRRibhyAM dvijasattamaH
shlokas.6:
kUpe kathaM cha hitvainaM bhrAtarau jagmaturgRRihAn |
etadAchakShva me brahmanyadi shrAvyaM hi manyase
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
AsanpUrvayuge rAjanmunayo bhrAtarastrayaH |
ekatashcha dvitashchaiva tritashchAdityasaMnibhAH
shlokas.8:
sarve prajApatisamAH prajAvantastathaiva cha |
brahmalokajitaH sarve tapasA brahmavAdinaH
shlokas.9:
teShAM tu tapasA prIto niyamena damena cha |
abhavadgautamo nityaM pitA dharmarataH sadA
shlokas.10:
sa tu dIrgheNa kAlena teShAM prItimavApya cha |
jagAma bhagavAnsthAnamanurUpamivAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
rAjAnastasya ye pUrve yAjyA hyAsanmahAtmanaH |
te sarve svargate tasmi.nstasya putrAnapUjayan
shlokas.12:
teShAM tu karmaNA rAja.nstathaivAdhyayanena cha |
tritaH sa shreShThatAM prApa yathaivAsya pitA tathA
shlokas.13:
taM sma sarve mahAbhAgA munayaH puNyalakShaNAH |
apUjayanmahAbhAgaM tathA vidvattayaiva tu
shlokas.14:
kadAchiddhi tato rAjanbhrAtarAvekatadvitau |
yaj~nArthaM chakratushchittaM dhanArthaM cha visheShataH
shlokas.15:
tayoshchintA samabhavattritaM gRRihya parantapa |
yAjyAnsarvAnupAdAya pratigRRihya pashU.nstataH
shlokas.16:
somaM pAsyAmahe hRRiShTAH prApya yaj~naM mahAphalam |
chakrushchaiva mahArAja bhrAtarastraya eva ha
shlokas.17:
tathA tu te parikramya yAjyAnsarvAnpashUnprati |
yAjayitvA tato yAjyA.NllabdhvA cha subahUnpashUn
shlokas.18:
yAjyena karmaNA tena pratigRRihya vidhAnataH |
prAchIM dishaM mahAtmAna Ajagmuste maharShayaH
shlokas.19:
tritasteShAM mahArAja purastAdyAti hRRiShTavat |
ekatashcha dvitashchaiva pRRiShThataH kAlayanpashUn
shlokas.20:
tayoshchintA samabhavaddRRiShTvA pashugaNaM mahat |
kathaM na syurimA gAva AvAbhyAM vai vinA tritam
shlokas.21:
tAvanyonyaM samAbhAShya ekatashcha dvitashcha ha |
yadUchaturmithaH pApau tannibodha janeshvara
shlokas.22:
trito yaj~neShu kushalastrito vedeShu niShThitaH |
anyAstrito bahutarA gAvaH samupalapsyate
shlokas.23:
tadAvAM sahitau bhUtvA gAH prakAlya vrajAvahe |
trito.api gachChatAM kAmamAvAbhyAM vai vinAkRRitaH
shlokas.24:
teShAmAgachChatAM rAtrau pathisthAne vRRiko.abhavat |
tathA kUpo.avidUre.abhUtsarasvatyAstaTe mahAn
shlokas.25:
atha trito vRRikaM dRRiShTvA pathi tiShThantamagrataH |
tadbhayAdapasarpanvai tasminkUpe papAta ha
agAdhe sumahAghore sarvabhUtabhaya~Nkare
shlokas.26:
tritastato mahAbhAgaH kUpastho munisattamaH |
ArtanAdaM tatashchakre tau tu shushruvaturmunI
shlokas.27:
taM j~nAtvA patitaM kUpe bhrAtarAvekatadvitau |
vRRikatrAsAchcha lobhAchcha samutsRRijya prajagmatuH
shlokas.28:
bhrAtRRibhyAM pashulubdhAbhyAmutsRRiShTaH sa mahAtapAH |
udapAne mahArAja nirjale pA.nsusa.nvRRite
shlokas.29:
trita AtmAnamAlakShya kUpe vIruttRRiNAvRRite |
nimagnaM bharatashreShTha pApakRRinnarake yathA
shlokas.30:
buddhyA hyagaNayatprAj~no mRRityorbhIto hyasomapaH |
somaH kathaM nu pAtavya ihasthena mayA bhavet
shlokas.31:
sa evamanusa~nchintya tasminkUpe mahAtapAH |
dadarsha vIrudhaM tatra lambamAnAM yadRRichChayA
shlokas.32:
pA.nsugraste tataH kUpe vichintya salilaM muniH |
agnInsa~NkalpayAmAsa hotre chAtmAnameva cha
shlokas.33:
tatastAM vIrudhaM somaM sa~Nkalpya sumahAtapAH |
RRicho yajUMShi sAmAni manasA chintayanmuniH
grAvANaH sharkarAH kRRitvA prachakre.abhiShavaM nRRipa
shlokas.34:
AjyaM cha salilaM chakre bhAgA.nshcha tridivaukasAm |
somasyAbhiShavaM kRRitvA chakAra tumulaM dhvanim
shlokas.35:
sa chAvishaddivaM rAjansvaraH shaikShastritasya vai |
samavApa cha taM yaj~naM yathoktaM brahmavAdibhiH
shlokas.36:
vartamAne tathA yaj~ne tritasya sumahAtmanaH |
AvignaM tridivaM sarvaM kAraNaM cha na budhyate
shlokas.37:
tataH sutumulaM shabdaM shushrAvAtha bRRihaspatiH |
shrutvA chaivAbravIddevAnsarvAndevapurohitaH
shlokas.38:
tritasya vartate yaj~nastatra gachChAmahe surAH |
sa hi kruddhaH sRRijedanyAndevAnapi mahAtapAH
shlokas.39:
tachChrutvA vachanaM tasya sahitAH sarvadevatAH |
prayayustatra yatrAsau tritayaj~naH pravartate
shlokas.40:
te tatra gatvA vibudhAstaM kUpaM yatra sa tritaH |
dadRRishustaM mahAtmAnaM dIkShitaM yaj~nakarmasu
shlokas.41:
dRRiShTvA chainaM mahAtmAnaM shriyA paramayA yutam |
UchushchAtha mahAbhAgaM prAptA bhAgArthino vayam
shlokas.42:
athAbravIdRRiShirdevAnpashyadhvaM mAM divaukasaH |
asminpratibhaye kUpe nimagnaM naShTachetasam
shlokas.43:
tatastrito mahArAja bhAgA.nsteShAM yathAvidhi |
mantrayuktAnsamadadAtte cha prItAstadAbhavan
shlokas.44:
tato yathAvidhi prAptAnbhAgAnprApya divaukasaH |
prItAtmAno dadustasmai varAnyAnmanasechChati
shlokas.45:
sa tu vavre varaM devA.nstrAtumarhatha mAmitaH |
yashchehopaspRRishetkUpe sa somapagatiM labhet
shlokas.46:
tatra chormimatI rAjannutpapAta sarasvatI |
tayotkShiptastritastasthau pUjaya.nstridivaukasaH
shlokas.47:
tatheti choktvA vibudhA jagmU rAjanyathAgatam |
tritashchApyagamatprItaH svameva nilayaM tadA
shlokas.48:
kruddhaH sa tu samAsAdya tAvRRiShI bhrAtarau tadA |
uvAcha paruShaM vAkyaM shashApa cha mahAtapAH
shlokas.49:
pashulubdhau yuvAM yasmAnmAmutsRRijya pradhAvitau |
tasmAdrUpeNa teShAM vai daMShTriNAmabhitashcharau
shlokas.50:
bhavitArau mayA shaptau pApenAnena karmaNA |
prasavashchaiva yuvayorgolA~NgUlarkShavAnarAH
shlokas.51:
ityukte tu tadA tena kShaNAdeva vishAM pate |
tathAbhUtAvadRRishyetAM vachanAtsatyavAdinaH
shlokas.52:
tatrApyamitavikrAntaH spRRiShTvA toyaM halAyudhaH |
dattvA cha vividhAndAyAnpUjayitvA cha vai dvijAn
shlokas.53:
udapAnaM cha taM dRRiShTvA prashasya cha punaH punaH |
nadIgatamadInAtmA prApto vinashanaM tadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vinashanaM rAjannAjagAma halAyudhaH |
shUdrAbhIrAnprati dveShAdyatra naShTA sarasvatI
shlokas.2:
yasmAtsA bharatashreShTha dveShAnnaShTA sarasvatI |
tasmAttadRRiShayo nityaM prAhurvinashaneti ha
shlokas.3:
tachchApyupaspRRishya balaH sarasvatyAM mahAbalaH |
subhUmikaM tato.agachChatsarasvatyAstaTe vare
shlokas.4:
tatra chApsarasaH shubhrA nityakAlamatandritAH |
krIDAbhirvimalAbhishcha krIDanti vimalAnanAH
shlokas.5:
tatra devAH sagandharvA mAsi mAsi janeshvara |
abhigachChanti tattIrthaM puNyaM brAhmaNasevitam
shlokas.6:
tatrAdRRishyanta gandharvAstathaivApsarasAM gaNAH |
sametya sahitA rAjanyathAprAptaM yathAsukham
shlokas.7:
tatra modanti devAshcha pitarashcha savIrudhaH |
puNyaiH puShpaiH sadA divyaiH kIryamANAH punaH punaH
shlokas.8:
AkrIDabhUmiH sA rAja.nstAsAmapsarasAM shubhA |
subhUmiketi vikhyAtA sarasvatyAstaTe vare
shlokas.9:
tatra snAtvA cha dattvA cha vasu vipreShu mAdhavaH |
shrutvA gItaM cha taddivyaM vAditrANAM cha niHsvanam
shlokas.10:
ChAyAshcha vipulA dRRiShTvA devagandharvarakShasAm |
gandharvANAM tatastIrthamAgachChadrohiNIsutaH
shlokas.11:
vishvAvasumukhAstatra gandharvAstapasAnvitAH |
nRRittavAditragItaM cha kurvanti sumanoramam
shlokas.12:
tatra dattvA haladharo viprebhyo vividhaM vasu |
ajAvikaM gokharoShTraM suvarNaM rajataM tathA
shlokas.13:
bhojayitvA dvijAnkAmaiH santarpya cha mahAdhanaiH |
prayayau sahito vipraiH stUyamAnashcha mAdhavaH
shlokas.14:
tasmAdgandharvatIrthAchcha mahAbAhurari.ndamaH |
gargasroto mahAtIrthamAjagAmaikakuNDalI
shlokas.15:
yatra gargeNa vRRiddhena tapasA bhAvitAtmanA |
kAlaj~nAnagatishchaiva jyotiShAM cha vyatikramaH
shlokas.16:
utpAtA dAruNAshchaiva shubhAshcha janamejaya |
sarasvatyAH shubhe tIrthe vihitA vai mahAtmanA
tasya nAmnA cha tattIrthaM gargasrota iti smRRitam
shlokas.17:
tatra gargaM mahAbhAgamRRiShayaH suvratA nRRipa |
upAsAM chakrire nityaM kAlaj~nAnaM prati prabho
shlokas.18:
tatra gatvA mahArAja balaH shvetAnulepanaH |
vidhivaddhi dhanaM dattvA munInAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.19:
uchchAvachA.nstathA bhakShyAndvijebhyo vipradAya saH |
nIlavAsAstato.agachChachCha~NkhatIrthaM mahAyashAH
shlokas.20:
tatrApashyanmahAsha~NkhaM mahAmerumivochChritam |
shvetaparvatasa~NkAshamRRiShisa~NghairniShevitam
sarasvatyAstaTe jAtaM nagaM tAladhvajo balI
shlokas.21:
yakShA vidyAdharAshchaiva rAkShasAshchAmitaujasaH |
pishAchAshchAmitabalA yatra siddhAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.22:
te sarve hyashanaM tyaktvA phalaM tasya vanaspateH |
vrataishcha niyamaishchaiva kAle kAle sma bhu~njate
shlokas.23:
prAptaishcha niyamaistaistairvicharantaH pRRithakpRRithak |
adRRishyamAnA manujairvyacharanpuruSharShabha
shlokas.24:
evaM khyAto narapate loke.asminsa vanaspatiH |
tatra tIrthaM sarasvatyAH pAvanaM lokavishrutam
shlokas.25:
tasmi.nshcha yadushArdUlo dattvA tIrthe yashasvinAm |
tAmrAyasAni bhANDAni vastrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.26:
pUjayitvA dvijA.nshchaiva pUjitashcha tapodhanaiH |
puNyaM dvaitavanaM rAjannAjagAma halAyudhaH
shlokas.27:
tatra gatvA munIndRRiShTvA nAnAveShadharAnbalaH |
Aplutya salile chApi pUjayAmAsa vai dvijAn
shlokas.28:
tathaiva dattvA viprebhyaH paribhogAnsupuShkalAn |
tataH prAyAdbalo rAjandakShiNena sarasvatIm
shlokas.29:
gatvA chaiva mahAbAhurnAtidUraM mahAyashAH |
dharmAtmA nAgadhanvAnaM tIrthamAgamadachyutaH
shlokas.30:
yatra pannagarAjasya vAsukeH saMniveshanam |
mahAdyutermahArAja bahubhiH pannagairvRRitam
yatrAsannRRiShayaH siddhAH sahasrANi chaturdasha
shlokas.31:
yatra devAH samAgamya vAsukiM pannagottamam |
sarvapannagarAjAnamabhyaShi~nchanyathAvidhi
pannagebhyo bhayaM tatra vidyate na sma kaurava
shlokas.32:
tatrApi vidhivaddattvA viprebhyo ratnasa~nchayAn |
prAyAtprAchIM dishaM rAjandIpyamAnaH svatejasA
shlokas.33:
Aplutya bahusho hRRiShTasteShu tIrtheShu lA~NgalI |
dattvA vasu dvijAtibhyo jagAmAti tapasvinaH
shlokas.34:
tatrasthAnRRiShisa~NghA.nstAnabhivAdya halAyudhaH |
tato rAmo.agamattIrthamRRiShibhiH sevitaM mahat
shlokas.35:
yatra bhUyo nivavRRite prA~NmukhA vai sarasvatI |
RRiShINAM naimiSheyANAmavekShArthaM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.36:
nivRRittAM tAM sarichChreShThAM tatra dRRiShTvA tu lA~NgalI |
babhUva vismito rAjanbalaH shvetAnulepanaH
shlokas.37:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kasmAtsarasvatI brahmannivRRittA prA~NmukhI tataH |
vyAkhyAtumetadichChAmi sarvamadhvaryusattama
shlokas.38:
kasmi.nshcha kAraNe tatra vismito yadunandanaH |
vinivRRittA sarichChreShThA kathametaddvijottama
shlokas.39:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pUrvaM kRRitayuge rAjannaimiSheyAstapasvinaH |
vartamAne subahule satre dvAdashavArShike
RRiShayo bahavo rAja.nstatra sampratipedire
shlokas.40:
uShitvA cha mahAbhAgAstasminsatre yathAvidhi |
nivRRitte naimiSheye vai satre dvAdashavArShike
AjagmurRRiShayastatra bahavastIrthakAraNAt
shlokas.41:
RRiShINAM bahulatvAttu sarasvatyA vishAM pate |
tIrthAni nagarAyante kUle vai dakShiNe tadA
shlokas.42:
samantapa~nchakaM yAvattAvatte dvijasattamAH |
tIrthalobhAnnaravyAghra nadyAstIraM samAshritAH
shlokas.43:
juhvatAM tatra teShAM tu munInAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
svAdhyAyenApi mahatA babhUvuH pUritA dishaH
shlokas.44:
agnihotraistatasteShAM hUyamAnairmahAtmanAm |
ashobhata sarichChreShThA dIpyamAnaiH samantataH
shlokas.45:
vAlakhilyA mahArAja ashmakuTTAshcha tApasAH |
dantolUkhalinashchAnye samprakShAlAstathApare
shlokas.46:
vAyubhakShA jalAhArAH parNabhakShAshcha tApasAH |
nAnAniyamayuktAshcha tathA sthaNDilashAyinaH
shlokas.47:
Asanvai munayastatra sarasvatyAH samIpataH |
shobhayantaH sarichChreShThAM ga~NgAmiva divaukasaH
shlokas.48:
tataH pashchAtsamApeturRRiShayaH satrayAjinaH |
te.avakAshaM na dadRRishuH kurukShetre mahAvratAH
shlokas.49:
tato yaj~nopavItaiste tattIrthaM nirmimAya vai |
juhuvushchAgnihotrANi chakrushcha vividhAH kriyAH
shlokas.50:
tatastamRRiShisa~NghAtaM nirAshaM chintayAnvitam |
darshayAmAsa rAjendra teShAmarthe sarasvatI
shlokas.51:
tataH ku~njAnbahUnkRRitvA saMnivRRittA saridvarA |
RRiShINAM puNyatapasAM kAruNyAjjanamejaya
shlokas.52:
tato nivRRitya rAjendra teShAmarthe sarasvatI |
bhUyaH pratIchyabhimukhI susrAva saritAM varA
shlokas.53:
amoghA gamanaM kRRitvA teShAM bhUyo vrajAmyaham |
ityadbhutaM mahachchakre tato rAjanmahAnadI
shlokas.54:
evaM sa ku~njo rAjendra naimiSheya iti smRRitaH |
kurukShetre kurushreShTha kuruShva mahatIH kriyAH
shlokas.55:
tatra ku~njAnbahUndRRiShTvA saMnivRRittAM cha tAM nadIm |
babhUva vismayastatra rAmasyAtha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.56:
upaspRRishya tu tatrApi vidhivadyadunandanaH |
dattvA dAyAndvijAtibhyo bhANDAni vividhAni cha
bhakShyaM peyaM cha vividhaM brAhmaNAnpratyapAdayat
shlokas.57:
tataH prAyAdbalo rAjanpUjyamAno dvijAtibhiH |
sarasvatItIrthavaraM nAnAdvijagaNAyutam
shlokas.58:
badare~NgudakAshmaryaplakShAshvatthavibhItakaiH |
panasaishcha palAshaishcha karIraiH pIlubhistathA
shlokas.59:
sarasvatItIraruhairbandhanaiH syandanaistathA |
parUShakavanaishchaiva bilvairAmrAtakaistathA
shlokas.60:
atimuktakaShaNDaishcha pArijAtaishcha shobhitam |
kadalIvanabhUyiShThamiShTaM kAntaM manoramam
shlokas.61:
vAyvambuphalaparNAdairdantolUkhalikairapi |
tathAshmakuTTairvAneyairmunibhirbahubhirvRRitam
shlokas.62:
svAdhyAyaghoShasa~NghuShTaM mRRigayUthashatAkulam |
ahi.nsrairdharmaparamairnRRibhiratyantasevitam
shlokas.63:
saptasArasvataM tIrthamAjagAma halAyudhaH |
yatra ma~NkaNakaH siddhastapastepe mahAmuniH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
saptasArasvataM kasmAtkashcha ma~NkaNako muniH |
kathaM siddhashcha bhagavAnkashchAsya niyamo.abhavat
shlokas.2:
kasya va.nshe samutpannaH kiM chAdhItaM dvijottama |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM vidhivaddvijasattama
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
rAjansapta sarasvatyo yAbhirvyAptamidaM jagat |
AhUtA balavadbhirhi tatra tatra sarasvatI
shlokas.4:
suprabhA kA~nchanAkShI cha vishAlA mAnasahradA |
sarasvatI oghavatI suveNurvimalodakA
shlokas.5:
pitAmahasya mahato vartamAne mahItale |
vitate yaj~navATe vai sameteShu dvijAtiShu
shlokas.6:
puNyAhaghoShairvimalairvedAnAM ninadaistathA |
deveShu chaiva vyagreShu tasminyaj~navidhau tadA
shlokas.7:
tatra chaiva mahArAja dIkShite prapitAmahe |
yajatastatra satreNa sarvakAmasamRRiddhinA
shlokas.8:
manasA chintitA hyarthA dharmArthakushalaistadA |
upatiShThanti rAjendra dvijAtI.nstatra tatra ha
shlokas.9:
jagushcha tatra gandharvA nanRRitushchApsarogaNAH |
vAditrANi cha divyAni vAdayAmAsura~njasA
shlokas.10:
tasya yaj~nasya sampattyA tutuShurdevatA api |
vismayaM paramaM jagmuH kimu mAnuShayonayaH
shlokas.11:
vartamAne tathA yaj~ne puShkarasthe pitAmahe |
abruvannRRiShayo rAjannAyaM yaj~no mahAphalaH
na dRRishyate sarichChreShThA yasmAdiha sarasvatI
shlokas.12:
tachChrutvA bhagavAnprItaH sasmArAtha sarasvatIm |
pitAmahena yajatA AhUtA puShkareShu vai
suprabhA nAma rAjendra nAmnA tatra sarasvatI
shlokas.13:
tAM dRRiShTvA munayastuShTA vegayuktAM sarasvatIm |
pitAmahaM mAnayantIM kratuM te bahu menire
shlokas.14:
evameShA sarichChreShThA puShkareShu sarasvatI |
pitAmahArthaM sambhUtA tuShTyarthaM cha manIShiNAm
shlokas.15:
naimiShe munayo rAjansamAgamya samAsate |
tatra chitrAH kathA hyAsanvedaM prati janeshvara
shlokas.16:
tatra te munayo hyAsannAnAsvAdhyAyavedinaH |
te samAgamya munayaH sasmarurvai sarasvatIm
shlokas.17:
sA tu dhyAtA mahArAja RRiShibhiH satrayAjibhiH |
samAgatAnAM rAjendra sahAyArthaM mahAtmanAm
AjagAma mahAbhAgA tatra puNyA sarasvatI
shlokas.18:
naimiShe kA~nchanAkShI tu munInAM satrayAjinAm |
AgatA saritAM shreShThA tatra bhArata pUjitA
shlokas.19:
gayasya yajamAnasya gayeShveva mahAkratum |
AhUtA saritAM shreShThA gayayaj~ne sarasvatI
shlokas.20:
vishAlAM tu gayeShvAhurRRiShayaH sa.nshitavratAH |
saritsA himavatpArshvAtprasUtA shIghragAminI
shlokas.21:
auddAlakestathA yaj~ne yajatastatra bhArata |
samete sarvataH sphIte munInAM maNDale tadA
shlokas.22:
uttare kosalAbhAge puNye rAjanmahAtmanaH |
auddAlakena yajatA pUrvaM dhyAtA sarasvatI
shlokas.23:
AjagAma sarichChreShThA taM deshamRRiShikAraNAt |
pUjyamAnA munigaNairvalkalAjinasa.nvRRitaiH
manohradeti vikhyAtA sA hi tairmanasA hRRitA
shlokas.24:
suveNurRRiShabhadvIpe puNye rAjarShisevite |
kuroshcha yajamAnasya kurukShetre mahAtmanaH
AjagAma mahAbhAgA sarichChreShThA sarasvatI
shlokas.25:
oghavatyapi rAjendra vasiShThena mahAtmanA |
samAhUtA kurukShetre divyatoyA sarasvatI
shlokas.26:
dakSheNa yajatA chApi ga~NgAdvAre sarasvatI |
vimalodA bhagavatI brahmaNA yajatA punaH
samAhUtA yayau tatra puNye haimavate girau
shlokas.27:
ekIbhUtAstatastAstu tasmi.nstIrthe samAgatAH |
saptasArasvataM tIrthaM tatastatprathitaM bhuvi
shlokas.28:
iti sapta sarasvatyo nAmataH parikIrtitAH |
saptasArasvataM chaiva tIrthaM puNyaM tathA smRRitam
shlokas.29:
shRRiNu ma~NkaNakasyApi kaumArabrahmachAriNaH |
ApagAmavagADhasya rAjanprakrIDitaM mahat
shlokas.30:
dRRiShTvA yadRRichChayA tatra striyamambhasi bhArata |
snAyantIM ruchirApA~NgIM digvAsasamaninditAm
sarasvatyAM mahArAja chaskande vIryamambhasi
shlokas.31:
tadretaH sa tu jagrAha kalashe vai mahAtapAH |
saptadhA pravibhAgaM tu kalashasthaM jagAma ha
tatrarShayaH sapta jAtA jaj~nire marutAM gaNAH
shlokas.32:
vAyuvego vAyubalo vAyuhA vAyumaNDalaH |
vAyujvAlo vAyuretA vAyuchakrashcha vIryavAn
evamete samutpannA marutAM janayiShNavaH
shlokas.33:
idamanyachcha rAjendra shRRiNvAshcharyataraM bhuvi |
maharSheshcharitaM yAdRRiktriShu lokeShu vishrutam
shlokas.34:
purA ma~NkaNakaH siddhaH kushAgreNeti naH shrutam |
kShataH kila kare rAja.nstasya shAkaraso.asravat
sa vi shAkarasaM dRRiShTvA harShAviShTaH pranRRittavAn
shlokas.35:
tatastasminpranRRitte vai sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM cha yat |
pranRRittamubhayaM vIra tejasA tasya mohitam
shlokas.36:
brahmAdibhiH surai rAjannRRiShibhishcha tapodhanaiH |
vij~napto vai mahAdeva RRiSherarthe narAdhipa
nAyaM nRRityedyathA deva tathA tvaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.37:
tato devo muniM dRRiShTvA harShAviShTamatIva ha |
surANAM hitakAmArthaM mahAdevo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.38:
bho bho brAhmaNa dharmaj~na kimarthaM narinartsi vai |
harShasthAnaM kimarthaM vai tavedaM munisattama
tapasvino dharmapathe sthitasya dvijasattama
shlokas.39:
RRiShiruvAcha||
kiM na pashyasi me brahmankarAchChAkarasaM srutam |
yaM dRRiShTvA vai pranRRitto.ahaM harSheNa mahatA vibho
shlokas.40:
taM prahasyAbravIddevo muniM rAgeNa mohitam |
ahaM na vismayaM vipra gachChAmIti prapashya mAm
shlokas.41:
evamuktvA munishreShThaM mahAdevena dhImatA |
a~NgulyagreNa rAjendra svA~NguShThastADito.abhavat
shlokas.42:
tato bhasma kShatAdrAjannirgataM himasaMnibham |
taddRRiShTvA vrIDito rAjansa muniH pAdayorgataH
shlokas.43:
RRiShiruvAcha||
nAnyaM devAdahaM manye rudrAtparataraM mahat |
surAsurasya jagato gatistvamasi shUladhRRik
shlokas.44:
tvayA sRRiShTamidaM vishvaM vadantIha manIShiNaH |
tvAmeva sarvaM vishati punareva yugakShaye
shlokas.45:
devairapi na shakyastvaM parij~nAtuM kuto mayA |
tvayi sarve sma dRRishyante surA brahmAdayo.anagha
shlokas.46:
sarvastvamasi devAnAM kartA kArayitA cha ha |
tvatprasAdAtsurAH sarve modantIhAkutobhayAH
shlokas.47:
evaM stutvA mahAdevaM sa RRiShiH praNato.abravIt |
bhagava.nstvatprasAdAdvai tapo me na kSharediti
shlokas.48:
tato devaH prItamanAstamRRiShiM punarabravIt |
tapaste vardhatAM vipra matprasAdAtsahasradhA
Ashrame cheha vatsyAmi tvayA sArdhamahaM sadA
shlokas.49:
saptasArasvate chAsminyo mAmarchiShyate naraH |
na tasya durlabhaM ki~nchidbhaviteha paratra cha
sArasvataM cha lokaM te gamiShyanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.50:
etanma~NkaNakasyApi charitaM bhUritejasaH |
sa hi putraH sajanyAyAmutpanno mAtarishvanA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
uShitvA tatra rAmastu sampUjyAshramavAsinaH |
tathA ma~NkaNake prItiM shubhAM chakre halAyudhaH
shlokas.2:
dattvA dAnaM dvijAtibhyo rajanIM tAmupoShya cha |
pUjito munisa~Nghaishcha prAtarutthAya lA~NgalI
shlokas.3:
anuj~nApya munInsarvAnspRRiShTvA toyaM cha bhArata |
prayayau tvarito rAmastIrthahetormahAbalaH
shlokas.4:
tata aushanasaM tIrthamAjagAma halAyudhaH |
kapAlamochanaM nAma yatra mukto mahAmuniH
shlokas.5:
mahatA shirasA rAjangrastaja~Ngho mahodaraH |
rAkShasasya mahArAja rAmakShiptasya vai purA
shlokas.6:
tatra pUrvaM tapastaptaM kAvyena sumahAtmanA |
yatrAsya nItirakhilA prAdurbhUtA mahAtmanaH
tatrasthashchintayAmAsa daityadAnavavigraham
shlokas.7:
tatprApya cha balo rAja.nstIrthapravaramuttamam |
vidhivaddhi dadau vittaM brAhmaNAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.8:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kapAlamochanaM brahmankathaM yatra mahAmuniH |
muktaH kathaM chAsya shiro lagnaM kena cha hetunA
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
purA vai daNDakAraNye rAghaveNa mahAtmanA |
vasatA rAjashArdUla rAkShasAstatra hi.nsitAH
shlokas.10:
janasthAne shirashChinnaM rAkShasasya durAtmanaH |
kShureNa shitadhAreNa tatpapAta mahAvane
shlokas.11:
mahodarasya tallagnaM ja~NghAyAM vai yadRRichChayA |
vane vicharato rAjannasthi bhittvAsphurattadA
shlokas.12:
sa tena lagnena tadA dvijAtirna shashAka ha |
abhigantuM mahAprAj~nastIrthAnyAyatanAni cha
shlokas.13:
sa pUtinA visravatA vedanArto mahAmuniH |
jagAma sarvatIrthAni pRRithivyAmiti naH shrutam
shlokas.14:
sa gatvA saritaH sarvAH samudrA.nshcha mahAtapAH |
kathayAmAsa tatsarvamRRiShINAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.15:
AplutaH sarvatIrtheShu na cha mokShamavAptavAn |
sa tu shushrAva viprendro munInAM vachanaM mahat
shlokas.16:
sarasvatyAstIrthavaraM khyAtamaushanasaM tadA |
sarvapApaprashamanaM siddhakShetramanuttamam
shlokas.17:
sa tu gatvA tatastatra tIrthamaushanasaM dvijaH |
tata aushanase tIrthe tasyopaspRRishatastadA
tachChirashcharaNaM muktvA papAtAntarjale tadA
shlokas.18:
tataH sa virujo rAjanpUtAtmA vItakalmaShaH |
AjagAmAshramaM prItaH kRRitakRRityo mahodaraH
shlokas.19:
so.atha gatvAshramaM puNyaM vipramukto mahAtapAH |
kathayAmAsa tatsarvamRRiShINAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.20:
te shrutvA vachanaM tasya tatastIrthasya mAnada |
kapAlamochanamiti nAma chakruH samAgatAH
shlokas.21:
tatra dattvA bahUndAyAnviprAnsampUjya mAdhavaH |
jagAma vRRiShNipravaro ruSha~NgorAshramaM tadA
shlokas.22:
yatra taptaM tapo ghoramArShTiSheNena bhArata |
brAhmaNyaM labdhavA.nstatra vishvAmitro mahAmuniH
shlokas.23:
tato haladharaH shrImAnbrAhmaNaiH parivAritaH |
jagAma yatra rAjendra ruSha~Ngustanumatyajat
shlokas.24:
ruSha~NgurbrAhmaNo vRRiddhastaponityashcha bhArata |
dehanyAse kRRitamanA vichintya bahudhA bahu
shlokas.25:
tataH sarvAnupAdAya tanayAnvai mahAtapAH |
ruSha~NgurabravIttatra nayadhvaM mA pRRithUdakam
shlokas.26:
vij~nAyAtItavayasaM ruSha~NguM te tapodhanAH |
taM vai tIrthamupAninyuH sarasvatyAstapodhanam
shlokas.27:
sa taiH putraistadA dhImAnAnIto vai sarasvatIm |
puNyAM tIrthashatopetAM viprasa~NghairniShevitAm
shlokas.28:
sa tatra vidhinA rAjannAplutaH sumahAtapAH |
j~nAtvA tIrthaguNA.nshchaiva prAhedamRRiShisattamaH
suprItaH puruShavyAghra sarvAnputrAnupAsataH
shlokas.29:
sarasvatyuttare tIre yastyajedAtmanastanum |
pRRithUdake japyaparo nainaM shvomaraNaM tapet
shlokas.30:
tatrAplutya sa dharmAtmA upaspRRishya halAyudhaH |
dattvA chaiva bahUndAyAnviprANAM vipravatsalaH
shlokas.31:
sasarja yatra bhagavA.NllokA.NllokapitAmahaH |
yatrArShTiSheNaH kauravya brAhmaNyaM sa.nshitavrataH
tapasA mahatA rAjanprAptavAnRRiShisattamaH
shlokas.32:
sindhudvIpashcha rAjarShirdevApishcha mahAtapAH |
brAhmaNyaM labdhavAnyatra vishvAmitro mahAmuniH
mahAtapasvI bhagavAnugratejA mahAtapAH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathamArShTiSheNo bhagavAnvipulaM taptavA.nstapaH |
sindhudvIpaH kathaM chApi brAhmaNyaM labdhavA.nstadA
shlokas.2:
devApishcha kathaM brahmanvishvAmitrashcha sattama |
tanmamAchakShva bhagavanparaM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
purA kRRitayuge rAjannArShTiSheNo dvijottamaH |
vasangurukule nityaM nityamadhyayane rataH
shlokas.4:
tasya rAjangurukule vasato nityameva ha |
samAptiM nAgamadvidyA nApi vedA vishAM pate
shlokas.5:
sa nirviNNastato rAja.nstapastepe mahAtapAH |
tato vai tapasA tena prApya vedAnanuttamAn
shlokas.6:
sa vidvAnvedayuktashcha siddhashchApyRRiShisattamaH |
tatra tIrthe varAnprAdAttrIneva sumahAtapAH
shlokas.7:
asmi.nstIrthe mahAnadyA adyaprabhRRiti mAnavaH |
Apluto vAjimedhasya phalaM prApnoti puShkalam
shlokas.8:
adyaprabhRRiti naivAtra bhayaM vyAlAdbhaviShyati |
api chAlpena yatnena phalaM prApsyati puShkalam
shlokas.9:
evamuktvA mahAtejA jagAma tridivaM muniH |
evaM siddhaH sa bhagavAnArShTiSheNaH pratApavAn
shlokas.10:
tasminneva tadA tIrthe sindhudvIpaH pratApavAn |
devApishcha mahArAja brAhmaNyaM prApaturmahat
shlokas.11:
tathA cha kaushikastAta taponityo jitendriyaH |
tapasA vai sutaptena brAhmaNatvamavAptavAn
shlokas.12:
gAdhirnAma mahAnAsItkShatriyaH prathito bhuvi |
tasya putro.abhavadrAjanvishvAmitraH pratApavAn
shlokas.13:
sa rAjA kaushikastAta mahAyogyabhavatkila |
sa putramabhiShichyAtha vishvAmitraM mahAtapAH
shlokas.14:
dehanyAse manashchakre tamUchuH praNatAH prajAH |
na gantavyaM mahAprAj~na trAhi chAsmAnmahAbhayAt
shlokas.15:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha tato gAdhiH prajAstadA |
vishvasya jagato goptA bhaviShyati suto mama
shlokas.16:
ityuktvA tu tato gAdhirvishvAmitraM niveshya cha |
jagAma tridivaM rAjanvishvAmitro.abhavannRRipaH
na cha shaknoti pRRithivIM yatnavAnapi rakShitum
shlokas.17:
tataH shushrAva rAjA sa rAkShasebhyo mahAbhayam |
niryayau nagarAchchApi chatura~NgabalAnvitaH
shlokas.18:
sa gatvA dUramadhvAnaM vasiShThAshramamabhyayAt |
tasya te sainikA rAja.nshchakrustatrAnayAnbahUn
shlokas.19:
tatastu bhagavAnvipro vasiShTho.a.ashramamabhyayAt |
dadRRishe cha tataH sarvaM bhajyamAnaM mahAvanam
shlokas.20:
tasya kruddho mahArAja vasiShTho munisattamaH |
sRRijasva shabarAnghorAniti svAM gAmuvAcha ha
shlokas.21:
tathoktA sAsRRijaddhenuH puruShAnghoradarshanAn |
te cha tadbalamAsAdya babha~njuH sarvatodisham
shlokas.22:
taddRRiShTvA vidrutaM sainyaM vishvAmitrastu gAdhijaH |
tapaH paraM manyamAnastapasyeva mano dadhe
shlokas.23:
so.asmi.nstIrthavare rAjansarasvatyAH samAhitaH |
niyamaishchopavAsaishcha karshayandehamAtmanaH
shlokas.24:
jalAhAro vAyubhakShaH parNAhArashcha so.abhavat |
tathA sthaNDilashAyI cha ye chAnye niyamAH pRRithak
shlokas.25:
asakRRittasya devAstu vratavighnaM prachakrire |
na chAsya niyamAdbuddhirapayAti mahAtmanaH
shlokas.26:
tataH pareNa yatnena taptvA bahuvidhaM tapaH |
tejasA bhAskarAkAro gAdhijaH samapadyata
shlokas.27:
tapasA tu tathA yuktaM vishvAmitraM pitAmahaH |
amanyata mahAtejA varado varamasya tat
shlokas.28:
sa tu vavre varaM rAjansyAmahaM brAhmaNastviti |
tatheti chAbravIdbrahmA sarvalokapitAmahaH
shlokas.29:
sa labdhvA tapasogreNa brAhmaNatvaM mahAyashAH |
vichachAra mahIM kRRitsnAM kRRitakAmaH suropamaH
shlokas.30:
tasmi.nstIrthavare rAmaH pradAya vividhaM vasu |
payasvinIstathA dhenUryAnAni shayanAni cha
shlokas.31:
tathA vastrANyala~NkAraM bhakShyaM peyaM cha shobhanam |
adadAnmudito rAjanpUjayitvA dvijottamAn
shlokas.32:
yayau rAja.nstato rAmo bakasyAshramamantikAt |
yatra tepe tapastIvraM dAlbhyo baka iti shrutiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
brahmayonibhirAkIrNaM jagAma yadunandanaH |
yatra dAlbhyo bako rAjanpashvarthaM sumahAtapAH
juhAva dhRRitarAShTrasya rAShTraM vaichitravIryiNaH
shlokas.2:
tapasA ghorarUpeNa karshayandehamAtmanaH |
krodhena mahatAviShTo dharmAtmA vai pratApavAn
shlokas.3:
purA hi naimiSheyANAM satre dvAdashavArShike |
vRRitte vishvajito.ante vai pA~nchAlAnRRiShayo.agaman
shlokas.4:
tatreshvaramayAchanta dakShiNArthaM manIShiNaH |
balAnvitAnvatsatarAnnirvyAdhInekavi.nshatim
shlokas.5:
tAnabravIdbako vRRiddho vibhajadhvaM pashUniti |
pashUnetAnahaM tyaktvA bhikShiShye rAjasattamam
shlokas.6:
evamuktvA tato rAjannRRiShInsarvAnpratApavAn |
jagAma dhRRitarAShTrasya bhavanaM brAhmaNottamaH
shlokas.7:
sa samIpagato bhUtvA dhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram |
ayAchata pashUndAlbhyaH sa chainaM ruShito.abravIt
shlokas.8:
yadRRichChayA mRRitA dRRiShTvA gAstadA nRRipasattama |
etAnpashUnnaya kShipraM brahmabandho yadIchChasi
shlokas.9:
RRiShistvatha vachaH shrutvA chintayAmAsa dharmavit |
aho bata nRRisha.nsaM vai vAkyamukto.asmi sa.nsadi
