shlokas.10:
chintayitvA muhUrtaM cha roShAviShTo dvijottamaH |
matiM chakre vinAshAya dhRRitarAShTrasya bhUpateH
shlokas.11:
sa utkRRitya mRRitAnAM vai mA.nsAni dvijasattamaH |
juhAva dhRRitarAShTrasya rAShTraM narapateH purA
shlokas.12:
avakIrNe sarasvatyAstIrthe prajvAlya pAvakam |
bako dAlbhyo mahArAja niyamaM paramAsthitaH
sa taireva juhAvAsya rAShTraM mA.nsairmahAtapAH
shlokas.13:
tasmi.nstu vidhivatsatre sampravRRitte sudAruNe |
akShIyata tato rAShTraM dhRRitarAShTrasya pArthiva
shlokas.14:
ChidyamAnaM yathAnantaM vanaM parashunA vibho |
babhUvApahataM tachchApyavakIrNamachetanam
shlokas.15:
dRRiShTvA tadavakIrNaM tu rAShTraM sa manujAdhipaH |
babhUva durmanA rAja.nshchintayAmAsa cha prabhuH
shlokas.16:
mokShArthamakarodyatnaM brAhmaNaiH sahitaH purA |
athAsau pArthivaH khinnaste cha viprAstadA nRRipa
shlokas.17:
yadA chApi na shaknoti rAShTraM mochayituM nRRipa |
atha vaiprAshnikA.nstatra paprachCha janamejaya
shlokas.18:
tato vaiprAshnikAH prAhuH pashuviprakRRitastvayA |
mA.nsairabhijuhotIti tava rAShTraM munirbakaH
shlokas.19:
tena te hUyamAnasya rAShTrasyAsya kShayo mahAn |
tasyaitattapasaH karma yena te hyanayo mahAn
apAM ku~nje sarasvatyAstaM prasAdaya pArthiva
shlokas.20:
sarasvatIM tato gatvA sa rAjA bakamabravIt |
nipatya shirasA bhUmau prA~njalirbharatarShabha
shlokas.21:
prasAdaye tvA bhagavannaparAdhaM kShamasva me |
mama dInasya lubdhasya maurkhyeNa hatachetasaH
tvaM gatistvaM cha me nAthaH prasAdaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.22:
taM tathA vilapantaM tu shokopahatachetasam |
dRRiShTvA tasya kRRipA jaj~ne rAShTraM tachcha vyamochayat
shlokas.23:
RRiShiH prasannastasyAbhUtsa.nrambhaM cha vihAya saH |
mokShArthaM tasya rAShTrasya juhAva punarAhutim
shlokas.24:
mokShayitvA tato rAShTraM pratigRRihya pashUnbahUn |
hRRiShTAtmA naimiShAraNyaM jagAma punareva hi
shlokas.25:
dhRRitarAShTro.api dharmAtmA svasthachetA mahAmanAH |
svameva nagaraM rAjA pratipede maharddhimat
shlokas.26:
tatra tIrthe mahArAja bRRihaspatirudAradhIH |
asurANAmabhAvAya bhAvAya cha divaukasAm
shlokas.27:
mA.nsairapi juhAveShTimakShIyanta tato.asurAH |
daivatairapi sambhagnA jitakAshibhirAhave
shlokas.28:
tatrApi vidhivaddattvA brAhmaNebhyo mahAyashAH |
vAjinaH ku~njarA.nshchaiva rathA.nshchAshvatarIyutAn
shlokas.29:
ratnAni cha mahArhANi dhanaM dhAnyaM cha puShkalam |
yayau tIrthaM mahAbAhuryAyAtaM pRRithivIpate
shlokas.30:
yatra yaj~ne yayAtestu mahArAja sarasvatI |
sarpiH payashcha susrAva nAhuShasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.31:
tatreShTvA puruShavyAghro yayAtiH pRRithivIpatiH |
AkrAmadUrdhvaM mudito lebhe lokA.nshcha puShkalAn
shlokas.32:
yayAteryajamAnasya yatra rAjansarasvatI |
prasRRitA pradadau kAmAnbrAhmaNAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.33:
yatra yatra hi yo vipro yAnyAnkAmAnabhIpsati |
tatra tatra sarichChreShThA sasarja subahUnrasAn
shlokas.34:
tatra devAH sagandharvAH prItA yaj~nasya sampadA |
vismitA mAnuShAshchAsandRRiShTvA tAM yaj~nasampadam
shlokas.35:
tatastAlaketurmahAdharmasetu;rmahAtmA kRRitAtmA mahAdAnanityaH |
vasiShThApavAhaM mahAbhImavegaM; dhRRitAtmA jitAtmA samabhyAjagAma

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
vasiShThasyApavAho vai bhImavegaH kathaM nu saH |
kimarthaM cha sarichChreShThA tamRRiShiM pratyavAhayat
shlokas.2:
kena chAsyAbhavadvairaM kAraNaM kiM cha tatprabho |
sha.nsa pRRiShTo mahAprAj~na na hi tRRipyAmi kathyatAm
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vishvAmitrasya chaivarShervasiShThasya cha bhArata |
bhRRishaM vairamabhUdrAja.nstapaHspardhAkRRitaM mahat
shlokas.4:
Ashramo vai vasiShThasya sthANutIrthe.abhavanmahAn |
pUrvataH pashchimashchAsIdvishvAmitrasya dhImataH
shlokas.5:
yatra sthANurmahArAja taptavAnsumahattapaH |
yatrAsya karma tadghoraM pravadanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.6:
yatreShTvA bhagavAnsthANuH pUjayitvA sarasvatIm |
sthApayAmAsa tattIrthaM sthANutIrthamiti prabho
shlokas.7:
tatra sarve surAH skandamabhyaShi~nchannarAdhipa |
senApatyena mahatA surArivinibarhaNam
shlokas.8:
tasminsarasvatItIrthe vishvAmitro mahAmuniH |
vasiShThaM chAlayAmAsa tapasogreNa tachChRRiNu
shlokas.9:
vishvAmitravasiShThau tAvahanyahani bhArata |
spardhAM tapaHkRRitAM tIvrAM chakratustau tapodhanau
shlokas.10:
tatrApyadhikasantApo vishvAmitro mahAmuniH |
dRRiShTvA tejo vasiShThasya chintAmabhijagAma ha
tasya buddhiriyaM hyAsIddharmanityasya bhArata
shlokas.11:
iyaM sarasvatI tUrNaM matsamIpaM tapodhanam |
AnayiShyati vegena vasiShThaM japatAM varam
ihAgataM dvijashreShThaM haniShyAmi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.12:
evaM nishchitya bhagavAnvishvAmitro mahAmuniH |
sasmAra saritAM shreShThAM krodhasa.nraktalochanaH
shlokas.13:
sA dhyAtA muninA tena vyAkulatvaM jagAma ha |
jaj~ne chainaM mahAvIryaM mahAkopaM cha bhAminI
shlokas.14:
tata enaM vepamAnA vivarNA prA~njalistadA |
upatasthe munivaraM vishvAmitraM sarasvatI
shlokas.15:
hatavIrA yathA nArI sAbhavadduHkhitA bhRRisham |
brUhi kiM karavANIti provAcha munisattamam
shlokas.16:
tAmuvAcha muniH kruddho vasiShThaM shIghramAnaya |
yAvadenaM nihanmyadya tachChrutvA vyathitA nadI
shlokas.17:
sA~njaliM tu tataH kRRitvA puNDarIkanibhekShaNA |
vivyathe suvirUDheva latA vAyusamIritA
shlokas.18:
tathAgatAM tu tAM dRRiShTvA vepamAnAM kRRitA~njalim |
vishvAmitro.abravItkruddho vasiShThaM shIghramAnaya
shlokas.19:
tato bhItA sarichChreShThA chintayAmAsa bhArata |
ubhayoH shApayorbhItA kathametadbhaviShyati
shlokas.20:
sAbhigamya vasiShThaM tu imamarthamachodayat |
yaduktA saritAM shreShThA vishvAmitreNa dhImatA
shlokas.21:
ubhayoH shApayorbhItA vepamAnA punaH punaH |
chintayitvA mahAshApamRRiShivitrAsitA bhRRisham
shlokas.22:
tAM kRRishAM cha vivarNAM cha dRRiShTvA chintAsamanvitAm |
uvAcha rAjandharmAtmA vasiShTho dvipadAM varaH
shlokas.23:
trAhyAtmAnaM sarichChreShThe vaha mAM shIghragAminI |
vishvAmitraH shapeddhi tvAM mA kRRithAstvaM vichAraNAm
shlokas.24:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA kRRipAshIlasya sA sarit |
chintayAmAsa kauravya kiM kRRitaM sukRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.25:
tasyAshchintA samutpannA vasiShTho mayyatIva hi |
kRRitavAnhi dayAM nityaM tasya kAryaM hitaM mayA
shlokas.26:
atha kUle svake rAja~njapantamRRiShisattamam |
juhvAnaM kaushikaM prekShya sarasvatyabhyachintayat
shlokas.27:
idamantaramityeva tataH sA saritAM varA |
kUlApahAramakarotsvena vegena sA sarit
shlokas.28:
tena kUlApahAreNa maitrAvaruNirauhyata |
uhyamAnashcha tuShTAva tadA rAjansarasvatIm
shlokas.29:
pitAmahasya sarasaH pravRRittAsi sarasvati |
vyAptaM chedaM jagatsarvaM tavaivAmbhobhiruttamaiH
shlokas.30:
tvamevAkAshagA devi megheShUtsRRijase payaH |
sarvAshchApastvameveti tvatto vayamadhImahe
shlokas.31:
puShTirdyutistathA kIrtiH siddhirvRRiddhirumA tathA |
tvameva vANI svAhA tvaM tvayyAyattamidaM jagat
tvameva sarvabhUteShu vasasIha chaturvidhA
shlokas.32:
evaM sarasvatI rAjanstUyamAnA maharShiNA |
vegenovAha taM vipraM vishvAmitrAshramaM prati
nyavedayata chAbhIkShNaM vishvAmitrAya taM munim
shlokas.33:
tamAnItaM sarasvatyA dRRiShTvA kopasamanvitaH |
athAnveShatpraharaNaM vasiShThAntakaraM tadA
shlokas.34:
taM tu kruddhamabhiprekShya brahmahatyAbhayAnnadI |
apovAha vasiShThaM tu prAchIM dishamatandritA
ubhayoH kurvatI vAkyaM va~nchayitvA tu gAdhijam
shlokas.35:
tato.apavAhitaM dRRiShTvA vasiShThamRRiShisattamam |
abravIdatha sa~Nkruddho vishvAmitro hyamarShaNaH
shlokas.36:
yasmAnmA tvaM sarichChreShThe va~nchayitvA punargatA |
shoNitaM vaha kalyANi rakShogrAmaNisaMmatam
shlokas.37:
tataH sarasvatI shaptA vishvAmitreNa dhImatA |
avahachChoNitonmishraM toyaM sa.nvatsaraM tadA
shlokas.38:
atharShayashcha devAshcha gandharvApsarasastathA |
sarasvatIM tathA dRRiShTvA babhUvurbhRRishaduHkhitAH
shlokas.39:
evaM vasiShThApavAho loke khyAto janAdhipa |
AgachChachcha punarmArgaM svameva saritAM varA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA shaptA tena kruddhena vishvAmitreNa dhImatA |
tasmi.nstIrthavare shubhre shoNitaM samupAvahat
shlokas.2:
athAjagmustato rAjanrAkShasAstatra bhArata |
tatra te shoNitaM sarve pibantaH sukhamAsate
shlokas.3:
tRRiptAshcha subhRRishaM tena sukhitA vigatajvarAH |
nRRityantashcha hasantashcha yathA svargajitastathA
shlokas.4:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya RRiShayaH satapodhanAH |
tIrthayAtrAM samAjagmuH sarasvatyAM mahIpate
shlokas.5:
teShu sarveShu tIrtheShu Aplutya munipu~NgavAH |
prApya prItiM parAM chApi tapolubdhA vishAradAH
prayayurhi tato rAjanyena tIrthaM hi tattathA
shlokas.6:
athAgamya mahAbhAgAstattIrthaM dAruNaM tadA |
dRRiShTvA toyaM sarasvatyAH shoNitena pariplutam
pIyamAnaM cha rakShobhirbahubhirnRRipasattama
shlokas.7:
tAndRRiShTvA rAkShasAnrAjanmunayaH sa.nshitavratAH |
paritrANe sarasvatyAH paraM yatnaM prachakrire
shlokas.8:
te tu sarve mahAbhAgAH samAgamya mahAvratAH |
AhUya saritAM shreShThAmidaM vachanamabruvan
shlokas.9:
kAraNaM brUhi kalyANi kimarthaM te hrado hyayam |
evamAkulatAM yAtaH shrutvA pAsyAmahe vayam
shlokas.10:
tataH sA sarvamAchaShTa yathAvRRittaM pravepatI |
duHkhitAmatha tAM dRRiShTvA ta Uchurvai tapodhanAH
shlokas.11:
kAraNaM shrutamasmAbhiH shApashchaiva shruto.anaghe |
kariShyanti tu yatprAptaM sarva eva tapodhanAH
shlokas.12:
evamuktvA sarichChreShThAmUchuste.atha parasparam |
vimochayAmahe sarve shApAdetAM sarasvatIm
shlokas.13:
teShAM tu vachanAdeva prakRRitisthA sarasvatI |
prasannasalilA jaj~ne yathA pUrvaM tathaiva hi
vimuktA cha sarichChreShThA vibabhau sA yathA purA
shlokas.14:
dRRiShTvA toyaM sarasvatyA munibhistaistathA kRRitam |
kRRitA~njalIstato rAjanrAkShasAH kShudhayArditAH
UchustAnvai munInsarvAnkRRipAyuktAnpunaH punaH
shlokas.15:
vayaM hi kShudhitAshchaiva dharmAddhInAshcha shAshvatAt |
na cha naH kAmakAro.ayaM yadvayaM pApakAriNaH
shlokas.16:
yuShmAkaM chAprasAdena duShkRRitena cha karmaNA |
pakSho.ayaM vardhate.asmAkaM yataH sma brahmarAkShasAH
shlokas.17:
evaM hi vaishyashUdrANAM kShatriyANAM tathaiva cha |
ye brAhmaNAnpradviShanti te bhavantIha rAkShasAH
shlokas.18:
AchAryamRRitvijaM chaiva guruM vRRiddhajanaM tathA |
prANino ye.avamanyante te bhavantIha rAkShasAH
yoShitAM chaiva pApAnAM yonidoSheNa vardhate
shlokas.19:
tatkurudhvamihAsmAkaM kAruNyaM dvijasattamAH |
shaktA bhavantaH sarveShAM lokAnAmapi tAraNe
shlokas.20:
teShAM te munayaH shrutvA tuShTuvustAM mahAnadIm |
mokShArthaM rakShasAM teShAmUchuH prayatamAnasAH
shlokas.21:
kShutakITAvapannaM cha yachchochChiShTAshitaM bhavet |
keshAvapannamAdhUtamArugNamapi yadbhavet
shvabhiH sa.nspRRiShTamannaM cha bhAgo.asau rakShasAmiha
shlokas.22:
tasmAjj~nAtvA sadA vidvAnetAnyannAni varjayet |
rAkShasAnnamasau bhu~Nkte yo bhu~Nkte hyannamIdRRisham
shlokas.23:
shodhayitvA tatastIrthamRRiShayaste tapodhanAH |
mokShArthaM rAkShasAnAM cha nadIM tAM pratyachodayan
shlokas.24:
maharShINAM mataM j~nAtvA tataH sA saritAM varA |
aruNAmAnayAmAsa svAM tanuM puruSharShabha
shlokas.25:
tasyAM te rAkShasAH snAtvA tanUstyaktvA divaM gatAH |
aruNAyAM mahArAja brahmahatyApahA hi sA
shlokas.26:
etamarthamabhij~nAya devarAjaH shatakratuH |
tasmi.nstIrthavare snAtvA vimuktaH pApmanA kila
shlokas.27:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kimarthaM bhagavA~nshakro brahmahatyAmavAptavAn |
kathamasmi.nshcha tIrthe vai AplutyAkalmaSho.abhavat
shlokas.28:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shRRiNuShvaitadupAkhyAnaM yathAvRRittaM janeshvara |
yathA bibheda samayaM namuchervAsavaH purA
shlokas.29:
namuchirvAsavAdbhItaH sUryarashmiM samAvishat |
tenendraH sakhyamakarotsamayaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.30:
nArdreNa tvA na shuShkeNa na rAtrau nApi vAhani |
vadhiShyAmyasurashreShTha sakhe satyena te shape
shlokas.31:
evaM sa kRRitvA samayaM sRRiShTvA nIhAramIshvaraH |
chichChedAsya shiro rAjannapAM phenena vAsavaH
shlokas.32:
tachChiro namucheshChinnaM pRRiShThataH shakramanvayAt |
he mitrahanpApa iti bruvANaM shakramantikAt
shlokas.33:
evaM sa shirasA tena chodyamAnaH punaH punaH |
pitAmahAya santapta evamarthaM nyavedayat
shlokas.34:
tamabravIllokagururaruNAyAM yathAvidhi |
iShTvopaspRRisha devendra brahmahatyApahA hi sA
shlokas.35:
ityuktaH sa sarasvatyAH ku~nje vai janamejaya |
iShTvA yathAvadbalabhidaruNAyAmupAspRRishat
shlokas.36:
sa muktaH pApmanA tena brahmahatyAkRRitena ha |
jagAma saMhRRiShTamanAstridivaM tridasheshvaraH
shlokas.37:
shirastachchApi namuchestatraivAplutya bhArata |
lokAnkAmadughAnprAptamakShayAnrAjasattama
shlokas.38:
tatrApyupaspRRishya balo mahAtmA; dattvA cha dAnAni pRRithagvidhAni |
avApya dharmaM paramAryakarmA; jagAma somasya mahatsa tIrtham
shlokas.39:
yatrAyajadrAjasUyena somaH; sAkShAtpurA vidhivatpArthivendra |
atrirdhImAnvipramukhyo babhUva; hotA yasminkratumukhye mahAtmA
shlokas.40:
yasyAnte.abhUtsumahAndAnavAnAM; daiteyAnAM rAkShasAnAM cha devaiH |
sa sa~NgrAmastArakAkhyaH sutIvro; yatra skandastArakAkhyaM jaghAna
shlokas.41:
senApatyaM labdhavAndevatAnAM; mahAseno yatra daityAntakartA |
sAkShAchchAtra nyavasatkArttikeyaH; sadA kumAro yatra sa plakSharAjaH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
sarasvatyAH prabhAvo.ayamuktaste dvijasattama |
kumArasyAbhiShekaM tu brahmanvyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.2:
yasminkAle cha deshe cha yathA cha vadatAM vara |
yaishchAbhiShikto bhagavAnvidhinA yena cha prabhuH
shlokas.3:
skando yathA cha daityAnAmakarotkadanaM mahat |
tathA me sarvamAchakShva paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kuruva.nshasya sadRRishamidaM kautUhalaM tava |
harShamutpAdayatyetadvacho me janamejaya
shlokas.5:
hanta te kathayiShyAmi shRRiNvAnasya janAdhipa |
abhiShekaM kumArasya prabhAvaM cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.6:
tejo mAheshvaraM skannamagnau prapatitaM purA |
tatsarvabhakSho bhagavAnnAshakaddagdhumakShayam
shlokas.7:
tenAsIdati tejasvI dIptimAnhavyavAhanaH |
na chaiva dhArayAmAsa garbhaM tejomayaM tadA
shlokas.8:
sa ga~NgAmabhisa~Ngamya niyogAdbrahmaNaH prabhuH |
garbhamAhitavAndivyaM bhAskaropamatejasam
shlokas.9:
atha ga~NgApi taM garbhamasahantI vidhAraNe |
utsasarja girau ramye himavatyamarArchite
shlokas.10:
sa tatra vavRRidhe lokAnAvRRitya jvalanAtmajaH |
dadRRishurjvalanAkAraM taM garbhamatha kRRittikAH
shlokas.11:
sharastambe mahAtmAnamanalAtmajamIshvaram |
mamAyamiti tAH sarvAH putrArthinyo.abhichakramuH
shlokas.12:
tAsAM viditvA bhAvaM taM mAtR^INAM bhagavAnprabhuH |
prasnutAnAM payaH ShaDbhirvadanairapibattadA
shlokas.13:
taM prabhAvaM samAlakShya tasya bAlasya kRRittikAH |
paraM vismayamApannA devyo divyavapurdharAH
shlokas.14:
yatrotsRRiShTaH sa bhagavAnga~NgayA girimUrdhani |
sa shailaH kA~nchanaH sarvaH sambabhau kurusattama
shlokas.15:
vardhatA chaiva garbheNa pRRithivI tena ra~njitA |
atashcha sarve sa.nvRRittA girayaH kA~nchanAkarAH
shlokas.16:
kumArashcha mahAvIryaH kArttikeya iti smRRitaH |
gA~NgeyaH pUrvamabhavanmahAyogabalAnvitaH
shlokas.17:
sa devastapasA chaiva vIryeNa cha samanvitaH |
vavRRidhe.atIva rAjendra chandravatpriyadarshanaH
shlokas.18:
sa tasminkA~nchane divye sharastambe shriyA vRRitaH |
stUyamAnastadA shete gandharvairmunibhistathA
shlokas.19:
tathainamanvanRRityanta devakanyAH sahasrashaH |
divyavAditranRRittaj~nAH stuvantyashchArudarshanAH
shlokas.20:
anvAste cha nadI devaM ga~NgA vai saritAM varA |
dadhAra pRRithivI chainaM bibhratI rUpamuttamam
shlokas.21:
jAtakarmAdikAstasya kriyAshchakre bRRihaspatiH |
vedashchainaM chaturmUrtirupatasthe kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.22:
dhanurvedashchatuShpAdaH shastragrAmaH sasa~NgrahaH |
tatrainaM samupAtiShThatsAkShAdvANI cha kevalA
shlokas.23:
sa dadarsha mahAvIryaM devadevamumApatim |
shailaputryA sahAsInaM bhUtasa~NghashatairvRRitam
shlokas.24:
nikAyA bhUtasa~NghAnAM paramAdbhutadarshanAH |
vikRRitA vikRRitAkArA vikRRitAbharaNadhvajAH
shlokas.25:
vyAghrasiMharkShavadanA biDAlamakarAnanAH |
vRRiShada.nshamukhAshchAnye gajoShTravadanAstathA
shlokas.26:
ulUkavadanAH kechidgRRidhragomAyudarshanAH |
krau~nchapArAvatanibhairvadanai rA~Nkavairapi
shlokas.27:
shvAvichChalyakagodhAnAM kharaiDakagavAM tathA |
sadRRishAni vapUMShyanye tatra tatra vyadhArayan
shlokas.28:
kechichChailAmbudaprakhyAshchakrAlAtagadAyudhAH |
kechida~njanapu~njAbhAH kechichChvetAchalaprabhAH
shlokas.29:
saptamAtRRigaNAshchaiva samAjagmurvishAM pate |
sAdhyA vishve.atha maruto vasavaH pitarastathA
shlokas.30:
rudrAdityAstathA siddhA bhujagA dAnavAH khagAH |
brahmA svayambhUrbhagavAnsaputraH saha viShNunA
shlokas.31:
shakrastathAbhyayAddraShTuM kumAravaramachyutam |
nAradapramukhAshchApi devagandharvasattamAH
shlokas.32:
devarShayashcha siddhAshcha bRRihaspatipurogamAH |
RRibhavo nAma varadA devAnAmapi devatAH
te.api tatra samAjagmuryAmA dhAmAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.33:
sa tu bAlo.api bhagavAnmahAyogabalAnvitaH |
abhyAjagAma deveshaM shUlahastaM pinAkinam
shlokas.34:
tamAvrajantamAlakShya shivasyAsInmanogatam |
yugapachChailaputryAshcha ga~NgAyAH pAvakasya cha
shlokas.35:
kiM nu pUrvamayaM bAlo gauravAdabhyupaiShyati |
api mAmiti sarveShAM teShAmAsInmanogatam
shlokas.36:
teShAmetamabhiprAyaM chaturNAmupalakShya saH |
yugapadyogamAsthAya sasarja vividhAstanUH
shlokas.37:
tato.abhavachchaturmUrtiH kShaNena bhagavAnprabhuH |
skandaH shAkho vishAkhashcha naigameShashcha pRRiShThataH
shlokas.38:
evaM sa kRRitvA hyAtmAnaM chaturdhA bhagavAnprabhuH |
yato rudrastataH skando jagAmAdbhutadarshanaH
shlokas.39:
vishAkhastu yayau yena devI girivarAtmajA |
shAkho yayau cha bhagavAnvAyumUrtirvibhAvasum
naigameSho.agamadga~NgAM kumAraH pAvakaprabhaH
shlokas.40:
sarve bhAsvaradehAste chatvAraH samarUpiNaH |
tAnsamabhyayuravyagrAstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.41:
hAhAkAro mahAnAsIddevadAnavarakShasAm |
taddRRiShTvA mahadAshcharyamadbhutaM romaharShaNam
shlokas.42:
tato rudrashcha devI cha pAvakashcha pitAmaham |
ga~NgayA sahitAH sarve praNipeturjagatpatim
shlokas.43:
praNipatya tataste tu vidhivadrAjapu~Ngava |
idamUchurvacho rAjankArttikeyapriyepsayA
shlokas.44:
asya bAlasya bhagavannAdhipatyaM yathepsitam |
asmatpriyArthaM devesha sadRRishaM dAtumarhasi
shlokas.45:
tataH sa bhagavAndhImAnsarvalokapitAmahaH |
manasA chintayAmAsa kimayaM labhatAmiti
shlokas.46:
aishvaryANi hi sarvANi devagandharvarakShasAm |
bhUtayakShaviha~NgAnAM pannagAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.47:
pUrvamevAdideshAsau nikAyeShu mahAtmanAm |
samarthaM cha tamaishvarye mahAmatiramanyata
shlokas.48:
tato muhUrtaM sa dhyAtvA devAnAM shreyasi sthitaH |
senApatyaM dadau tasmai sarvabhUteShu bhArata
shlokas.49:
sarvadevanikAyAnAM ye rAjAnaH parishrutAH |
tAnsarvAnvyAdideshAsmai sarvabhUtapitAmahaH
shlokas.50:
tataH kumAramAdAya devA brahmapurogamAH |
abhiShekArthamAjagmuH shailendraM sahitAstataH
shlokas.51:
puNyAM haimavatIM devIM sarichChreShThAM sarasvatIm |
samantapa~nchake yA vai triShu lokeShu vishrutA
shlokas.52:
tatra tIre sarasvatyAH puNye sarvaguNAnvite |
niShedurdevagandharvAH sarve sampUrNamAnasAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.abhiShekasambhArAnsarvAnsambhRRitya shAstrataH |
bRRihaspatiH samiddhe.agnau juhAvAjyaM yathAvidhi
shlokas.2:
tato himavatA datte maNipravarashobhite |
divyaratnAchite divye niShaNNaH paramAsane
shlokas.3:
sarvama~NgalasambhArairvidhimantrapuraskRRitam |
AbhiShechanikaM dravyaM gRRihItvA devatAgaNAH
shlokas.4:
indrAviShNU mahAvIryau sUryAchandramasau tathA |
dhAtA chaiva vidhAtA cha tathA chaivAnilAnalau
shlokas.5:
pUShNA bhagenAryamNA cha a.nshena cha vivasvatA |
rudrashcha sahito dhImAnmitreNa varuNena cha
shlokas.6:
rudrairvasubhirAdityairashvibhyAM cha vRRitaH prabhuH |
vishvedevairmarudbhishcha sAdhyaishcha pitRRibhiH saha
shlokas.7:
gandharvairapsarobhishcha yakSharAkShasapannagaiH |
devarShibhirasa~NkhyeyaistathA brahmarShibhirvaraiH
shlokas.8:
vaikhAnasairvAlakhilyairvAyvAhArairmarIchipaiH |
bhRRigubhishchA~Ngirobhishcha yatibhishcha mahAtmabhiH
sarvairvidyAdharaiH puNyairyogasiddhaistathA vRRitaH
shlokas.9:
pitAmahaH pulastyashcha pulahashcha mahAtapAH |
a~NgirAH kashyapo.atrishcha marIchirbhRRigureva cha
shlokas.10:
kraturharaH prachetAshcha manurdakShastathaiva cha |
RRitavashcha grahAshchaiva jyotIMShi cha vishAM pate
shlokas.11:
mUrtimatyashcha sarito vedAshchaiva sanAtanAH |
samudrAshcha hradAshchaiva tIrthAni vividhAni cha
pRRithivI dyaurdishashchaiva pAdapAshcha janAdhipa
shlokas.12:
aditirdevamAtA cha hrIH shrIH svAhA sarasvatI |
umA shachI sinIvAlI tathA chAnumatiH kuhUH
rAkA cha dhiShaNA chaiva patnyashchAnyA divaukasAm
shlokas.13:
himavA.nshchaiva vindhyashcha merushchAnekashRRi~NgavAn |
airAvataH sAnucharaH kalAH kAShThAstathaiva cha
mAsArdhamAsA RRitavastathA rAtryahanI nRRipa
shlokas.14:
uchchaiHshravA hayashreShTho nAgarAjashcha vAmanaH |
aruNo garuDashchaiva vRRikShAshchauShadhibhiH saha
shlokas.15:
dharmashcha bhagavAndevaH samAjagmurhi sa~NgatAH |
kAlo yamashcha mRRityushcha yamasyAnucharAshcha ye
shlokas.16:
bahulatvAchcha noktA ye vividhA devatAgaNAH |
te kumArAbhiShekArthaM samAjagmustatastataH
shlokas.17:
jagRRihuste tadA rAjansarva eva divaukasaH |
AbhiShechanikaM bhANDaM ma~NgalAni cha sarvashaH
shlokas.18:
divyasambhArasa.nyuktaiH kalashaiH kA~nchanairnRRipa |
sarasvatIbhiH puNyAbhirdivyatoyAbhireva tu
shlokas.19:
abhyaShi~nchankumAraM vai samprahRRiShTA divaukasaH |
senApatiM mahAtmAnamasurANAM bhayAvaham
shlokas.20:
purA yathA mahArAja varuNaM vai jaleshvaram |
tathAbhyaShi~nchadbhagavAnbrahmA lokapitAmahaH
kashyapashcha mahAtejA ye chAnye nAnukIrtitAH
shlokas.21:
tasmai brahmA dadau prIto balino vAtaraMhasaH |
kAmavIryadharAnsiddhAnmahApAriShadAnprabhuH
shlokas.22:
nandiSheNaM lohitAkShaM ghaNTAkarNaM cha saMmatam |
chaturthamasyAnucharaM khyAtaM kumudamAlinam
shlokas.23:
tataH sthANuM mahAvegaM mahApAriShadaM kratum |
mAyAshatadharaM kAmaM kAmavIryabalAnvitam
dadau skandAya rAjendra surArivinibarhaNam
shlokas.24:
sa hi devAsure yuddhe daityAnAM bhImakarmaNAm |
jaghAna dorbhyAM sa~NkruddhaH prayutAni chaturdasha
shlokas.25:
tathA devA dadustasmai senAM nairRRitasa~NkulAm |
devashatrukShayakarImajayyAM vishvarUpiNIm
shlokas.26:
jayashabdaM tatashchakrurdevAH sarve savAsavAH |
gandharvayakSharakShA.nsi munayaH pitarastathA
shlokas.27:
yamaH prAdAdanucharau yamakAlopamAvubhau |
unmAthaM cha pramAthaM cha mahAvIryau mahAdyutI
shlokas.28:
subhrAjo bhAskarashchaiva yau tau sUryAnuyAyinau |
tau sUryaH kArttikeyAya dadau prItaH pratApavAn
shlokas.29:
kailAsashRRi~Ngasa~NkAshau shvetamAlyAnulepanau |
somo.apyanucharau prAdAnmaNiM sumaNimeva cha
shlokas.30:
jvAlAjihvaM tathA jyotirAtmajAya hutAshanaH |
dadAvanucharau shUrau parasainyapramAthinau
shlokas.31:
parighaM cha vaTaM chaiva bhImaM cha sumahAbalam |
dahatiM dahanaM chaiva prachaNDau vIryasaMmatau
a.nsho.apyanucharAnpa~ncha dadau skandAya dhImate
shlokas.32:
utkroshaM pa~NkajaM chaiva vajradaNDadharAvubhau |
dadAvanalaputrAya vAsavaH paravIrahA
tau hi shatrUnmahendrasya jaghnatuH samare bahUn
shlokas.33:
chakraM vikramakaM chaiva sa~NkramaM cha mahAbalam |
skandAya trInanucharAndadau viShNurmahAyashAH
shlokas.34:
vardhanaM nandanaM chaiva sarvavidyAvishAradau |
skandAya dadatuH prItAvashvinau bharatarShabha
shlokas.35:
kundanaM kusumaM chaiva kumudaM cha mahAyashAH |
DambarADambarau chaiva dadau dhAtA mahAtmane
shlokas.36:
vakrAnuvakrau balinau meShavaktrau balotkaTau |
dadau tvaShTA mahAmAyau skandAyAnucharau varau
shlokas.37:
suvrataM satyasandhaM cha dadau mitro mahAtmane |
kumArAya mahAtmAnau tapovidyAdharau prabhuH
shlokas.38:
sudarshanIyau varadau triShu lokeShu vishrutau |
suprabhaM cha mahAtmAnaM shubhakarmANameva cha
kArttikeyAya samprAdAdvidhAtA lokavishrutau
shlokas.39:
pAlitakaM kAlikaM cha mahAmAyAvinAvubhau |
pUShA cha pArShadau prAdAtkArttikeyAya bhArata
shlokas.40:
balaM chAtibalaM chaiva mahAvaktrau mahAbalau |
pradadau kArttikeyAya vAyurbharatasattama
shlokas.41:
ghasaM chAtighasaM chaiva timivaktrau mahAbalau |
pradadau kArttikeyAya varuNaH satyasa~NgaraH
shlokas.42:
suvarchasaM mahAtmAnaM tathaivApyativarchasam |
himavAnpradadau rAjanhutAshanasutAya vai
shlokas.43:
kA~nchanaM cha mahAtmAnaM meghamAlinameva cha |
dadAvanucharau meruragniputrAya bhArata
shlokas.44:
sthiraM chAtisthiraM chaiva merurevAparau dadau |
mahAtmane.agniputrAya mahAbalaparAkramau
shlokas.45:
uchChritaM chAtishRRi~NgaM cha mahApAShANayodhinau |
pradadAvagniputrAya vindhyaH pAriShadAvubhau
shlokas.46:
sa~NgrahaM vigrahaM chaiva samudro.api gadAdharau |
pradadAvagniputrAya mahApAriShadAvubhau
shlokas.47:
unmAdaM puShpadantaM cha sha~NkukarNaM tathaiva cha |
pradadAvagniputrAya pArvatI shubhadarshanA
shlokas.48:
jayaM mahAjayaM chaiva nAgau jvalanasUnave |
pradadau puruShavyAghra vAsukiH pannageshvaraH
shlokas.49:
evaM sAdhyAshcha rudrAshcha vasavaH pitarastathA |
sAgarAH saritashchaiva girayashcha mahAbalAH
shlokas.50:
daduH senAgaNAdhyakShA~nshUlapaTTishadhAriNaH |
divyapraharaNopetAnnAnAveShavibhUShitAn
shlokas.51:
shRRiNu nAmAni chAnyeShAM ye.anye skandasya sainikAH |
vividhAyudhasampannAshchitrAbharaNavarmiNaH
shlokas.52:
sha~NkukarNo nikumbhashcha padmaH kumuda eva cha |
ananto dvAdashabhujastathA kRRiShNopakRRiShNakau
shlokas.53:
droNashravAH kapiskandhaH kA~nchanAkSho jalandhamaH |
akShasantarjano rAjankunadIkastamobhrakRRit
shlokas.54:
ekAkSho dvAdashAkShashcha tathaivaikajaTaH prabhuH |
sahasrabAhurvikaTo vyAghrAkShaH kShitikampanaH
shlokas.55:
puNyanAmA sunAmA cha suvaktraH priyadarshanaH |
parishrutaH kokanadaH priyamAlyAnulepanaH
shlokas.56:
ajodaro gajashirAH skandhAkShaH shatalochanaH |
jvAlAjihvaH karAlashcha sitakesho jaTI hariH
shlokas.57:
chaturdaMShTro.aShTajihvashcha meghanAdaH pRRithushravAH |
vidyudakSho dhanurvaktro jaTharo mArutAshanaH
shlokas.58:
udarAkSho jhaShAkShashcha vajranAbho vasuprabhaH |
samudravego rAjendra shailakampI tathaiva cha
shlokas.59:
putrameShaH pravAhashcha tathA nandopanandakau |
dhUmraH shvetaH kali~Ngashcha siddhArtho varadastathA
shlokas.60:
priyakashchaiva nandashcha gonandashcha pratApavAn |
Anandashcha pramodashcha svastiko dhruvakastathA
shlokas.61:
kShemavApaH sujAtashcha siddhayAtrashcha bhArata |
govrajaH kanakApIDo mahApAriShadeshvaraH
shlokas.62:
gAyano hasanashchaiva bANaH khaDgashcha vIryavAn |
vaitAlI chAtitAlI cha tathA katikavAtikau
shlokas.63:
ha.nsajaH pa~NkadigdhA~NgaH samudronmAdanashcha ha |
raNotkaTaH prahAsashcha shvetashIrShashcha nandakaH
shlokas.64:
kAlakaNThaH prabhAsashcha tathA kumbhANDako.aparaH |
kAlakAkShaH sitashchaiva bhUtalonmathanastathA
shlokas.65:
yaj~navAhaH pravAhashcha devayAjI cha somapaH |
sajAlashcha mahAtejAH krathakrAthau cha bhArata
shlokas.66:
tuhanashcha tuhAnashcha chitradevashcha vIryavAn |
madhuraH suprasAdashcha kirITI cha mahAbalaH
shlokas.67:
vasano madhuvarNashcha kalashodara eva cha |
dhamanto manmathakaraH sUchIvaktrashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.68:
shvetavaktraH suvaktrashcha chAruvaktrashcha pANDuraH |
daNDabAhuH subAhushcha rajaH kokilakastathA
shlokas.69:
achalaH kanakAkShashcha bAlAnAmayikaH prabhuH |
sa~nchArakaH kokanado gRRidhravaktrashcha jambukaH
shlokas.70:
lohAshavaktro jaTharaH kumbhavaktrashcha kuNDakaH |
madgugrIvashcha kRRiShNaujA ha.nsavaktrashcha chandrabhAH
shlokas.71:
pANikUrmA cha shambUkaH pa~nchavaktrashcha shikShakaH |
chAShavaktrashcha jambUkaH shAkavaktrashcha kuNDakaH
shlokas.72:
yogayuktA mahAtmAnaH satataM brAhmaNapriyAH |
paitAmahA mahAtmAno mahApAriShadAshcha ha
yauvanasthAshcha bAlAshcha vRRiddhAshcha janamejaya
shlokas.73:
sahasrashaH pAriShadAH kumAramupatasthire |
vaktrairnAnAvidhairye tu shRRiNu tA~njanamejaya
shlokas.76:
mArjArashashavaktrAshcha dIrghavaktrAshcha bhArata |
nakulolUkavaktrAshcha shvavaktrAshcha tathApare
shlokas.78:
RRikShashArdUlavaktrAshcha dvIpisiMhAnanAstathA |
bhImA gajAnanAshchaiva tathA nakramukhAH pare
shlokas.80:
mahAjaTharapAdA~NgAstArakAkShAshcha bhArata |
pArAvatamukhAshchAnye tathA vRRiShamukhAH pare
shlokas.83:
sthUlodarAH kRRishA~NgAshcha sthUlA~NgAshcha kRRishodarAH |
hrasvagrIvA mahAkarNA nAnAvyAlavibhUShitAH
shlokas.84:
gajendracharmavasanAstathA kRRiShNAjinAmbarAH |
skandhemukhA mahArAja tathA hyudaratomukhAH
shlokas.85:
pRRiShThemukhA hanumukhAstathA ja~NghAmukhA api |
pArshvAnanAshcha bahavo nAnAdeshamukhAstathA
shlokas.86:
tathA kITapata~NgAnAM sadRRishAsyA gaNeshvarAH |
nAnAvyAlamukhAshchAnye bahubAhushirodharAH
shlokas.88:
chIrasa.nvRRitagAtrAshcha tathA phalakavAsasaH |
nAnAveShadharAshchaiva charmavAsasa eva cha
shlokas.89:
uShNIShiNo mukuTinaH kambugrIvAH suvarchasaH |
kirITinaH pa~nchashikhAstathA kaThinamUrdhajAH
shlokas.90:
trishikhA dvishikhAshchaiva tathA saptashikhAH pare |
shikhaNDino mukuTino muNDAshcha jaTilAstathA
shlokas.92:
kRRiShNA nirmA.nsavaktrAshcha dIrghapRRiShThA nirUdarAH |
sthUlapRRiShThA hrasvapRRiShThAH pralambodaramehanAH
shlokas.93:
mahAbhujA hrasvabhujA hrasvagAtrAshcha vAmanAH |
kubjAshcha dIrghaja~NghAshcha hastikarNashirodharAH
shlokas.94:
hastinAsAH kUrmanAsA vRRikanAsAstathApare |
dIrghoShThA dIrghajihvAshcha vikarAlA hyadhomukhAH
shlokas.96:
suvibhaktasharIrAshcha dIptimantaH svala~NkRRitAH |
pi~NgAkShAH sha~NkukarNAshcha vakranAsAshcha bhArata
shlokas.97:
pRRithudaMShTrA mahAdaMShTrAH sthUlauShThA harimUrdhajAH |
nAnApAdauShThadaMShTrAshcha nAnAhastashirodharAH
nAnAvarmabhirAchChannA nAnAbhAShAshcha bhArata
shlokas.98:
kushalA deshabhAShAsu jalpanto.anyonyamIshvarAH |
hRRiShTAH paripatanti sma mahApAriShadAstathA
shlokas.99:
dIrghagrIvA dIrghanakhA dIrghapAdashirobhujAH |
pi~NgAkShA nIlakaNThAshcha lambakarNAshcha bhArata
shlokas.100:
vRRikodaranibhAshchaiva kechida~njanasaMnibhAH |
shvetA~NgA lohitagrIvAH pi~NgAkShAshcha tathApare
kalmAShA bahavo rAja.nshchitravarNAshcha bhArata
shlokas.102:
punaH praharaNAnyeShAM kIrtyamAnAni me shRRiNu |
sheShaiH kRRitaM pAriShadairAyudhAnAM parigraham
shlokas.103:
pAshodyatakarAH kechidvyAditAsyAH kharAnanAH |
pRRithvakShA nIlakaNThAshcha tathA parighabAhavaH
shlokas.104:
shataghnIchakrahastAshcha tathA musalapANayaH |
shUlAsihastAshcha tathA mahAkAyA mahAbalAH
shlokas.105:
gadAbhushuNDihastAshcha tathA tomarapANayaH |
asimudgarahastAshcha daNDahastAshcha bhArata
shlokas.107:
abhiShekaM kumArasya dRRiShTvA hRRiShTA raNapriyAH |
ghaNTAjAlapinaddhA~NgA nanRRituste mahaujasaH
shlokas.108:
ete chAnye cha bahavo mahApAriShadA nRRipa |
upatasthurmahAtmAnaM kArttikeyaM yashasvinam
shlokas.109:
divyAshchApyAntarikShAshcha pArthivAshchAnilopamAH |
vyAdiShTA daivataiH shUrAH skandasyAnucharAbhavan
shlokas.110:
tAdRRishAnAM sahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
abhiShiktaM mahAtmAnaM parivAryopatasthire

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shRRiNu mAtRRigaNAnrAjankumArAnucharAnimAn |
kIrtyamAnAnmayA vIra sapatnagaNasUdanAn
shlokas.2:
yashasvinInAM mAtR^INAM shRRiNu nAmAni bhArata |
yAbhirvyAptAstrayo lokAH kalyANIbhishcharAcharAH
shlokas.3:
prabhAvatI vishAlAkShI palitA gonasI tathA |
shrImatI bahulA chaiva tathaiva bahuputrikA
shlokas.4:
apsujAtA cha gopAlI bRRihadambAlikA tathA |
jayAvatI mAlatikA dhruvaratnA bhaya~NkarI
shlokas.5:
vasudAmA sudAmA cha vishokA nandinI tathA |
ekachUDA mahAchUDA chakranemishcha bhArata
shlokas.6:
uttejanI jayatsenA kamalAkShyatha shobhanA |
shatru~njayA tathA chaiva krodhanA shalabhI kharI
shlokas.7:
mAdhavI shubhavaktrA cha tIrthanemishcha bhArata |
gItapriyA cha kalyANI kadrulA chAmitAshanA
shlokas.8:
meghasvanA bhogavatI subhrUshcha kanakAvatI |
alAtAkShI vIryavatI vidyujjihvA cha bhArata
shlokas.9:
padmAvatI sunakShatrA kandarA bahuyojanA |
santAnikA cha kauravya kamalA cha mahAbalA
shlokas.10:
sudAmA bahudAmA cha suprabhA cha yashasvinI |
nRRityapriyA cha rAjendra shatolUkhalamekhalA
shlokas.11:
shataghaNTA shatAnandA bhaganandA cha bhAminI |
vapuShmatI chandrashItA bhadrakAlI cha bhArata
shlokas.12:
sa~NkArikA niShkuTikA bhramA chatvaravAsinI |
suma~NgalA svastimatI vRRiddhikAmA jayapriyA
shlokas.13:
dhanadA suprasAdA cha bhavadA cha jaleshvarI |
eDI bheDI sameDI cha vetAlajananI tathA
kaNDUtiH kAlikA chaiva devamitrA cha bhArata
shlokas.14:
lambasI ketakI chaiva chitrasenA tathA balA |
kukkuTikA sha~NkhanikA tathA jarjarikA nRRipa
shlokas.15:
kuNDArikA kokalikA kaNDarA cha shatodarI |
utkrAthinI jareNA cha mahAvegA cha ka~NkaNA
shlokas.16:
manojavA kaNTakinI praghasA pUtanA tathA |
khashayA churvyuTirvAmA kroshanAtha taDitprabhA
shlokas.17:
maNDodarI cha tuNDA cha koTarA meghavAsinI |
subhagA lambinI lambA vasuchUDA vikatthanI
shlokas.18:
UrdhvaveNIdharA chaiva pi~NgAkShI lohamekhalA |
pRRithuvaktrA madhurikA madhukumbhA tathaiva cha
shlokas.19:
pakShAlikA manthanikA jarAyurjarjarAnanA |
khyAtA dahadahA chaiva tathA dhamadhamA nRRipa
shlokas.20:
khaNDakhaNDA cha rAjendra pUShaNA maNikuNDalA |
amochA chaiva kauravya tathA lambapayodharA
shlokas.21:
veNuvINAdharA chaiva pi~NgAkShI lohamekhalA |
shasholUkamukhI kRRiShNA kharaja~NghA mahAjavA
shlokas.22:
shishumAramukhI shvetA lohitAkShI vibhIShaNA |
jaTAlikA kAmacharI dIrghajihvA balotkaTA
shlokas.23:
kAleDikA vAmanikA mukuTA chaiva bhArata |
lohitAkShI mahAkAyA haripiNDI cha bhUmipa
shlokas.24:
ekAkSharA sukusumA kRRiShNakarNI cha bhArata |
kShurakarNI chatuShkarNI karNaprAvaraNA tathA
shlokas.25:
chatuShpathaniketA cha gokarNI mahiShAnanA |
kharakarNI mahAkarNI bherIsvanamahAsvanA
shlokas.26:
sha~NkhakumbhasvanA chaiva bha~NgadA cha mahAbalA |
gaNA cha sugaNA chaiva tathAbhItyatha kAmadA
shlokas.27:
chatuShpatharatA chaiva bhUtitIrthAnyagocharA |
pashudA vittadA chaiva sukhadA cha mahAyashAH
payodA gomahiShadA suviShANA cha bhArata
shlokas.28:
pratiShThA supratiShThA cha rochamAnA surochanA |
gokarNI cha sukarNI cha sasirA stherikA tathA
ekachakrA megharavA meghamAlA virochanA
shlokas.29:
etAshchAnyAshcha bahavo mAtaro bharatarShabha |
kArttikeyAnuyAyinyo nAnArUpAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.30:
dIrghanakhyo dIrghadantyo dIrghatuNDyashcha bhArata |
saralA madhurAshchaiva yauvanasthAH svala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.31:
mAhAtmyena cha sa.nyuktAH kAmarUpadharAstathA |
nirmA.nsagAtryaH shvetAshcha tathA kA~nchanasaMnibhAH
shlokas.32:
kRRiShNameghanibhAshchAnyA dhUmrAshcha bharatarShabha |
aruNAbhA mahAbhAgA dIrghakeshyaH sitAmbarAH
shlokas.33:
UrdhvaveNIdharAshchaiva pi~NgAkShyo lambamekhalAH |
lambodaryo lambakarNAstathA lambapayodharAH
shlokas.34:
tAmrAkShyastAmravarNAshcha haryakShyashcha tathAparAH |
varadAH kAmachAriNyo nityapramuditAstathA
shlokas.35:
yAmyo raudryastathA saumyAH kauberyo.atha mahAbalAH |
vAruNyo.atha cha mAhendryastathAgneyyaH parantapa
shlokas.36:
vAyavyashchAtha kaumAryo brAhmyashcha bharatarShabha |
rUpeNApsarasAM tulyA jave vAyusamAstathA
shlokas.37:
parapuShTopamA vAkye tatharddhyA dhanadopamAH |
shakravIryopamAshchaiva dIptyA vahnisamAstathA
shlokas.38:
vRRikShachatvaravAsinyashchatuShpathaniketanAH |
guhAshmashAnavAsinyaH shailaprasravaNAlayAH
shlokas.39:
nAnAbharaNadhAriNyo nAnAmAlyAmbarAstathA |
nAnAvichitraveShAshcha nAnAbhAShAstathaiva cha
shlokas.40:
ete chAnye cha bahavo gaNAH shatrubhaya~NkarAH |
anujagmurmahAtmAnaM tridashendrasya saMmate
shlokas.41:
tataH shaktyastramadadadbhagavAnpAkashAsanaH |
guhAya rAjashArdUla vinAshAya suradviShAm
shlokas.42:
mahAsvanAM mahAghaNTAM dyotamAnAM sitaprabhAm |
taruNAdityavarNAM cha patAkAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.43:
dadau pashupatistasmai sarvabhUtamahAchamUm |
ugrAM nAnApraharaNAM tapovIryabalAnvitAm
shlokas.44:
viShNurdadau vaijayantIM mAlAM balavivardhinIm |
umA dadau chArajasI vAsasI sUryasaprabhe
shlokas.45:
ga~NgA kamaNDaluM divyamamRRitodbhavamuttamam |
dadau prItyA kumArAya daNDaM chaiva bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.46:
garuDo dayitaM putraM mayUraM chitrabarhiNam |
aruNastAmrachUDaM cha pradadau charaNAyudham
shlokas.47:
pAshaM tu varuNo rAjA balavIryasamanvitam |
kRRiShNAjinaM tathA brahmA brahmaNyAya dadau prabhuH
samareShu jayaM chaiva pradadau lokabhAvanaH
shlokas.48:
senApatyamanuprApya skando devagaNasya ha |
shushubhe jvalito.archiShmAndvitIya iva pAvakaH
tataH pAriShadaishchaiva mAtRRibhishcha samanvitaH
shlokas.49:
sA senA nairRRitI bhImA saghaNTochChritaketanA |
sabherIsha~NkhamurajA sAyudhA sapatAkinI
shAradI dyaurivAbhAti jyotirbhirupashobhitA
shlokas.50:
tato devanikAyAste bhUtasenAgaNAstathA |
vAdayAmAsuravyagrA bherIsha~NkhA.nshcha puShkalAn
shlokas.51:
paTahA~njharjharA.nshchaiva kRRikachAngoviShANikAn |
ADambarAngomukhA.nshcha DiNDimA.nshcha mahAsvanAn
shlokas.52:
tuShTuvuste kumAraM cha sarve devAH savAsavAH |
jagushcha devagandharvA nanRRitushchApsarogaNAH
shlokas.53:
tataH prIto mahAsenastridashebhyo varaM dadau |
ripUnhantAsmi samare ye vo vadhachikIrShavaH
shlokas.54:
pratigRRihya varaM devAstasmAdvibudhasattamAt |
prItAtmAno mahAtmAno menire nihatAnripUn
shlokas.55:
sarveShAM bhUtasa~NghAnAM harShAnnAdaH samutthitaH |
apUrayata lokA.nstrInvare datte mahAtmanA
shlokas.56:
sa niryayau mahAseno mahatyA senayA vRRitaH |
vadhAya yudhi daityAnAM rakShArthaM cha divaukasAm
shlokas.57:
vyavasAyo jayo dharmaH siddhirlakShmIrdhRRitiH smRRitiH |
mahAsenasya sainyAnAmagre jagmurnarAdhipa
shlokas.58:
sa tayA bhImayA devaH shUlamudgarahastayA |
gadAmusalanArAchashaktitomarahastayA
dRRiptasiMhaninAdinyA vinadya prayayau guhaH
shlokas.59:
taM dRRiShTvA sarvadaiteyA rAkShasA dAnavAstathA |
vyadravanta dishaH sarvA bhayodvignAH samantataH
abhyadravanta devAstAnvividhAyudhapANayaH
shlokas.60:
dRRiShTvA cha sa tataH kruddhaH skandastejobalAnvitaH |
shaktyastraM bhagavAnbhImaM punaH punaravAsRRijat
AdadhachchAtmanastejo haviSheddha ivAnalaH
shlokas.61:
abhyasyamAne shaktyastre skandenAmitatejasA |
ulkAjvAlA mahArAja papAta vasudhAtale
shlokas.62:
saMhrAdayantashcha tathA nirghAtAshchApatankShitau |
yathAntakAlasamaye sughorAH syustathA nRRipa
shlokas.63:
kShiptA hyekA tathA shaktiH sughorAnalasUnunA |
tataH koTyo viniShpetuH shaktInAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.64:
sa shaktyastreNa sa~NgrAme jaghAna bhagavAnprabhuH |
daityendraM tArakaM nAma mahAbalaparAkramam
vRRitaM daityAyutairvIrairbalibhirdashabhirnRRipa
shlokas.65:
mahiShaM chAShTabhiH padmairvRRitaM sa~Nkhye nijaghnivAn |
tripAdaM chAyutashatairjaghAna dashabhirvRRitam
shlokas.66:
hradodaraM nikharvaishcha vRRitaM dashabhirIshvaraH |
jaghAnAnucharaiH sArdhaM vividhAyudhapANibhiH
shlokas.67:
tatrAkurvanta vipulaM nAdaM vadhyatsu shatruShu |
kumArAnucharA rAjanpUrayanto disho dasha
shlokas.68:
shaktyastrasya tu rAjendra tato.archirbhiH samantataH |
dagdhAH sahasrasho daityA nAdaiH skandasya chApare
shlokas.69:
patAkayAvadhUtAshcha hatAH kechitsuradviShaH |
kechidghaNTAravatrastA nipeturvasudhAtale
kechitpraharaNaishChinnA vinipeturgatAsavaH
shlokas.70:
evaM suradviSho.anekAnbalavAnAtatAyinaH |
jaghAna samare vIraH kArttikeyo mahAbalaH
shlokas.71:
bANo nAmAtha daiteyo baleH putro mahAbalaH |
krau~nchaM parvatamAsAdya devasa~NghAnabAdhata
shlokas.72:
tamabhyayAnmahAsenaH surashatrumudAradhIH |
sa kArttikeyasya bhayAtkrau~nchaM sharaNameyivAn
shlokas.73:
tataH krau~nchaM mahAmanyuH krau~nchanAdaninAditam |
shaktyA bibheda bhagavAnkArttikeyo.agnidattayA
shlokas.76:
viniShpatadbhiH sharabhaiH siMhaishcha sahasA drutaiH |
shochyAmapi dashAM prApto rarAjaiva sa parvataH
shlokas.77:
vidyAdharAH samutpetustasya shRRi~NganivAsinaH |
kiMnarAshcha samudvignAH shaktipAtaravoddhatAH
shlokas.79:
tAnnijaghnuratikramya kumArAnucharA mRRidhe |
bibheda shaktyA krau~nchaM cha pAvakiH paravIrahA
shlokas.80:
bahudhA chaikadhA chaiva kRRitvAtmAnaM mahAtmanA |
shaktiH kShiptA raNe tasya pANimeti punaH punaH
shlokas.81:
evamprabhAvo bhagavAnato bhUyashcha pAvakiH |
krau~nchastena vinirbhinno daityAshcha shatasho hatAH
shlokas.82:
tataH sa bhagavAndevo nihatya vibudhadviShaH |
sabhAjyamAno vibudhaiH paraM harShamavApa ha
shlokas.83:
tato dundubhayo rAjanneduH sha~NkhAshcha bhArata |
mumuchurdevayoShAshcha puShpavarShamanuttamam
shlokas.84:
divyagandhamupAdAya vavau puNyashcha mArutaH |
gandharvAstuShTuvushchainaM yajvAnashcha maharShayaH
shlokas.85:
kechidenaM vyavasyanti pitAmahasutaM prabhum |
sanatkumAraM sarveShAM brahmayoniM tamagrajam
shlokas.86:
kechinmaheshvarasutaM kechitputraM vibhAvasoH |
umAyAH kRRittikAnAM cha ga~NgAyAshcha vadantyuta
shlokas.87:
ekadhA cha dvidhA chaiva chaturdhA cha mahAbalam |
yoginAmIshvaraM devaM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.88:
etatte kathitaM rAjankArttikeyAbhiShechanam |
shRRiNu chaiva sarasvatyAstIrthava.nshasya puNyatAm
shlokas.89:
babhUva tIrthapravaraM hateShu surashatruShu |
kumAreNa mahArAja triviShTapamivAparam
shlokas.90:
aishvaryANi cha tatrastho dadAvIshaH pRRithakpRRithak |
tadA nairRRitamukhyebhyastrailokye pAvakAtmajaH
shlokas.91:
evaM sa bhagavA.nstasmi.nstIrthe daityakulAntakaH |
abhiShikto mahArAja devasenApatiH suraiH
shlokas.92:
aujasaM nAma tattIrthaM yatra pUrvamapAM patiH |
abhiShiktaH suragaNairvaruNo bharatarShabha
shlokas.93:
tasmi.nstIrthavare snAtvA skandaM chAbhyarchya lA~NgalI |
brAhmaNebhyo dadau rukmaM vAsA.nsyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.94:
uShitvA rajanIM tatra mAdhavaH paravIrahA |
pUjya tIrthavaraM tachcha spRRiShTvA toyaM cha lA~NgalI
hRRiShTaH prItamanAshchaiva hyabhavanmAdhavottamaH
shlokas.95:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
yathAbhiShikto bhagavAnskando devaiH samAgataiH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
atyadbhutamidaM brahma~nshrutavAnasmi tattvataH |
abhiShekaM kumArasya vistareNa yathAvidhi
shlokas.2:
yachChrutvA pUtamAtmAnaM vijAnAmi tapodhana |
prahRRiShTAni cha romANi prasannaM cha mano mama
shlokas.3:
abhiShekaM kumArasya daityAnAM cha vadhaM tathA |
shrutvA me paramA prItirbhUyaH kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.4:
apAM patiH kathaM hyasminnabhiShiktaH surAsuraiH |
tanme brUhi mahAprAj~na kushalo hyasi sattama
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannidaM chitraM pUrvakalpe yathAtatham |
Adau kRRitayuge tasminvartamAne yathAvidhi
varuNaM devatAH sarvAH sametyedamathAbruvan
shlokas.6:
yathAsmAnsurarATshakro bhayebhyaH pAti sarvadA |
tathA tvamapi sarvAsAM saritAM vai patirbhava
shlokas.7:
vAsashcha te sadA deva sAgare makarAlaye |
samudro.ayaM tava vashe bhaviShyati nadIpatiH
shlokas.8:
somena sArdhaM cha tava hAnivRRiddhI bhaviShyataH |
evamastviti tAndevAnvaruNo vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.9:
samAgamya tataH sarve varuNaM sAgarAlayam |
apAM patiM prachakrurhi vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.10:
abhiShichya tato devA varuNaM yAdasAM patim |
jagmuH svAnyeva sthAnAni pUjayitvA jaleshvaram
shlokas.11:
abhiShiktastato devairvaruNo.api mahAyashAH |
saritaH sAgarA.nshchaiva nadA.nshchaiva sarA.nsi cha
pAlayAmAsa vidhinA yathA devA~nshatakratuH
shlokas.12:
tatastatrApyupaspRRishya dattvA cha vividhaM vasu |
agnitIrthaM mahAprAj~naH sa jagAma pralambahA
naShTo na dRRishyate yatra shamIgarbhe hutAshanaH
shlokas.13:
lokAlokavinAshe cha prAdurbhUte tadAnagha |
upatasthurmahAtmAnaM sarvalokapitAmaham
shlokas.14:
agniH pranaShTo bhagavAnkAraNaM cha na vidmahe |
sarvalokakShayo mA bhUtsampAdayatu no.analam
shlokas.15:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kimarthaM bhagavAnagniH pranaShTo lokabhAvanaH |
vij~nAtashcha kathaM devaistanmamAchakShva tattvataH
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhRRigoH shApAdbhRRishaM bhIto jAtavedAH pratApavAn |
shamIgarbhamathAsAdya nanAsha bhagavA.nstataH
shlokas.17:
pranaShTe tu tadA vahnau devAH sarve savAsavAH |
anveShanta tadA naShTaM jvalanaM bhRRishaduHkhitAH
shlokas.18:
tato.agnitIrthamAsAdya shamIgarbhasthameva hi |
dadRRishurjvalanaM tatra vasamAnaM yathAvidhi
shlokas.19:
devAH sarve naravyAghra bRRihaspatipurogamAH |
jvalanaM taM samAsAdya prItAbhUvansavAsavAH
punaryathAgataM jagmuH sarvabhakShashcha so.abhavat
shlokas.20:
bhRRigoH shApAnmahIpAla yaduktaM brahmavAdinA |
tatrApyAplutya matimAnbrahmayoniM jagAma ha
shlokas.21:
sasarja bhagavAnyatra sarvalokapitAmahaH |
tatrAplutya tato brahmA saha devaiH prabhuH purA
sasarja chAnnAni tathA devatAnAM yathAvidhi
shlokas.22:
tatra snAtvA cha dattvA cha vasUni vividhAni cha |
kauberaM prayayau tIrthaM tatra taptvA mahattapaH
dhanAdhipatyaM samprApto rAjannailabilaH prabhuH
shlokas.23:
tatrasthameva taM rAjandhanAni nidhayastathA |
upatasthurnarashreShTha tattIrthaM lA~NgalI tataH
gatvA snAtvA cha vidhivadbrAhmaNebhyo dhanaM dadau
shlokas.24:
dadRRishe tatra tatsthAnaM kaubere kAnanottame |
purA yatra tapastaptaM vipulaM sumahAtmanA
shlokas.25:
yatra rAj~nA kubereNa varA labdhAshcha puShkalAH |
dhanAdhipatyaM sakhyaM cha rudreNAmitatejasA
shlokas.26:
suratvaM lokapAlatvaM putraM cha nalakUbaram |
yatra lebhe mahAbAho dhanAdhipatira~njasA
shlokas.27:
abhiShiktashcha tatraiva samAgamya marudgaNaiH |
vAhanaM chAsya taddattaM ha.nsayuktaM manoramam
vimAnaM puShpakaM divyaM nairRRitaishvaryameva cha
shlokas.28:
tatrAplutya balo rAjandattvA dAyA.nshcha puShkalAn |
jagAma tvarito rAmastIrthaM shvetAnulepanaH
shlokas.29:
niShevitaM sarvasattvairnAmnA badarapAchanam |
nAnartukavanopetaM sadApuShpaphalaM shubham

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastIrthavaraM rAmo yayau badarapAchanam |
tapasvisiddhacharitaM yatra kanyA dhRRitavratA
shlokas.2:
bharadvAjasya duhitA rUpeNApratimA bhuvi |
sruchAvatI nAma vibho kumArI brahmachAriNI
shlokas.3:
tapashchachAra sAtyugraM niyamairbahubhirnRRipa |
bhartA me devarAjaH syAditi nishchitya bhAminI
shlokas.4:
samAstasyA vyatikrAntA bahvyaH kurukulodvaha |
charantyA niyamA.nstA.nstAnstrIbhistIvrAnsudushcharAn
shlokas.5:
tasyAstu tena vRRittena tapasA cha vishAM pate |
bhaktyA cha bhagavAnprItaH parayA pAkashAsanaH
shlokas.6:
AjagAmAshramaM tasyAstridashAdhipatiH prabhuH |
AsthAya rUpaM viprarShervasiShThasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.7:
sA taM dRRiShTvogratapasaM vasiShThaM tapatAM varam |
AchArairmunibhirdRRiShTaiH pUjayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.8:
uvAcha niyamaj~nA cha kalyANI sA priya.nvadA |
bhagavanmunishArdUla kimAj~nApayasi prabho
shlokas.9:
sarvamadya yathAshakti tava dAsyAmi suvrata |
shakrabhaktyA tu te pANiM na dAsyAmi katha~nchana
shlokas.10:
vrataishcha niyamaishchaiva tapasA cha tapodhana |
shakrastoShayitavyo vai mayA tribhuvaneshvaraH
shlokas.11:
ityukto bhagavAndevaH smayanniva nirIkShya tAm |
uvAcha niyamaj~nAM tAM sAntvayanniva bhArata
shlokas.12:
ugraM tapashcharasi vai viditA me.asi suvrate |
yadarthamayamArambhastava kalyANi hRRidgataH
shlokas.13:
tachcha sarvaM yathAbhUtaM bhaviShyati varAnane |
tapasA labhyate sarvaM sarvaM tapasi tiShThati
shlokas.14:
yAni sthAnAni divyAni vibudhAnAM shubhAnane |
tapasA tAni prApyAni tapomUlaM mahatsukham
shlokas.15:
iha kRRitvA tapo ghoraM dehaM saMnyasya mAnavAH |
devatvaM yAnti kalyANi shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.16:
pachasvaitAni subhage badarANi shubhavrate |
pachetyuktvA sa bhagavA~njagAma balasUdanaH
shlokas.17:
Amantrya tAM tu kalyANIM tato japyaM jajApa saH |
avidUre tatastasmAdAshramAttIrtha uttame
indratIrthe mahArAja triShu lokeShu vishrute
shlokas.18:
tasyA jij~nAsanArthaM sa bhagavAnpAkashAsanaH |
badarANAmapachanaM chakAra vibudhAdhipaH
shlokas.19:
tataH sa prayatA rAjanvAgyatA vigataklamA |
tatparA shuchisa.nvItA pAvake samadhishrayat
apachadrAjashArdUla badarANi mahAvratA
shlokas.20:
tasyAH pachantyAH sumahAnkAlo.agAtpuruSharShabha |
na cha sma tAnyapachyanta dinaM cha kShayamabhyagAt
shlokas.21:
hutAshanena dagdhashcha yastasyAH kAShThasa~nchayaH |
akAShThamagniM sA dRRiShTvA svasharIramathAdahat
shlokas.22:
pAdau prakShipya sA pUrvaM pAvake chArudarshanA |
dagdhau dagdhau punaH pAdAvupAvartayatAnaghA
shlokas.23:
charaNau dahyamAnau cha nAchintayadaninditA |
duHkhaM kamalapatrAkShI maharSheH priyakAmyayA
shlokas.24:
atha tatkarma dRRiShTvAsyAH prItastribhuvaneshvaraH |
tataH sa.ndarshayAmAsa kanyAyai rUpamAtmanaH
shlokas.25:
uvAcha cha surashreShThastAM kanyAM sudRRiDhavratAm |
prIto.asmi te shubhe bhaktyA tapasA niyamena cha
shlokas.26:
tasmAdyo.abhimataH kAmaH sa te sampatsyate shubhe |
dehaM tyaktvA mahAbhAge tridive mayi vatsyasi
shlokas.27:
idaM cha te tIrthavaraM sthiraM loke bhaviShyati |
sarvapApApahaM subhru nAmnA badarapAchanam
vikhyAtaM triShu lokeShu brahmarShibhirabhiplutam
shlokas.28:
asminkhalu mahAbhAge shubhe tIrthavare purA |
tyaktvA saptarShayo jagmurhimavantamarundhatIm
shlokas.29:
tataste vai mahAbhAgA gatvA tatra susa.nshitAH |
vRRittyarthaM phalamUlAni samAhartuM yayuH kila
shlokas.30:
teShAM vRRittyarthinAM tatra vasatAM himavadvane |
anAvRRiShTiranuprAptA tadA dvAdashavArShikI
shlokas.31:
te kRRitvA chAshramaM tatra nyavasanta tapasvinaH |
arundhatyapi kalyANI taponityAbhavattadA
shlokas.32:
arundhatIM tato dRRiShTvA tIvraM niyamamAsthitAm |
athAgamattrinayanaH suprIto varadastadA
shlokas.33:
brAhmaM rUpaM tataH kRRitvA mahAdevo mahAyashAH |
tAmabhyetyAbravIddevo bhikShAmichChAmyahaM shubhe
shlokas.34:
pratyuvAcha tataH sA taM brAhmaNaM chArudarshanA |
kShINo.annasa~nchayo vipra badarANIha bhakShaya
tato.abravInmahAdevaH pachasvaitAni suvrate
shlokas.35:
ityuktA sApachattAni brAhmaNapriyakAmyayA |
adhishritya samiddhe.agnau badarANi yashasvinI
shlokas.36:
divyA manoramAH puNyAH kathAH shushrAva sA tadA |
atItA sA tvanAvRRiShTirghorA dvAdashavArShikI
shlokas.37:
anashnantyAH pachantyAshcha shRRiNvantyAshcha kathAH shubhAH |
ahaHsamaH sa tasyAstu kAlo.atItaH sudAruNaH
shlokas.38:
tataste munayaH prAptAH phalAnyAdAya parvatAt |
tataH sa bhagavAnprItaH provAchArundhatIM tadA
shlokas.39:
upasarpasva dharmaj~ne yathApUrvamimAnRRiShIn |
prIto.asmi tava dharmaj~ne tapasA niyamena cha
shlokas.40:
tataH sa.ndarshayAmAsa svarUpaM bhagavAnharaH |
tato.abravIttadA tebhyastasyAstachcharitaM mahat
shlokas.41:
bhavadbhirhimavatpRRiShThe yattapaH samupArjitam |
asyAshcha yattapo viprA na samaM tanmataM mama
shlokas.42:
anayA hi tapasvinyA tapastaptaM sudushcharam |
anashnantyA pachantyA cha samA dvAdasha pAritAH
shlokas.43:
tataH provAcha bhagavA.nstAmevArundhatIM punaH |
varaM vRRiNIShva kalyANi yatte.abhilaShitaM hRRidi
shlokas.44:
sAbravItpRRithutAmrAkShI devaM saptarShisa.nsadi |
bhagavAnyadi me prItastIrthaM syAdidamuttamam
siddhadevarShidayitaM nAmnA badarapAchanam
shlokas.45:
tathAsmindevadevesha trirAtramuShitaH shuchiH |
prApnuyAdupavAsena phalaM dvAdashavArShikam
evamastviti tAM choktvA haro yAtastadA divam
shlokas.46:
RRiShayo vismayaM jagmustAM dRRiShTvA chApyarundhatIm |
ashrAntAM chAvivarNAM cha kShutpipAsAsahAM satIm
shlokas.47:
evaM siddhiH parA prAptA arundhatyA vishuddhayA |
yathA tvayA mahAbhAge madarthaM sa.nshitavrate
shlokas.48:
visheSho hi tvayA bhadre vrate hyasminsamarpitaH |
tathA chedaM dadAmyadya niyamena sutoShitaH
shlokas.49:
visheShaM tava kalyANi prayachChAmi varaM vare |
arundhatyA varastasyA yo datto vai mahAtmanA
shlokas.50:
tasya chAhaM prasAdena tava kalyANi tejasA |
pravakShyAmyaparaM bhUyo varamatra yathAvidhi
shlokas.51:
yastvekAM rajanIM tIrthe vatsyate susamAhitaH |
sa snAtvA prApsyate lokAndehanyAsAchcha durlabhAn
shlokas.52:
ityuktvA bhagavAndevaH sahasrAkShaH pratApavAn |
sruchAvatIM tataH puNyAM jagAma tridivaM punaH
shlokas.53:
gate vajradhare rAja.nstatra varShaM papAta ha |
puShpANAM bharatashreShTha divyAnAM divyagandhinAm
shlokas.54:
nedurdundubhayashchApi samantAtsumahAsvanAH |
mArutashcha vavau yuktyA puNyagandho vishAM pate
shlokas.55:
utsRRijya tu shubhaM dehaM jagAmendrasya bhAryatAm |
tapasogreNa sA labdhvA tena reme sahAchyuta
shlokas.56:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kA tasyA bhagavanmAtA kva sa.nvRRiddhA cha shobhanA |
shrotumichChAmyahaM brahmanparaM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.57:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bhAradvAjasya viprarSheH skannaM reto mahAtmanaH |
dRRiShTvApsarasamAyAntIM ghRRitAchIM pRRithulochanAm
shlokas.58:
sa tu jagrAha tadretaH kareNa japatAM varaH |
tadAvapatparNapuTe tatra sA sambhavachChubhA
shlokas.59:
tasyAstu jAtakarmAdi kRRitvA sarvaM tapodhanaH |
nAma chAsyAH sa kRRitavAnbhAradvAjo mahAmuniH
shlokas.60:
sruchAvatIti dharmAtmA tadarShigaNasa.nsadi |
sa cha tAmAshrame nyasya jagAma himavadvanam
shlokas.61:
tatrApyupaspRRishya mahAnubhAvo; vasUni dattvA cha mahAdvijebhyaH |
jagAma tIrthaM susamAhitAtmA; shakrasya vRRiShNipravarastadAnIm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
indratIrthaM tato gatvA yadUnAM pravaro balI |
viprebhyo dhanaratnAni dadau snAtvA yathAvidhi
shlokas.2:
tatra hyamararAjo.asAvIje kratushatena ha |
bRRihaspateshcha deveshaH pradadau vipulaM dhanam
shlokas.3:
nirargalAnsajArUthyAnsarvAnvividhadakShiNAn |
AjahAra kratU.nstatra yathoktAnvedapAragaiH
shlokas.4:
tAnkratUnbharatashreShTha shatakRRitvo mahAdyutiH |
pUrayAmAsa vidhivattataH khyAtaH shatakratuH
shlokas.5:
tasya nAmnA cha tattIrthaM shivaM puNyaM sanAtanam |
indratIrthamiti khyAtaM sarvapApapramochanam
shlokas.6:
upaspRRishya cha tatrApi vidhivanmusalAyudhaH |
brAhmaNAnpUjayitvA cha pAnAchChAdanabhojanaiH
shubhaM tIrthavaraM tasmAdrAmatIrthaM jagAma ha
shlokas.7:
yatra rAmo mahAbhAgo bhArgavaH sumahAtapAH |
asakRRitpRRithivIM sarvAM hatakShatriyapu~NgavAm
shlokas.8:
upAdhyAyaM puraskRRitya kashyapaM munisattamam |
ayajadvAjapeyena so.ashvamedhashatena cha
pradadau dakShiNArthaM cha pRRithivIM vai sasAgarAm
shlokas.9:
rAmo dattvA dhanaM tatra dvijebhyo janamejaya |
upaspRRishya yathAnyAyaM pUjayitvA tathA dvijAn
shlokas.10:
puNye tIrthe shubhe deshe vasu dattvA shubhAnanaH |
munI.nshchaivAbhivAdyAtha yamunAtIrthamAgamat
shlokas.11:
yatrAnayAmAsa tadA rAjasUyaM mahIpate |
putro.aditermahAbhAgo varuNo vai sitaprabhaH
shlokas.12:
tatra nirjitya sa~NgrAme mAnuShAndaivatA.nstathA |
varaM kratuM samAjahre varuNaH paravIrahA
shlokas.13:
tasminkratuvare vRRitte sa~NgrAmaH samajAyata |
devAnAM dAnavAnAM cha trailokyasya kShayAvahaH
shlokas.14:
rAjasUye kratushreShThe nivRRitte janamejaya |
jAyate sumahAghoraH sa~NgrAmaH kShatriyAnprati
shlokas.15:
sIrAyudhastadA rAmastasmi.nstIrthavare tadA |
tatra snAtvA cha dattvA cha dvijebhyo vasu mAdhavaH
shlokas.16:
vanamAlI tato hRRiShTaH stUyamAno dvijAtibhiH |
tasmAdAdityatIrthaM cha jagAma kamalekShaNaH
shlokas.17:
yatreShTvA bhagavA~njyotirbhAskaro rAjasattama |
jyotiShAmAdhipatyaM cha prabhAvaM chAbhyapadyata
shlokas.18:
tasyA nadyAstu tIre vai sarve devAH savAsavAH |
vishvedevAH samaruto gandharvApsarasashcha ha
shlokas.19:
dvaipAyanaH shukashchaiva kRRiShNashcha madhusUdanaH |
yakShAshcha rAkShasAshchaiva pishAchAshcha vishAM pate
shlokas.20:
ete chAnye cha bahavo yogasiddhAH sahasrashaH |
tasmi.nstIrthe sarasvatyAH shive puNye parantapa
shlokas.21:
tatra hatvA purA viShNurasurau madhukaiTabhau |
Apluto bharatashreShTha tIrthapravara uttame
shlokas.22:
dvaipAyanashcha dharmAtmA tatraivAplutya bhArata |
samprAptaH paramaM yogaM siddhiM cha paramAM gataH
shlokas.23:
asito devalashchaiva tasminneva mahAtapAH |
paramaM yogamAsthAya RRiShiryogamavAptavAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminneva tu dharmAtmA vasati sma tapodhanaH |
gArhasthyaM dharmamAsthAya asito devalaH purA
shlokas.2:
dharmanityaH shuchirdAnto nyastadaNDo mahAtapAH |
karmaNA manasA vAchA samaH sarveShu jantuShu
shlokas.3:
akrodhano mahArAja tulyanindApriyApriyaH |
kA~nchane loShTake chaiva samadarshI mahAtapAH
shlokas.4:
devatAH pUjayannityamatithI.nshcha dvijaiH saha |
brahmacharyarato nityaM sadA dharmaparAyaNaH
shlokas.5:
tato.abhyetya mahArAja yogamAsthAya bhikShukaH |
jaigIShavyo munirdhImA.nstasmi.nstIrthe samAhitaH
shlokas.6:
devalasyAshrame rAjannyavasatsa mahAdyutiH |
yoganityo mahArAja siddhiM prApto mahAtapAH
shlokas.7:
taM tatra vasamAnaM tu jaigIShavyaM mahAmunim |
devalo darshayanneva naivAyu~njata dharmataH
shlokas.8:
evaM tayormahArAja dIrghakAlo vyatikramat |
jaigIShavyaM muniM chaiva na dadarshAtha devalaH
shlokas.9:
AhArakAle matimAnparivrADjanamejaya |
upAtiShThata dharmaj~no bhaikShakAle sa devalam
shlokas.10:
sa dRRiShTvA bhikShurUpeNa prAptaM tatra mahAmunim |
gauravaM paramaM chakre prItiM cha vipulAM tathA
shlokas.11:
devalastu yathAshakti pUjayAmAsa bhArata |
RRiShidRRiShTena vidhinA samA bahvyaH samAhitaH
shlokas.12:
kadAchittasya nRRipate devalasya mahAtmanaH |
chintA sumahatI jAtA muniM dRRiShTvA mahAdyutim
shlokas.13:
samAstu samatikrAntA bahvyaH pUjayato mama |
na chAyamalaso bhikShurabhyabhAShata ki~nchana
shlokas.14:
evaM vigaNayanneva sa jagAma mahodadhim |
antarikShacharaH shrImAnkalashaM gRRihya devalaH
shlokas.15:
gachChanneva sa dharmAtmA samudraM saritAM patim |
jaigIShavyaM tato.apashyadgataM prAgeva bhArata
shlokas.16:
tataH savismayashchintAM jagAmAthAsitaH prabhuH |
kathaM bhikShurayaM prAptaH samudre snAta eva cha
shlokas.17:
ityevaM chintayAmAsa maharShirasitastadA |
snAtvA samudre vidhivachChuchirjapyaM jajApa ha
shlokas.18:
kRRitajapyAhnikaH shrImAnAshramaM cha jagAma ha |
kalashaM jalapUrNaM vai gRRihItvA janamejaya
shlokas.19:
tataH sa pravishanneva svamAshramapadaM muniH |
AsInamAshrame tatra jaigIShavyamapashyata
shlokas.20:
na vyAharati chaivainaM jaigIShavyaH katha~nchana |
kAShThabhUto.a.ashramapade vasati sma mahAtapAH
shlokas.21:
taM dRRiShTvA chAplutaM toye sAgare sAgaropamam |
praviShTamAshramaM chApi pUrvameva dadarsha saH
shlokas.22:
asito devalo rAja.nshchintayAmAsa buddhimAn |
dRRiShTaH prabhAvaM tapaso jaigIShavyasya yogajam
shlokas.23:
chintayAmAsa rAjendra tadA sa munisattamaH |
mayA dRRiShTaH samudre cha Ashrame cha kathaM tvayam
shlokas.24:
evaM vigaNayanneva sa munirmantrapAragaH |
utpapAtAshramAttasmAdantarikShaM vishAM pate
jij~nAsArthaM tadA bhikShorjaigIShavyasya devalaH
shlokas.25:
so.antarikShacharAnsiddhAnsamapashyatsamAhitAn |
jaigIShavyaM cha taiH siddhaiH pUjyamAnamapashyata
shlokas.26:
tato.asitaH susa.nrabdho vyavasAyI dRRiDhavrataH |
apashyadvai divaM yAntaM jaigIShavyaM sa devalaH
shlokas.27:
tasmAchcha pitRRilokaM taM vrajantaM so.anvapashyata |
pitRRilokAchcha taM yAntaM yAmyaM lokamapashyata
shlokas.28:
tasmAdapi samutpatya somalokamabhiShTutam |
vrajantamanvapashyatsa jaigIShavyaM mahAmunim
shlokas.29:
lokAnsamutpatantaM cha shubhAnekAntayAjinAm |
tato.agnihotriNAM lokA.nstebhyashchApyutpapAta ha
shlokas.30:
darshaM cha paurNamAsaM cha ye yajanti tapodhanAH |
tebhyaH sa dadRRishe dhImA.NllokebhyaH pashuyAjinAm
vrajantaM lokamamalamapashyaddevapUjitam
shlokas.31:
chAturmAsyairbahuvidhairyajante ye tapodhanAH |
teShAM sthAnaM tathA yAntaM tathAgniShTomayAjinAm
shlokas.32:
agniShTutena cha tathA ye yajanti tapodhanAH |
tatsthAnamanusamprAptamanvapashyata devalaH
shlokas.33:
vAjapeyaM kratuvaraM tathA bahusuvarNakam |
Aharanti mahAprAj~nAsteShAM lokeShvapashyata
shlokas.34:
yajante puNDarIkeNa rAjasUyena chaiva ye |
teShAM lokeShvapashyachcha jaigIShavyaM sa devalaH
shlokas.35:
ashvamedhaM kratuvaraM naramedhaM tathaiva cha |
Aharanti narashreShThAsteShAM lokeShvapashyata
shlokas.36:
sarvamedhaM cha duShprApaM tathA sautrAmaNiM cha ye |
teShAM lokeShvapashyachcha jaigIShavyaM sa devalaH
shlokas.37:
dvAdashAhaishcha satrairye yajante vividhairnRRipa |
teShAM lokeShvapashyachcha jaigIShavyaM sa devalaH
shlokas.38:
mitrAvaruNayorlokAnAdityAnAM tathaiva cha |
salokatAmanuprAptamapashyata tato.asitaH
shlokas.39:
rudrANAM cha vasUnAM cha sthAnaM yachcha bRRihaspateH |
tAni sarvANyatItaM cha samapashyattato.asitaH
shlokas.40:
Aruhya cha gavAM lokaM prayAntaM brahmasatriNAm |
lokAnapashyadgachChantaM jaigIShavyaM tato.asitaH
shlokas.41:
trI.NllokAnaparAnvipramutpatantaM svatejasA |
pativratAnAM lokA.nshcha vrajantaM so.anvapashyata
shlokas.42:
tato munivaraM bhUyo jaigIShavyamathAsitaH |
nAnvapashyata yogasthamantarhitamari.ndama
shlokas.43:
so.achintayanmahAbhAgo jaigIShavyasya devalaH |
prabhAvaM suvratatvaM cha siddhiM yogasya chAtulAm
shlokas.44:
asito.apRRichChata tadA siddhA.NllokeShu sattamAn |
prayataH prA~njalirbhUtvA dhIrastAnbrahmasatriNaH
shlokas.45:
jaigIShavyaM na pashyAmi taM sha.nsata mahaujasam |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.46:
siddhA UchuH||
shRRiNu devala bhUtArthaM sha.nsatAM no dRRiDhavrata |
jaigIShavyo gato lokaM shAshvataM brahmaNo.avyayam
shlokas.47:
sa shrutvA vachanaM teShAM siddhAnAM brahmasatriNAm |
asito devalastUrNamutpapAta papAta cha
shlokas.48:
tataH siddhAsta Uchurhi devalaM punareva ha |
na devala gatistatra tava gantuM tapodhana
brahmaNaH sadanaM vipra jaigIShavyo yadAptavAn
shlokas.49:
teShAM tadvachanaM shrutvA siddhAnAM devalaH punaH |
AnupUrvyeNa lokA.nstAnsarvAnavatatAra ha
shlokas.50:
svamAshramapadaM puNyamAjagAma pata~Ngavat |
pravishanneva chApashyajjaigIShavyaM sa devalaH
shlokas.51:
tato buddhyA vyagaNayaddevalo dharmayuktayA |
dRRiShTvA prabhAvaM tapaso jaigIShavyasya yogajam
shlokas.52:
tato.abravInmahAtmAnaM jaigIShavyaM sa devalaH |
vinayAvanato rAjannupasarpya mahAmunim
mokShadharmaM samAsthAtumichCheyaM bhagavannaham
shlokas.53:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA upadeshaM chakAra saH |
vidhiM cha yogasya paraM kAryAkAryaM cha shAstrataH
shlokas.54:
saMnyAsakRRitabuddhiM taM tato dRRiShTvA mahAtapAH |
sarvAshchAsya kriyAshchakre vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.55:
saMnyAsakRRitabuddhiM taM bhUtAni pitRRibhiH saha |
tato dRRiShTvA praruruduH ko.asmAnsa.nvibhajiShyati
shlokas.56:
devalastu vachaH shrutvA bhUtAnAM karuNaM tathA |
disho dasha vyAharatAM mokShaM tyaktuM mano dadhe
shlokas.57:
tatastu phalamUlAni pavitrANi cha bhArata |
puShpANyoShadhayashchaiva rorUyante sahasrashaH
shlokas.58:
punarno devalaH kShudro nUnaM Chetsyati durmatiH |
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyo yo dattvA nAvabudhyate
shlokas.59:
tato bhUyo vyagaNayatsvabuddhyA munisattamaH |
mokShe gArhasthyadharme vA kiM nu shreyaskaraM bhavet
shlokas.60:
iti nishchitya manasA devalo rAjasattama |
tyaktvA gArhasthyadharmaM sa mokShadharmamarochayat
shlokas.61:
evamAdIni sa~nchintya devalo nishchayAttataH |
prAptavAnparamAM siddhiM paraM yogaM cha bhArata
shlokas.62:
tato devAH samAgamya bRRihaspatipurogamAH |
jaigIShavyaM tapashchAsya prasha.nsanti tapasvinaH
shlokas.63:
athAbravIdRRiShivaro devAnvai nAradastadA |
jaigIShavye tapo nAsti vismApayati yo.asitam
shlokas.64:
tameva.nvAdinaM dhIraM pratyUchuste divaukasaH |
maivamityeva sha.nsanto jaigIShavyaM mahAmunim
shlokas.65:
tatrApyupaspRRishya tato mahAtmA; dattvA cha vittaM halabhRRiddvijebhyaH |
avApya dharmaM paramAryakarmA; jagAma somasya mahatsa tIrtham

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yatrejivAnuDupatI rAjasUyena bhArata |
tasminvRRitte mahAnAsItsa~NgrAmastArakAmayaH
shlokas.2:
tatrApyupaspRRishya balo dattvA dAnAni chAtmavAn |
sArasvatasya dharmAtmA munestIrthaM jagAma ha
shlokas.3:
yatra dvAdashavArShikyAmanAvRRiShTyAM dvijottamAn |
vedAnadhyApayAmAsa purA sArasvato muniH
shlokas.4:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM dvAdashavArShikyAmanAvRRiShTyAM tapodhanaH |
vedAnadhyApayAmAsa purA sArasvato muniH
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
AsItpUrvaM mahArAja munirdhImAnmahAtapAH |
dadhIcha iti vikhyAto brahmachArI jitendriyaH
shlokas.6:
tasyAtitapasaH shakro bibheti satataM vibho |
na sa lobhayituM shakyaH phalairbahuvidhairapi
shlokas.7:
pralobhanArthaM tasyAtha prAhiNotpAkashAsanaH |
divyAmapsarasaM puNyAM darshanIyAmalambusAm
shlokas.8:
tasya tarpayato devAnsarasvatyAM mahAtmanaH |
samIpato mahArAja sopAtiShThata bhAminI
shlokas.9:
tAM divyavapuShaM dRRiShTvA tasyarSherbhAvitAtmanaH |
retaH skannaM sarasvatyAM tatsA jagrAha nimnagA
shlokas.10:
kukShau chApyadadhaddRRiShTvA tadretaH puruSharShabha |
sA dadhAra cha taM garbhaM putrahetormahAnadI
shlokas.11:
suShuve chApi samaye putraM sA saritAM varA |
jagAma putramAdAya tamRRiShiM prati cha prabho
shlokas.12:
RRiShisa.nsadi taM dRRiShTvA sA nadI munisattamam |
tataH provAcha rAjendra dadatI putramasya tam
brahmarShe tava putro.ayaM tvadbhaktyA dhArito mayA
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvA te.apsarasaM reto yatskannaM prAgalambusAm |
tatkukShiNA vai brahmarShe tvadbhaktyA dhRRitavatyaham
shlokas.14:
na vinAshamidaM gachChettvatteja iti nishchayAt |
pratigRRihNIShva putraM svaM mayA dattamaninditam
shlokas.15:
ityuktaH pratijagrAha prItiM chAvApa uttamAm |
mantravachchopajighrattaM mUrdhni premNA dvijottamaH
shlokas.16:
pariShvajya chiraM kAlaM tadA bharatasattama |
sarasvatyai varaM prAdAtprIyamANo mahAmuniH
shlokas.17:
vishve devAH sapitaro gandharvApsarasAM gaNAH |
tRRiptiM yAsyanti subhage tarpyamANAstavAmbhasA
shlokas.18:
ityuktvA sa tu tuShTAva vachobhirvai mahAnadIm |
prItaH paramahRRiShTAtmA yathAvachChRRiNu pArthiva
shlokas.19:
prasRRitAsi mahAbhAge saraso brahmaNaH purA |
jAnanti tvAM sarichChreShThe munayaH sa.nshitavratAH
shlokas.20:
mama priyakarI chApi satataM priyadarshane |
tasmAtsArasvataH putro mahA.nste varavarNini
shlokas.21:
tavaiva nAmnA prathitaH putraste lokabhAvanaH |
sArasvata iti khyAto bhaviShyati mahAtapAH
shlokas.22:
eSha dvAdashavArShikyAmanAvRRiShTyAM dvijarShabhAn |
sArasvato mahAbhAge vedAnadhyApayiShyati
shlokas.23:
puNyAbhyashcha saridbhyastvaM sadA puNyatamA shubhe |
bhaviShyasi mahAbhAge matprasAdAtsarasvati
shlokas.24:
evaM sA sa.nstutA tena varaM labdhvA mahAnadI |
putramAdAya muditA jagAma bharatarShabha
shlokas.25:
etasminneva kAle tu virodhe devadAnavaiH |
shakraH praharaNAnveShI lokA.nstrInvichachAra ha
shlokas.26:
na chopalebhe bhagavA~nshakraH praharaNaM tadA |
yadvai teShAM bhavedyogyaM vadhAya vibudhadviShAm
shlokas.27:
tato.abravItsurA~nshakro na me shakyA mahAsurAH |
RRite.asthibhirdadhIchasya nihantuM tridashadviShaH
shlokas.28:
tasmAdgatvA RRiShishreShTho yAchyatAM surasattamAH |
dadhIchAsthIni dehIti tairvadhiShyAmahe ripUn
shlokas.29:
sa devairyAchito.asthIni yatnAdRRiShivarastadA |
prANatyAgaM kuruShveti chakAraivAvichArayan
sa lokAnakShayAnprApto devapriyakarastadA
shlokas.30:
tasyAsthibhiratho shakraH samprahRRiShTamanAstadA |
kArayAmAsa divyAni nAnApraharaNAnyuta
vajrANi chakrANi gadA gurudaNDA.nshcha puShkalAn
shlokas.31:
sa hi tIvreNa tapasA sambhRRitaH paramarShiNA |
prajApatisutenAtha bhRRiguNA lokabhAvanaH
shlokas.32:
atikAyaH sa tejasvI lokasAravinirmitaH |
jaj~ne shailaguruH prA.nshurmahimnA prathitaH prabhuH
nityamudvijate chAsya tejasA pAkashAsanaH
shlokas.33:
tena vajreNa bhagavAnmantrayuktena bhArata |
bhRRishaM krodhavisRRiShTena brahmatejobhavena cha
daityadAnavavIrANAM jaghAna navatIrnava
shlokas.34:
atha kAle vyatikrAnte mahatyatibhaya~Nkare |
anAvRRiShTiranuprAptA rAjandvAdashavArShikI
shlokas.35:
tasyAM dvAdashavArShikyAmanAvRRiShTyAM maharShayaH |
vRRittyarthaM prAdravanrAjankShudhArtAH sarvatodisham
shlokas.36:
digbhyastAnpradrutAndRRiShTvA muniH sArasvatastadA |
gamanAya matiM chakre taM provAcha sarasvatI
shlokas.37:
na gantavyamitaH putra tavAhAramahaM sadA |
dAsyAmi matsyapravarAnuShyatAmiha bhArata
shlokas.38:
ityuktastarpayAmAsa sa pitR^IndevatAstathA |
AhAramakaronnityaM prANAnvedA.nshcha dhArayan
shlokas.39:
atha tasyAmatItAyAmanAvRRiShTyAM maharShayaH |
anyonyaM paripaprachChuH punaH svAdhyAyakAraNAt
shlokas.40:
teShAM kShudhAparItAnAM naShTA vedA vidhAvatAm |
sarveShAmeva rAjendra na kashchitpratibhAnavAn
shlokas.41:
atha kashchidRRiShisteShAM sArasvatamupeyivAn |
kurvANaM sa.nshitAtmAnaM svAdhyAyamRRiShisattamam
shlokas.42:
sa gatvAchaShTa tebhyashcha sArasvatamatiprabham |
svAdhyAyamamaraprakhyaM kurvANaM vijane jane
shlokas.43:
tataH sarve samAjagmustatra rAjanmaharShayaH |
sArasvataM munishreShThamidamUchuH samAgatAH
shlokas.44:
asmAnadhyApayasveti tAnuvAcha tato muniH |
shiShyatvamupagachChadhvaM vidhivadbho mametyuta
shlokas.45:
tato.abravIdRRiShigaNo bAlastvamasi putraka |
sa tAnAha na me dharmo nashyediti punarmunIn
shlokas.46:
yo hyadharmeNa vibrUyAdgRRihNIyAdvApyadharmataH |
mriyatAM tAvubhau kShipraM syAtAM vA vairiNAvubhau
shlokas.47:
na hAyanairna palitairna vittena na bandhubhiH |
RRiShayashchakrire dharmaM yo.anUchAnaH sa no mahAn
shlokas.48:
etachChrutvA vachastasya munayaste vidhAnataH |
tasmAdvedAnanuprApya punardharmaM prachakrire
shlokas.49:
ShaShTirmunisahasrANi shiShyatvaM pratipedire |
sArasvatasya viprarShervedasvAdhyAyakAraNAt
shlokas.50:
muShTiM muShTiM tataH sarve darbhANAM te.abhyupAharan |
tasyAsanArthaM viprarSherbAlasyApi vashe sthitAH
shlokas.51:
tatrApi dattvA vasu rauhiNeyo; mahAbalaH keshavapUrvajo.atha |
jagAma tIrthaM muditaH krameNa; khyAtaM mahadvRRiddhakanyA sma yatra

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM kumArI bhagava.nstapoyuktA hyabhUtpurA |
kimarthaM cha tapastepe ko vAsyA niyamo.abhavat
shlokas.2:
suduShkaramidaM brahma.nstvattaH shrutamanuttamam |
AkhyAhi tattvamakhilaM yathA tapasi sA sthitA
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
RRiShirAsInmahAvIryaH kuNirgArgyo mahAyashAH |
sa taptvA vipulaM rAja.nstapo vai tapatAM varaH
mAnasIM sa sutAM subhrUM samutpAditavAnvibhuH
shlokas.4:
tAM cha dRRiShTvA bhRRishaM prItaH kuNirgArgyo mahAyashAH |
jagAma tridivaM rAjansantyajyeha kalevaram
shlokas.5:
subhrUH sA hyatha kalyANI puNDarIkanibhekShaNA |
mahatA tapasogreNa kRRitvAshramamaninditA
shlokas.6:
upavAsaiH pUjayantI pitR^IndevA.nshcha sA purA |
tasyAstu tapasogreNa mahAnkAlo.atyagAnnRRipa
shlokas.7:
sA pitrA dIyamAnApi bhartre naichChadaninditA |
AtmanaH sadRRishaM sA tu bhartAraM nAnvapashyata
shlokas.8:
tataH sA tapasogreNa pIDayitvAtmanastanum |
pitRRidevArchanaratA babhUva vijane vane
shlokas.9:
sAtmAnaM manyamAnApi kRRitakRRityaM shramAnvitA |
vArddhakena cha rAjendra tapasA chaiva karshitA
shlokas.10:
sA nAshakadyadA gantuM padAtpadamapi svayam |
chakAra gamane buddhiM paralokAya vai tadA
shlokas.11:
moktukAmAM tu tAM dRRiShTvA sharIraM nArado.abravIt |
asa.nskRRitAyAH kanyAyAH kuto lokAstavAnaghe
shlokas.12:
evaM hi shrutamasmAbhirdevaloke mahAvrate |
tapaH paramakaM prAptaM na tu lokAstvayA jitAH
shlokas.13:
tannAradavachaH shrutvA sAbravIdRRiShisa.nsadi |
tapaso.ardhaM prayachChAmi pANigrAhasya sattamAH
shlokas.14:
ityukte chAsyA jagrAha pANiM gAlavasambhavaH |
RRiShiH prAkShRRi~NgavAnnAma samayaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.15:
samayena tavAdyAhaM pANiM sprakShyAmi shobhane |
yadyekarAtraM vastavyaM tvayA saha mayeti ha
shlokas.16:
tatheti sA pratishrutya tasmai pANiM dadau tadA |
chakre cha pANigrahaNaM tasyodvAhaM cha gAlaviH
shlokas.17:
sA rAtrAvabhavadrAja.nstaruNI devavarNinI |
divyAbharaNavastrA cha divyasraganulepanA
shlokas.18:
tAM dRRiShTvA gAlaviH prIto dIpayantImivAtmanA |
uvAsa cha kShapAmekAM prabhAte sAbravIchcha tam
shlokas.19:
yastvayA samayo vipra kRRito me tapatAM vara |
tenoShitAsmi bhadraM te svasti te.astu vrajAmyaham
shlokas.20:
sAnuj~nAtAbravIdbhUyo yo.asmi.nstIrthe samAhitaH |
vatsyate rajanImekAM tarpayitvA divaukasaH
shlokas.21:
chatvAri.nshatamaShTau cha dve chAShTau samyagAcharet |
yo brahmacharyaM varShANi phalaM tasya labheta saH
evamuktvA tataH sAdhvI dehaM tyaktvA divaM gatA
shlokas.22:
RRiShirapyabhavaddInastasyA rUpaM vichintayan |
samayena tapo.ardhaM cha kRRichChrAtpratigRRihItavAn
shlokas.23:
sAdhayitvA tadAtmAnaM tasyAH sa gatimanvayAt |
duHkhito bharatashreShTha tasyA rUpabalAtkRRitaH
etatte vRRiddhakanyAyA vyAkhyAtaM charitaM mahat
shlokas.24:
tatrasthashchApi shushrAva hataM shalyaM halAyudhaH |
tatrApi dattvA dAnAni dvijAtibhyaH parantapa
shushocha shalyaM sa~NgrAme nihataM pANDavaistadA
shlokas.25:
samantapa~nchakadvArAttato niShkramya mAdhavaH |
paprachCharShigaNAnrAmaH kurukShetrasya yatphalam
shlokas.26:
te pRRiShTA yadusiMhena kurukShetraphalaM vibho |
samAchakhyurmahAtmAnastasmai sarvaM yathAtatham

shlokas.1:
RRiShaya UchuH||
prajApateruttaravediruchyate; sanAtanA rAma samantapa~nchakam |
samIjire yatra purA divaukaso; vareNa satreNa mahAvarapradAH
shlokas.2:
purA cha rAjarShivareNa dhImatA; bahUni varShANyamitena tejasA |
prakRRiShTametatkuruNA mahAtmanA; tataH kurukShetramitIha paprathe
shlokas.3:
rAma uvAcha||
kimarthaM kuruNA kRRiShTaM kShetrametanmahAtmanA |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM kathyamAnaM tapodhanAH
shlokas.4:
RRiShaya UchuH||
purA kila kuruM rAma kRRiShantaM satatotthitam |
abhyetya shakrastridivAtparyapRRichChata kAraNam
shlokas.5:
kimidaM vartate rAjanprayatnena pareNa cha |
rAjarShe kimabhipretaM yeneyaM kRRiShyate kShitiH
shlokas.6:
kururuvAcha||
iha ye puruShAH kShetre mariShyanti shatakrato |
te gamiShyanti sukRRitA.NllokAnpApavivarjitAn
shlokas.7:
avahasya tataH shakro jagAma tridivaM prabhuH |
rAjarShirapyanirviNNaH karShatyeva vasundharAm
shlokas.8:
AgamyAgamya chaivainaM bhUyo bhUyo.avahasya cha |
shatakraturanirviNNaM pRRiShTvA pRRiShTvA jagAma ha
shlokas.9:
yadA tu tapasogreNa chakarSha vasudhAM nRRipaH |
tataH shakro.abravIddevAnrAjarSheryachchikIrShitam
shlokas.10:
tachChrutvA chAbruvandevAH sahasrAkShamidaM vachaH |
vareNa chChandyatAM shakra rAjarShiryadi shakyate
shlokas.11:
yadi hyatra pramItA vai svargaM gachChanti mAnavAH |
asmAnaniShTvA kratubhirbhAgo no na bhaviShyati
shlokas.12:
Agamya cha tataH shakrastadA rAjarShimabravIt |
alaM khedena bhavataH kriyatAM vachanaM mama
shlokas.13:
mAnavA ye nirAhArA dehaM tyakShyantyatandritAH |
yudhi vA nihatAH samyagapi tiryaggatA nRRipa
shlokas.14:
te svargabhAjo rAjendra bhavantviti mahAmate |
tathAstviti tato rAjA kuruH shakramuvAcha ha
shlokas.15:
tatastamabhyanuj~nApya prahRRiShTenAntarAtmanA |
jagAma tridivaM bhUyaH kShipraM balaniShUdanaH
shlokas.16:
evametadyadushreShTha kRRiShTaM rAjarShiNA purA |
shakreNa chApyanuj~nAtaM puNyaM prANAnvimu~nchatAm
shlokas.17:
api chAtra svayaM shakro jagau gAthAM surAdhipaH |
kurukShetre nibaddhAM vai tAM shRRiNuShva halAyudha
shlokas.18:
pA.nsavo.api kurukShetrAdvAyunA samudIritAH |
api duShkRRitakarmANaM nayanti paramAM gatim
shlokas.19:
surarShabhA brAhmaNasattamAshcha; tathA nRRigAdyA naradevamukhyAH |
iShTvA mahArhaiH kratubhirnRRisiMha; saMnyasya dehAnsugatiM prapannAH
shlokas.20:
tarantukArantukayoryadantaraM; rAmahradAnAM cha machakrukasya |
etatkurukShetrasamantapa~nchakaM; prajApateruttaravediruchyate
shlokas.21:
shivaM mahatpuNyamidaM divaukasAM; susaMmataM svargaguNaiH samanvitam |
atashcha sarve.api vasundharAdhipA; hatA gamiShyanti mahAtmanAM gatim

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kurukShetraM tato dRRiShTvA dattvA dAyA.nshcha sAtvataH |
AshramaM sumahaddivyamagamajjanamejaya
shlokas.2:
madhUkAmravanopetaM plakShanyagrodhasa~Nkulam |
chiribilvayutaM puNyaM panasArjunasa~Nkulam
shlokas.3:
taM dRRiShTvA yAdavashreShThaH pravaraM puNyalakShaNam |
paprachCha tAnRRiShInsarvAnkasyAshramavarastvayam
shlokas.4:
te tu sarve mahAtmAnamUchU rAjanhalAyudham |
shRRiNu vistarato rAma yasyAyaM pUrvamAshramaH
shlokas.5:
atra viShNuH purA devastaptavA.nstapa uttamam |
atrAsya vidhivadyaj~nAH sarve vRRittAH sanAtanAH
shlokas.6:
atraiva brAhmaNI siddhA kaumArabrahmachAriNI |
yogayuktA divaM yAtA tapaHsiddhA tapasvinI
shlokas.7:
babhUva shrImatI rAja~nshANDilyasya mahAtmanaH |
sutA dhRRitavratA sAdhvI niyatA brahmachAriNI
shlokas.8:
sA tu prApya paraM yogaM gatA svargamanuttamam |
bhuktvAshrame.ashvamedhasya phalaM phalavatAM shubhA
gatA svargaM mahAbhAgA pUjitA niyatAtmabhiH
shlokas.9:
abhigamyAshramaM puNyaM dRRiShTvA cha yadupu~NgavaH |
RRiShI.nstAnabhivAdyAtha pArshve himavato.achyutaH
skandhAvArANi sarvANi nivartyAruruhe.achalam
shlokas.10:
nAtidUraM tato gatvA nagaM tAladhvajo balI |
puNyaM tIrthavaraM dRRiShTvA vismayaM paramaM gataH
shlokas.11:
prabhavaM cha sarasvatyAH plakShaprasravaNaM balaH |
samprAptaH kArapachanaM tIrthapravaramuttamam
shlokas.12:
halAyudhastatra chApi dattvA dAnaM mahAbalaH |
AplutaH salile shIte tasmAchchApi jagAma ha
AshramaM paramaprIto mitrasya varuNasya cha
shlokas.13:
indro.agniraryamA chaiva yatra prAkprItimApnuvan |
taM deshaM kArapachanAdyamunAyAM jagAma ha
shlokas.14:
snAtvA tatrApi dharmAtmA parAM tuShTimavApya cha |
RRiShibhishchaiva siddhaishcha sahito vai mahAbalaH
upaviShTaH kathAH shubhrAH shushrAva yadupu~NgavaH
shlokas.15:
tathA tu tiShThatAM teShAM nArado bhagavAnRRiShiH |
AjagAmAtha taM deshaM yatra rAmo vyavasthitaH
shlokas.16:
jaTAmaNDalasa.nvItaH svarNachIrI mahAtapAH |
hemadaNDadharo rAjankamaNDaludharastathA
shlokas.17:
kachChapIM sukhashabdAM tAM gRRihya vINAM manoramAm |
nRRitye gIte cha kushalo devabrAhmaNapUjitaH
shlokas.18:
prakartA kalahAnAM cha nityaM cha kalahapriyaH |
taM deshamagamadyatra shrImAnrAmo vyavasthitaH
shlokas.19:
pratyutthAya tu te sarve pUjayitvA yatavratam |
devarShiM paryapRRichChanta yathAvRRittaM kurUnprati
shlokas.20:
tato.asyAkathayadrAjannAradaH sarvadharmavit |
sarvameva yathAvRRittamatItaM kurusa~NkShayam
shlokas.21:
tato.abravIdrauhiNeyo nAradaM dInayA girA |
kimavasthaM tu tatkShatraM ye cha tatrAbhavannRRipAH
shlokas.22:
shrutametanmayA pUrvaM sarvameva tapodhana |
vistarashravaNe jAtaM kautUhalamatIva me
shlokas.23:
nArada uvAcha||
pUrvameva hato bhIShmo droNaH sindhupatistathA |
hato vaikartanaH karNaH putrAshchAsya mahArathAH
shlokas.24:
bhUrishravA rauhiNeya madrarAjashcha vIryavAn |
ete chAnye cha bahavastatra tatra mahAbalAH
shlokas.25:
priyAnprANAnparityajya priyArthaM kauravasya vai |
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha samareShvanivartinaH
shlokas.26:
ahatA.nstu mahAbAho shRRiNu me tatra mAdhava |
dhArtarAShTrabale sheShAH kRRipo bhojashcha vIryavAn
ashvatthAmA cha vikrAnto bhagnasainyA disho gatAH
shlokas.27:
duryodhano hate sainye pradruteShu kRRipAdiShu |
hradaM dvaipAyanaM nAma vivesha bhRRishaduHkhitaH
shlokas.28:
shayAnaM dhArtarAShTraM tu stambhite salile tadA |
pANDavAH saha kRRiShNena vAgbhirugrAbhirArdayan
shlokas.29:
sa tudyamAno balavAnvAgbhI rAma samantataH |
utthitaH prAgghradAdvIraH pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm
shlokas.30:
sa chApyupagato yuddhaM bhImena saha sAmpratam |
bhaviShyati cha tatsadyastayo rAma sudAruNam
shlokas.31:
yadi kautUhalaM te.asti vraja mAdhava mA chiram |
pashya yuddhaM mahAghoraM shiShyayoryadi manyase
shlokas.32:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
nAradasya vachaH shrutvA tAnabhyarchya dvijarShabhAn |
sarvAnvisarjayAmAsa ye tenAbhyAgatAH saha
gamyatAM dvArakAM cheti so.anvashAdanuyAyinaH
shlokas.33:
so.avatIryAchalashreShThAtplakShaprasravaNAchChubhAt |
tataH prItamanA rAmaH shrutvA tIrthaphalaM mahat
viprANAM saMnidhau shlokamagAyadidamachyutaH
shlokas.34:
sarasvatIvAsasamA kuto ratiH; sarasvatIvAsasamAH kuto guNAH |
sarasvatIM prApya divaM gatA janAH; sadA smariShyanti nadIM sarasvatIm
shlokas.35:
sarasvatI sarvanadIShu puNyA; sarasvatI lokasukhAvahA sadA |
sarasvatIM prApya janAH suduShkRRitAH; sadA na shochanti paratra cheha cha
shlokas.36:
tato muhurmuhuH prItyA prekShamANaH sarasvatIm |
hayairyuktaM rathaM shubhramAtiShThata parantapaH
shlokas.37:
sa shIghragAminA tena rathena yadupu~NgavaH |
didRRikShurabhisamprAptaH shiShyayuddhamupasthitam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM tadabhavadyuddhaM tumulaM janamejaya |
yatra duHkhAnvito rAjA dhRRitarAShTro.abravIdidam
shlokas.2:
rAmaM saMnihitaM dRRiShTvA gadAyuddha upasthite |
mama putraH kathaM bhImaM pratyayudhyata sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rAmasAMnidhyamAsAdya putro duryodhanastava |
yuddhakAmo mahAbAhuH samahRRiShyata vIryavAn
shlokas.4:
dRRiShTvA lA~NgalinaM rAjA pratyutthAya cha bhArata |
prItyA paramayA yukto yudhiShThiramathAbravIt
shlokas.5:
samantapa~nchakaM kShipramito yAma vishAM pate |
prathitottaravedI sA devaloke prajApateH
shlokas.6:
tasminmahApuNyatame trailokyasya sanAtane |
sa~NgrAme nidhanaM prApya dhruvaM svargo bhaviShyati
shlokas.7:
tathetyuktvA mahArAja kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
samantapa~nchakaM vIraH prAyAdabhimukhaH prabhuH
shlokas.8:
tato duryodhano rAjA pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm |
padbhyAmamarShAddyutimAnagachChatpANDavaiH saha
shlokas.9:
tathA yAntaM gadAhastaM varmaNA chApi da.nshitam |
antarikShagatA devAH sAdhu sAdhvityapUjayan
vAtikAshcha narA ye.atra dRRiShTvA te harShamAgatAH
shlokas.10:
sa pANDavaiH parivRRitaH kururAjastavAtmajaH |
mattasyeva gajendrasya gatimAsthAya so.avrajat
shlokas.11:
tataH sha~NkhaninAdena bherINAM cha mahAsvanaiH |
siMhanAdaishcha shUrANAM dishaH sarvAH prapUritAH
shlokas.12:
pratIchyabhimukhaM deshaM yathoddiShTaM sutena te |
gatvA cha taiH parikShiptaM samantAtsarvatodisham
shlokas.13:
dakShiNena sarasvatyAH svayanaM tIrthamuttamam |
tasmindeshe tvaniriNe tatra yuddhamarochayan
shlokas.14:
tato bhImo mahAkoTiM gadAM gRRihyAtha varmabhRRit |
bibhradrUpaM mahArAja sadRRishaM hi garutmataH
shlokas.15:
avabaddhashirastrANaH sa~Nkhye kA~nchanavarmabhRRit |
rarAja rAjanputraste kA~nchanaH shailarADiva
shlokas.16:
varmabhyAM sa.nvRRitau vIrau bhImaduryodhanAvubhau |
sa.nyuge cha prakAshete sa.nrabdhAviva ku~njarau
shlokas.17:
raNamaNDalamadhyasthau bhrAtarau tau nararShabhau |
ashobhetAM mahArAja chandrasUryAvivoditau
shlokas.18:
tAvanyonyaM nirIkShetAM kruddhAviva mahAdvipau |
dahantau lochanai rAjanparasparavadhaiShiNau
shlokas.19:
samprahRRiShTamanA rAjangadAmAdAya kauravaH |
sRRikkiNI sa.nlihanrAjankrodharaktekShaNaH shvasan
shlokas.20:
tato duryodhano rAjA gadAmAdAya vIryavAn |
bhImasenamabhiprekShya gajo gajamivAhvayat
shlokas.21:
adrisAramayIM bhImastathaivAdAya vIryavAn |
AhvayAmAsa nRRipatiM siMhaH siMhaM yathA vane
shlokas.22:
tAvudyatagadApANI duryodhanavRRikodarau |
sa.nyuge sma prakAshete girI sashikharAviva
shlokas.23:
tAvubhAvabhisa~NkruddhAvubhau bhImaparAkramau |
ubhau shiShyau gadAyuddhe rauhiNeyasya dhImataH
shlokas.24:
ubhau sadRRishakarmANau yamavAsavayoriva |
tathA sadRRishakarmANau varuNasya mahAbalau
shlokas.25:
vAsudevasya rAmasya tathA vaishravaNasya cha |
sadRRishau tau mahArAja madhukaiTabhayoryudhi
shlokas.26:
ubhau sadRRishakarmANau raNe sundopasundayoH |
tathaiva kAlasya samau mRRityoshchaiva parantapau
shlokas.27:
anyonyamabhidhAvantau mattAviva mahAdvipau |
vAshitAsa~Ngame dRRiptau sharadIva madotkaTau
shlokas.28:
mattAviva jigIShantau mAta~Ngau bharatarShabhau |
ubhau krodhaviShaM dIptaM vamantAvuragAviva
shlokas.29:
anyonyamabhisa.nrabdhau prekShamANAvari.ndamau |
ubhau bharatashArdUlau vikrameNa samanvitau
shlokas.30:
siMhAviva durAdharShau gadAyuddhe parantapau |
nakhadaMShTrAyudhau vIrau vyAghrAviva durutsahau
shlokas.31:
prajAsaMharaNe kShubdhau samudrAviva dustarau |
lohitA~NgAviva kruddhau pratapantau mahArathau
shlokas.32:
rashmimantau mahAtmAnau dIptimantau mahAbalau |
dadRRishAte kurushreShThau kAlasUryAvivoditau
shlokas.33:
vyAghrAviva susa.nrabdhau garjantAviva toyadau |
jahRRiShAte mahAbAhU siMhau kesariNAviva
shlokas.34:
gajAviva susa.nrabdhau jvalitAviva pAvakau |
dadRRishustau mahAtmAnau sashRRi~NgAviva parvatau
shlokas.35:
roShAtprasphuramANoShThau nirIkShantau parasparam |
tau sametau mahAtmAnau gadAhastau narottamau
shlokas.36:
ubhau paramasaMhRRiShTAvubhau paramasaMmatau |
sadashvAviva heShantau bRRiMhantAviva ku~njarau
shlokas.37:
vRRiShabhAviva garjantau duryodhanavRRikodarau |
