daityAviva balonmattau rejatustau narottamau
shlokas.38:
tato duryodhano rAjannidamAha yudhiShThiram |
sRRi~njayaiH saha tiShThantaM tapantamiva bhAskaram
shlokas.39:
idaM vyavasitaM yuddhaM mama bhImasya chobhayoH |
upopaviShTAH pashyadhvaM vimardaM nRRipasattamAH
shlokas.40:
tataH samupaviShTaM tatsumahadrAjamaNDalam |
virAjamAnaM dadRRishe divIvAdityamaNDalam
shlokas.41:
teShAM madhye mahAbAhuH shrImAnkeshavapUrvajaH |
upaviShTo mahArAja pUjyamAnaH samantataH
shlokas.42:
shushubhe rAjamadhyastho nIlavAsAH sitaprabhaH |
nakShatrairiva sampUrNo vRRito nishi nishAkaraH
shlokas.43:
tau tathA tu mahArAja gadAhastau durAsadau |
anyonyaM vAgbhirugrAbhistakShamANau vyavasthitau
shlokas.44:
apriyANi tato.anyonyamuktvA tau kurupu~Ngavau |
udIkShantau sthitau vIrau vRRitrashakrAvivAhave

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vAgyuddhamabhavattumulaM janamejaya |
yatra duHkhAnvito rAjA dhRRitarAShTro.abravIdidam
shlokas.2:
dhigastu khalu mAnuShyaM yasya niShTheyamIdRRishI |
ekAdashachamUbhartA yatra putro mamAbhibhUH
shlokas.3:
Aj~nApya sarvAnnRRipatInbhuktvA chemAM vasundharAm |
gadAmAdAya vegena padAtiH prasthito raNam
shlokas.4:
bhUtvA hi jagato nAtho hyanAtha iva me sutaH |
gadAmudyamya yo yAti kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.5:
aho duHkhaM mahatprAptaM putreNa mama sa~njaya |
evamuktvA sa duHkhArto virarAma janAdhipaH
shlokas.6:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa meghaninado harShAdvinadanniva govRRiShaH |
AjuhAva tataH pArthaM yuddhAya yudhi vIryavAn
shlokas.7:
bhImamAhvayamAne tu kururAje mahAtmani |
prAdurAsansughorANi rUpANi vividhAnyuta
shlokas.8:
vavurvAtAH sanirghAtAH pA.nsuvarShaM papAta cha |
babhUvushcha dishaH sarvAstimireNa samAvRRitAH
shlokas.9:
mahAsvanAH sanirghAtAstumulA romaharShaNAH |
petustatholkAH shatashaH sphoTayantyo nabhastalam
shlokas.10:
rAhushchAgrasadAdityamaparvaNi vishAM pate |
chakampe cha mahAkampaM pRRithivI savanadrumA
shlokas.11:
rUkShAshcha vAtAH pravavurnIchaiH sharkaravarShiNaH |
girINAM shikharANyeva nyapatanta mahItale
shlokas.12:
mRRigA bahuvidhAkArAH sampatanti disho dasha |
dIptAH shivAshchApyanadanghorarUpAH sudAruNAH
shlokas.13:
nirghAtAshcha mahAghorA babhUvU romaharShaNAH |
dIptAyAM dishi rAjendra mRRigAshchAshubhavAdinaH
shlokas.14:
udapAnagatAshchApo vyavardhanta samantataH |
asharIrA mahAnAdAH shrUyante sma tadA nRRipa
shlokas.15:
evamAdIni dRRiShTvAtha nimittAni vRRikodaraH |
uvAcha bhrAtaraM jyeShThaM dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.16:
naiSha shakto raNe jetuM mandAtmA mAM suyodhanaH |
adya krodhaM vimokShyAmi nigUDhaM hRRidaye chiram
suyodhane kauravendre khANDave pAvako yathA
shlokas.17:
shalyamadyoddhariShyAmi tava pANDava hRRichChayam |
nihatya gadayA pApamimaM kurukulAdhamam
shlokas.18:
adya kIrtimayIM mAlAM pratimokShyAmyahaM tvayi |
hatvemaM pApakarmANaM gadayA raNamUrdhani
shlokas.19:
adyAsya shatadhA dehaM bhinadmi gadayAnayA |
nAyaM praveShTA nagaraM punarvAraNasAhvayam
shlokas.20:
sarpotsargasya shayane viShadAnasya bhojane |
pramANakoTyAM pAtasya dAhasya jatuveshmani
shlokas.21:
sabhAyAmavahAsasya sarvasvaharaNasya cha |
varShamaj~nAtavAsasya vanavAsasya chAnagha
shlokas.22:
adyAntameShAM duHkhAnAM gantA bharatasattama |
ekAhnA vinihatyemaM bhaviShyAmyAtmano.anRRiNaH
shlokas.23:
adyAyurdhArtarAShTrasya durmaterakRRitAtmanaH |
samAptaM bharatashreShTha mAtApitroshcha darshanam
shlokas.24:
adyAyaM kururAjasya shantanoH kulapA.nsanaH |
prANA~nshriyaM cha rAjyaM cha tyaktvA sheShyati bhUtale
shlokas.25:
rAjA cha dhRRitarAShTro.adya shrutvA putraM mayA hatam |
smariShyatyashubhaM karma yattachChakunibuddhijam
shlokas.26:
ityuktvA rAjashArdUla gadAmAdAya vIryavAn |
avAtiShThata yuddhAya shakro vRRitramivAhvayan
shlokas.27:
tamudyatagadaM dRRiShTvA kailAsamiva shRRi~NgiNam |
bhImasenaH punaH kruddho duryodhanamuvAcha ha
shlokas.28:
rAj~nashcha dhRRitarAShTrasya tathA tvamapi chAtmanaH |
smara tadduShkRRitaM karma yadvRRittaM vAraNAvate
shlokas.29:
draupadI cha parikliShTA sabhAyAM yadrajasvalA |
dyUte cha va~nchito rAjA yattvayA saubalena cha
shlokas.30:
vane duHkhaM cha yatprAptamasmAbhistvatkRRitaM mahat |
virATanagare chaiva yonyantaragatairiva
tatsarvaM yAtayAmyadya diShTyA dRRiShTo.asi durmate
shlokas.31:
tvatkRRite.asau hataH shete sharatalpe pratApavAn |
gA~Ngeyo rathinAM shreShTho nihato yAj~naseninA
shlokas.32:
hato droNashcha karNashcha tathA shalyaH pratApavAn |
vairAgnerAdikartA cha shakuniH saubalo hataH
shlokas.33:
prAtikAmI tathA pApo draupadyAH kleshakRRiddhataH |
bhrAtaraste hatAH sarve shUrA vikrAntayodhinaH
shlokas.34:
ete chAnye cha bahavo nihatAstvatkRRite nRRipAH |
tvAmadya nihaniShyAmi gadayA nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.35:
ityevamuchchai rAjendra bhAShamANaM vRRikodaram |
uvAcha vItabhI rAjanputraste satyavikramaH
shlokas.36:
kiM katthitena bahudhA yudhyasva tvaM vRRikodara |
adya te.ahaM vineShyAmi yuddhashraddhAM kulAdhama
shlokas.37:
naiva duryodhanaH kShudra kenachittvadvidhena vai |
shakyastrAsayituM vAchA yathAnyaH prAkRRito naraH
shlokas.38:
chirakAlepsitaM diShTyA hRRidayasthamidaM mama |
tvayA saha gadAyuddhaM tridashairupapAditam
shlokas.39:
kiM vAchA bahunoktena katthitena cha durmate |
vANI sampadyatAmeShA karmaNA mA chiraM kRRithAH
shlokas.40:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA sarva evAbhyapUjayan |
rAjAnaH somakAshchaiva ye tatrAsansamAgatAH
shlokas.41:
tataH sampUjitaH sarvaiH samprahRRiShTatanUruhaH |
bhUyo dhIraM manashchakre yuddhAya kurunandanaH
shlokas.42:
taM mattamiva mAta~NgaM talatAlairnarAdhipAH |
bhUyaH saMharShayAM chakrurduryodhanamamarShaNam
shlokas.43:
taM mahAtmA mahAtmAnaM gadAmudyamya pANDavaH |
abhidudrAva vegena dhArtarAShTraM vRRikodaraH
shlokas.44:
bRRiMhanti ku~njarAstatra hayA heShanti chAsakRRit |
shastrANi chApyadIpyanta pANDavAnAM jayaiShiNAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato duryodhano dRRiShTvA bhImasenaM tathAgatam |
pratyudyayAvadInAtmA vegena mahatA nadan
shlokas.2:
samApetaturAnadya shRRi~NgiNau vRRiShabhAviva |
mahAnirghAtaghoShashcha samprahArastayorabhUt
shlokas.3:
abhavachcha tayoryuddhaM tumulaM romaharShaNam |
jigIShatoryudhAnyonyamindraprahrAdayoriva
shlokas.4:
rudhirokShitasarvA~Ngau gadAhastau manasvinau |
dadRRishAte mahAtmAnau puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.5:
tathA tasminmahAyuddhe vartamAne sudAruNe |
khadyotasa~Nghairiva khaM darshanIyaM vyarochata
shlokas.6:
tathA tasminvartamAne sa~Nkule tumule bhRRisham |
ubhAvapi parishrAntau yudhyamAnAvari.ndamau
shlokas.7:
tau muhUrtaM samAshvasya punareva parantapau |
abhyahArayatAM tatra sampragRRihya gade shubhe
shlokas.8:
tau tu dRRiShTvA mahAvIryau samAshvastau nararShabhau |
balinau vAraNau yadvadvAshitArthe madotkaTau
shlokas.9:
apAravIryau samprekShya pragRRihItagadAvubhau |
vismayaM paramaM jagmurdevagandharvadAnavAH
shlokas.10:
pragRRihItagadau dRRiShTvA duryodhanavRRikodarau |
sa.nshayaH sarvabhUtAnAM vijaye samapadyata
shlokas.11:
samAgamya tato bhUyo bhrAtarau balinAM varau |
anyonyasyAntaraprepsU prachakrAte.antaraM prati
shlokas.12:
yamadaNDopamAM gurvImindrAshanimivodyatAm |
dadRRishuH prekShakA rAjanraudrIM vishasanIM gadAm
shlokas.13:
Avidhyato gadAM tasya bhImasenasya sa.nyuge |
shabdaH sutumulo ghoro muhUrtaM samapadyata
shlokas.14:
AvidhyantamabhiprekShya dhArtarAShTro.atha pANDavam |
gadAmalaghuvegAM tAM vismitaH sambabhUva ha
shlokas.15:
chara.nshcha vividhAnmArgAnmaNDalAni cha bhArata |
ashobhata tadA vIro bhUya eva vRRikodaraH
shlokas.16:
tau parasparamAsAdya yattAvanyonyarakShaNe |
mArjArAviva bhakShArthe tatakShAte muhurmuhuH
shlokas.17:
acharadbhImasenastu mArgAnbahuvidhA.nstathA |
maNDalAni vichitrANi sthAnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.18:
gomUtrikANi chitrANi gatapratyAgatAni cha |
parimokShaM prahArANAM varjanaM paridhAvanam
shlokas.19:
abhidravaNamAkShepamavasthAnaM savigraham |
parAvartanasa.nvartamavaplutamathAplutam
upanyastamapanyastaM gadAyuddhavishAradau
shlokas.20:
evaM tau vicharantau tu nyaghnatAM vai parasparam |
va~nchayantau punashchaiva cheratuH kurusattamau
shlokas.21:
vikrIDantau subalinau maNDalAni pracheratuH |
gadAhastau tatastau tu maNDalAvasthitau balI
shlokas.22:
dakShiNaM maNDalaM rAjandhArtarAShTro.abhyavartata |
savyaM tu maNDalaM tatra bhImaseno.abhyavartata
shlokas.23:
tathA tu charatastasya bhImasya raNamUrdhani |
duryodhano mahArAja pArshvadeshe.abhyatADayat
shlokas.24:
Ahatastu tadA bhImastava putreNa bhArata |
Avidhyata gadAM gurvIM prahAraM tamachintayan
shlokas.25:
indrAshanisamAM ghorAM yamadaNDamivodyatAm |
dadRRishuste mahArAja bhImasenasya tAM gadAm
shlokas.26:
AvidhyantaM gadAM dRRiShTvA bhImasenaM tavAtmajaH |
samudyamya gadAM ghorAM pratyavidhyadari.ndamaH
shlokas.27:
gadAmArutavegena tava putrasya bhArata |
shabda AsItsutumulastejashcha samajAyata
shlokas.28:
sa charanvividhAnmArgAnmaNDalAni cha bhAgashaH |
samashobhata tejasvI bhUyo bhImAtsuyodhanaH
shlokas.29:
AviddhA sarvavegena bhImena mahatI gadA |
sadhUmaM sArchiShaM chAgniM mumochogrA mahAsvanA
shlokas.30:
AdhUtAM bhImasenena gadAM dRRiShTvA suyodhanaH |
adrisAramayIM gurvImAvidhyanbahvashobhata
shlokas.31:
gadAmArutavegaM hi dRRiShTvA tasya mahAtmanaH |
bhayaM vivesha pANDUnvai sarvAneva sasomakAn
shlokas.32:
tau darshayantau samare yuddhakrIDAM samantataH |
gadAbhyAM sahasAnyonyamAjaghnaturari.ndamau
shlokas.33:
tau parasparamAsAdya daMShTrAbhyAM dviradau yathA |
ashobhetAM mahArAja shoNitena pariplutau
shlokas.34:
evaM tadabhavadyuddhaM ghorarUpamasa.nvRRitam |
parivRRitte.ahani krUraM vRRitravAsavayoriva
shlokas.35:
dRRiShTvA vyavasthitaM bhImaM tava putro mahAbalaH |
chara.nshchitratarAnmArgAnkaunteyamabhidudruve
shlokas.36:
tasya bhImo mahAvegAM jAmbUnadapariShkRRitAm |
abhikruddhasya kruddhastu tADayAmAsa tAM gadAm
shlokas.37:
savisphuli~Ngo nirhrAdastayostatrAbhighAtajaH |
prAdurAsInmahArAja sRRiShTayorvajrayoriva
shlokas.38:
vegavatyA tayA tatra bhImasenapramuktayA |
nipatantyA mahArAja pRRithivI samakampata
shlokas.39:
tAM nAmRRiShyata kauravyo gadAM pratihatAM raNe |
matto dvipa iva kruddhaH pratiku~njaradarshanAt
shlokas.40:
sa savyaM maNDalaM rAjannudbhrAmya kRRitanishchayaH |
Ajaghne mUrdhni kaunteyaM gadayA bhImavegayA
shlokas.41:
tayA tvabhihato bhImaH putreNa tava pANDavaH |
nAkampata mahArAja tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.42:
AshcharyaM chApi tadrAjansarvasainyAnyapUjayan |
yadgadAbhihato bhImo nAkampata padAtpadam
shlokas.43:
tato gurutarAM dIptAM gadAM hemapariShkRRitAm |
duryodhanAya vyasRRijadbhImo bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.44:
taM prahAramasambhrAnto lAghavena mahAbalaH |
moghaM duryodhanashchakre tatrAbhUdvismayo mahAn
shlokas.45:
sA tu moghA gadA rAjanpatantI bhImachoditA |
chAlayAmAsa pRRithivIM mahAnirghAtanisvanA
shlokas.46:
AsthAya kaushikAnmArgAnutpatansa punaH punaH |
gadAnipAtaM praj~nAya bhImasenamava~nchayat
shlokas.47:
va~nchayitvA tathA bhImaM gadayA kurusattamaH |
tADayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho vakShodeshe mahAbalaH
shlokas.48:
gadayAbhihato bhImo muhyamAno mahAraNe |
nAbhyamanyata kartavyaM putreNAbhyAhatastava
shlokas.49:
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne rAjansomakapANDavAH |
bhRRishopahatasa~NkalpA nahRRiShTamanaso.abhavan
shlokas.50:
sa tu tena prahAreNa mAta~Nga iva roShitaH |
hastivaddhastisa~NkAshamabhidudrAva te sutam
shlokas.51:
tatastu rabhaso bhImo gadayA tanayaM tava |
abhidudrAva vegena siMho vanagajaM yathA
shlokas.52:
upasRRitya tu rAjAnaM gadAmokShavishAradaH |
Avidhyata gadAM rAjansamuddishya sutaM tava
shlokas.53:
atADayadbhImasenaH pArshve duryodhanaM tadA |
sa vihvalaH prahAreNa jAnubhyAmagamanmahIm
shlokas.54:
tasmi.nstu bharatashreShThe jAnubhyAmavanIM gate |
udatiShThattato nAdaH sRRi~njayAnAM jagatpate
shlokas.55:
teShAM tu ninadaM shrutvA sRRi~njayAnAM nararShabhaH |
amarShAdbharatashreShTha putraste samakupyata
shlokas.56:
utthAya tu mahAbAhuH kruddho nAga iva shvasan |
didhakShanniva netrAbhyAM bhImasenamavaikShata
shlokas.57:
tataH sa bharatashreShTho gadApANirabhidravat |
pramathiShyanniva shiro bhImasenasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.58:
sa mahAtmA mahAtmAnaM bhImaM bhImaparAkramaH |
atADayachCha~Nkhadeshe sa chachAlAchalopamaH
shlokas.59:
sa bhUyaH shushubhe pArthastADito gadayA raNe |
udbhinnarudhiro rAjanprabhinna iva ku~njaraH
shlokas.60:
tato gadAM vIrahaNImayasmayIM; pragRRihya vajrAshanitulyanisvanAm |
atADayachChatrumamitrakarshano; balena vikramya dhana~njayAgrajaH
shlokas.61:
sa bhImasenAbhihatastavAtmajaH; papAta sa~NkampitadehabandhanaH |
supuShpito mArutavegatADito; mahAvane sAla ivAvaghUrNitaH
shlokas.62:
tataH praNedurjahRRiShushcha pANDavAH; samIkShya putraM patitaM kShitau tava |
tataH sutaste pratilabhya chetanAM; samutpapAta dvirado yathA hradAt
shlokas.63:
sa pArthivo nityamamarShitastadA; mahArathaH shikShitavatparibhraman |
atADayatpANDavamagrataH sthitaM; sa vihvalA~Ngo jagatImupAspRRishat
shlokas.64:
sa siMhanAdAnvinanAda kauravo; nipAtya bhUmau yudhi bhImamojasA |
bibheda chaivAshanitulyatejasA; gadAnipAtena sharIrarakShaNam
shlokas.65:
tato.antarikShe ninado mahAnabhU;ddivaukasAmapsarasAM cha neduShAm |
papAta chochchairamarapraveritaM; vichitrapuShpotkaravarShamuttamam
shlokas.66:
tataH parAnAvishaduttamaM bhayaM; samIkShya bhUmau patitaM narottamam |
ahIyamAnaM cha balena kauravaM; nishamya bhedaM cha dRRiDhasya varmaNaH
shlokas.67:
tato muhUrtAdupalabhya chetanAM; pramRRijya vaktraM rudhirArdramAtmanaH |
dhRRitiM samAlambya vivRRittalochano; balena sa.nstabhya vRRikodaraH sthitaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
samudIrNaM tato dRRiShTvA sa~NgrAmaM kurumukhyayoH |
athAbravIdarjunastu vAsudevaM yashasvinam
shlokas.2:
anayorvIrayoryuddhe ko jyAyAnbhavato mataH |
kasya vA ko guNo bhUyAnetadvada janArdana
shlokas.3:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
upadesho.anayostulyo bhImastu balavattaraH |
kRRitayatnatarastveSha dhArtarAShTro vRRikodarAt
shlokas.4:
bhImasenastu dharmeNa yudhyamAno na jeShyati |
anyAyena tu yudhyanvai hanyAdeSha suyodhanam
shlokas.5:
mAyayA nirjitA devairasurA iti naH shrutam |
virochanashcha shakreNa mAyayA nirjitaH sakhe
mAyayA chAkShipattejo vRRitrasya balasUdanaH
shlokas.6:
pratij~nAtaM tu bhImena dyUtakAle dhana~njaya |
UrU bhetsyAmi te sa~Nkhye gadayeti suyodhanam
shlokas.7:
so.ayaM pratij~nAM tAM chApi pArayitvArikarshanaH |
mAyAvinaM cha rAjAnaM mAyayaiva nikRRintatu
shlokas.8:
yadyeSha balamAsthAya nyAyena prahariShyati |
viShamasthastato rAjA bhaviShyati yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.9:
punareva cha vakShyAmi pANDavedaM nibodha me |
dharmarAjAparAdhena bhayaM naH punarAgatam
shlokas.10:
kRRitvA hi sumahatkarma hatvA bhIShmamukhAnkurUn |
jayaH prApto yashashchAgryaM vairaM cha pratiyAtitam
tadevaM vijayaH prAptaH punaH sa.nshayitaH kRRitaH
shlokas.11:
abuddhireShA mahatI dharmarAjasya pANDava |
yadekavijaye yuddhaM paNitaM kRRitamIdRRisham
suyodhanaH kRRitI vIra ekAyanagatastathA
shlokas.12:
api choshanasA gItaH shrUyate.ayaM purAtanaH |
shlokastattvArthasahitastanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.13:
punarAvartamAnAnAM bhagnAnAM jIvitaiShiNAm |
bhetavyamarisheShANAmekAyanagatA hi te
shlokas.14:
suyodhanamimaM bhagnaM hatasainyaM hradaM gatam |
parAjitaM vanaprepsuM nirAshaM rAjyalambhane
shlokas.15:
ko nveSha sa.nyuge prAj~naH punardva.ndve samAhvayet |
api vo nirjitaM rAjyaM na hareta suyodhanaH
shlokas.16:
yastrayodashavarShANi gadayA kRRitanishramaH |
charatyUrdhvaM cha tiryakcha bhImasenajighA.nsayA
shlokas.17:
evaM chenna mahAbAhuranyAyena haniShyati |
eSha vaH kauravo rAjA dhArtarAShTro bhaviShyati
shlokas.18:
dhana~njayastu shrutvaitatkeshavasya mahAtmanaH |
prekShato bhImasenasya hastenorumatADayat
shlokas.19:
gRRihya sa~nj~nAM tato bhImo gadayA vyacharadraNe |
maNDalAni vichitrANi yamakAnItarANi cha
shlokas.20:
dakShiNaM maNDalaM savyaM gomUtrakamathApi cha |
vyacharatpANDavo rAjannariM saMmohayanniva
shlokas.21:
tathaiva tava putro.api gadAmArgavishAradaH |
vyacharallaghu chitraM cha bhImasenajighA.nsayA
shlokas.22:
Adhunvantau gade ghore chandanAgarurUShite |
vairasyAntaM parIpsantau raNe kruddhAvivAntakau
shlokas.23:
anyonyaM tau jighA.nsantau pravIrau puruSharShabhau |
yuyudhAte garutmantau yathA nAgAmiShaiShiNau
shlokas.24:
maNDalAni vichitrANi charatornRRipabhImayoH |
gadAsampAtajAstatra prajaj~nuH pAvakArchiShaH
shlokas.25:
samaM praharatostatra shUrayorbalinormRRidhe |
kShubdhayorvAyunA rAjandvayoriva samudrayoH
shlokas.26:
tayoH praharatostulyaM mattaku~njarayoriva |
gadAnirghAtasaMhrAdaH prahArANAmajAyata
shlokas.27:
tasmi.nstadA samprahAre dAruNe sa~Nkule bhRRisham |
ubhAvapi parishrAntau yudhyamAnAvari.ndamau
shlokas.28:
tau muhUrtaM samAshvasya punareva parantapau |
abhyahArayatAM kruddhau pragRRihya mahatI gade
shlokas.29:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM ghorarUpamasa.nvRRitam |
gadAnipAtai rAjendra takShatorvai parasparam
shlokas.30:
vyAyAmapradrutau tau tu vRRiShabhAkShau tarasvinau |
anyonyaM jaghnaturvIrau pa~Nkasthau mahiShAviva
shlokas.31:
jarjarIkRRitasarvA~Ngau rudhireNAbhisamplutau |
dadRRishAte himavati puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.32:
duryodhanena pArthastu vivare sampradarshite |
IShadutsmayamAnastu sahasA prasasAra ha
shlokas.33:
tamabhyAshagataM prAj~no raNe prekShya vRRikodaraH |
avAkShipadgadAM tasmai vegena mahatA balI
shlokas.34:
avakShepaM tu taM dRRiShTvA putrastava vishAM pate |
apAsarpattataH sthAnAtsA moghA nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.35:
mokShayitvA prahAraM taM sutastava sa sambhramAt |
bhImasenaM cha gadayA prAharatkurusattamaH
shlokas.36:
tasya viShyandamAnena rudhireNAmitaujasaH |
prahAragurupAtAchcha mUrCheva samajAyata
shlokas.37:
duryodhanastaM cha veda pIDitaM pANDavaM raNe |
dhArayAmAsa bhImo.api sharIramatipIDitam
shlokas.38:
amanyata sthitaM hyenaM prahariShyantamAhave |
ato na prAharattasmai punareva tavAtmajaH
shlokas.39:
tato muhUrtamAshvasya duryodhanamavasthitam |
vegenAbhyadravadrAjanbhImasenaH pratApavAn
shlokas.40:
tamApatantaM samprekShya sa.nrabdhamamitaujasam |
moghamasya prahAraM taM chikIrShurbharatarShabha
shlokas.41:
avasthAne matiM kRRitvA putrastava mahAmanAH |
iyeShotpatituM rAja.nshChalayiShyanvRRikodaram
shlokas.42:
abudhyadbhImasenastadrAj~nastasya chikIrShitam |
athAsya samabhidrutya samutkramya cha siMhavat
shlokas.43:
sRRityA va~nchayato rAjanpunarevotpatiShyataH |
UrubhyAM prAhiNodrAjangadAM vegena pANDavaH
shlokas.44:
sA vajraniShpeShasamA prahitA bhImakarmaNA |
UrU duryodhanasyAtha babha~nja priyadarshanau
shlokas.45:
sa papAta naravyAghro vasudhAmanunAdayan |
bhagnorurbhImasenena putrastava mahIpate
shlokas.46:
vavurvAtAH sanirghAtAH pA.nsuvarShaM papAta cha |
chachAla pRRithivI chApi savRRikShakShupaparvatA
shlokas.47:
tasminnipatite vIre patyau sarvamahIkShitAm |
mahAsvanA punardIptA sanirghAtA bhaya~NkarI
papAta cholkA mahatI patite pRRithivIpatau
shlokas.48:
tathA shoNitavarShaM cha pA.nsuvarShaM cha bhArata |
vavarSha maghavA.nstatra tava putre nipAtite
shlokas.49:
yakShANAM rAkShasAnAM cha pishAchAnAM tathaiva cha |
antarikShe mahAnAdaH shrUyate bharatarShabha
shlokas.50:
tena shabdena ghoreNa mRRigANAmatha pakShiNAm |
jaj~ne ghoratamaH shabdo bahUnAM sarvatodisham
shlokas.51:
ye tatra vAjinaH sheShA gajAshcha manujaiH saha |
mumuchuste mahAnAdaM tava putre nipAtite
shlokas.52:
bherIsha~NkhamRRida~NgAnAmabhavachcha svano mahAn |
antarbhUmigatashchaiva tava putre nipAtite
shlokas.53:
bahupAdairbahubhujaiH kabandhairghoradarshanaiH |
nRRityadbhirbhayadairvyAptA dishastatrAbhavannRRipa
shlokas.54:
dhvajavanto.astravantashcha shastravantastathaiva cha |
prAkampanta tato rAja.nstava putre nipAtite
shlokas.55:
hradAH kUpAshcha rudhiramudvemurnRRipasattama |
nadyashcha sumahAvegAH pratisrotovahAbhavan
shlokas.56:
pulli~NgA iva nAryastu strIli~NgAH puruShAbhavan |
duryodhane tadA rAjanpatite tanaye tava
shlokas.57:
dRRiShTvA tAnadbhutotpAtAnpA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH saha |
AvignamanasaH sarve babhUvurbharatarShabha
shlokas.58:
yayurdevA yathAkAmaM gandharvApsarasastathA |
kathayanto.adbhutaM yuddhaM sutayostava bhArata
shlokas.59:
tathaiva siddhA rAjendra tathA vAtikachAraNAH |
narasiMhau prasha.nsantau viprajagmuryathAgatam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
taM pAtitaM tato dRRiShTvA mahAshAlamivodgatam |
prahRRiShTamanasaH sarve babhUvustatra pANDavAH
shlokas.2:
unmattamiva mAta~NgaM siMhena vinipAtitam |
dadRRishurhRRiShTaromANaH sarve te chApi somakAH
shlokas.3:
tato duryodhanaM hatvA bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
patitaM kauravendraM tamupagamyedamabravIt
shlokas.4:
gaurgauriti purA manda draupadImekavAsasam |
yatsabhAyAM hasannasmA.nstadA vadasi durmate
tasyAvahAsasya phalamadya tvaM samavApnuhi
shlokas.5:
evamuktvA sa vAmena padA maulimupAspRRishat |
shirashcha rAjasiMhasya pAdena samaloDayat
shlokas.6:
tathaiva krodhasa.nrakto bhImaH parabalArdanaH |
punarevAbravIdvAkyaM yattachChRRiNu narAdhipa
shlokas.7:
ye.asmAnpuro.apanRRityanta punargauriti gauriti |
tAnvayaM pratinRRityAmaH punargauriti gauriti
shlokas.8:
nAsmAkaM nikRRitirvahnirnAkShadyUtaM na va~nchanA |
svabAhubalamAshritya prabAdhAmo vayaM ripUn
shlokas.9:
so.avApya vairasya parasya pAraM; vRRikodaraH prAha shanaiH prahasya |
yudhiShThiraM keshavasRRi~njayA.nshcha; dhana~njayaM mAdravatIsutau cha
shlokas.10:
rajasvalAM draupadImAnayanye; ye chApyakurvanta sadasyavastrAm |
tAnpashyadhvaM pANDavairdhArtarAShTrA;nraNe hatA.nstapasA yAj~nasenyAH
shlokas.11:
ye naH purA ShaNDhatilAnavocha;nkrUrA rAj~no dhRRitarAShTrasya putrAH |
te no hatAH sagaNAH sAnubandhAH; kAmaM svargaM narakaM vA vrajAmaH
shlokas.12:
punashcha rAj~naH patitasya bhUmau; sa tAM gadAM skandhagatAM nirIkShya |
vAmena pAdena shiraH pramRRidya; duryodhanaM naikRRitiketyavochat
shlokas.13:
hRRiShTena rAjankurupArthivasya; kShudrAtmanA bhImasenena pAdam |
dRRiShTvA kRRitaM mUrdhani nAbhyananda;ndharmAtmAnaH somakAnAM prabarhAH
shlokas.14:
tava putraM tathA hatvA katthamAnaM vRRikodaram |
nRRityamAnaM cha bahusho dharmarAjo.abravIdidam
shlokas.15:
mA shiro.asya padA mardIrmA dharmaste.atyagAnmahAn |
rAjA j~nAtirhatashchAyaM naitannyAyyaM tavAnagha
shlokas.16:
vidhvasto.ayaM hatAmAtyo hatabhrAtA hataprajaH |
utsannapiNDo bhrAtA cha naitannyAyyaM kRRitaM tvayA
shlokas.17:
dhArmiko bhImaseno.asAvityAhustvAM purA janAH |
sa kasmAdbhImasena tvaM rAjAnamadhitiShThasi
shlokas.18:
dRRiShTvA duryodhanaM rAjA kuntIputrastathAgatam |
netrAbhyAmashrupUrNAbhyAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.19:
nUnametadbalavatA dhAtrAdiShTaM mahAtmanA |
yadvayaM tvAM jighA.nsAmastvaM chAsmAnkurusattama
shlokas.20:
Atmano hyaparAdhena mahadvyasanamIdRRisham |
prAptavAnasi yallobhAnmadAdbAlyAchcha bhArata
shlokas.21:
ghAtayitvA vayasyA.nshcha bhrAtR^Inatha pitR^I.nstathA |
putrAnpautrA.nstathAchAryA.nstato.asi nidhanaM gataH
shlokas.22:
tavAparAdhAdasmAbhirbhrAtaraste mahArathAH |
nihatA j~nAtayashchAnye diShTaM manye duratyayam
shlokas.23:
snuShAshcha prasnuShAshchaiva dhRRitarAShTrasya vihvalAH |
garhayiShyanti no nUnaM vidhavAH shokakarshitAH
shlokas.24:
evamuktvA suduHkhArto nishashvAsa sa pArthivaH |
vilalApa chiraM chApi dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
adharmeNa hataM dRRiShTvA rAjAnaM mAdhavottamaH |
kimabravIttadA sUta baladevo mahAbalaH
shlokas.2:
gadAyuddhavisheShaj~no gadAyuddhavishAradaH |
kRRitavAnrauhiNeyo yattanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shirasyabhihataM dRRiShTvA bhImasenena te sutam |
rAmaH praharatAM shreShThashchukrodha balavadbalI
shlokas.4:
tato madhye narendrANAmUrdhvabAhurhalAyudhaH |
kurvannArtasvaraM ghoraM dhigdhigbhImetyuvAcha ha
shlokas.5:
aho dhigyadadho nAbheH prahRRitaM shuddhavikrame |
naitaddRRiShTaM gadAyuddhe kRRitavAnyadvRRikodaraH
shlokas.6:
adho nAbhyA na hantavyamiti shAstrasya nishchayaH |
ayaM tvashAstravinmUDhaH svachChandAtsampravartate
shlokas.7:
tasya tattadbruvANasya roShaH samabhavanmahAn |
tato lA~Ngalamudyamya bhImamabhyadravadbalI
shlokas.8:
tasyordhvabAhoH sadRRishaM rUpamAsInmahAtmanaH |
bahudhAtuvichitrasya shvetasyeva mahAgireH
shlokas.9:
tamutpatantaM jagrAha keshavo vinayAnataH |
bAhubhyAM pInavRRittAbhyAM prayatnAdbalavadbalI
shlokas.10:
sitAsitau yaduvarau shushubhAte.adhikaM tataH |
nabhogatau yathA rAja.nshchandrasUryau dinakShaye
shlokas.11:
uvAcha chainaM sa.nrabdhaM shamayanniva keshavaH |
AtmavRRiddhirmitravRRiddhirmitramitrodayastathA
viparItaM dviShatsvetatShaDvidhA vRRiddhirAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
Atmanyapi cha mitreShu viparItaM yadA bhavet |
tadA vidyAnmanojyAnimAshu shAntikaro bhavet
shlokas.13:
asmAkaM sahajaM mitraM pANDavAH shuddhapauruShAH |
svakAH pitRRiShvasuH putrAste parairnikRRitA bhRRisham
shlokas.14:
pratij~nApAraNaM dharmaH kShatriyasyeti vettha ha |
suyodhanasya gadayA bha~NktAsmyUrU mahAhave
iti pUrvaM pratij~nAtaM bhImena hi sabhAtale
shlokas.15:
maitreyeNAbhishaptashcha pUrvameva maharShiNA |
UrU bhetsyati te bhImo gadayeti parantapa
ato doShaM na pashyAmi mA krudhastvaM pralambahan
shlokas.16:
yaunairhArdaishcha sambandhaiH sambaddhAH smeha pANDavaiH |
teShAM vRRiddhyAbhivRRiddhirno mA krudhaH puruSharShabha
shlokas.17:
rAma uvAcha||
dharmaH sucharitaH sadbhiH saha dvAbhyAM niyachChati |
arthashchAtyarthalubdhasya kAmashchAtiprasa~NginaH
shlokas.18:
dharmArthau dharmakAmau cha kAmArthau chApyapIDayan |
dharmArthakAmAnyo.abhyeti so.atyantaM sukhamashnute
shlokas.19:
tadidaM vyAkulaM sarvaM kRRitaM dharmasya pIDanAt |
bhImasenena govinda kAmaM tvaM tu yathAttha mAm
shlokas.20:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
aroShaNo hi dharmAtmA satataM dharmavatsalaH |
bhavAnprakhyAyate loke tasmAtsa.nshAmya mA krudhaH
shlokas.21:
prAptaM kaliyugaM viddhi pratij~nAM pANDavasya cha |
AnRRiNyaM yAtu vairasya pratij~nAyAshcha pANDavaH
shlokas.22:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dharmachChalamapi shrutvA keshavAtsa vishAM pate |
naiva prItamanA rAmo vachanaM prAha sa.nsadi
shlokas.23:
hatvAdharmeNa rAjAnaM dharmAtmAnaM suyodhanam |
jihmayodhIti loke.asminkhyAtiM yAsyati pANDavaH
shlokas.24:
duryodhano.api dharmAtmA gatiM yAsyati shAshvatIm |
RRijuyodhI hato rAjA dhArtarAShTro narAdhipaH
shlokas.25:
yuddhadIkShAM pravishyAjau raNayaj~naM vitatya cha |
hutvAtmAnamamitrAgnau prApa chAvabhRRithaM yashaH
shlokas.26:
ityuktvA rathamAsthAya rauhiNeyaH pratApavAn |
shvetAbhrashikharAkAraH prayayau dvArakAM prati
shlokas.27:
pA~nchAlAshcha savArShNeyAH pANDavAshcha vishAM pate |
rAme dvAravatIM yAte nAtipramanaso.abhavan
shlokas.28:
tato yudhiShThiraM dInaM chintAparamadhomukham |
shokopahatasa~NkalpaM vAsudevo.abravIdidam
shlokas.29:
dharmarAja kimarthaM tvamadharmamanumanyase |
hatabandhoryadetasya patitasya vichetasaH
shlokas.30:
duryodhanasya bhImena mRRidyamAnaM shiraH padA |
upaprekShasi kasmAttvaM dharmaj~naH sannarAdhipa
shlokas.31:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na mamaitatpriyaM kRRiShNa yadrAjAnaM vRRikodaraH |
padA mUrdhnyaspRRishatkrodhAnna cha hRRiShye kulakShaye
shlokas.32:
nikRRityA nikRRitA nityaM dhRRitarAShTrasutairvayam |
bahUni paruShANyuktvA vanaM prasthApitAH sma ha
shlokas.33:
bhImasenasya tadduHkhamatIva hRRidi vartate |
iti sa~nchintya vArShNeya mayaitatsamupekShitam
shlokas.34:
tasmAddhatvAkRRitapraj~naM lubdhaM kAmavashAnugam |
labhatAM pANDavaH kAmaM dharme.adharme.api vA kRRite
shlokas.35:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ityukte dharmarAjena vAsudevo.abravIdidam |
kAmamastvevamiti vai kRRichChrAdyadukulodvahaH
shlokas.36:
ityukto vAsudevena bhImapriyahitaiShiNA |
anvamodata tatsarvaM yadbhImena kRRitaM yudhi
shlokas.37:
bhImaseno.api hatvAjau tava putramamarShaNaH |
abhivAdyAgrataH sthitvA samprahRRiShTaH kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.38:
provAcha sumahAtejA dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
harShAdutphullanayano jitakAshI vishAM pate
shlokas.39:
tavAdya pRRithivI rAjankShemA nihatakaNTakA |
tAM prashAdhi mahArAja svadharmamanupAlayan
shlokas.40:
yastu kartAsya vairasya nikRRityA nikRRitipriyaH |
so.ayaM vinihataH shete pRRithivyAM pRRithivIpate
shlokas.41:
duHshAsanaprabhRRitayaH sarve te chogravAdinaH |
rAdheyaH shakunishchApi nihatAstava shatravaH
shlokas.42:
seyaM ratnasamAkIrNA mahI savanaparvatA |
upAvRRittA mahArAja tvAmadya nihatadviSham
shlokas.43:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
gataM vairasya nidhanaM hato rAjA suyodhanaH |
kRRiShNasya matamAsthAya vijiteyaM vasundharA
shlokas.44:
diShTyA gatastvamAnRRiNyaM mAtuH kopasya chobhayoH |
diShTyA jayasi durdharSha diShTyA shatrurnipAtitaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
hataM duryodhanaM dRRiShTvA bhImasenena sa.nyuge |
pANDavAH sRRi~njayAshchaiva kimakurvata sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hataM duryodhanaM dRRiShTvA bhImasenena sa.nyuge |
siMheneva mahArAja mattaM vanagajaM vane
shlokas.3:
prahRRiShTamanasastatra kRRiShNena saha pANDavAH |
pA~nchAlAH sRRi~njayAshchaiva nihate kurunandane
shlokas.4:
AvidhyannuttarIyANi siMhanAdA.nshcha nedire |
naitAnharShasamAviShTAniyaM sehe vasundharA
shlokas.5:
dhanUMShyanye vyAkShipanta jyAshchApyanye tathAkShipan |
dadhmuranye mahAsha~NkhAnanye jaghnushcha dundubhIH
shlokas.6:
chikrIDushcha tathaivAnye jahasushcha tavAhitAH |
abruva.nshchAsakRRidvIrA bhImasenamidaM vachaH
shlokas.7:
duShkaraM bhavatA karma raNe.adya sumahatkRRitam |
kauravendraM raNe hatvA gadayAtikRRitashramam
shlokas.8:
indreNeva hi vRRitrasya vadhaM paramasa.nyuge |
tvayA kRRitamamanyanta shatrorvadhamimaM janAH
shlokas.9:
charantaM vividhAnmArgAnmaNDalAni cha sarvashaH |
duryodhanamimaM shUraM ko.anyo hanyAdvRRikodarAt
shlokas.10:
vairasya cha gataH pAraM tvamihAnyaiH sudurgamam |
ashakyametadanyena sampAdayitumIdRRisham
shlokas.11:
ku~njareNeva mattena vIra sa~NgrAmamUrdhani |
duryodhanashiro diShTyA pAdena mRRiditaM tvayA
shlokas.12:
siMhena mahiShasyeva kRRitvA sa~Ngaramadbhutam |
duHshAsanasya rudhiraM diShTyA pItaM tvayAnagha
shlokas.13:
ye viprakurvanrAjAnaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
mUrdhni teShAM kRRitaH pAdo diShTyA te svena karmaNA
shlokas.14:
amitrANAmadhiShThAnAdvadhAdduryodhanasya cha |
bhIma diShTyA pRRithivyAM te prathitaM sumahadyashaH
shlokas.15:
evaM nUnaM hate vRRitre shakraM nandanti bandinaH |
tathA tvAM nihatAmitraM vayaM nandAma bhArata
shlokas.16:
duryodhanavadhe yAni romANi hRRiShitAni naH |
adyApi na vihRRiShyanti tAni tadviddhi bhArata
ityabruvanbhImasenaM vAtikAstatra sa~NgatAH
shlokas.17:
tAnhRRiShTAnpuruShavyAghrAnpA~nchAlAnpANDavaiH saha |
bruvataH sadRRishaM tatra provAcha madhusUdanaH
shlokas.18:
na nyAyyaM nihataH shatrurbhUyo hantuM janAdhipAH |
asakRRidvAgbhirugrAbhirnihato hyeSha mandadhIH
shlokas.19:
tadaivaiSha hataH pApo yadaiva nirapatrapaH |
lubdhaH pApasahAyashcha suhRRidAM shAsanAtigaH
shlokas.20:
bahusho viduradroNakRRipagA~NgeyasRRi~njayaiH |
pANDubhyaH prochyamAno.api pitryama.nshaM na dattavAn
shlokas.21:
naiSha yogyo.adya mitraM vA shatrurvA puruShAdhamaH |
kimanenAtinunnena vAgbhiH kAShThasadharmaNA
shlokas.22:
ratheShvArohata kShipraM gachChAmo vasudhAdhipAH |
diShTyA hato.ayaM pApAtmA sAmAtyaj~nAtibAndhavaH
shlokas.23:
iti shrutvA tvadhikShepaM kRRiShNAdduryodhano nRRipaH |
amarShavashamApanna udatiShThadvishAM pate
shlokas.24:
sphigdeshenopaviShTaH sa dorbhyAM viShTabhya medinIm |
dRRiShTiM bhrUsa~NkaTAM kRRitvA vAsudeve nyapAtayat
shlokas.25:
ardhonnatasharIrasya rUpamAsInnRRipasya tat |
kruddhasyAshIviShasyeva chChinnapuchChasya bhArata
shlokas.26:
prANAntakaraNIM ghorAM vedanAmavichintayan |
duryodhano vAsudevaM vAgbhirugrAbhirArdayat
shlokas.27:
ka.nsadAsasya dAyAda na te lajjAstyanena vai |
adharmeNa gadAyuddhe yadahaM vinipAtitaH
shlokas.28:
UrU bhindhIti bhImasya smRRitiM mithyA prayachChatA |
kiM na vij~nAtametanme yadarjunamavochathAH
shlokas.29:
ghAtayitvA mahIpAlAnRRijuyuddhAnsahasrashaH |
jihmairupAyairbahubhirna te lajjA na te ghRRiNA
shlokas.30:
ahanyahani shUrANAM kurvANaH kadanaM mahat |
shikhaNDinaM puraskRRitya ghAtitaste pitAmahaH
shlokas.31:
ashvatthAmnaH sanAmAnaM hatvA nAgaM sudurmate |
AchAryo nyAsitaH shastraM kiM tanna viditaM mama
shlokas.32:
sa chAnena nRRisha.nsena dhRRiShTadyumnena vIryavAn |
pAtyamAnastvayA dRRiShTo na chainaM tvamavArayaH
shlokas.33:
vadhArthaM pANDuputrasya yAchitAM shaktimeva cha |
ghaTotkache vya.nsayathAH kastvattaH pApakRRittamaH
shlokas.34:
ChinnabAhuH prAyagatastathA bhUrishravA balI |
tvayA nisRRiShTena hataH shaineyena durAtmanA
shlokas.35:
kurvANashchottamaM karma karNaH pArthajigIShayA |
vya.nsanenAshvasenasya pannagendrasutasya vai
shlokas.36:
punashcha patite chakre vyasanArtaH parAjitaH |
pAtitaH samare karNashchakravyagro.agraNIrnRRiNAm
shlokas.37:
yadi mAM chApi karNaM cha bhIShmadroNau cha sa.nyuge |
RRijunA pratiyudhyethA na te syAdvijayo dhruvam
shlokas.38:
tvayA punaranAryeNa jihmamArgeNa pArthivAH |
svadharmamanutiShThanto vayaM chAnye cha ghAtitAH
shlokas.39:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
hatastvamasi gAndhAre sabhrAtRRisutabAndhavaH |
sagaNaH sasuhRRichchaiva pApamArgamanuShThitaH
shlokas.40:
tavaiva duShkRRitairvIrau bhIShmadroNau nipAtitau |
karNashcha nihataH sa~Nkhye tava shIlAnuvartakaH
shlokas.41:
yAchyamAno mayA mUDha pitryama.nshaM na ditsasi |
pANDavebhyaH svarAjyArdhaM lobhAchChakuninishchayAt
shlokas.42:
viShaM te bhImasenAya dattaM sarve cha pANDavAH |
pradIpitA jatugRRihe mAtrA saha sudurmate
shlokas.43:
sabhAyAM yAj~nasenI cha kRRiShTA dyUte rajasvalA |
tadaiva tAvadduShTAtmanvadhyastvaM nirapatrapaH
shlokas.44:
anakShaj~naM cha dharmaj~naM saubalenAkShavedinA |
nikRRityA yatparAjaiShIstasmAdasi hato raNe
shlokas.45:
jayadrathena pApena yatkRRiShNA kleshitA vane |
yAteShu mRRigayAM teShu tRRiNabindorathAshrame
shlokas.46:
abhimanyushcha yadbAla eko bahubhirAhave |
tvaddoShairnihataH pApa tasmAdasi hato raNe
shlokas.47:
duryodhana uvAcha||
adhItaM vidhivaddattaM bhUH prashAstA sasAgarA |
mUrdhni sthitamamitrANAM ko nu svantataro mayA
shlokas.48:
yadiShTaM kShatrabandhUnAM svadharmamanupashyatAm |
tadidaM nidhanaM prAptaM ko nu svantataro mayA
shlokas.49:
devArhA mAnuShA bhogAH prAptA asulabhA nRRipaiH |
aishvaryaM chottamaM prAptaM ko nu svantataro mayA
shlokas.50:
sasuhRRitsAnubandhashcha svargaM gantAhamachyuta |
yUyaM vihatasa~NkalpAH shochanto vartayiShyatha
shlokas.51:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
asya vAkyasya nidhane kururAjasya bhArata |
apatatsumahadvarShaM puShpANAM puNyagandhinAm
shlokas.52:
avAdayanta gandharvA jagushchApsarasAM gaNAH |
siddhAshcha mumuchurvAchaH sAdhu sAdhviti bhArata
shlokas.53:
vavau cha surabhirvAyuH puNyagandho mRRiduH sukhaH |
vyarAjatAmalaM chaiva nabho vaiDUryasaMnibham
shlokas.54:
atyadbhutAni te dRRiShTvA vAsudevapurogamAH |
duryodhanasya pUjAM cha dRRiShTvA vrIDAmupAgaman
shlokas.55:
hatA.nshchAdharmataH shrutvA shokArtAH shushuchurhi te |
bhIShmaM droNaM tathA karNaM bhUrishravasameva cha
shlokas.56:
tA.nstu chintAparAndRRiShTvA pANDavAndInachetasaH |
provAchedaM vachaH kRRiShNo meghadundubhinisvanaH
shlokas.57:
naiSha shakyo.atishIghrAstraste cha sarve mahArathAH |
RRijuyuddhena vikrAntA hantuM yuShmAbhirAhave
shlokas.58:
upAyA vihitA hyete mayA tasmAnnarAdhipAH |
anyathA pANDaveyAnAM nAbhaviShyajjayaH kvachit
shlokas.59:
te hi sarve mahAtmAnashchatvAro.atirathA bhuvi |
na shakyA dharmato hantuM lokapAlairapi svayam
shlokas.60:
tathaivAyaM gadApANirdhArtarAShTro gataklamaH |
na shakyo dharmato hantuM kAlenApIha daNDinA
shlokas.61:
na cha vo hRRidi kartavyaM yadayaM ghAtito nRRipaH |
mithyAvadhyAstathopAyairbahavaH shatravo.adhikAH
shlokas.62:
pUrvairanugato mArgo devairasuraghAtibhiH |
sadbhishchAnugataH panthAH sa sarvairanugamyate
shlokas.63:
kRRitakRRityAH sma sAyAhne nivAsaM rochayAmahe |
sAshvanAgarathAH sarve vishramAmo narAdhipAH
shlokas.64:
vAsudevavachaH shrutvA tadAnIM pANDavaiH saha |
pA~nchAlA bhRRishasaMhRRiShTA vineduH siMhasa~Nghavat
shlokas.65:
tataH prAdhmApaya~nsha~NkhAnpA~nchajanyaM cha mAdhavaH |
hRRiShTA duryodhanaM dRRiShTvA nihataM puruSharShabhAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataste prayayuH sarve nivAsAya mahIkShitaH |
sha~NkhAnpradhmApayanto vai hRRiShTAH parighabAhavaH
shlokas.2:
pANDavAngachChatashchApi shibiraM no vishAM pate |
maheShvAso.anvagAtpashchAdyuyutsuH sAtyakistathA
shlokas.3:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha draupadeyAshcha sarvashaH |
sarve chAnye maheShvAsA yayuH svashibirANyuta
shlokas.4:
tataste prAvishanpArthA hatatviTkaM hateshvaram |
duryodhanasya shibiraM ra~NgavadvisRRite jane
shlokas.5:
gatotsavaM puramiva hRRitanAgamiva hradam |
strIvarShavarabhUyiShThaM vRRiddhAmAtyairadhiShThitam
shlokas.6:
tatraitAnparyupAtiShThanduryodhanapuraHsarAH |
kRRitA~njalipuTA rAjankAShAyamalinAmbarAH
shlokas.7:
shibiraM samanuprApya kururAjasya pANDavAH |
avaterurmahArAja rathebhyo rathasattamAH
shlokas.8:
tato gANDIvadhanvAnamabhyabhAShata keshavaH |
sthitaH priyahite nityamatIva bharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
avaropaya gANDIvamakShayyau cha maheShudhI |
athAhamavarokShyAmi pashchAdbharatasattama
shlokas.10:
svayaM chaivAvaroha tvametachChreyastavAnagha |
tachchAkarottathA vIraH pANDuputro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.11:
atha pashchAttataH kRRiShNo rashmInutsRRijya vAjinAm |
avArohata medhAvI rathAdgANDIvadhanvanaH
shlokas.12:
athAvatIrNe bhUtAnAmIshvare sumahAtmani |
kapirantardadhe divyo dhvajo gANDIvadhanvanaH
shlokas.13:
sa dagdho droNakarNAbhyAM divyairastrairmahArathaH |
atha dIpto.agninA hyAshu prajajvAla mahIpate
shlokas.14:
sopAsa~NgaH sarashmishcha sAshvaH sayugabandhuraH |
bhasmIbhUto.apatadbhUmau ratho gANDIvadhanvanaH
shlokas.15:
taM tathA bhasmabhUtaM tu dRRiShTvA pANDusutAH prabho |
abhavanvismitA rAjannarjunashchedamabravIt
shlokas.16:
kRRitA~njaliH sapraNayaM praNipatyAbhivAdya cha |
govinda kasmAdbhagavanratho dagdho.ayamagninA
shlokas.17:
kimetanmahadAshcharyamabhavadyadunandana |
tanme brUhi mahAbAho shrotavyaM yadi manyase
shlokas.18:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
astrairbahuvidhairdagdhaH pUrvamevAyamarjuna |
madadhiShThitatvAtsamare na vishIrNaH parantapa
shlokas.19:
idAnIM tu vishIrNo.ayaM dagdho brahmAstratejasA |
mayA vimuktaH kaunteya tvayyadya kRRitakarmaNi
shlokas.20:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
IShadutsmayamAnashcha bhagavAnkeshavo.arihA |
pariShvajya cha rAjAnaM yudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.21:
diShTyA jayasi kaunteya diShTyA te shatravo jitAH |
diShTyA gANDIvadhanvA cha bhImasenashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.22:
tvaM chApi kushalI rAjanmAdrIputrau cha pANDavau |
muktA vIrakShayAdasmAtsa~NgrAmAnnihatadviShaH
kShipramuttarakAlAni kuru kAryANi bhArata
shlokas.23:
upayAtamupaplavyaM saha gANDIvadhanvanA |
AnIya madhuparkaM mAM yatpurA tvamavochathAH
shlokas.24:
eSha bhrAtA sakhA chaiva tava kRRiShNa dhana~njayaH |
rakShitavyo mahAbAho sarvAsvApatsviti prabho
tava chaivaM bruvANasya tathetyevAhamabruvam
shlokas.25:
sa savyasAchI guptaste vijayI cha nareshvara |
bhrAtRRibhiH saha rAjendra shUraH satyaparAkramaH
mukto vIrakShayAdasmAtsa~NgrAmAdromaharShaNAt
shlokas.26:
evamuktastu kRRiShNena dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
hRRiShTaromA mahArAja pratyuvAcha janArdanam
shlokas.27:
pramuktaM droNakarNAbhyAM brahmAstramarimardana |
kastvadanyaH sahetsAkShAdapi vajrI pura.ndaraH
shlokas.28:
bhavatastu prasAdena sa~NgrAme bahavo jitAH |
mahAraNagataH pArtho yachcha nAsItparA~NmukhaH
shlokas.29:
tathaiva cha mahAbAho paryAyairbahubhirmayA |
karmaNAmanusantAnaM tejasashcha gatiH shubhA
shlokas.30:
upaplavye maharShirme kRRiShNadvaipAyano.abravIt |
yato dharmastataH kRRiShNo yataH kRRiShNastato jayaH
shlokas.31:
ityevamukte te vIrAH shibiraM tava bhArata |
pravishya pratyapadyanta kosharatnarddhisa~nchayAn
shlokas.32:
rajataM jAtarUpaM cha maNInatha cha mauktikAn |
bhUShaNAnyatha mukhyAni kambalAnyajinAni cha
dAsIdAsamasa~NkhyeyaM rAjyopakaraNAni cha
shlokas.33:
te prApya dhanamakShayyaM tvadIyaM bharatarShabha |
udakroshanmaheShvAsA narendra vijitArayaH
shlokas.34:
te tu vIrAH samAshvasya vAhanAnyavamuchya cha |
atiShThanta muhuH sarve pANDavAH sAtyakistathA
shlokas.35:
athAbravInmahArAja vAsudevo mahAyashAH |
asmAbhirma~NgalArthAya vastavyaM shibirAdbahiH
shlokas.36:
tathetyuktvA cha te sarve pANDavAH sAtyakistathA |
vAsudevena sahitA ma~NgalArthaM yayurbahiH
shlokas.37:
te samAsAdya saritaM puNyAmoghavatIM nRRipa |
nyavasannatha tAM rAtriM pANDavA hatashatravaH
shlokas.38:
tataH sampreShayAmAsuryAdavaM nAgasAhvayam |
sa cha prAyAjjavenAshu vAsudevaH pratApavAn
dArukaM rathamAropya yena rAjAmbikAsutaH
shlokas.39:
tamUchuH samprayAsyantaM sainyasugrIvavAhanam |
pratyAshvAsaya gAndhArIM hataputrAM yashasvinIm
shlokas.40:
sa prAyAtpANDavairuktastatpuraM sAtvatAM varaH |
AsasAdayiShuH kShipraM gAndhArIM nihatAtmajAm

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kimarthaM rAjashArdUlo dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
gAndhAryAH preShayAmAsa vAsudevaM parantapam
shlokas.2:
yadA pUrvaM gataH kRRiShNaH shamArthaM kauravAnprati |
na cha taM labdhavAnkAmaM tato yuddhamabhUdidam
shlokas.3:
nihateShu tu yodheShu hate duryodhane tathA |
pRRithivyAM pANDaveyasya niHsapatne kRRite yudhi
shlokas.4:
vidrute shibire shUnye prApte yashasi chottame |
kiM nu tatkAraNaM brahmanyena kRRiShNo gataH punaH
shlokas.5:
na chaitatkAraNaM brahmannalpaM vai pratibhAti me |
yatrAgamadameyAtmA svayameva janArdanaH
shlokas.6:
tattvato vai samAchakShva sarvamadhvaryusattama |
yachchAtra kAraNaM brahmankAryasyAsya vinishchaye
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tvadyukto.ayamanuprashno yanmAM pRRichChasi pArthiva |
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi yathAvadbharatarShabha
shlokas.8:
hataM duryodhanaM dRRiShTvA bhImasenena sa.nyuge |
vyutkramya samayaM rAjandhArtarAShTraM mahAbalam
shlokas.9:
anyAyena hataM dRRiShTvA gadAyuddhena bhArata |
yudhiShThiraM mahArAja mahadbhayamathAvishat
shlokas.10:
chintayAno mahAbhAgAM gAndhArIM tapasAnvitAm |
ghoreNa tapasA yuktAM trailokyamapi sA dahet
shlokas.11:
tasya chintayamAnasya buddhiH samabhavattadA |
gAndhAryAH krodhadIptAyAH pUrvaM prashamanaM bhavet
shlokas.12:
sA hi putravadhaM shrutvA kRRitamasmAbhirIdRRisham |
mAnasenAgninA kruddhA bhasmasAnnaH kariShyati
shlokas.13:
kathaM duHkhamidaM tIvraM gAndhArI prasahiShyati |
shrutvA vinihataM putraM ChalenAjihmayodhinam
shlokas.14:
evaM vichintya bahudhA bhayashokasamanvitaH |
vAsudevamidaM vAkyaM dharmarAjo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.15:
tava prasAdAdgovinda rAjyaM nihatakaNTakam |
aprApyaM manasApIha prAptamasmAbhirachyuta
shlokas.16:
pratyakShaM me mahAbAho sa~NgrAme romaharShaNe |
vimardaH sumahAnprAptastvayA yAdavanandana
shlokas.17:
tvayA devAsure yuddhe vadhArthamamaradviShAm |
yathA sAhyaM purA dattaM hatAshcha vibudhadviShaH
shlokas.18:
sAhyaM tathA mahAbAho dattamasmAkamachyuta |
sArathyena cha vArShNeya bhavatA yaddhRRitA vayam
shlokas.19:
yadi na tvaM bhavennAthaH phalgunasya mahAraNe |
kathaM shakyo raNe jetuM bhavedeSha balArNavaH
shlokas.20:
gadAprahArA vipulAH parighaishchApi tADanam |
shaktibhirbhiNDipAlaishcha tomaraiH saparashvadhaiH
shlokas.21:
vAchashcha paruShAH prAptAstvayA hyasmaddhitaiShiNA |
tAshcha te saphalAH sarvA hate duryodhane.achyuta
shlokas.22:
gAndhAryA hi mahAbAho krodhaM budhyasva mAdhava |
sA hi nityaM mahAbhAgA tapasogreNa karshitA
shlokas.23:
putrapautravadhaM shrutvA dhruvaM naH sampradhakShyati |
tasyAH prasAdanaM vIra prAptakAlaM mataM mama
shlokas.24:
kashcha tAM krodhadIptAkShIM putravyasanakarshitAm |
vIkShituM puruShaH shaktastvAmRRite puruShottama
shlokas.25:
tatra me gamanaM prAptaM rochate tava mAdhava |
gAndhAryAH krodhadIptAyAH prashamArthamari.ndama
shlokas.26:
tvaM hi kartA vikartA cha lokAnAM prabhavApyayaH |
hetukAraNasa.nyuktairvAkyaiH kAlasamIritaiH
shlokas.27:
kShiprameva mahAprAj~na gAndhArIM shamayiShyasi |
pitAmahashcha bhagavAnkRRiShNastatra bhaviShyati
shlokas.28:
sarvathA te mahAbAho gAndhAryAH krodhanAshanam |
kartavyaM sAtvatashreShTha pANDavAnAM hitaiShiNA
shlokas.29:
dharmarAjasya vachanaM shrutvA yadukulodvahaH |
Amantrya dArukaM prAha rathaH sajjo vidhIyatAm
shlokas.30:
keshavasya vachaH shrutvA tvaramANo.atha dArukaH |
nyavedayadrathaM sajjaM keshavAya mahAtmane
shlokas.31:
taM rathaM yAdavashreShThaH samAruhya parantapaH |
jagAma hAstinapuraM tvaritaH keshavo vibhuH
shlokas.32:
tataH prAyAnmahArAja mAdhavo bhagavAnrathI |
nAgasAhvayamAsAdya pravivesha cha vIryavAn
shlokas.33:
pravishya nagaraM vIro rathaghoSheNa nAdayan |
vidito dhRRitarAShTrasya so.avatIrya rathottamAt
shlokas.34:
abhyagachChadadInAtmA dhRRitarAShTraniveshanam |
pUrvaM chAbhigataM tatra so.apashyadRRiShisattamam
shlokas.35:
pAdau prapIDya kRRiShNasya rAj~nashchApi janArdanaH |
abhyavAdayadavyagro gAndhArIM chApi keshavaH
shlokas.36:
tatastu yAdavashreShTho dhRRitarAShTramadhokShajaH |
pANimAlambya rAj~naH sa sasvaraM praruroda ha
shlokas.37:
sa muhUrtamivotsRRijya bAShpaM shokasamudbhavam |
prakShAlya vAriNA netre Achamya cha yathAvidhi
uvAcha prashritaM vAkyaM dhRRitarAShTramari.ndamaH
shlokas.38:
na te.astyaviditaM ki~nchidbhUtabhavyasya bhArata |
kAlasya cha yathA vRRittaM tatte suviditaM prabho
shlokas.39:
yadidaM pANDavaiH sarvaistava chittAnurodhibhiH |
kathaM kulakShayo na syAttathA kShatrasya bhArata
shlokas.40:
bhrAtRRibhiH samayaM kRRitvA kShAntavAndharmavatsalaH |
dyUtachChalajitaiH shaktairvanavAso.abhyupAgataH
shlokas.41:
aj~nAtavAsacharyA cha nAnAveshasamAvRRitaiH |
anye cha bahavaH kleshAstvashaktairiva nityadA
shlokas.42:
mayA cha svayamAgamya yuddhakAla upasthite |
sarvalokasya sAMnidhye grAmA.nstvaM pa~ncha yAchitaH
shlokas.43:
tvayA kAlopasRRiShTena lobhato nApavarjitAH |
tavAparAdhAnnRRipate sarvaM kShatraM kShayaM gatam
shlokas.44:
bhIShmeNa somadattena bAhlikena kRRipeNa cha |
droNena cha saputreNa vidureNa cha dhImatA
yAchitastvaM shamaM nityaM na cha tatkRRitavAnasi
shlokas.45:
kAlopahatachitto hi sarvo muhyati bhArata |
yathA mUDho bhavAnpUrvamasminnarthe samudyate
shlokas.46:
kimanyatkAlayogAddhi diShTameva parAyaNam |
mA cha doShaM mahArAja pANDaveShu niveshaya
shlokas.47:
alpo.apyatikramo nAsti pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
dharmato nyAyatashchaiva snehatashcha parantapa
shlokas.48:
etatsarvaM tu vij~nAya AtmadoShakRRitaM phalam |
asUyAM pANDuputreShu na bhavAnkartumarhati
shlokas.49:
kulaM va.nshashcha piNDashcha yachcha putrakRRitaM phalam |
gAndhAryAstava chaivAdya pANDaveShu pratiShThitam
shlokas.50:
etatsarvamanudhyAtvA Atmanashcha vyatikramam |
shivena pANDavAndhyAhi namaste bharatarShabha
shlokas.51:
jAnAsi cha mahAbAho dharmarAjasya yA tvayi |
bhaktirbharatashArdUla snehashchApi svabhAvataH
shlokas.52:
etachcha kadanaM kRRitvA shatrUNAmapakAriNAm |
dahyate sma divArAtraM na cha sharmAdhigachChati
shlokas.53:
tvAM chaiva narashArdUla gAndhArIM cha yashasvinIm |
sa shochanbharatashreShTha na shAntimadhigachChati
shlokas.54:
hriyA cha parayAviShTo bhavantaM nAdhigachChati |
putrashokAbhisantaptaM buddhivyAkulitendriyam
shlokas.55:
evamuktvA mahArAja dhRRitarAShTraM yadUttamaH |
uvAcha paramaM vAkyaM gAndhArIM shokakarshitAm
shlokas.56:
saubaleyi nibodha tvaM yattvAM vakShyAmi suvrate |
tvatsamA nAsti loke.asminnadya sImantinI shubhe
shlokas.57:
jAnAmi cha yathA rAj~ni sabhAyAM mama saMnidhau |
dharmArthasahitaM vAkyamubhayoH pakShayorhitam
uktavatyasi kalyANi na cha te tanayaiH shrutam
shlokas.58:
duryodhanastvayA chokto jayArthI paruShaM vachaH |
shRRiNu mUDha vacho mahyaM yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.59:
tadidaM samanuprAptaM tava vAkyaM nRRipAtmaje |
evaM viditvA kalyANi mA sma shoke manaH kRRithAH
pANDavAnAM vinAshAya mA te buddhiH kadAchana
shlokas.60:
shaktA chAsi mahAbhAge pRRithivIM sacharAcharAm |
chakShuShA krodhadIptena nirdagdhuM tapaso balAt
shlokas.61:
vAsudevavachaH shrutvA gAndhArI vAkyamabravIt |
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi keshava
shlokas.62:
AdhibhirdahyamAnAyA matiH sa~nchalitA mama |
sA me vyavasthitA shrutvA tava vAkyaM janArdana
shlokas.63:
rAj~nastvandhasya vRRiddhasya hataputrasya keshava |
tvaM gatiH saha tairvIraiH pANDavairdvipadAM vara
shlokas.64:
etAvaduktvA vachanaM mukhaM prachChAdya vAsasA |
putrashokAbhisantaptA gAndhArI praruroda ha
shlokas.66:
samAshvAsya cha gAndhArIM dhRRitarAShTraM cha mAdhavaH |
drauNeH sa~NkalpitaM bhAvamanvabudhyata keshavaH
shlokas.67:
tatastvarita utthAya pAdau mUrdhnA praNamya cha |
dvaipAyanasya rAjendra tataH kauravamabravIt
shlokas.68:
ApRRichChe tvAM kurushreShTha mA cha shoke manaH kRRithAH |
drauNeH pApo.astyabhiprAyastenAsmi sahasotthitaH
pANDavAnAM vadhe rAtrau buddhistena pradarshitA
shlokas.69:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM gAndhAryA sahito.abravIt |
dhRRitarAShTro mahAbAhuH keshavaM keshisUdanam
shlokas.70:
shIghraM gachCha mahAbAho pANDavAnparipAlaya |
bhUyastvayA sameShyAmi kShiprameva janArdana
prAyAttatastu tvarito dArukeNa sahAchyutaH
shlokas.71:
vAsudeve gate rAjandhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram |
AshvAsayadameyAtmA vyAso lokanamaskRRitaH
shlokas.72:
vAsudevo.api dharmAtmA kRRitakRRityo jagAma ha |
shibiraM hAstinapurAddidRRikShuH pANDavAnnRRipa
shlokas.73:
Agamya shibiraM rAtrau so.abhyagachChata pANDavAn |
tachcha tebhyaH samAkhyAya sahitastaiH samAvishat

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
adhiShThitaH padA mUrdhni bhagnasaktho mahIM gataH |
shauTIramAnI putro me kAnyabhAShata sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
atyarthaM kopano rAjA jAtavairashcha pANDuShu |
vyasanaM paramaM prAptaH kimAha paramAhave
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanpravakShyAmi yathAvRRittaM narAdhipa |
rAj~nA yaduktaM bhagnena tasminvyasana Agate
shlokas.4:
bhagnasaktho nRRipo rAjanpA.nsunA so.avaguNThitaH |
yamayanmUrdhajA.nstatra vIkShya chaiva disho dasha
shlokas.5:
keshAnniyamya yatnena niHshvasannurago yathA |
sa.nrambhAshruparItAbhyAM netrAbhyAmabhivIkShya mAm
shlokas.6:
bAhU dharaNyAM niShpiShya muhurmatta iva dvipaH |
prakIrNAnmUrdhajAndhunvandantairdantAnupaspRRishan
garhayanpANDavaM jyeShThaM niHshvasyedamathAbravIt
shlokas.7:
bhIShme shAntanave nAthe karNe chAstrabhRRitAM vare |
gautame shakunau chApi droNe chAstrabhRRitAM vare
shlokas.8:
ashvatthAmni tathA shalye shUre cha kRRitavarmaNi |
imAmavasthAM prApto.asmi kAlo hi duratikramaH
shlokas.9:
ekAdashachamUbhartA so.ahametAM dashAM gataH |
kAlaM prApya mahAbAho na kashchidativartate
shlokas.10:
AkhyAtavyaM madIyAnAM ye.asmi~njIvanti sa~Ngare |
yathAhaM bhImasenena vyutkramya samayaM hataH
shlokas.11:
bahUni sunRRisha.nsAni kRRitAni khalu pANDavaiH |
bhUrishravasi karNe cha bhIShme droNe cha shrImati
shlokas.12:
idaM chAkIrtijaM karma nRRisha.nsaiH pANDavaiH kRRitam |
yena te satsu nirvedaM gamiShyantIti me matiH
shlokas.13:
kA prItiH sattvayuktasya kRRitvopadhikRRitaM jayam |
ko vA samayabhettAraM budhaH saMmantumarhati
shlokas.14:
adharmeNa jayaM labdhvA ko nu hRRiShyeta paNDitaH |
yathA saMhRRiShyate pApaH pANDuputro vRRikodaraH
shlokas.15:
kiM nu chitramatastvadya bhagnasakthasya yanmama |
kruddhena bhImasenena pAdena mRRiditaM shiraH
shlokas.16:
pratapantaM shriyA juShTaM vartamAnaM cha bandhuShu |
evaM kuryAnnaro yo hi sa vai sa~njaya pUjitaH
shlokas.17:
abhij~nau kShatradharmasya mama mAtA pitA cha me |
tau hi sa~njaya duHkhArtau vij~nApyau vachanAnmama
shlokas.18:
iShTaM bhRRityA bhRRitAH samyagbhUH prashAstA sasAgarA |
mUrdhni sthitamamitrANAM jIvatAmeva sa~njaya
shlokas.19:
dattA dAyA yathAshakti mitrANAM cha priyaM kRRitam |
amitrA bAdhitAH sarve ko nu svantataro mayA
shlokas.20:
yAtAni pararAShTrANi nRRipA bhuktAshcha dAsavat |
priyebhyaH prakRRitaM sAdhu ko nu svantataro mayA
shlokas.21:
mAnitA bAndhavAH sarve mAnyaH sampUjito janaH |
tritayaM sevitaM sarvaM ko nu svantataro mayA
shlokas.22:
Aj~naptaM nRRipamukhyeShu mAnaH prAptaH sudurlabhaH |
AjAneyaistathA yAtaM ko nu svantataro mayA
shlokas.23:
adhItaM vidhivaddattaM prAptamAyurnirAmayam |
svadharmeNa jitA lokAH ko nu svantataro mayA
shlokas.24:
diShTyA nAhaM jitaH sa~Nkhye parAnpreShyavadAshritaH |
diShTyA me vipulA lakShmIrmRRite tvanyaM gatA vibho
shlokas.25:
yadiShTaM kShatrabandhUnAM svadharmamanutiShThatAm |
nidhanaM tanmayA prAptaM ko nu svantataro mayA
shlokas.26:
diShTyA nAhaM parAvRRitto vairAtprAkRRitavajjitaH |
diShTyA na vimatiM kA~nchidbhajitvA tu parAjitaH
shlokas.27:
suptaM vAtha pramattaM vA yathA hanyAdviSheNa vA |
evaM vyutkrAntadharmeNa vyutkramya samayaM hataH
shlokas.28:
ashvatthAmA mahAbhAgaH kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
kRRipaH shAradvatashchaiva vaktavyA vachanAnmama
shlokas.29:
adharmeNa pravRRittAnAM pANDavAnAmanekashaH |
vishvAsaM samayaghnAnAM na yUyaM gantumarhatha
shlokas.30:
vAtikA.nshchAbravIdrAjA putraste satyavikramaH |
adharmAdbhImasenena nihato.ahaM yathA raNe
shlokas.31:
so.ahaM droNaM svargagataM shalyakarNAvubhau tathA |
vRRiShasenaM mahAvIryaM shakuniM chApi saubalam
shlokas.32:
jalasandhaM mahAvIryaM bhagadattaM cha pArthivam |
saumadattiM maheShvAsaM saindhavaM cha jayadratham
shlokas.33:
duHshAsanapurogA.nshcha bhrAtR^InAtmasamA.nstathA |
dauHshAsaniM cha vikrAntaM lakShmaNaM chAtmajAvubhau
shlokas.34:
etA.nshchAnyA.nshcha subahUnmadIyA.nshcha sahasrashaH |
pRRiShThato.anugamiShyAmi sArthahIna ivAdhvagaH
shlokas.35:
kathaM bhrAtR^InhatA~nshrutvA bhartAraM cha svasA mama |
rorUyamANA duHkhArtA duHshalA sA bhaviShyati
shlokas.36:
snuShAbhiH prasnuShAbhishcha vRRiddho rAjA pitA mama |
gAndhArIsahitaH kroshankAM gatiM pratipatsyate
shlokas.37:
nUnaM lakShmaNamAtApi hataputrA hateshvarA |
vinAshaM yAsyati kShipraM kalyANI pRRithulochanA
shlokas.38:
yadi jAnAti chArvAkaH parivrADvAgvishAradaH |
kariShyati mahAbhAgo dhruvaM so.apachitiM mama
shlokas.39:
samantapa~nchake puNye triShu lokeShu vishrute |
ahaM nidhanamAsAdya lokAnprApsyAmi shAshvatAn
shlokas.40:
tato janasahasrANi bAShpapUrNAni mAriSha |
pralApaM nRRipateH shrutvA vidravanti disho dasha
shlokas.41:
sasAgaravanA ghorA pRRithivI sacharAcharA |
chachAlAtha sanirhrAdA dishashchaivAvilAbhavan
shlokas.42:
te droNaputramAsAdya yathAvRRittaM nyavedayan |
vyavahAraM gadAyuddhe pArthivasya cha ghAtanam
shlokas.43:
tadAkhyAya tataH sarve droNaputrasya bhArata |
dhyAtvA cha suchiraM kAlaM jagmurArtA yathAgatam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vAtikAnAM sakAshAttu shrutvA duryodhanaM hatam |
hatashiShTAstato rAjankauravANAM mahArathAH
shlokas.2:
vinirbhinnAH shitairbANairgadAtomarashaktibhiH |
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH
tvaritA javanairashvairAyodhanamupAgaman
shlokas.3:
tatrApashyanmahAtmAnaM dhArtarAShTraM nipAtitam |
prabhagnaM vAyuvegena mahAshAlaM yathA vane
shlokas.4:
bhUmau viveShTamAnaM taM rudhireNa samukShitam |
mahAgajamivAraNye vyAdhena vinipAtitam
shlokas.5:
vivartamAnaM bahusho rudhiraughapariplutam |
yadRRichChayA nipatitaM chakramAdityagocharam
shlokas.6:
mahAvAtasamutthena sa.nshuShkamiva sAgaram |
pUrNachandramiva vyomni tuShArAvRRitamaNDalam
shlokas.7:
reNudhvastaM dIrghabhujaM mAta~Ngasamavikramam |
vRRitaM bhUtagaNairghoraiH kravyAdaishcha samantataH
yathA dhanaM lipsamAnairbhRRityairnRRipatisattamam
shlokas.8:
bhrukuTIkRRitavaktrAntaM krodhAdudvRRittachakShuSham |
sAmarShaM taM naravyAghraM vyAghraM nipatitaM yathA
shlokas.9:
te tu dRRiShTvA maheShvAsA bhUtale patitaM nRRipam |
mohamabhyAgamansarve kRRipaprabhRRitayo rathAH
shlokas.10:
avatIrya rathebhyastu prAdravanrAjasaMnidhau |
duryodhanaM cha samprekShya sarve bhUmAvupAvishan
shlokas.11:
tato drauNirmahArAja bAShpapUrNekShaNaH shvasan |
uvAcha bharatashreShThaM sarvalokeshvareshvaram
shlokas.12:
na nUnaM vidyate.asahyaM mAnuShye ki~nchideva hi |
yatra tvaM puruShavyAghra sheShe pA.nsuShu rUShitaH
shlokas.13:
bhUtvA hi nRRipatiH pUrvaM samAj~nApya cha medinIm |
kathameko.adya rAjendra tiShThase nirjane vane
shlokas.14:
duHshAsanaM na pashyAmi nApi karNaM mahAratham |
nApi tAnsuhRRidaH sarvAnkimidaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.15:
duHkhaM nUnaM kRRitAntasya gatiM j~nAtuM katha~nchana |
lokAnAM cha bhavAnyatra shete pA.nsuShu rUShitaH
shlokas.16:
eSha mUrdhAvasiktAnAmagre gatvA parantapaH |
satRRiNaM grasate pA.nsuM pashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.17:
kva te tadamalaM ChatraM vyajanaM kva cha pArthiva |
sA cha te mahatI senA kva gatA pArthivottama
shlokas.18:
durvij~neyA gatirnUnaM kAryANAM kAraNAntare |
yadvai lokagururbhUtvA bhavAnetAM dashAM gataH
shlokas.19:
adhruvA sarvamartyeShu dhruvaM shrIrupalakShyate |
bhavato vyasanaM dRRiShTvA shakravispardhino bhRRisham
shlokas.20:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA duHkhitasya visheShataH |
uvAcha rAjanputraste prAptakAlamidaM vachaH
shlokas.21:
vimRRijya netre pANibhyAM shokajaM bAShpamutsRRijan |
kRRipAdInsa tadA vIrAnsarvAneva narAdhipaH
shlokas.22:
IdRRisho martyadharmo.ayaM dhAtrA nirdiShTa uchyate |
vinAshaH sarvabhUtAnAM kAlaparyAyakAritaH
shlokas.23:
so.ayaM mAM samanuprAptaH pratyakShaM bhavatAM hi yaH |
pRRithivIM pAlayitvAhametAM niShThAmupAgataH
shlokas.24:
diShTyA nAhaM parAvRRitto yuddhe kasyA~nchidApadi |
diShTyAhaM nihataH pApaishChalenaiva visheShataH
shlokas.25:
utsAhashcha kRRito nityaM mayA diShTyA yuyutsatA |
diShTyA chAsmi hato yuddhe nihataj~nAtibAndhavaH
shlokas.26:
diShTyA cha vo.ahaM pashyAmi muktAnasmAjjanakShayAt |
svastiyuktA.nshcha kalyA.nshcha tanme priyamanuttamam
shlokas.27:
mA bhavanto.anutapyantAM sauhRRidAnnidhanena me |
yadi vedAH pramANaM vo jitA lokA mayAkShayAH
shlokas.28:
manyamAnaH prabhAvaM cha kRRiShNasyAmitatejasaH |
tena na chyAvitashchAhaM kShatradharmAtsvanuShThitAt
shlokas.29:
sa mayA samanuprApto nAsmi shochyaH katha~nchana |
kRRitaM bhavadbhiH sadRRishamanurUpamivAtmanaH
yatitaM vijaye nityaM daivaM tu duratikramam
shlokas.30:
etAvaduktvA vachanaM bAShpavyAkulalochanaH |
tUShNIM babhUva rAjendra rujAsau vihvalo bhRRisham
shlokas.31:
tathA tu dRRiShTvA rAjAnaM bAShpashokasamanvitam |
drauNiH krodhena jajvAla yathA vahnirjagatkShaye
shlokas.32:
sa tu krodhasamAviShTaH pANau pANiM nipIDya cha |
bAShpavihvalayA vAchA rAjAnamidamabravIt
shlokas.33:
pitA me nihataH kShudraiH sunRRisha.nsena karmaNA |
na tathA tena tapyAmi yathA rAja.nstvayAdya vai
shlokas.34:
shRRiNu chedaM vacho mahyaM satyena vadataH prabho |
iShTApUrtena dAnena dharmeNa sukRRitena cha
shlokas.35:
adyAhaM sarvapA~nchAlAnvAsudevasya pashyataH |
sarvopAyairhi neShyAmi pretarAjaniveshanam
anuj~nAM tu mahArAja bhavAnme dAtumarhati
shlokas.36:
iti shrutvA tu vachanaM droNaputrasya kauravaH |
manasaH prItijananaM kRRipaM vachanamabravIt
AchArya shIghraM kalashaM jalapUrNaM samAnaya
shlokas.37:
sa tadvachanamAj~nAya rAj~no brAhmaNasattamaH |
kalashaM pUrNamAdAya rAj~no.antikamupAgamat
shlokas.38:
tamabravInmahArAja putrastava vishAM pate |
mamAj~nayA dvijashreShTha droNaputro.abhiShichyatAm
senApatyena bhadraM te mama chedichChasi priyam
shlokas.39:
rAj~no niyogAdyoddhavyaM brAhmaNena visheShataH |
vartatA kShatradharmeNa hyevaM dharmavido viduH
shlokas.40:
rAj~nastu vachanaM shrutvA kRRipaH shAradvatastataH |
drauNiM rAj~no niyogena senApatye.abhyaShechayat
shlokas.41:
so.abhiShikto mahArAja pariShvajya nRRipottamam |
prayayau siMhanAdena dishaH sarvA vinAdayan
shlokas.42:
duryodhano.api rAjendra shoNitaughapariplutaH |
tAM nishAM pratipede.atha sarvabhUtabhayAvahAm
shlokas.43:
apakramya tu te tUrNaM tasmAdAyodhanAnnRRipa |
shokasa.nvignamanasashchintAdhyAnaparAbhavan
